attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the exploration prospect receiving laboratory services

attributes.name: analytical_suite_specification
attributes.description: Detailed specification of the analytical methods, analyte packages, and quality control protocols contracted for this prospect. May reference specific method codes, detection limits, and reporting requirements tailored to the prospect's commodity targets and exploration stage.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this prospect-laboratory assignment: active (in use), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (contract ended), or terminated (relationship ended early).

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory services contract or agreement expires or is scheduled for renewal for this prospect-laboratory pairing.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory services contract or agreement became effective for this prospect-laboratory pairing.

attributes.name: cost_per_sample_negotiated
attributes.description: Negotiated cost per sample for this prospect-laboratory pairing, which may differ from the laboratory's standard pricing due to volume commitments, contract terms, or analytical suite customization. Used for prospect-level budget forecasting and cost control.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prospect-laboratory assignment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: laboratory_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this laboratory for this prospect: primary (main analytical provider), umpire (dispute resolution), check (QA/QC verification), metallurgical (test work), or specialist (specific analyte or method).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this assignment record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this assignment record.

attributes.name: preferred_laboratory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this laboratory is designated as the preferred or primary provider for this specific prospect. Governs default laboratory selection for routine sample submissions from this prospect.

attributes.name: sample_volume_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum number of samples committed to this laboratory for this prospect under the contract terms, used to secure volume-based pricing discounts.

attributes.name: turnaround_priority
attributes.description: Default turnaround time priority level for samples from this prospect: standard (routine exploration), priority (active drilling program), rush (resource definition), or critical (feasibility study). Governs SLA expectations and cost per sample.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this assignment record.

products.name: prospect_processing_campaign
products.description: This association product represents the processing campaign relationship between exploration prospects and processing plants. It captures the operational history of ore routing, blending campaigns, and processing performance for each prospect-plant combination. Each record links one prospect to one processing plant with attributes that track processing dates, tonnages, recoveries, and routing priorities—data that exists only in the context of this specific prospect being processed through this specific plant.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, a single exploration prospect's ore can be processed through multiple processing plants over its lifecycle due to plant upgrades, capacity constraints, ore blending strategies, or multi-plant site configurations. Conversely, a single processing plant routinely processes ore from multiple prospects simultaneously or sequentially through blending campaigns and feed scheduling. This is a fundamental operational relationship in mine-to-mill optimization where processing performance, tonnages, and routing priorities are tracked per prospect-plant combination.

attributes.name: prospect_processing_campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this prospect-plant processing campaign record. Primary key.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prospect Processing Campaign - Processing Plant Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the processing plant facility performing the processing

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the exploration prospect whose ore is being processed

attributes.name: average_recovery_achieved
attributes.description: Actual average metallurgical recovery rate achieved for ore from this prospect when processed through this plant, expressed as percentage (0-100). Tracks real performance vs nameplate.

attributes.name: blend_percentage_target
attributes.description: Target percentage (0-100) of this prospects ore in the plant feed blend when multiple prospects are being processed simultaneously. Used for blending optimization.

attributes.name: campaign_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes about this specific prospect-plant processing campaign, including performance observations, blending considerations, or metallurgical issues.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this prospect-plant processing campaign. Active = currently processing; completed = campaign finished; suspended = temporarily halted; planned = future campaign.

attributes.name: cumulative_tonnes_processed
attributes.description: Total cumulative tonnage of ore from this prospect that has been processed through this plant, measured in metric tonnes. Updated as processing occurs.

attributes.name: ore_routing_priority
attributes.description: Business priority classification for routing ore from this prospect to this plant. Primary = preferred plant; secondary = backup plant; opportunistic = capacity-dependent; trial = test campaign.

attributes.name: processing_end_date
attributes.description: Date when ore from this prospect ceased being processed through this plant for this campaign. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: processing_start_date
attributes.description: Date when ore from this prospect first entered this processing plant for this campaign or processing period.

products.name: prospect_processing_route
products.description: This association product represents the operational routing relationship between exploration prospects and processing circuits. It captures the metallurgical suitability, processing performance, and circuit assignment decisions for ore from specific prospects. Each record links one prospect to one processing circuit with attributes that track circuit-specific performance metrics, processing volumes, and metallurgical characteristics that exist only in the context of this prospect-circuit pairing.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, ore from a single exploration prospect can be routed to multiple processing circuits based on metallurgical characteristics (e.g., oxide ore to leach circuits, sulphide ore to flotation circuits, different grade zones to different processing routes). Conversely, each processing circuit handles ore from multiple prospects as mine plans evolve and different ore sources are blended or sequenced through the plant. This is an operational routing relationship actively managed by metallurgical and processing teams.

attributes.name: prospect_processing_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this prospect-circuit routing relationship record. Primary key.

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prospect Processing Route - Processing Circuit Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the processing circuit that handles ore from this prospect

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the exploration prospect that is the source of ore being processed

attributes.name: average_feed_grade_pct
attributes.description: Average head grade of ore from this prospect when fed to this circuit, expressed as percentage of primary commodity. Tracks prospect-specific feed characteristics.

attributes.name: average_recovery
attributes.description: Average metallurgical recovery rate achieved for ore from this prospect when processed through this circuit, expressed as a percentage. Tracks circuit-specific performance by ore source.

attributes.name: circuit_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when this prospect ore was first routed to this specific processing circuit. Tracks when the routing relationship was established.

attributes.name: circuit_suitability_rating
attributes.description: Metallurgical assessment of how suitable this circuit is for processing ore from this prospect based on ore characteristics and circuit design. Values: Optimal, Suitable, Marginal, Unsuitable.

attributes.name: last_processed_date
attributes.description: Date when ore from this prospect was most recently processed through this circuit. Tracks recency of the routing relationship.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing metallurgical observations, processing challenges, or operational considerations specific to processing this prospect ore through this circuit.

attributes.name: primary_commodity_target
attributes.description: Primary commodity being targeted for recovery when processing this prospect ore through this circuit (e.g., copper, gold, iron ore). May differ from prospect primary commodity if circuit is optimized for specific recovery.

attributes.name: processing_route
attributes.description: Description of the processing route or flowsheet path that ore from this prospect follows through this circuit (e.g., 'Oxide Leach Route', 'Sulphide Flotation Route', 'Primary Comminution'). Captures the specific metallurgical pathway.

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this prospect-circuit routing relationship. Values: Active (currently processing), Inactive (temporarily suspended), Planned (future routing), Decommissioned (no longer used).

attributes.name: tonnes_processed
attributes.description: Cumulative total tonnes of ore from this prospect that have been processed through this specific circuit. Enables prospect-circuit level throughput tracking.

products.name: deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment assignment between exploration prospects and mining equipment assets. It captures the operational deployment of specific equipment to specific prospect areas for exploration activities including drilling, trenching, sampling, and geophysical surveys. Each record links one asset to one prospect for a defined deployment period with role, utilization tracking, and assignment status for cost allocation and resource planning purposes.. Existence Justification: In mining exploration operations, prospects require multiple types of equipment assets over their lifecycle (drill rigs for resource definition, excavators for trenching programs, sampling equipment, geophysical survey equipment), and equipment assets are deployed sequentially or concurrently across multiple prospects within regional exploration programs. The business actively manages these deployments as operational assignments with specific start/end dates, equipment roles, utilization tracking for cost allocation to prospects, and assignment status for resource planning.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: role

attributes.name: start_date

attributes.name: utilization_hours
attributes.description: Total operational hours the equipment asset was actively utilized on exploration activities for this prospect during the deployment period. Used for cost allocation, productivity analysis, and equipment performance tracking.

products.name: prospect_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between an exploration prospect and a vendor providing exploration services (drilling, assay, geophysics). It captures the service relationship, contract terms, performance metrics, and financial details that exist only in the context of a specific prospect-vendor combination. Each record links one prospect to one vendor with attributes tracking the nature, duration, value, and quality of the service engagement.. Existence Justification: In mining exploration operations, each prospect requires services from multiple specialized vendors (drilling contractors, assay laboratories, geophysics contractors, geological consultants), and each vendor provides services across multiple prospects for the mining company. The business actively manages these engagements as distinct operational relationships, tracking service type, contract value, performance ratings, and engagement dates for each prospect-vendor combination to inform future sourcing decisions and vendor selection.

domains.name: geology
domains.description: Owns the geological model of the orebody including lithological logging, structural mapping, ore body definitions, grade control, block models, and GIS-referenced spatial data. Provides foundational geological intelligence that drives mine planning, cut-off grade decisions, and resource-to-reserve conversion.

products.name: orebody
products.description: Master definition of each discrete orebody or mineralised zone within the mining tenement portfolio. Captures geological characterisation including commodity type, deposit style (porphyry, VMS, BIF, sedimentary), structural controls, mineralisation type, spatial extent, and discovery date. Serves as the foundational anchor entity linking all geological modelling, resource estimation, grade control, and mine planning activities. Each orebody record also owns its child geological domains (statistically homogeneous estimation zones). Sourced from Geovia GEMS and Hexagon MinePlan geological models.

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the orebody or mineralised zone within the mining tenement portfolio. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Orebodies are defined by primary commodity (iron ore, copper, lithium). Links to standardized commodity master for pricing indices, regulatory classification, JORC reporting, and market analysis. Repl

attributes.name: competent_person_id

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Orebodies are fundamental cost tracking units in mining operations. Each orebody accumulates exploration, development, and production costs through its lifecycle. Essential for AISC reporting, reserve

attributes.name: profit_centre_id

attributes.name: site_id

attributes.name: tenement_id

attributes.name: alteration_type

attributes.name: average_grade

attributes.name: average_grade_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the average grade. Aligns with commodity type and industry reporting standards.

attributes.name: centroid_elevation_m

attributes.name: centroid_latitude

attributes.name: centroid_longitude

attributes.name: contained_metal_kt

attributes.name: coordinate_system

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cutoff_grade

attributes.name: cutoff_grade_unit

attributes.name: depletion_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: vertical_extent_m

products.name: geological_unit

attributes.name: commodity_id

attributes.name: alteration_type

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: colour_code_rgb

attributes.name: density_g_cm3

attributes.name: depositional_environment

attributes.name: effective_from_date
