attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.environmental_permit. Business justification: ROM stockpiles may require permits for dust emissions and stormwater runoff management. Links stockpile operations to environmental compliance obligations and monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: ROM stockpiles (pads, infrastructure) are capitalized as fixed assets for depreciation, asset register management, and balance sheet reporting. Asset accounting link for mining infrastructure.

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: ROM stockpiles are segregated by geological domain for metallurgical performance. Required for blending strategies, recovery optimization, and managing domain-specific processing characteristics.

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Life of Mine (LOM) plan under which this ROM stockpile is designed and scheduled. Links stockpile configuration to the governing mine plan for long-term production scheduling and capital planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: ROM stockpiles contain material from specific orebodies. Essential for blending strategies, grade management, metallurgical performance prediction, and traceability from pit to plant.

attributes.name: pit_design_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open-cut pit or underground mining area that primarily feeds this ROM stockpile. Supports production reconciliation and ore source tracking.

attributes.name: primary_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: ROM stockpiles often blend ore from multiple tenements; tracking primary source tenement enables royalty allocation, grade reconciliation by license area, and accurate production reporting for regulat

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: ROM stockpiles accumulate ore from specific prospects. Stockpile management tracks source prospect for blending decisions, metallurgical planning, and grade reconciliation. Critical for managing ore q

attributes.name: bulk_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Estimated bulk density of the ROM stockpile material in tonnes per cubic metre. Used to convert survey-derived volume measurements to tonne estimates for inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ROM stockpile pad was formally commissioned and made available for ore dumping operations. Marks the start of the operational lifecycle for this pad.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: current_inventory_t
attributes.description: Current estimated tonnes of ore on the ROM stockpile pad at the time of the last survey or inventory snapshot. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar truck dispatch data and periodic survey reconciliation.

attributes.name: cut_off_grade_pct
attributes.description: Minimum economic grade threshold applied to classify material as ore (vs waste) for this stockpile. Material below cut-off grade is directed to waste dumps. Determined by LOM economic parameters.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; CIM Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ROM stockpile pad was formally decommissioned and removed from active operations. Null for currently active pads. Supports LOM planning and mine rehabilitation scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; ISO 14001

attributes.name: design_capacity_t
attributes.description: Maximum engineered storage capacity of the ROM stockpile pad in dry metric tonnes (DMT) as per mine design specifications. Used for capacity planning, haulage scheduling, and LOM planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste rock (gangue) mixed with ore in the ROM stockpile due to mining dilution. High dilution reduces head grade and processing plant recovery. Tracked against mine design dilution targets.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: easting_m
attributes.description: Easting coordinate of the ROM stockpile pad centroid in metres, referenced to the mine site local grid or MGA/UTM coordinate system. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the ROM stockpile pad base in metres above sea level (mAHD or equivalent datum). Used for drainage design, geotechnical assessment, and survey volume calculations.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the environmental permit or approval governing the operation of this ROM stockpile pad, including conditions related to dust suppression, drainage, and contamination prevention.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Requirements; IsoMetrix; ICMM Principles

attributes.name: fms_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone code assigned to this ROM stockpile in the Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System (FMS). Used to track haul truck dump assignments, cycle times, and tonne delivery records to this pad.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations Standards

attributes.name: geotechnical_zone
attributes.description: Geotechnical classification zone of the stockpile pad foundation and surrounding area. Informs structural stability assessments, load-bearing capacity, and safe stacking height limits for the ROM pad.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Mine Geotechnical Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: head_grade_cu_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of copper (Cu) content in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage. Applicable for copper operations; null for non-copper commodities. Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: head_grade_fe_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of iron (Fe) content in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage. Derived from assay data and geological block model estimates. Used for processing plant feed quality management.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: head_grade_primary_pct
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of the primary valuable element in the ROM stockpile expressed as a percentage, applicable to the commodity type (e.g., Li2O for lithium, Ni for nickel, ash content for coal). Sourced from LabWare LIMS assay results and geological model.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the current inventory estimate was last updated or surveyed. Critical for understanding the currency of the inventory figure and scheduling reclaim operations.

attributes.name: max_stack_height_m
attributes.description: Maximum permitted stacking height of ore on the ROM stockpile pad in metres, as determined by geotechnical assessment and mine design. Exceeding this limit creates slope stability and safety risks.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Geotechnical Standards; ISO 45001

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site where this ROM stockpile is physically located. Links to the mine site master record for geographic and operational context.

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: Primary mining method used to extract ore delivered to this ROM stockpile. Determines operational characteristics, dilution profiles, and equipment types associated with the material.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: Estimated moisture content of the ROM stockpile material expressed as a percentage. Critical for accurate tonne reconciliation (wet vs dry), processing plant feed management, and transport logistics (weight limits).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 3087 (Coal Moisture)

attributes.name: northing_m
attributes.description: Northing coordinate of the ROM stockpile pad centroid in metres, referenced to the mine site local grid or MGA/UTM coordinate system. Used for GIS mapping and spatial analysis.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; GIS Standards; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information about the ROM stockpile pad not captured in structured fields (e.g., temporary access restrictions, blending instructions, survey anomalies).

attributes.name: ore_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of in-situ ore successfully extracted and delivered to the ROM stockpile relative to the geological resource model estimate. Tracks ore loss during mining operations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: pad_area_m2
attributes.description: Total surface area of the ROM stockpile pad in square metres as per mine design. Used for capacity calculations, survey volume estimation, and infrastructure planning.

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_t
attributes.description: Difference between scheduled tonnes and actual surveyed inventory tonnes for the current period. Positive value indicates over-delivery; negative indicates under-delivery. Key metric for production schedule adherence and ore loss/dilution tracking.

attributes.name: scada_tag_code
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System tag identifier associated with this ROM stockpile for real-time process data monitoring (e.g., belt scale feed rate, moisture sensor readings). Enables integration between the master record and time-series operational data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_tonnes_t
attributes.description: Planned tonnes to be delivered to this ROM stockpile in the current production scheduling period as per the mine production schedule. Used for reconciliation variance calculation against actual inventory.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: stockpile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the ROM stockpile pad, used across operational systems including Caterpillar MineStar, OSIsoft PI, and mine planning tools. Unique within the mine site.

attributes.name: stockpile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the ROM stockpile pad (e.g., 'North ROM Pad 1', 'Crusher Feed Stockpile A'). Used in operational reporting and mine planning communications.

attributes.name: stockpile_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the ROM stockpile pad. Active = receiving material; Reclaiming = material being drawn down to processing plant; Full = at design capacity; Depleted = empty; On Hold = temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: stockpile_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the stockpile's operational role within the ore flow: ROM Pad (direct dump from haul trucks), Crusher Feed, Blend Stockpile, Low-Grade, High-Grade, or Waste. Drives processing plant feed sequencing.

attributes.name: surveyed_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of material on the ROM stockpile pad as measured by the most recent survey (drone, LiDAR, or conventional survey). Combined with bulk density to derive tonne inventory estimate.

products.name: haulage_cycle
products.description: Transactional record of an individual haul truck cycle from loading point to dump point, capturing truck ID, operator ID, loader/excavator ID, load origin (bench, stockpile), dump destination (crusher, stockpile, waste dump), payload tonnes, cycle time breakdown (spot, load, haul full, queue, dump, haul empty), distance travelled, fuel consumption, and road segment. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS GPS telemetry. Enables truck-shovel match analysis, OEE calculation, and haulage route optimization.

attributes.name: haulage_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual haul truck cycle record in the Silver layer. Primary key generated by the Databricks lakehouse ingestion pipeline from Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System (FMS) telemetry data.

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mining bench or level from which the material was extracted for this cycle. Aligns with the mine design bench nomenclature in Hexagon MinePlan. Used for grade control, production scheduling, and geological reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Individual haulage cycles contribute to cost centre actuals for fleet cost tracking, fuel cost allocation, and productivity analysis. Operational cost allocation for mining haulage.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine worker who operated the haul truck during this cycle. Links to the workforce/personnel master record. Used for operator performance analysis and fatigue management compliance.

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Haulage cycles track geological domain of source material for blending control. Required for real-time stockpile management, ensuring plant feed meets metallurgical specifications.

attributes.name: grade_control_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.grade_control_block. Business justification: Haulage cycles load material classified by grade control blocks. N:1 relationship (many cycles from one grade control block). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: haul_route_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.haul_route. Business justification: haulage_cycle represents movement along defined haul routes. Adding haul_route_id FK provides access to route characteristics (gradient, surface type, speed limits). The haul_route table contains rout

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mining_block. Business justification: Haulage cycles load from mining blocks. N:1 relationship (many cycles from one block). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Haulage cycles transport material from specific orebodies to destinations. Required for ore tracking, stockpile blending decisions, and linking equipment productivity to geological sources.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: Haulage cycles originate from pits or underground levels. This FK provides source location context for material movement tracking. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: primary_haulage_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the haul truck asset that performed this cycle. Links to the equipment/fleet master record in the Fleet Management System (FMS) and Infor EAM asset registry.

attributes.name: primary_haulage_load_location_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spatial location (bench, pit, stope, or ROM pad) from which the truck was loaded. Links to the mine location/spatial master for origin-based production and grade tracking.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Haulage cycles are executed against a production schedule. N:1 relationship (many cycles per schedule). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Haulage cycles can dump to ROM stockpiles. N:1 relationship (many cycles to one stockpile). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: safety_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.safety_observation. Business justification: Haulage cycles are high-risk activities frequently observed for speed, fatigue, and interaction compliance. Links specific cycles to safety observations for behavior-based safety program tracking.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.shift_report. Business justification: Haulage cycles occur during a shift and roll up to shift report. N:1 relationship (many cycles per shift). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine shift during which this haulage cycle occurred. Links to the shift schedule master for shift-based production reporting and crew allocation analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Haulage cycles consume fuel tracked in material master for cost accounting. Business need: fuel consumption tracking, haulage cost calculation, fuel inventory management, procurement planning. Real pr

attributes.name: tertiary_haulage_functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary haul road segment traversed during this cycle. Used for road condition monitoring, fuel consumption benchmarking by route, and haulage route optimisation.

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.waste_dump. Business justification: Haulage cycles can dump waste to waste dumps. N:1 relationship (many cycles to one dump). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: cycle_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the haul truck completed the empty return haul and the cycle was closed. Used to calculate total cycle time and production throughput per shift.

attributes.name: cycle_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the haulage cycle as assigned by Caterpillar MineStar FMS. Used for cross-system traceability and operational reporting. Format: CYC-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX.

attributes.name: cycle_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The real-world timestamp when the haul truck arrived at the loading point and the cycle commenced (spot time begins). Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar GPS telemetry. Principal business event timestamp for the cycle.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the haulage cycle record. 'completed' indicates a full cycle was recorded; 'aborted' indicates the cycle was interrupted; 'partial' indicates incomplete telemetry data; 'under_review' indicates data quality investigation is in progress.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cycle record was sourced. Primarily 'minestar' (Caterpillar MineStar FMS GPS telemetry), but may be 'manual' for dispatcher-entered corrections, 'scada' for SCADA-integrated sites, or 'pi_system' for OSIsoft PI System integrations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: Estimated proportion (0.0 to 1.0) of waste or gangue material mixed with ore in this truck load, as assessed by the grade control model. Dilution (waste mixed with ore during mining) directly impacts mill feed grade and recovery rate. Key metric for mine planning reconciliation.

attributes.name: dump_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when the truck arrived at the dump point to when it departed after discharging its load. Includes tipping and body lowering time. Used in cycle time analysis and dump point throughput modelling.

attributes.name: dump_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the dump destination for this cycle. Values: crusher (primary crusher feed), rom_pad (Run of Mine stockpile pad), stockpile (grade-segregated stockpile), waste_dump (permanent waste rock dump), tsf (Tailings Storage Facility). Drives material flow reconciliation.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_litres
attributes.description: Total diesel fuel consumed in litres during this haulage cycle as recorded by the truck's on-board fuel monitoring system integrated with Caterpillar MineStar. Used for C1 (C1 Cash Cost) per tonne calculation, OPEX tracking, and GHG emissions reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ISO 14001

attributes.name: haul_empty_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the empty (return) haul from the dump destination back to the loading point. Compared against haul full time to assess road grade asymmetry and return route efficiency.

attributes.name: haul_full_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds for the loaded (full) haul from the loading point to the dump destination. Reflects haul road conditions, grade, distance, and truck speed. Key input for haulage route optimisation and fuel modelling.

attributes.name: is_overloaded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the truck payload exceeded the nominal rated payload capacity for this cycle (True = overloaded). Overloading causes accelerated tyre and suspension wear, increases maintenance costs, and may breach equipment warranty conditions. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar TPMS.

attributes.name: is_rehandle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle involved rehandling of previously stockpiled material (True = rehandle). Rehandle cycles are tracked separately from primary extraction cycles for accurate OPEX (Operating Expenditure) per tonne reporting and production efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: load_pass_count
attributes.description: Number of bucket/dipper passes made by the loading unit (excavator or shovel) to fill the haul truck to its payload target. Used in truck-shovel match factor analysis and loader bucket fill factor assessment.

attributes.name: load_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when loading commenced to when the truck departed the loading point with a full load. Reflects loader productivity and number of passes required. Used in truck-shovel match factor analysis.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the material hauled during this cycle. Distinguishes ore (economic mineral-bearing rock) from waste (gangue and overburden) for strip ratio calculation, grade control, and production reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ore|waste|low_grade_ore|overburden|topsoil|tailings — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: nominal_payload_tonnes
attributes.description: The rated/design payload capacity of the haul truck model in metric tonnes as specified by the manufacturer. Used as the denominator for payload utilisation percentage calculation and overload detection.

attributes.name: ore_grade_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated head grade of the material in the truck load as assigned by the grade control model at the time of loading (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Nullable for waste loads. Used for production grade reconciliation against JORC resource model.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: payload_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual measured payload weight of the truck load in metric tonnes, as recorded by the on-board payload monitoring system (TPMS) integrated with Caterpillar MineStar. Primary quantitative measure of material moved per cycle. Used for production reconciliation and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this haulage cycle occurred, derived from the cycle start timestamp. Used as the primary date dimension key for daily production reporting, shift reconciliation, and LOM (Life of Mine) plan vs actual tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: queue_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds the truck spent waiting in queue at the dump point before being able to discharge its load. Indicates crusher or dump point congestion. Used for bottleneck analysis and production scheduling optimisation.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this haulage cycle record was first ingested and created in the Databricks Silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of the FMS telemetry pipeline.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this haulage cycle record was last modified in the Databricks Silver layer, including dispatcher corrections, payload adjustments, or data quality remediation. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: spot_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration in seconds from when the truck arrived at the loading point to when loading commenced. Measures truck positioning efficiency. A key component of the cycle time breakdown used in truck-shovel match factor analysis.

attributes.name: total_cycle_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds for the complete haulage cycle from spot to end of empty return haul. Sum of spot, load, haul full, queue, dump, and haul empty times. Primary KPI input for truck productivity and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) reporting.

products.name: grade_control_block
products.description: Grade control block record representing a short-range ore classification unit used to direct ore and waste to appropriate destinations. Captures block ID, location, ore type, cut-off grade classification (ore/waste/low-grade), assay results, confidence level, and dispatch instruction. Sourced from LabWare LIMS and Geovia GEMS. The operational SSOT for ore/waste discrimination at the face.

attributes.name: grade_control_block_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the grade control block record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS Block Model Standards

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: grade_control_block has bench_name (STRING) and bench_elevation_m (DECIMAL) but no FK to bench table. Adding bench_id FK normalizes bench reference and removes redundant name and elevation columns. Th

attributes.name: block_model_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.block_model_cell. Business justification: Grade control blocks are derived from block model cells for operational execution. Essential for linking short-term mine plans to long-term resource models and tracking model accuracy.

attributes.name: geological_domain_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.geological_domain. Business justification: Grade control blocks are classified by geological domain for estimation consistency. Critical for applying correct grade estimation parameters and ensuring operational classification matches resource

attributes.name: lims_sample_batch_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Sample Batch ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the assay sample batch in LabWare LIMS from which the grade data for this block was sourced. Provides traceability from the grade control block back to the laboratory analysis records.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this grade control block to the corresponding mining block or polygon in the mine planning system (Hexagon MinePlan or Deswik). Enables reconciliation between grade control and mine plan.

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Grade control blocks are spatial subdivisions of orebodies for operational ore/waste classification. Critical for dispatch decisions, dilution tracking, and production reconciliation against orebody m

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: grade_control_block has pit_name (STRING) but no FK to pit_or_level table. Adding pit_or_level_id FK normalizes pit/level reference and removes redundant name column. The pit_or_level table contains n

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Grade control blocks are classified and dispatched according to production schedule. N:1 relationship (many blocks per schedule). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Grade control blocks are sampled within prospect boundaries. Grade control programs reference exploration prospect geology for classification, dispatch decisions, and ore/waste designation. Essential

attributes.name: resource_model_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geological resource block model version from which this grade control block's initial grade estimates were derived. Enables traceability back to the JORC-compliant resource model in Geovia GEMS.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Resource Model; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Grade control blocks are dispatched to specific product destinations (lump, fines, different grade products). Critical operational decision linking mine execution to product specifications. Ore_type_c

attributes.name: standard_job_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the drill-and-blast pattern associated with this grade control block. Links the block to the blast design from which grade control samples were collected. Used for blast-to-mill reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Blast Design; Drill and Blast SOP

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Grade control blocks must be attributed to tenements for accurate reserve depletion reporting, royalty calculations on mined ore grades, and compliance with mining lease resource extraction conditions

attributes.name: block_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the grade control block as assigned in Geovia GEMS or the mine's block model system. Used for cross-system traceability and field reference.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model; JORC Code 2012 Section 1

attributes.name: block_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the grade control block, typically combining bench, row, and column identifiers for operational reference at the mine face.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan Grade Control Module

attributes.name: block_size_x_m
attributes.description: Horizontal dimension of the grade control block in the X (easting) direction, in metres. Defines the block geometry used for volume and tonnage calculations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model Specification; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: block_size_y_m
attributes.description: Horizontal dimension of the grade control block in the Y (northing) direction, in metres. Defines the block geometry used for volume and tonnage calculations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model Specification; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: block_size_z_m
attributes.description: Vertical dimension (height) of the grade control block in metres, typically equal to the bench height. Used for volume and tonnage calculations.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Block Model Specification; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: block_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grade control block indicating its operational state. 'active' = classified and awaiting dispatch; 'dispatched' = ore/waste destination assigned; 'mined_out' = block fully extracted; 'on_hold' = pending re-assay or review; 'cancelled' = block voided.

attributes.name: block_volume_m3
attributes.description: Calculated volume of the grade control block in cubic metres, derived from block dimensions. Used as the basis for in-situ tonnage estimation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; JORC Code 2012 Resource Estimation

attributes.name: bulk_density_tm3
attributes.description: Bulk density of the material in the grade control block expressed in tonnes per cubic metre (t/m³). Used to convert block volume to in-situ tonnes. Sourced from laboratory measurements or geological domain defaults.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Table 1 Item 14; LabWare LIMS Density Measurements

attributes.name: centroid_easting_m
attributes.description: Easting coordinate of the block centroid in the mine's local or projected coordinate system (metres). Used for spatial location, blast pattern design, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: GIS Standards; Geovia GEMS Spatial Reference; Mine Survey SOP

attributes.name: centroid_northing_m
attributes.description: Northing coordinate of the block centroid in the mine's local or projected coordinate system (metres). Used for spatial location, blast pattern design, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: GIS Standards; Geovia GEMS Spatial Reference; Mine Survey SOP

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Grade control classification of the block based on cut-off grade analysis. Determines whether the block is directed to the mill, ROM pad, low-grade stockpile, or waste dump. This is the primary ore/waste discrimination decision for the block.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 2; CIM Definition Standards 2014; Cut-off Grade Methodology

attributes.name: classification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ore/waste classification decision was made for this grade control block, based on assay results and cut-off grade analysis. Represents the principal business event date for this entity.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Grade Control Procedure

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Confidence level assigned to the grade estimate for this block, reflecting the density and quality of sampling data. 'high' = well-drilled with close-spaced samples; 'medium' = adequate sampling; 'low' = sparse data, interpolated grade. Influences dispatch decision risk.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 2 (Measured/Indicated/Inferred analogue for grade control); CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grade control block record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Data Governance Audit Trail Standards; IFRS 6

attributes.name: cut_off_grade
attributes.description: The minimum economic grade threshold applied to classify this block as ore or waste. Blocks with primary_grade at or above this value are classified as ore. Derived from the current LOM (Life of Mine) economic parameters and commodity price assumptions.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 2; CIM Definition Standards; Mine Economics SOP

attributes.name: dilution_factor_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of waste or gangue material mixed with ore during mining of this block, expressed as a percentage. Dilution reduces the effective grade of mined material relative to in-situ grade. Used for reconciliation and production planning.
attributes.references: Mine Planning SOP; JORC Code 2012 Table 1 Item 16; Dilution Control Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispatch instruction was issued and material from this grade control block was directed to its assigned destination. Used for production scheduling reconciliation and haulage tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Production Reporting SOP

attributes.name: dispatch_destination
attributes.description: Assigned destination for the material in this grade control block based on its classification. Drives truck dispatch instructions in the Fleet Management System (FMS). 'mill_feed' = direct to processing plant; 'rom_pad' = Run of Mine stockpile; 'low_grade_stockpile' = future processing; 'waste_dump' = permanent waste; 'tsf' = Tailings Storage Facility.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS Dispatch; Mine Operations SOP; ROM Pad Management Procedure

attributes.name: dispatch_instruction_code
attributes.description: Specific dispatch instruction code issued to the Fleet Management System (FMS) for truck routing of material from this block. Corresponds to a destination code in Caterpillar MineStar for automated truck assignment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Dispatch SOP

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Statistical or geostatistical method used to estimate the grade of this block from drill hole or blast hole assay data. Common methods include Ordinary Kriging, Inverse Distance Weighting, and Nearest Neighbour.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Estimation Module; JORC Code 2012 Table 1 Item 22; CIM Geostatistics Guidelines

attributes.name: insitu_tonnes
attributes.description: Estimated in-situ dry metric tonnes of material within the grade control block, calculated from block volume and bulk density. Represents the raw tonnage before mining dilution or recovery adjustments.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012 Section 2; CIM Definition Standards; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: is_resampled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grade control block has been subject to a re-assay or resampling event due to initial classification uncertainty or grade variability. True = block was resampled; False = original assay used. Supports audit trail for classification decisions.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Grade Control QA/QC SOP; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: mined_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the grade control block was fully extracted and the block status transitioned to 'mined_out'. Used for production reconciliation, LOM tracking, and mine closure planning.
attributes.references: Mine Production Reporting SOP; LOM Planning Standards

attributes.name: mineral_domain_code
attributes.description: Geological domain or mineralisation zone code to which this block belongs, as defined in the resource model. Used for grade estimation and variogram modelling within homogeneous geological units.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Domain Model; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: primary_grade
attributes.description: Assay-derived grade of the primary commodity (e.g., Fe%, Cu%, Li ppm) for the grade control block. The principal quantitative fact driving ore/waste classification and dispatch decisions. Units depend on commodity (% for Fe/Cu, ppm for Li/Au).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Assay Results; JORC Code 2012 Table 1; ISO 11536 (Iron Ore Analysis)

attributes.name: primary_grade_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Commodity Grade Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the primary commodity grade value (e.g., 'pct' for percentage, 'ppm' for parts per million, 'g_per_t' for grams per tonne). Ensures correct interpretation of the primary_grade field across different commodities.

attributes.name: recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the primary commodity that will be recovered during mineral processing of this block's material. Used for contained metal calculations and production forecasting.
attributes.references: Metallurgical Recovery Model; JORC Code 2012 Table 1 Item 17; Mine Planning SOP

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Number of drill hole or blast hole assay samples used in the grade estimation for this block. Higher sample counts generally indicate greater confidence in the grade estimate.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Code 2012 Table 1 Item 20

attributes.name: secondary_grade
attributes.description: Assay-derived grade of a secondary or by-product commodity (e.g., SiO2%, Al2O3%, S%) for the grade control block. Used for penalty/bonus calculations, blending decisions, and metallurgical planning.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Assay Results; JORC Code 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: secondary_grade_element
attributes.description: Chemical element or compound symbol for the secondary grade value (e.g., 'SiO2', 'Al2O3', 'S', 'P'). Identifies which element the secondary_grade field represents for this block.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this grade control block record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Data Governance Audit Trail Standards; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: shift_report
products.description: Shift-level production performance record and the consolidated SSOT for all mine production actuals. Captures actual ore tonnes mined, waste tonnes moved, metres advanced (drill and development), blasts fired, equipment operating hours and utilisation rates versus scheduled targets, crew supervisor, significant events (breakdowns, safety incidents, weather delays), and handover notes. Includes daily rollup capability for management reporting. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS, OSIsoft PI, and crew reporting systems. Feeds production reconciliation, KPI dashboards, regulatory production returns, and management reporting.

attributes.name: shift_report_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the shift report record. Primary key for the shift_report data product in the mine domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Shift-level costs are allocated to cost centres for daily cost tracking, reconciliation against budget, and operational cost reporting. Standard shift-to-finance integration for mining operations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift supervisor or leading hand responsible for the crew during this shift. Used for accountability, handover management, and workforce reporting. Maps to the workforce master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Caterpillar MineStar FMS; ISO 45001

attributes.name: grievance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to community.grievance. Business justification: Shift reports document community complaints received during operations (noise, dust, traffic, safety concerns). Supervisors log grievances in shift handovers for follow-up. Real business process: oper

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Shift reports document incidents that occurred during the shift for handover and management reporting. Standard mining operational practice to reference incidents in shift documentation.

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.lom_plan. Business justification: Shift reports track progress against LOM plan. N:1 relationship (many shifts in one LOM plan). No bidirectional conflict. Valid planning link.

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.opex_budget. Business justification: Shift actuals are reconciled against opex budgets for daily cost control, forecast accuracy, and operational budget tracking. Real-time budget variance monitoring for mining operations.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.pit_or_level

attributes.name: primary_commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Shift reports track which commodity was primarily mined during the shift. Required for daily production reporting, reconciliation against plan, and operational performance tracking. New attribute need

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine production schedule record that defines the targets for this shift. Links actuals to the scheduled plan for variance analysis and LOM planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Shift reports document production from specific prospects. Daily reporting attributes tonnes and grade to source prospect for production accounting, resource depletion tracking, and operational perfor

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.shift_schedule. Business justification: Shift reports capture actual production outcomes for a scheduled workforce shift. Linking to shift_schedule enables variance analysis between planned workforce deployment and actual production deliver

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Daily shift reports track production by tenement for expenditure commitment substantiation, quarterly regulatory reporting, and operational performance analysis by license area. Required for annual co

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Shift reports track consumables usage from site warehouses (explosives, fuel, ground support). Business need: shift-level consumables reconciliation, warehouse demand forecasting, inventory replenishm

attributes.name: blasts_fired_count
attributes.description: Number of blast events executed during the shift. Used for drill-and-blast productivity tracking, explosive consumption reconciliation, and regulatory blast notification compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; MSHA; ISO 45001

attributes.name: breakdown_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to unplanned equipment breakdowns and mechanical failures. Used for Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) analysis and maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift report record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: crew_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of personnel (operators, technicians, supervisors) who worked during the shift. Used for workforce productivity analysis, labour cost allocation, and safety compliance (persons on site).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Caterpillar MineStar FMS; ISO 45001; MSHA

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste material mixed with ore during mining operations for the shift, expressed as a decimal. Dilution control is a critical operational metric impacting ore quality and processing recovery rates.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP; JORC 2012

attributes.name: equipment_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total aggregate operating hours across all production equipment (trucks, excavators, drills) during the shift. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS engine hours. Used for OEE calculation and maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: equipment_scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total aggregate scheduled operating hours for all production equipment during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used as the denominator for equipment utilisation rate calculation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: equipment_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Actual equipment utilisation rate for the shift expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.8500 = 85%). Calculated as equipment operating hours divided by equipment scheduled hours. Key input to Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; OEE Industry Standard

attributes.name: handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text handover communication from the outgoing shift supervisor to the incoming shift supervisor. Captures outstanding tasks, equipment status, safety hazards, and operational priorities for continuity of operations.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; ISO 45001; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: is_daily_rollup_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift report has been included in the daily production rollup for management reporting. True when the shift data has been aggregated into the daily summary; False when pending rollup.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift report record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: lost_time_injury_count
attributes.description: Number of Lost Time Injuries (LTIs) recorded during the shift — injuries resulting in at least one full shift of lost work time. Key input to Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; MSHA; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: metres_developed
attributes.description: Total metres of underground development advance (drives, declines, crosscuts) completed during the shift. Applicable to underground mining operations. Used for development schedule tracking.
attributes.references: Deswik; Hexagon MinePlan; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: metres_drilled
attributes.description: Total metres of drilling completed during the shift across all drill rigs, including blast hole drilling and development drilling. Used for drill-and-blast performance tracking and production scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: metres_drilled_target
attributes.description: Scheduled target metres of drilling for the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for drill performance variance analysis.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: mining_method
attributes.description: The primary mining extraction method employed during this shift. Distinguishes open-cut from underground methods and specific underground techniques such as Sub-Level Caving (SLC), longwall, or cut-and-fill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open_cut|underground_sublevel_caving|underground_longwall|underground_room_and_pillar|underground_cut_and_fill|underground_block_caving|surface_strip — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: ore_grade_fe_pct
attributes.description: Average head grade of iron (Fe) content in ore mined during the shift, expressed as a decimal percentage. Sourced from assay results and grade control data. Used for production reconciliation and mineral resource reporting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS; JORC 2012; SEC S-K 1300; CIM Standards

attributes.name: ore_mined_target_tonnes
attributes.description: Scheduled target ore tonnes to be mined during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for variance analysis and production reconciliation against actuals.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: ore_mined_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual tonnes of ore material mined and dispatched to the Run of Mine (ROM) pad or stockpile during the shift. Core production KPI. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar FMS truck payload data and OSIsoft PI belt weigher integration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC 2012; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to scheduled preventive maintenance activities. Distinguishes planned downtime from unplanned breakdowns for OEE and availability reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Infor EAM; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Total number of safety incidents (including near misses, first aid, medical treatment, and lost time injuries) recorded during the shift. Used for LTIFR and TRIFR calculation and regulatory HSE reporting.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; MSHA; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date to which this shift report is attributed for daily rollup and management reporting purposes. Aligns with the mine site operational day boundary (which may differ from midnight). Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the shift concluded at the mine site. Used in conjunction with shift_start_timestamp to calculate shift duration and for production period boundary alignment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: shift_report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shift report, typically formatted as SR-YYYY-MM-DD-SHF-NNN (e.g., SR-2024-07-15-DAY-001). Used for cross-system reference, regulatory production returns, and management reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the shift commenced at the mine site. Principal business event timestamp for the shift. Used for production reconciliation, KPI dashboards, and regulatory production returns. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC 2012

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift report record. Draft indicates data entry in progress; submitted indicates supervisor sign-off; approved indicates management review complete; closed indicates period locked; voided indicates record cancelled.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period within the 24-hour operational cycle. Typical values: day (e.g., 06:00–18:00), night (e.g., 18:00–06:00), afternoon, or extended for non-standard shift patterns.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: significant_events_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing significant events during the shift including major breakdowns, safety incidents, geotechnical events, blast misfires, environmental exceedances, or other notable occurrences. Critical for shift handover and management reporting.
attributes.references: Mine Operations SOP; IsoMetrix; ISO 45001; ISO 14001

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this shift report data was sourced. Values: MINESTAR (Caterpillar MineStar FMS), OSI_PI (OSIsoft PI System), CREW_REPORT (crew reporting system), MANUAL (manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: strip_ratio_actual
attributes.description: Actual strip ratio for the shift, calculated as waste tonnes moved divided by ore tonnes mined (overburden to ore ratio). A key economic indicator for open-cut mining operations used in OPEX and LOM planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP; JORC 2012

attributes.name: waste_moved_target_tonnes
attributes.description: Scheduled target waste tonnes to be moved during the shift as per the mine production schedule. Used for strip ratio variance analysis and LOM planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: waste_moved_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual tonnes of waste rock (overburden and interburden) moved to waste dumps during the shift. Used to calculate the strip ratio and track overburden removal progress against the Life of Mine (LOM) plan.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System; Mine Operations SOP

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the mine site during the shift. Used to contextualise production performance, explain delays, and support environmental and safety compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|storm|fog|dust_storm|snow|extreme_heat|hail — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: weather_delay_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of production lost during the shift due to adverse weather conditions (e.g., lightning stand-down, heavy rain, dust storm). Used for delay analysis and production variance reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Mine Operations SOP; ISO 14001

products.name: waste_dump
products.description: Master record of waste rock dump facilities including dump name, location coordinates, design capacity (tonnes/BCM), current fill volume, geotechnical classification, liner type, leachate management status, and rehabilitation plan reference. Sourced from mine planning systems and IsoMetrix. The SSOT for waste dump inventory and geotechnical compliance.

attributes.name: waste_dump_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the waste rock dump facility record. Primary key for the waste_dump master data product.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Waste dumps are managed under cost centres for waste handling cost tracking, rehabilitation provision calculation, and environmental cost management. Core environmental accounting link.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.environmental_monitoring. Business justification: Waste dumps monitored for groundwater quality, geotechnical stability, and acid rock drainage. Regulatory requirement to link dump facility to monitoring program for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.environmental_permit. Business justification: Waste dumps require specific environmental permits for construction and operation covering geotechnical stability, water management, and rehabilitation. Regulatory requirement in all mining jurisdicti

attributes.name: hse_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.audit. Business justification: Waste dumps subject to periodic environmental and geotechnical audits per regulatory requirements. Links dump facility to audit findings for compliance tracking and corrective action management.

attributes.name: land_compensation_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to community.land_compensation_agreement. Business justification: Waste dump footprints often occupy compensated land parcels. Agreement terms govern placement, access, rehabilitation obligations, and ongoing payments. Real business process: land use compliance, com

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.lom_plan. Business justification: Waste dumps are planned as part of LOM plan. N:1 relationship (many dumps in one LOM plan). No bidirectional conflict. Valid planning link.

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: pit_design_id
attributes.description: Reference to the open-cut pit or underground mining area that primarily generates the waste material deposited in this dump. Supports strip ratio and waste tracking by source area.

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rehabilitation_provision. Business justification: Waste dumps trigger rehabilitation provisions for closure cost estimation, balance sheet liability management, and environmental accounting. Core environmental accounting link for mining closure oblig

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Waste dumps must be located within authorized tenement boundaries or have specific surface rights agreements. Critical for environmental compliance, Programme of Work approvals, and land use authoriza

attributes.name: acid_rock_drainage_risk
attributes.description: Classification of the waste dump's potential to generate Acid Rock Drainage (ARD) based on net acid generation (NAG) testing and acid-base accounting (ABA) of the waste material. Drives encapsulation design, water management, and long-term monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; INAP ARD Guidelines; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which waste emplacement operations formally ceased and the dump was closed to further filling. Null if the dump is still active. Used for LOM planning and rehabilitation scheduling.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date on which the waste dump facility was formally commissioned and first received waste material. Marks the start of the operational lifecycle for compliance and LOM tracking purposes.
attributes.references: Mine Planning Records; Hexagon MinePlan; ISO 14001

attributes.name: current_fill_tonnes
attributes.description: Cumulative mass of waste material currently emplaced in the dump expressed in dry metric tonnes. Derived from FMS truck payload data and survey reconciliation. Used for mass-balance and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: current_fill_volume_bcm
attributes.description: Cumulative volume of waste material currently emplaced in the dump expressed in Bank Cubic Metres (BCM). Updated from survey data and FMS haulage records. Used to calculate remaining capacity and track fill progression against LOM schedule.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; Hexagon MinePlan Survey Module

attributes.name: design_capacity_bcm
attributes.description: Total approved design capacity of the waste dump expressed in Bank Cubic Metres (BCM). Represents the maximum volume of in-situ material the facility is permitted and engineered to receive. Sourced from mine planning systems (Hexagon MinePlan, Deswik).
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; JORC Code 2012; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: design_capacity_tonnes
attributes.description: Total approved design capacity of the waste dump expressed in dry metric tonnes. Complements BCM capacity for mass-balance reconciliation and LOM planning. Sourced from mine planning systems.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; LOM Planning Standards

attributes.name: dump_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the waste dump facility, used in mine planning systems (Hexagon MinePlan, Deswik) and regulatory submissions. Unique across the mine site.

attributes.name: dump_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the waste dump facility (e.g., 'North Waste Dump 1', 'Southern Overburden Emplacement'). Used in operational communications, mine plans, and regulatory reports.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Tailings and Waste Management Guidelines

attributes.name: dump_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the waste dump facility. Active indicates ongoing waste emplacement; closed indicates emplacement has ceased; rehabilitating indicates progressive or final rehabilitation is underway per the mine closure plan.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; IsoMetrix HSE Module

attributes.name: dump_type
attributes.description: Classification of the waste dump by material type deposited. Overburden refers to material above the ore body; waste rock is non-economic mineralised material; low-grade stockpile holds sub-cut-off-grade ore for potential future processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: overburden|waste_rock|low_grade_stockpile|mixed|tailings_co_disposal — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Waste Management Guidelines

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation of the waste dump crest above mean sea level in metres. Critical for geotechnical stability assessment, drainage design, and regulatory height limit compliance.
attributes.references: Geotechnical Engineering Standards; ISO 14001; Mine Design Standards

attributes.name: geotechnical_classification
attributes.description: Geotechnical risk classification of the waste dump based on foundation conditions, material properties, and consequence of failure. Class 1 (lowest risk) to Class 4 (highest risk). Drives inspection frequency, monitoring requirements, and regulatory reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: class_1|class_2|class_3|class_4 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ANCOLD Guidelines; Geotechnical Engineering Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: groundwater_monitoring_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether ongoing groundwater quality monitoring is required for this waste dump as a condition of the environmental permit or based on ARD risk classification. True triggers monitoring schedule in IsoMetrix.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions; IsoMetrix Environmental Module

attributes.name: isometrix_facility_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this waste dump facility as recorded in IsoMetrix HSE and Environmental Monitoring module. Used for data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent topographic survey conducted on the waste dump to update volume and surface area measurements. Survey data is used to reconcile FMS haulage records with actual fill volumes.
attributes.references: Mine Survey Standards; Hexagon MinePlan Survey Module

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the waste dump centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GIS mapping, environmental monitoring zone delineation, and regulatory spatial reporting.
attributes.references: GIS Standard WGS84; ISO 14001; EIS Spatial Reporting

attributes.name: leachate_management_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the leachate collection and management system for the waste dump. Indicates whether leachate is being actively collected, passively monitored, or not required based on liner type and regulatory conditions.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions; IsoMetrix Environmental Module

attributes.name: liner_type
attributes.description: Type of engineered liner system installed at the base of the waste dump to control leachate migration and protect groundwater. None indicates an unlined facility; HDPE geomembrane is a high-density polyethylene synthetic liner. Sourced from mine design records and IsoMetrix.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions; IsoMetrix Environmental Module

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the waste dump centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GIS mapping, environmental monitoring zone delineation, and regulatory spatial reporting.
attributes.references: GIS Standard WGS84; ISO 14001; EIS Spatial Reporting

attributes.name: max_height_m
attributes.description: Maximum permitted or current height of the waste dump from base to crest in metres. A key geotechnical design parameter governing slope stability and regulatory permit conditions.
attributes.references: Geotechnical Engineering Standards; Mine Permit Conditions; ICMM

attributes.name: mine_plan_dump_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this waste dump as recorded in the mine planning system (Hexagon MinePlan or Deswik). Used for data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and LOM schedule integration.

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled geotechnical or environmental inspection of the waste dump as required by the geotechnical classification, permit conditions, or IsoMetrix inspection schedule.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ISO 45001; IsoMetrix HSE Module; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, geotechnical observations, or special conditions applicable to this waste dump that are not captured in structured fields. Used by mine planning and environmental teams.

attributes.name: overall_slope_angle_deg
attributes.description: Designed overall slope angle of the waste dump in degrees from horizontal. A critical geotechnical stability parameter reviewed against factor-of-safety thresholds in the geotechnical design report.
attributes.references: Geotechnical Engineering Standards; ICMM Slope Stability Guidelines

attributes.name: permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the environmental permit or licence for this waste dump expires and must be renewed. Triggers compliance workflow in IsoMetrix for permit renewal actions.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions; IsoMetrix Environmental Module

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory permit or licence number issued by the relevant environmental authority authorising the construction and operation of this waste dump. Required for compliance tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions; IsoMetrix Environmental Module

attributes.name: progressive_rehab_area_ha
attributes.description: Cumulative area of the waste dump that has been progressively rehabilitated to date, expressed in hectares. Used to track rehabilitation progress against permit commitments and LOM closure plan milestones.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: progressive_rehab_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether progressive rehabilitation (rehabilitation of completed dump benches during the operational phase) is required as a permit condition or company commitment. True drives progressive rehab scheduling in the LOM plan.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste dump master record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001 Record Keeping

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this waste dump master record was most recently updated in the data platform. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; ISO 14001 Record Keeping

attributes.name: rehabilitation_bond_amount
attributes.description: Financial assurance (bond) amount in the site's functional currency held by the relevant regulatory authority to cover the estimated cost of rehabilitating this waste dump to an approved post-mining land use standard. Commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; IFRS 6; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: rehabilitation_bond_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rehabilitation bond amount (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Required for multi-jurisdiction financial reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 6; ICMM Mine Closure Framework

attributes.name: rehabilitation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the approved mine rehabilitation and closure plan applicable to this waste dump. Links to the formal closure plan document registered in the document management system. Required for regulatory compliance and bond calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; EIS; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the qualified geotechnical engineer responsible for the design, monitoring, and sign-off of this waste dump facility. Required for regulatory accountability and competent person declarations.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ISO 45001; Mine Permit Conditions

attributes.name: surface_area_ha
attributes.description: Total surface footprint of the waste dump facility in hectares, including all active and inactive benches. Used for rehabilitation cost estimation, environmental bond calculation, and land tenure management.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS; Mine Rehabilitation Bond Calculation Standards

attributes.name: waste_rock_classification
attributes.description: Geochemical classification of the predominant waste rock material deposited in the dump based on laboratory acid-base accounting. Non-Acid Forming (NAF), Potentially Acid Forming (PAF), or Acid Forming (AF). Determines encapsulation and placement strategy.
attributes.references: INAP ARD Guidelines; LabWare LIMS; ISO 14001; EIS

products.name: survey_measurement
products.description: Mine survey measurement record capturing periodic topographic and volumetric surveys of pits, dumps, stockpiles, and underground workings. Includes survey date, method (drone, LiDAR, total station), surveyed volume/tonnes, comparison to previous survey, and variance to design. Sourced from survey systems and Hexagon MinePlan. Enables production reconciliation and geotechnical monitoring.

attributes.name: survey_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each mine survey measurement record. Primary key for the survey_measurement data product.

attributes.name: bench_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.bench. Business justification: survey_measurement has bench_level (STRING) but no FK to bench table. Adding bench_id FK normalizes bench reference and removes redundant bench_level string column. The bench table contains bench_code

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine area, pit, bench, or underground zone where the survey was conducted. Links to the mine area master data product for spatial context.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan — Mine Area; Geovia GEMS — Mine Design

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific geographic location or spatial feature (stockpile, dump, TSF cell, stope) being surveyed, as defined in the mine's GIS (Geographic Information System) location master.

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.mining_block. Business justification: Surveys can measure individual mining blocks. N:1 relationship (many surveys of one block). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: pit_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_design. Business justification: Surveys measure actual pit progress against design. N:1 relationship (many surveys comparing to one design). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: pit_or_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.pit_or_level. Business justification: Survey measurements are conducted on pits or underground levels. Adding pit_or_level_id FK provides location context for survey records. No redundant columns to remove.

attributes.name: previous_survey_survey_measurement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding survey measurement record for the same location, enabling period-over-period volumetric change calculation and production reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan — Survey History; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: primary_survey_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed mine surveyor or survey crew responsible for conducting the field survey. Links to the workforce/personnel master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Personnel Master; MSHA — Surveyor Certification

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Surveys measure ROM stockpile volumes. N:1 relationship (many surveys of one stockpile over time). No bidirectional conflict. Valid operational link.

attributes.name: stope_design_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.stope_design. Business justification: For underground surveys, linking to stope_design provides access to design parameters for comparison with surveyed actuals. This is essential for underground survey reconciliation. No redundant column

attributes.name: survey_equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Mine surveys (stockpile volumes, pit progression, waste dump monitoring) are performed using specific survey equipment (total stations, drones, GPS rovers). Tracking which asset performed each survey

attributes.name: tenement_id
