domains.name: processing
domains.description: Covers all mineral processing and beneficiation activities from comminution (SAG, HPGR) through separation (DMS, flotation, leaching, SX-EW) to concentrate production. Tracks recovery rates, slurry parameters, reagent consumption, throughput, and product grade against LOM plan targets.

products.name: plant
products.description: Master register of all mineral processing plant facilities. Captures plant identity, site location, design capacity (tph), commissioned date, primary processing method (comminution, flotation, leaching, SX-EW, DMS, gravity, magnetic), ore type compatibility (iron ore, copper, gold, lithium, nickel, coal, diamonds), operational status (active, care-and-maintenance, decommissioned), number of processing lines, and nameplate recovery rate. SSOT for all processing facility master data. Parent entity for circuits, feed streams, and all operational records.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the mineral processing plant facility. Primary key for the processing_plant master register. SSOT for all processing facility master data.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding asset record in the enterprise asset management system (Infor EAM / SAP S/4HANA PM) for this processing plant facility. Enables linkage to maintenance work orders, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and asset lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM; IFRS 6

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Processing plants are delivered through capital projects. Tracks project that constructed/expanded the plant for handover, warranty, defects liability, performance guarantees, and capital cost allocat

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Processing plants are designed and optimized for specific commodities (iron ore, copper, coal). Essential for production planning, capacity allocation, JORC resource reporting, and LOM planning. Domai

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Every processing plant operates under a cost centre for opex tracking, AISC reporting, and variance analysis. processing_plant.opex_cost_centre (plain attr) is denormalized cost_centre_code; replace w

attributes.name: environmental_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.environmental_permit. Business justification: Processing plants operate under environmental permits governing air emissions, water discharge, and tailings management. Regulatory compliance tracking requires direct linkage between plant operations

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.functional_location. Business justification: Processing plants are physical assets in the functional location hierarchy. Maintenance planning, work order routing, and asset management require linking plants to their functional location for CMMS

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Plants send routine process control samples (shift composites, circuit optimization samples) to designated laboratories for analysis. Tracks primary lab relationship for turnaround management and meta

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing Life of Mine (LOM) plan under which this plant's design capacity, recovery targets, and throughput schedules are defined. Aligns plant master data with the mine planning SSOT.

attributes.name: primary_stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to community.stakeholder. Business justification: Processing plants engage with primary affected communities and indigenous groups. Required for stakeholder engagement registers, social licence reporting, community consultation tracking, and regulato

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where this processing plant is physically situated. Links the plant to its geographic and operational context.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Processing plants operate under granted mining licences on specific tenements. Required for regulatory compliance reporting, expenditure commitment tracking, and operational boundary verification. Eve

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Plant capital expenditure is tracked via WBS elements for project accounting and asset capitalization. processing_plant.capex_wbs_element (plain attr) is denormalized WBS code; replace with FK for cap

attributes.name: aisc_benchmark_usd_per_t
attributes.business_glossary_term: All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) Benchmark (USD per Tonne)
attributes.description: The budgeted or benchmark All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) for processing at this plant expressed in USD per dry metric tonne of ore processed. Used as the financial performance baseline for C1 cash cost reporting and LOM plan economics.
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; World Gold Council AISC Standard; IFRS

attributes.name: annual_capacity_mt
attributes.description: Nameplate annual throughput capacity expressed in million dry metric tonnes per annum (Mtpa). Derived from design_capacity_tph and planned operating hours but stored as a master data attribute for LOM plan alignment and regulatory resource reporting.

attributes.name: care_maintenance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the plant was placed into care-and-maintenance status. Null if the plant has never been placed on care-and-maintenance. Used for OPEX tracking, insurance, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: comminution_technology
attributes.description: Primary size-reduction (comminution) technology installed in the plant. SAG (Semi-Autogenous Grinding), HPGR (High Pressure Grinding Rolls), ball mill, rod mill, crusher, AG (Autogenous Grinding), or combined circuit. Drives energy consumption benchmarking and maintenance planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAG|HPGR|ball_mill|rod_mill|crusher|AG|combined — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the processing plant was formally commissioned and accepted into commercial production. Used for asset depreciation calculations (IFRS 16), LOM plan baseline, and regulatory reporting of production commencement.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Infor EAM

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the processing plant is located (e.g., 'AUS', 'CHL', 'ZAF', 'CAN'). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, MSHA) and environmental reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which the plant was permanently decommissioned and removed from the active asset register. Null if the plant is still operational or on care-and-maintenance. Triggers mine rehabilitation and closure obligations.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; IFRS 6; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: design_capacity_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate design throughput capacity of the plant expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph) of Run of Mine (ROM) feed. Represents the engineering-rated maximum throughput under optimal conditions. Used as the denominator for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ICMM Technical Guidelines; Infor EAM

attributes.name: elevation_masl
attributes.description: Elevation of the processing plant site in metres above sea level (mASL). Relevant for water balance modelling, slurry pipeline hydraulics design, and environmental impact assessments.

attributes.name: feed_grade_design_pct
attributes.description: Design ROM feed head grade (percentage of valuable mineral in the feed ore) for which the plant was engineered. Used as the baseline for metallurgical balance calculations, cut-off grade assessments, and LOM plan modelling.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the processing plant centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS (Geographic Information System) mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental impact zone delineation.

attributes.name: lims_plant_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Plant Code
attributes.description: The plant identifier used in the LabWare LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) for sample registration, assay result linkage, and metallurgical accounting. Enables traceability from plant feed to product assay.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the processing plant centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental impact zone delineation.

attributes.name: nameplate_recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Design-rated metallurgical recovery rate expressed as a percentage (0–100). Represents the percentage of the target valuable mineral in the feed that is expected to report to the concentrate or product stream under nameplate conditions. Key input to LOM plan financial modelling and JORC/NI 43-101 resource estimation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; CIM Standards

attributes.name: number_of_processing_lines
attributes.description: Total count of parallel processing lines (circuits) within the plant. Each line represents an independent processing train capable of treating ore from feed to product. Drives capacity planning, maintenance scheduling, and redundancy analysis.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the processing plant. 'active' = fully operational; 'care-and-maintenance' = temporarily idle but preserved; 'decommissioned' = permanently closed; 'commissioning' = in start-up phase; 'suspended' = temporarily halted due to regulatory or operational reasons.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; ISO 14001; Infor EAM

attributes.name: ore_type_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ore/commodity types this plant is designed and certified to process (e.g., 'iron ore, copper, gold, lithium, nickel, coal, diamonds'). Drives feed stream routing and LOM plan alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron ore|copper|gold|lithium|nickel|coal|diamonds|zinc|lead|manganese — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the processing plant, used across ERP, SCADA, and FMS systems (e.g., 'PP-PILBARA-01', 'PROC-CU-02'). Unique across the enterprise and referenced in operational reporting.

attributes.name: plant_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the processing plant including key design features, processing circuit configuration, historical context, and any notable operational characteristics. Supports regulatory submissions, investor reports, and technical documentation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SEC S-K 1300; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: plant_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the mineral processing plant facility (e.g., 'Pilbara Iron Ore Processing Plant 1', 'Olympic Dam Copper Concentrator'). Used in reports, dashboards, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the processing plant by metallurgical process family. 'concentrator' = physical separation to produce mineral concentrate; 'hydrometallurgical' = chemical leaching/SX-EW; 'pyrometallurgical' = smelting/roasting; 'beneficiation' = upgrading without full extraction; 'refinery' = final product refining; 'pelletising' = iron ore pellet production.

attributes.name: power_consumption_design_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate design electrical power consumption in kilowatts (kW) at full throughput. Used for energy cost modelling (OPEX), carbon footprint reporting (GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement), and grid capacity planning.
attributes.references: GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ISO 14001; ICMM

attributes.name: primary_processing_method
attributes.description: The principal mineral processing and beneficiation method employed by this plant. Comminution includes SAG/HPGR milling; flotation covers froth flotation separation; leaching includes heap and tank leaching; SX-EW (Solvent Extraction Electrowinning) for copper cathode production; DMS (Dense Media Separation) for coal/diamonds; gravity and magnetic separation for iron ore. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comminution|flotation|leaching|SX-EW|DMS|gravity|magnetic — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The primary saleable product form produced by this plant (e.g., 'concentrate' for copper/gold flotation plants, 'cathode' for SX-EW copper plants, 'pellet' for iron ore pelletising, 'fines'/'lump' for iron ore beneficiation, 'doré' for gold/silver). Drives sales contract and logistics configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concentrate|cathode|pellet|fines|lump|slurry|doré — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this processing plant master record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping obligations.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this processing plant master record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: sap_functional_location
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM) functional location code assigned to this processing plant. Enables linkage to maintenance work orders, preventive maintenance plans, and CAPEX/OPEX cost centre reporting in SAP.

attributes.name: scada_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system instance or node that monitors and controls this processing plant. Used to link real-time process historian data (OSIsoft PI System) to the plant master record.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or territory in which the processing plant is located (e.g., 'Western Australia', 'British Columbia', 'Antofagasta'). Used for jurisdictional regulatory compliance, environmental permitting, and geographic reporting.

attributes.name: tailings_generation_design_tph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Tailings Generation Rate (Tonnes Per Hour)
attributes.description: Nameplate design rate of tailings (gangue and process residue) generated by the plant in dry metric tonnes per hour. Drives TSF (Tailings Storage Facility) capacity planning, environmental licence conditions, and ICMM tailings governance compliance.
attributes.references: ICMM Tailings Governance Standard; ISO 14001; EIS

attributes.name: target_product_grade_pct
attributes.description: Design target grade of the primary valuable mineral in the final product expressed as a percentage (e.g., 28.5% Cu in copper concentrate, 62% Fe in iron ore lump). Used as the benchmark for metallurgical performance assessment and sales contract compliance.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: water_consumption_design_m3ph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Water Consumption (Cubic Metres Per Hour)
attributes.description: Nameplate design water consumption rate in cubic metres per hour (m³/h) for the plant under full throughput conditions. Critical for water balance management, environmental licence compliance, and EIS (Environmental Impact Statement) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Regulatory Requirements; ICMM Water Stewardship

products.name: circuit
products.description: Defines individual processing circuits within a plant (e.g., primary comminution, secondary grinding, rougher flotation, cleaner flotation, leach circuit, SX-EW circuit). Captures circuit type, feed material, design throughput, target recovery rate, and sequence order within the processing flowsheet. Enables circuit-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a processing circuit record within the mineral processing plant. Primary key for the processing_circuit data product.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Circuits are engineered for specific commodities with tailored flowsheets and reagent schemes. Critical for metallurgical accounting, recovery optimization, and circuit performance reporting. Replaces

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.functional_location. Business justification: Circuits are maintainable functional locations within plant hierarchy. Maintenance strategies, PM schedules, and work orders are assigned to circuit-level functional locations for granular maintenance

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Life of Mine (LOM) plan under which this circuit's design parameters and recovery targets were established. Enables traceability of circuit design basis to the governing mine plan.
attributes.references: JORC Code; CIM Standards; NI 43-101; Deswik

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral processing plant in which this circuit operates. Links circuit-level data to plant-level operational context.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Processing circuits (flotation, leaching, SXEW, DMS) have distinct hazard profiles requiring dedicated risk assessments. Flotation uses chemical reagents, leaching uses cyanide/acid, SXEW involves hig

attributes.name: circuit_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the processing circuit within the plant flowsheet (e.g., PC-SAG-01, FL-RGH-02). Used in P&ID documentation, SCADA tags, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; P&ID Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: circuit_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the processing circuit including its role in the plant flowsheet, key equipment, and any notable design features or operational constraints. Supports engineering documentation and onboarding.

attributes.name: circuit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the processing circuit (e.g., Primary SAG Mill Circuit, Rougher Flotation Circuit, Leach Circuit 1). Used in operational dashboards and reporting.

attributes.name: circuit_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the processing circuit. Drives scheduling, maintenance planning, and production reporting inclusion/exclusion.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 14001

attributes.name: circuit_type
attributes.description: Category of mineral processing technology employed in this circuit. Drives applicable KPIs, reagent profiles, and recovery benchmarks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: comminution|flotation|leaching|gravity_separation|dense_media_separation|sx_ew|thickening|filtration|classification — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM Guidance; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the processing circuit was formally commissioned and accepted into operational service. Used for asset age calculations, warranty tracking, and depreciation under IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Infor EAM; IFRS 16

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the processing circuit was or is planned to be permanently decommissioned. Nullable for active circuits. Used for mine closure planning, asset write-off scheduling, and rehabilitation cost provisioning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS 6; ISO 14001; Mine Closure Plans

attributes.name: design_availability_pct
attributes.description: Design basis mechanical availability of the circuit expressed as a percentage of scheduled operating hours. Used as the denominator in OEE calculations and production planning. Derived from MTBF and MTTR estimates at design stage.
attributes.references: ICMM Guidance; Infor EAM; OEE Standards

attributes.name: design_feed_size_p80_mm
attributes.description: Design basis P80 particle size of the feed material entering this circuit in millimetres. P80 represents the 80th percentile passing size. Critical for comminution circuit design and mill sizing.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: design_ph_target
attributes.description: Design basis target pH value for the circuit process stream. Applicable to flotation (pH control for selectivity), leaching (acid/alkaline conditions), and SX-EW circuits. Drives lime/acid reagent consumption.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: design_product_size_p80_mm
attributes.description: Design basis P80 particle size of the product leaving this circuit in millimetres. Defines the target grind size for comminution circuits and classification efficiency for downstream separation circuits.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: design_residence_time_min
attributes.description: Design basis residence time of material within the circuit expressed in minutes. Determines tank/vessel sizing and is a key parameter for leach kinetics, flotation recovery, and thickener design.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: design_slurry_density_pct
attributes.description: Design basis slurry density expressed as percentage solids by weight for circuits handling slurry streams. Critical for pump sizing, pipe design, and process control setpoints.
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: design_throughput_mtpa
attributes.description: Annualised nameplate design throughput capacity expressed in million dry metric tonnes per annum (Mtpa). Used for LOM plan alignment, capital project justification, and annual production reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code; SEC S-K 1300; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: design_throughput_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate design throughput capacity of the circuit expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph). Represents the engineering design basis used for LOM plan benchmarking and OEE calculations.

attributes.name: design_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Design basis utilisation rate of the circuit expressed as a percentage of available hours actually used for production. Combined with availability to derive OEE. Accounts for planned feed interruptions and scheduled downtime.
attributes.references: ICMM Guidance; OEE Standards; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: design_water_consumption_m3pt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Water Consumption (Cubic Metres Per Tonne)
attributes.description: Design basis fresh water consumption rate for this circuit expressed in cubic metres per dry metric tonne of feed processed. Used for water balance modelling, environmental licence compliance, and OPEX planning.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Water Stewardship Protocol; GRI 303

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current circuit configuration, design parameters, and targets are effective. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) management and historical performance benchmarking against the correct design basis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; IFRS; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which the current circuit configuration and design parameters are effective. Null for the current active version. Enables historical tracking of circuit design changes and target revisions over the LOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; IFRS; LOM Plan Standards

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the environmental operating permit or licence governing this circuit's operations (e.g., water use licence, air emission permit). Required for regulatory compliance reporting under ISO 14001 and EIS obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EIS Requirements; GRI Mining and Metals Supplement; IsoMetrix

attributes.name: feed_material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary feed material entering this circuit (e.g., ROM Ore for primary comminution, slurry for flotation). Determines applicable feed quality parameters and circuit design basis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rom_ore|crushed_ore|ground_ore|concentrate|slurry|leach_solution|tailings|recycled_stream — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: flowsheet_sequence_order
attributes.description: Integer position of this circuit within the overall plant processing flowsheet. Defines the order of material flow from feed preparation through to final product, enabling flowsheet visualisation and mass balance calculations.

attributes.name: installed_power_kw
attributes.description: Total installed electrical power capacity of the circuit in kilowatts (kW). Used for energy consumption benchmarking, OPEX modelling, and specific energy intensity calculations (kWh/t).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; ISO 50001

attributes.name: is_primary_circuit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this circuit is the primary (first-pass) processing circuit in the plant flowsheet as opposed to a secondary, scavenger, or retreatment circuit. Used for production reporting hierarchy and mass balance prioritisation.
attributes.references: ICMM Guidance; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: number_of_units
attributes.description: Count of parallel processing units (e.g., mills, flotation cells, leach tanks) operating within this circuit. Used for availability calculations, maintenance scheduling, and throughput modelling.

attributes.name: pi_af_element_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSIsoft PI Asset Framework (PI AF) Element Path
attributes.description: Full Asset Framework (AF) element path in the OSIsoft PI System for this processing circuit (e.g., \\Server\Plant\MillCircuit\SAG01). Enables direct linkage between the data product and real-time process historian data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; PI AF Standards

attributes.name: reagent_scheme_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard reagent addition scheme applied in this circuit (e.g., collector, frother, pH modifier for flotation; acid type for leaching). Links to reagent consumption planning and OPEX budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this processing circuit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this processing circuit record was last modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the process engineer accountable for the design, optimisation, and performance of this circuit. Used for accountability tracking and escalation routing.

attributes.name: scada_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Root tag prefix used in the SCADA/DCS system (OSIsoft PI) to identify all process data points associated with this circuit (e.g., PLANT1.SAG01). Enables automated data ingestion from the PI historian into the lakehouse.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: subtype
attributes.description: Specific processing sub-type within the circuit type category (e.g., SAG Mill under comminution, Rougher under flotation, CIL under leaching). Enables granular performance benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sag_mill|ball_mill|hpgr|rod_mill|rougher|scavenger|cleaner|recleaner|heap_leach|vat_leach|cil|cip|dms|jig|spiral|electrowinning|solvent_extraction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SME Mineral Processing Handbook; ICMM Guidance

attributes.name: target_feed_grade_pct
attributes.description: LOM plan target head grade of the feed material entering this circuit expressed as a percentage of the primary commodity. Used for cut-off grade optimisation and circuit performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: target_product_grade_pct
attributes.description: LOM plan target grade of the circuit output product expressed as a percentage of the primary commodity (e.g., concentrate grade for flotation, cathode purity for SX-EW). Used for sales contract compliance and resource reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code; CIM Standards; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: target_recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: LOM plan target metallurgical recovery rate for the primary commodity expressed as a percentage (e.g., 87.500 for 87.5%). Represents the expected proportion of valuable mineral extracted relative to feed grade. Basis for reserve reporting under JORC/CIM.
attributes.references: JORC Code; CIM Standards; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: upstream_circuit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on circuit (upstream_circuit_id)

products.name: feed_stream
products.description: Defines ore feed streams entering the processing plant including ROM feed, crushed feed, and recirculating loads. Captures stream identity, source (ROM pad, crusher, stockpile), nominal feed rate (tph), particle size distribution (P80), moisture content, and ore type classification. Supports mass balance and throughput tracking.

attributes.name: feed_stream_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ore feed stream record entering the processing plant. Primary key for the feed_stream data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the primary conveyor or feeder equipment delivering material to this feed stream. Links to the equipment asset register for maintenance scheduling and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Caterpillar MineStar; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the specific processing circuit (e.g., SAG/Ball Mill circuit, DMS circuit, flotation circuit) that this feed stream feeds into. Enables circuit-level mass balance and throughput analysis.

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Feed streams carry specific commodities from mine to plant. Fundamental for grade control, blending decisions, and feed scheduling. Replaces denormalized commodity text field with proper FK for refere

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the LOM (Life of Mine) plan version that defines the target feed parameters for this stream. Enables variance analysis between planned and actual feed characteristics for production reconciliation.

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Feed streams originate from specific orebodies. Mine-to-mill optimization and metallurgical reconciliation require tracking which orebody supplies each feed stream to correlate geological characterist

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the mineral processing plant or facility that this feed stream supplies. Supports multi-plant operations and mass balance reporting at plant level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Feed streams must reference production schedules to track which mine production periods feed which processing campaigns. Essential for ore type scheduling, blend optimization, and integrated mine-mill

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Feed streams originate from specific prospects/orebodies. Critical for mine-to-mill optimization, ore tracking, metallurgical reconciliation, and LOM planning. Real business need: tracking ore source

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the specific physical source location (ROM pad, stockpile, crusher station) from which this feed stream originates. Links to the plant location or stockpile master.

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Feed streams originate from ore extracted from specific tenements. Essential for royalty calculations, grade reconciliation against tenement reserves, and compliance with tenement-specific production

attributes.name: abrasion_index
attributes.description: Bond Abrasion Index (Ai) of the ore in the feed stream, a dimensionless measure of ore abrasiveness. Drives liner and media wear rate predictions for SAG mills, ball mills, and HPGR (High Pressure Grinding Rolls), informing maintenance scheduling and OPEX forecasting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; Infor EAM; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: bond_work_index_kwh_t
attributes.description: Bond Ball Mill Work Index (BWi) of the ore expressed in kilowatt-hours per tonne (kWh/t). Measures ore hardness and grindability; used to predict mill power requirements, throughput, and energy consumption in comminution circuit design and optimisation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; SME Mineral Processing Handbook

attributes.name: bulk_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Bulk density of the ore material in the feed stream expressed in tonnes per cubic metre (t/m³). Used to convert volumetric flow measurements to mass flow for mass balance calculations and stockpile volume reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which this feed stream was formally commissioned and accepted into operational service. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, warranty management, and CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) project closure reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA PS; ISO 14001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this feed stream record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and record provenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS 6; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: cut_off_grade_pct
attributes.description: The minimum economic grade threshold (cut-off grade) applied to material entering this feed stream. Material below cut-off grade is classified as waste and diverted to the waste dump. Defined per LOM plan and commodity economics.

attributes.name: design_capacity_tph
attributes.description: Maximum rated throughput capacity of the feed stream infrastructure (conveyor, feeder, chute) in dry metric tonnes per hour. Used for bottleneck analysis and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.

attributes.name: dilution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste material mixed with ore in the feed stream due to mining dilution. Dilution reduces the effective head grade and is tracked for reconciliation between geological resource model grades and actual plant feed grades.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this feed stream definition and its associated parameters (nominal rate, target grade, processing route) became operationally effective. Supports temporal versioning of feed stream configurations aligned to LOM plan revisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this feed stream definition ceases to be operationally effective. Null indicates the stream is currently active with no planned end date. Supports LOM plan stage transitions and plant reconfiguration tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the ore or slurry in the feed stream measured in degrees Celsius. Relevant for leaching circuits (SX-EW), autoclave operations, and cold-climate operations where freezing affects conveyor and crusher performance.

attributes.name: gangue_content_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of waste rock (gangue) minerals in the feed stream material. High gangue content increases dilution, reduces effective head grade, and impacts reagent consumption in flotation and leaching circuits.

attributes.name: head_grade_pct
attributes.description: The assay-determined grade of the primary valuable mineral in the feed stream expressed as a percentage (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Head grade is the key input for recovery rate calculations and production reconciliation against the LOM plan.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; LabWare LIMS; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the ore in the feed stream expressed as a percentage of total wet mass. Moisture affects conveyor performance, crusher throughput, mill power draw, and dry tonne calculations for mass balance and invoicing.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ISO 3087 (Coal Moisture)

attributes.name: nominal_feed_rate_tph
attributes.description: The design or nameplate feed rate for this stream expressed in dry metric tonnes per hour (tph). Represents the target throughput capacity used in LOM (Life of Mine) plan scheduling and plant design. Distinct from actual measured feed rate.

attributes.name: ore_type
attributes.description: Geological ore type classification of the material in this feed stream (e.g., oxide, sulphide, transitional, fresh, weathered). Ore type drives processing route selection, reagent dosing, and expected recovery rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oxide|sulphide|transitional|fresh|weathered|mixed|high_grade|low_grade — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: p50_particle_size_mm
attributes.description: The 50th percentile (median) passing particle size of the feed stream material in millimetres. Complements P80 to characterise the full particle size distribution (PSD) shape, supporting comminution circuit modelling and screen efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: p80_particle_size_mm
attributes.description: The 80th percentile passing particle size of the feed stream material expressed in millimetres (mm). P80 is the industry-standard metric for characterising particle size distribution (PSD) in comminution circuits. Critical input for SAG mill and HPGR (High Pressure Grinding Rolls) performance modelling.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS

attributes.name: pi_tag_feed_rate
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System historian tag name for the real-time feed rate measurement instrument (belt scale or flow meter) associated with this feed stream. Enables direct linkage between the data product and the SCADA/PI process historian for real-time and historical data retrieval.

attributes.name: pi_tag_particle_size
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSIsoft PI Tag - Particle Size Analyser
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI System historian tag name for the online particle size analyser (PSA) instrument monitoring P80 for this feed stream. Supports real-time comminution circuit control and automated variance alerting.

attributes.name: processing_route
attributes.description: The designated mineral processing route for material in this feed stream (e.g., SAG/Ball Mill comminution, DMS (Dense Media Separation), flotation, leaching, SX-EW (Solvent Extraction Electrowinning)). Determines downstream circuit routing and reagent requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sag_ball_mill|hpgr|dms|flotation|leaching|sx_ew|gravity|magnetic_separation|cil|cip — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: slurry_density_t_m3
attributes.description: Density of the ore-water slurry mixture in the feed stream expressed in tonnes per cubic metre. Applicable to wet processing circuits (SAG mill discharge, flotation feed). Monitored via OSIsoft PI System for real-time process control.

attributes.name: slurry_solids_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of solids by mass in the slurry feed stream (percent solids). A key process control parameter for wet grinding and flotation circuits; directly affects mill power draw, pump performance, and flotation cell residence time.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical origin point from which ore material enters this feed stream. ROM (Run of Mine) pad indicates direct truck tip; stockpile indicates reclaimed material; crusher indicates post-comminution feed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rom_pad|primary_crusher|secondary_crusher|tertiary_crusher|stockpile|reclaim_conveyor|direct_tip|sag_discharge — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: stream_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the feed stream within the processing plant configuration (e.g., FS-ROM-001, FS-CRU-002). Used in mass balance reconciliation and plant P&ID references.

attributes.name: stream_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the feed stream (e.g., 'Primary ROM Feed', 'SAG Mill Discharge', 'Crusher Product Recirculating Load'). Used in operational dashboards and reporting.

attributes.name: stream_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feed stream definition within the processing plant. Active streams are currently receiving material; suspended streams are temporarily offline; decommissioned streams are permanently retired from the circuit.

attributes.name: stream_type
attributes.description: Classification of the feed stream by its position and role in the comminution circuit. ROM (Run of Mine) feed is direct from the ROM pad; crushed feed is post-primary crusher; recirculating load is material returned for regrinding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rom_feed|crushed_feed|recirculating_load|classifier_overflow|classifier_underflow|screen_oversize|sag_discharge|ball_mill_discharge — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_feed_rate_tph
attributes.description: The planned or scheduled feed rate for this stream in dry metric tonnes per hour as defined in the current production schedule or LOM plan. Distinct from nominal (design) feed rate; used for shift-level production planning and variance reporting.
attributes.references: Deswik; Hexagon MinePlan; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: target_head_grade_pct
attributes.description: The planned head grade of the primary valuable mineral for this feed stream as per the current production schedule or LOM plan. Used for production reconciliation and variance analysis against actual assayed head grade.

attributes.name: target_p80_mm
attributes.description: The planned P80 particle size target for this feed stream in millimetres as specified in the processing plant design or LOM plan. Used to assess crusher and mill performance against design specifications.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: top_size_mm
attributes.description: Maximum lump size of material in the feed stream expressed in millimetres. Defines the upper bound of the particle size distribution and is critical for crusher gap settings, conveyor design, and mill liner protection.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this feed stream record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS 6; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

products.name: shift_production_run
products.description: Transactional record of each processing plant production shift — the operational heartbeat of the processing domain. Captures shift date, shift number (day/night/afternoon), plant ID, crew ID, tonnes fed (ROM dry and wet), tonnes processed, circuit availability (%), plant utilisation (%), OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), feed grade (head grade by element), operating hours, calendar hours, actual throughput rate (tph), design throughput rate (tph), feed blend composition (ore type percentages), primary ore type, weather conditions affecting operations, and shift supervisor sign-off. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian and MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Serves as the single source of truth for shift and daily production reporting against LOM plan targets. All circuit-level process events, reagent consumption, utility consumption, and operational exception records link back to this shift record via FK. Supports daily production meetings, weekly/monthly reporting, and annual reconciliation.

attributes.name: shift_production_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shift production run record in the processing plant. Primary key for this transactional entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete operational shift event with a clear lifecycle in the mineral processing domain.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Shift-level production costs (labour, consumables, utilities) are allocated to cost centres for unit cost calculation, AISC reporting, and budget variance analysis. Core mining cost accounting process

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operating crew assigned to this production shift. Used for crew performance tracking, shift handover management, and workforce productivity analytics. Links to the crew or workforce master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Incidents occur during production shifts; linking enables shift-level incident analysis, LTIFR/TRIFR calculation by production period, and correlation of incident frequency with operational conditions

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory. Business justification: Shift samples are dispatched to specific laboratories for analysis. Essential for tracking sample turnaround times, metallurgical accounting, and reconciling lab results with production data for perfo

attributes.name: lom_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Life of Mine (LOM) plan version against which this shift production run is being reconciled. Enables tracking of actual production performance versus the approved LOM plan targets for throughput, grade, and recovery.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: maintenance_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.work_order. Business justification: Production runs frequently trigger corrective maintenance work orders when equipment issues or process deviations are detected during shift operations. Links shift performance problems to maintenance

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Shift production runs process ore from specific orebodies. Operational reporting, grade reconciliation, and metallurgical accounting require linking production shifts to source orebody to compare actu

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mineral processing plant where this shift production run occurred. Links to the plant master reference. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category (resource reference to the processing facility). Used for plant-level production aggregation and benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.production_schedule. Business justification: Processing shift runs must align with mine production schedules for integrated mine-to-mill optimization, bottleneck analysis, and shift-level production reconciliation. Essential for real-time produc

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.prospect. Business justification: Production runs process ore from specific prospects. Essential for reconciliation between resource model predictions and actual metallurgical performance. Real business need: grade control, resource m

attributes.name: rom_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mine.rom_stockpile. Business justification: Processing shift runs track feed source from ROM stockpiles for inventory management, feed scheduling, and stockpile depletion tracking. Essential for real-time feed management and stockpile inventory

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Shifts produce specific saleable products (concentrate grades, cathodes). Essential for production reconciliation, inventory management, and linking shift output to sales contracts. Natural business r

attributes.name: source_tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Production runs process ore from specific tenements. Required for royalty payment calculations, tenement-specific statutory production reporting, and reconciliation of tenement reserves against actual

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the shift supervisor responsible for sign-off on this production run record. Required for accountability, regulatory compliance, and shift handover documentation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; ISO 45001; MSHA Mine Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Every processing shift generates tailings sent to specific TSF. Required for material flow tracking, mass balance reconciliation, TSF capacity planning, and water balance closure. Fundamental operatio

attributes.name: actual_throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Actual average processing rate achieved during the shift, expressed in dry tonnes per hour (tph). Calculated as tonnes processed divided by operating hours. Compared against design throughput rate for performance gap analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10)

attributes.name: calendar_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours in the shift period as defined by the site calendar (typically 12 hours for a standard shift). Used as the denominator for plant utilisation and OEE calculations. Expressed in decimal hours.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: circuit_availability_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of calendar hours during which the processing circuit was available for production, calculated as (calendar hours minus planned and unplanned downtime) divided by calendar hours, expressed as a percentage. Key KPI for processing plant performance against LOM plan targets.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: concentrate_produced_tonnes
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of mineral concentrate or final processed product produced during the shift. Used for production accounting, inventory management, and sales dispatch planning. Sourced from product weighbridge or belt scale measurements.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; SAP S/4HANA MM; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift production run record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of data ingestion from OSIsoft PI System and MES. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IFRS 6 Exploration Assets; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: design_throughput_rate_tph
attributes.description: Nameplate or design throughput rate of the processing plant circuit, expressed in dry tonnes per hour (tph), as specified in the LOM plan and plant design documentation. Used as the benchmark for actual throughput performance assessment.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; LOM Plan; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_blend_oxide_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of oxide ore type in the ROM feed blend during the shift. Part of the feed blend composition tracking used to predict and explain metallurgical recovery variations and circuit performance. Sourced from grade control block data and ROM stockpile management.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_blend_sulphide_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of sulphide ore type in the ROM feed blend during the shift. Used alongside oxide percentage to characterise the feed blend composition for metallurgical performance analysis and reagent dosage optimisation.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: feed_grade_element
attributes.description: Chemical element symbol for which the feed head grade is reported (e.g., Fe for iron ore, Cu for copper, Li for lithium). Enables multi-commodity processing plants to correctly attribute grade measurements to the target mineral. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Fe|Cu|Au|Ag|Li|Ni|Co|Zn|Pb|Mo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; IUPAC Chemical Nomenclature

attributes.name: feed_head_grade_pct
attributes.description: Assayed head grade of the primary valuable element (e.g., Fe%, Cu%, Li%) in the ROM feed during the shift, expressed as a percentage. Sourced from LabWare LIMS composite sample assay results. Critical input for metallurgical recovery calculations and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC; ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: feed_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the ROM feed expressed as a percentage of wet weight, measured by on-belt moisture analyser or laboratory sample. Used to convert wet tonnes to dry tonnes for metallurgical accounting and mass balance calculations.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012; ISO 17025

attributes.name: metallurgical_recovery_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the valuable element in the ROM feed that is successfully recovered into the final concentrate or product during the shift. Calculated from feed grade, product grade, and mass balance. Core KPI for processing efficiency and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: oee_pct
attributes.description: Overall Equipment Effectiveness expressed as a percentage, combining availability, performance, and quality rate for the processing plant during the shift. Industry-standard KPI for processing plant productivity benchmarking against LOM plan targets. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of hours the processing plant was in productive operation during the shift, excluding planned and unplanned downtime. Used in OEE calculation and throughput rate derivation. Expressed in decimal hours.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Hours of scheduled downtime during the shift for planned maintenance, inspections, or scheduled shutdowns. Used in circuit availability and OEE calculations. Sourced from Infor EAM work order schedules.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10)

attributes.name: plant_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of available hours during which the plant was actively processing ore, calculated as operating hours divided by available hours. Reflects how effectively available plant time is being used for production. Reported in daily production meetings.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; OEE Industry Standard (SEMI E10); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: primary_ore_type
attributes.description: Dominant ore type or lithological classification of the ROM feed processed during the shift (e.g., oxide, sulphide, mixed, transitional, fresh). Determines the applicable processing circuit configuration and expected metallurgical recovery. Sourced from Geovia GEMS geological model and grade control data.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS; Hexagon MinePlan; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: processing_circuit_type
attributes.description: Primary processing circuit configuration active during the shift. Identifies the comminution and separation technology applied (e.g., SAG/ball mill, HPGR, DMS, flotation, leach, SX-EW). Used for circuit-level performance benchmarking and maintenance planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAG_ball_mill|HPGR|DMS|flotation|leach|SX_EW|gravity|magnetic_separation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; Infor EAM; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: product_grade_pct
attributes.description: Assayed grade of the primary valuable element in the final concentrate or product produced during the shift, expressed as a percentage. Sourced from LabWare LIMS product sample assay. Used for product quality certification, sales contract compliance, and metallurgical accounting.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: rom_feed_tonnes_dry
attributes.business_glossary_term: Run of Mine (ROM) Feed Tonnes Dry
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed to the processing plant during the shift, calculated by applying the measured moisture factor to wet tonnes. Dry tonnes are the standard basis for metallurgical accounting, resource reporting, and LOM plan reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework; NI 43-101

attributes.name: rom_feed_tonnes_wet
attributes.business_glossary_term: Run of Mine (ROM) Feed Tonnes Wet
attributes.description: Total wet tonnes of Run of Mine (ROM) ore fed to the processing plant during the shift, as measured at the feed conveyor belt scale. Wet weight includes moisture content. Used for mass balance and throughput reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shift production run record. 'open' indicates the shift is in progress; 'completed' indicates shift has ended and data is captured; 'under_review' indicates supervisor review pending; 'approved' indicates shift supervisor sign-off complete; 'cancelled' indicates the shift was voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System); ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the production shift commenced. Used as the primary date dimension for daily production reporting, reconciliation against LOM plan targets, and regulatory reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (date-level precision).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the production shift concluded, sourced from the MES or OSIsoft PI System historian. Used for shift duration calculation, handover documentation, and OEE reporting. ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; IEC 62541 OPC-UA; ISO 8601

attributes.name: shift_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the shift supervisor covering significant events, process upsets, equipment issues, safety observations, or other contextual information relevant to the shift production run. Supports shift handover communication and exception reporting.

attributes.name: shift_number
attributes.description: Designates the shift rotation within the calendar day: 'day' (typically 06:00–18:00), 'night' (18:00–06:00), or 'afternoon' (14:00–22:00) depending on site roster configuration. Used for shift-based production reporting and crew scheduling.
attributes.references: MES (Manufacturing Execution System); ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: shift_run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shift production run, used in daily production reports, shift handover documentation, and reconciliation against LOM plan targets. Format: SPR-YYYY-MM-DD-PLANTCODE-SEQ. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES (Manufacturing Execution System); JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the production shift commenced, sourced from the MES or OSIsoft PI System historian. Used for accurate shift duration calculation, OEE computation, and integration with SCADA event logs. ISO 8601 format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; IEC 62541 OPC-UA; ISO 8601

attributes.name: supervisor_signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the shift supervisor formally approved and signed off the shift production run record. Marks the transition from 'under_review' to 'approved' status. Required for daily production reporting and audit compliance.

attributes.name: tonnes_processed
attributes.description: Total dry tonnes of ore that completed the primary processing circuit during the shift. May differ from ROM feed tonnes due to in-circuit inventory changes, spillage, or sampling losses. Used as the primary throughput metric for production reporting. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; MES; JORC Code 2012; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: unplanned_downtime_hours

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: ISO 8601; IFRS 6 Exploration Assets; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: weather_condition

Used for operational exception reporting and HSE compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|storm|fog|high_wind|dust_storm|snow|extreme_heat — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: weather_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether adverse weather conditions materially impacted processing plant operations or throughput during the shift. Used to qualify production shortfalls in reporting and distinguish weather-related downtime from equipment or process failures.

products.name: unit_operation_event
products.description: Unified transactional record of all mineral processing operations per shift per circuit, using a type discriminator to capture comminution (SAG, ball mill, HPGR, crusher), flotation (rougher, scavenger, cleaner), leaching (heap, tank, vat, CIL/CIP), SX-EW (solvent extraction, electrowinning), DMS (dense media separation), gravity separation (spirals, shaking tables, jigs), magnetic separation, and thickening/dewatering events. Common attributes: circuit ID, shift reference, feed tonnage, product tonnage, recovery (%), specific energy (kWh/t). Type-specific attribute groups capture process-specific parameters (e.g., P80 for comminution, froth depth for flotation, medium density for DMS, current density for SX-EW). Sourced from OSIsoft PI System SCADA historian and MES. Supports metallurgical accounting, process control, and LOM plan variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_operation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each unit operation event record in the mineral processing domain. Primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table.

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.name: circuit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific processing circuit (e.g., SAG mill circuit, flotation circuit, leach circuit) where this unit operation event occurred. Links to the circuit master.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System – Asset Framework hierarchy; MES circuit configuration
