attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.training_record. Business justification: Specific equipment classes require operator certification (haul truck licenses, dozer tickets, drill rig competencies). Assets should reference the required training/competency record to enforce that

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original capital expenditure (CAPEX) purchase price of the asset in the reporting currency. Used for depreciation calculations, asset register valuation, and capital replacement planning under IAS 16 and IFRS.

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the asset, typically combining equipment type and fleet number (e.g., 'Haul Truck HT-042', 'SAG Mill 01'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and work orders.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was formally commissioned and placed into operational service at the mine site. Marks the start of the asset's operational lifecycle for maintenance scheduling, warranty tracking, and depreciation under IFRS.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; IFRS 16; IAS 16

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which the asset's operating expenditure (OPEX) and maintenance costs are allocated. Enables financial reporting by asset and supports OPEX tracking against budget.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Maintenance criticality classification of the asset based on its impact on production, safety, and environmental compliance if it fails. Drives maintenance strategy selection, spare parts stocking levels, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) prioritisation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Criticality Analysis; ISO 55001 Asset Management; ICMM

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the acquisition cost and financial values associated with the asset (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Supports multi-currency asset register reporting.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was permanently removed from operational service and decommissioned. Null for assets still in service. Used for asset lifecycle reporting, capital replacement planning, and mine rehabilitation cost estimation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; IFRS 16; IAS 16

attributes.name: eam_asset_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for the asset record in Infor EAM. Used for system-of-record traceability and integration with maintenance work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: engine_power_kw
attributes.description: OEM-rated engine or motor power output of the asset in kilowatts (kW). Used for fuel consumption benchmarking, energy efficiency analysis, and equipment selection for mine planning. Null for non-powered assets.

attributes.name: fleet_number
attributes.description: Operational fleet number assigned to the asset at the mine site. Used by operators, dispatchers, and Fleet Management System (FMS) to identify and track the asset in the field. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar and Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Master; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: fuel_tank_capacity_litres
attributes.description: Maximum fuel tank capacity of the asset in litres. Used for fuel logistics planning, refuelling scheduling, and fuel consumption rate benchmarking. Null for electric or non-fuel-powered assets.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary energy source or fuel type powering the asset. Used for fuel consumption tracking, emissions reporting under GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement, and fleet electrification planning.
attributes.references: GRI 305 Emissions; ISO 14001; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring

attributes.name: is_mobile
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is a mobile mining unit (True) such as a haul truck, excavator, or drill rig, or a fixed plant asset (False) such as a conveyor, crusher, or mill. Drives different tracking, reporting, and maintenance workflows.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Classification; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or rebuild performed on the asset. Used to assess remaining component life, plan future overhauls, and calculate Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) in the maintenance management system.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order History; ICMM Asset Management Guidelines

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Descriptive operational location of the asset within the mine site (e.g., 'Pit 3 North Wall', 'Processing Plant - Grinding Circuit', 'ROM Pad'). Complements the site code with granular positional context for maintenance and dispatch.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Location Hierarchy; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: manufacture_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the asset was manufactured by the OEM. Used to calculate asset age, depreciation schedules, and Life of Mine (LOM) planning for fleet replacement.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: OEM model designation of the asset (e.g., CAT 793F, Komatsu 930E, Sandvik DR461i). Used for spare parts management, maintenance procedures, and performance benchmarking against OEM specifications.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_service_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance service for the asset as scheduled in Infor EAM. Used for maintenance planning, production scheduling, and availability forecasting.

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Current cumulative odometer reading in kilometres for mobile assets. Used alongside SMR hours for maintenance scheduling, tyre life management, and haul road condition monitoring. Null for fixed plant assets.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; Caterpillar MineStar FMS

attributes.name: operating_weight_tonnes
attributes.description: OEM-rated operating weight of the asset in metric tonnes. Used for road and haul route load limit compliance, ground bearing pressure calculations, and mine infrastructure design.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the asset indicating whether it is available for production, undergoing maintenance, on standby, or permanently decommissioned. Drives availability calculations and maintenance scheduling in Infor EAM and MineStar.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is company-owned, leased under a finance or operating lease, short-term hired, or contractor-supplied. Drives financial treatment under IFRS 16 and determines maintenance responsibility.

attributes.name: payload_capacity_tonnes
attributes.description: OEM-rated maximum payload capacity of the asset in metric tonnes. Applicable to haul trucks, loaders, and material handling equipment. Used for production planning, haulage cycle optimisation, and OEE calculations. Null for fixed plant assets.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset record was first created in the master register. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with asset register governance requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the asset record was most recently updated in the master register. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and integration refresh management in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: scada_tag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Tag
attributes.description: SCADA tag identifier used to link the asset to its real-time process data streams in the OSIsoft PI System historian. Applicable primarily to fixed plant assets such as conveyors, crushers, mills, and processing equipment.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) serial number uniquely identifying the physical asset unit. Used for warranty tracking, OEM service records, and regulatory compliance. Sourced from Infor EAM.

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the mine site where the asset is currently assigned and operated. Enables site-level fleet reporting, OEE benchmarking, and cross-site asset utilisation analysis. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Plant Master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Master; Infor EAM Location

attributes.name: smr_hours
attributes.description: Current cumulative Service Meter Reading (SMR) in engine hours recorded on the asset. Used as the primary trigger for preventive maintenance scheduling, component life tracking, and MTBF calculations in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM PM Scheduling; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Internal asset tag or barcode label affixed to the physical asset for inventory and maintenance identification. Distinct from fleet number and serial number. Sourced from Infor EAM.

attributes.name: telematics_unit_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the onboard telematics or GPS tracking unit installed on the asset. Used to link real-time positional and operational data from Caterpillar MineStar and OSIsoft PI System for fleet management and equipment health monitoring.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar FMS; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: OEM-specified or engineering-assessed useful operational life of the asset in years. Used for straight-line depreciation calculations, Life of Mine (LOM) fleet planning, and capital replacement scheduling under IAS 16.
attributes.references: IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Infor EAM

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM warranty for the asset expires. Used to trigger warranty claim processes, plan post-warranty maintenance strategies, and manage OEM service agreements in Infor EAM and Pronto Xi.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Master; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element associated with the asset for capital expenditure (CAPEX) tracking and project cost allocation. Used for mine development and capital project reporting.

products.name: asset_class
products.description: Reference classification hierarchy for mining equipment types organised into mobile fleet (haul trucks, excavators, drills, dozers, graders, water carts, light vehicles) and fixed plant (conveyors, crushers, SAG mills, ball mills, HPGR, flotation cells, thickeners, stackers, reclaimers). Each class defines OEM category, asset class code, size/capacity tier, expected useful life in operating hours, depreciation method, maintenance strategy type (time-based, condition-based, predictive), and target availability percentage. Serves as the reference master for fleet sizing models, maintenance planning, and capital budgeting.

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset class record in the mining equipment classification hierarchy. Primary key for the asset_class reference master.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Classification; SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Category

attributes.name: asset_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset class expressed in calendar years for financial depreciation and LOM planning purposes. Used alongside useful_life_operating_hours to determine the binding depreciation constraint. Supports CAPEX modelling and NPV/IRR analysis.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; IFRS Capital Budgeting Standards

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the nominal_capacity field (e.g., t for payload tonnes, t/h for throughput tonnes per hour, m3 for bucket/bowl volume, mm for drill hole diameter, kW for power rating). Ensures correct interpretation of capacity values across equipment types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: t|t/h|m3|m3/h|mm|kW|MW|m|km/h — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units; Infor EAM Unit of Measure; SAP S/4HANA Unit of Measure

attributes.name: capex_budget_category
attributes.description: Capital expenditure (CAPEX) budget category under which assets of this class are typically funded. Sustaining CAPEX covers replacement of existing capacity; expansion CAPEX covers new capacity additions. Used for capital allocation, LOM planning, and financial reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-IM Capital Investment Management; IFRS Capital Expenditure Classification; ICMM Financial Reporting

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the asset class within the equipment classification hierarchy (e.g., HT-320T for 320-tonne haul truck class, SAG-36FT for 36-foot SAG mill class). Used as the business key across ERP, EAM, and FMS systems.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Class Code; SAP S/4HANA PM Asset Class (ANLKL); Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Class

attributes.name: class_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the asset class including its primary function, operational context within the mine, and key distinguishing characteristics. Supports procurement specifications and capital budgeting documentation.

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the asset class describing the equipment type and key specification (e.g., 'Ultra-Class Haul Truck 320T', 'Semi-Autogenous Grinding Mill 36ft', 'Rotary Blasthole Drill 270mm'). Used in reports, dashboards, and maintenance planning documents.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Classification

attributes.name: class_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset class record. Active classes are in current use for fleet planning and procurement. Phasing_out classes are being replaced by newer models. Retired classes are no longer procured but may still have operating assets. Controls visibility in procurement and planning systems.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: co2_emission_factor_kg_per_hr
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emission factor for assets of this class in kilograms per operating hour, derived from OEM fuel consumption specifications and applicable emission conversion factors. Used for Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions reporting under GRI, ICMM, and regulatory environmental disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: GRI 305 Emissions; ICMM Environmental Reporting; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time; Data Governance Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: critical_equipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset class is designated as critical equipment whose failure would cause significant production loss, safety risk, or environmental incident. Critical equipment classes receive priority maintenance resourcing, enhanced spare parts stockholding, and elevated monitoring frequency in OSIsoft PI System.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Criticality Assessment; ISO 55001 Asset Management; ICMM Critical Equipment Management

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting depreciation method applied to assets of this class for financial reporting and capital budgeting purposes. Units_of_production is common for mining equipment tied to ore tonnes mined. Aligns with IAS 16 and IFRS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Key

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this asset class definition became effective and valid for use in fleet planning, procurement, and maintenance scheduling. Supports temporal validity tracking for the asset class master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Infor EAM; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset class definition ceases to be effective (nullable for open-ended active classes). Used to manage class version transitions when OEM specifications change or when a class is retired from the fleet register.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; Infor EAM; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Functional equipment type within the fleet category (e.g., haul_truck, excavator, blasthole_drill, dozer, grader, water_cart, light_vehicle, conveyor, crusher, sag_mill, ball_mill, hpgr, flotation_cell, thickener, stacker, reclaimer). attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Classification; Infor EAM Equipment Type; SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Category

attributes.name: fleet_category
attributes.description: Top-level classification distinguishing between mobile fleet assets (haul trucks, excavators, drills, dozers, graders, water carts, light vehicles) and fixed plant assets (conveyors, crushers, mills, flotation cells, thickeners). Drives maintenance strategy, depreciation treatment, and fleet sizing models.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Hierarchy; ICMM Asset Management Framework

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_rate_l_per_hr
attributes.description: Standard OEM-rated fuel consumption rate for assets of this class in litres per operating hour under typical mine operating conditions. Used for fuel budget forecasting, OPEX modelling, carbon emissions estimation, and fleet energy management reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fuel Management; OSIsoft PI System Fuel Monitoring; OEM Fuel Consumption Specifications; GRI 302 Energy

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class involve or carry hazardous materials (e.g., explosives transport vehicles, acid handling equipment in SX-EW circuits, cyanide dosing systems in leaching). Triggers mandatory HSE compliance controls, PPE requirements, and IsoMetrix risk assessment workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; IsoMetrix HSE Risk Assessment; MSHA Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: infor_eam_class_code
attributes.description: Corresponding asset class identifier in the Infor EAM system used for asset lifecycle management, preventive maintenance scheduling, and work order management. Enables bi-directional data reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational EAM system.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Classification; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was most recently modified, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance in the silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time; Data Governance Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_type
attributes.description: Primary maintenance strategy applied to assets of this class: time_based (fixed interval PM schedules), condition_based (triggered by measured condition thresholds), predictive (AI/ML-driven failure prediction from sensor data), or run_to_failure (for low-criticality components). Drives maintenance planning in Infor EAM and CMMS scheduling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Maintenance Strategy; ISO 55001 Asset Management; ICMM Asset Management Framework; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Plan

attributes.name: major_overhaul_interval_hours
attributes.description: Operating hour interval at which a major component overhaul or rebuild is required for assets of this class (e.g., 20,000 hours for engine rebuild, 40,000 hours for full structural overhaul). Drives long-range maintenance CAPEX planning and LOM cost modelling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Major Overhaul Planning; SAP S/4HANA PM; OEM Overhaul Specifications; ICMM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: minestar_equipment_class_code
attributes.description: Equipment class identifier as defined in the Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System (FMS). Used to align telematics data, productivity metrics, and equipment health signals from MineStar with the enterprise asset class master.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; FMS Equipment Classification

attributes.name: nominal_capacity
attributes.description: Principal quantitative capacity specification for the asset class expressed in the relevant unit of measure (e.g., payload tonnes for haul trucks, throughput tonnes per hour for mills and crushers, bucket capacity m³ for excavators, hole diameter mm for drills). The principal numeric fact defining the class's productive capability.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Infor EAM Asset Specifications; OEM Technical Specifications

attributes.name: oem_category
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) product category or model family designation as defined by the manufacturer (e.g., Caterpillar 793, Komatsu 930E, Liebherr T 284, Sandvik DR416i). Used for OEM warranty tracking, parts compatibility, and service agreement alignment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; Infor EAM OEM Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group

attributes.name: oem_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer for this asset class (e.g., Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr, Sandvik, Metso, FLSmidth). Used for vendor relationship management, warranty claims, and procurement sourcing strategies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Manufacturer Master; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Pronto Xi Supplier

attributes.name: operating_weight_tonnes
attributes.description: Gross operating weight of the asset class in metric tonnes as specified by the OEM. Used for haul road design, bridge load ratings, ground bearing pressure calculations, and site infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: OEM Technical Specifications; Infor EAM Asset Specifications; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: pm_interval_hours
attributes.description: Standard preventive maintenance (PM) service interval in operating hours for assets of this class (e.g., 250 hours for minor service, 1000 hours for major service). Defines the base PM scheduling cadence in the CMMS and Infor EAM maintenance plans.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance; SAP S/4HANA PM Maintenance Plan; OEM Service Manual

attributes.name: power_rating_kw
attributes.description: Installed engine or motor power rating for the asset class in kilowatts (kW) as specified by the OEM. Used for energy consumption modelling, fuel burn estimation, electrical infrastructure planning, and OPEX forecasting.
attributes.references: OEM Technical Specifications; Infor EAM Asset Specifications; OSIsoft PI System Energy Monitoring

attributes.name: replacement_cost_usd
attributes.description: Current estimated replacement cost for a single asset unit of this class in US dollars. Used for insurance valuation, capital budgeting, CAPEX planning, and NPV/IRR analysis in LOM financial models. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity in procurement negotiations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Valuation; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS Capital Budgeting; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: sap_asset_class_code
attributes.description: Corresponding asset class code (ANLKL) in SAP S/4HANA Fixed Asset Accounting (FI-AA) module. Used to reconcile the equipment master data with the financial asset register and ensure consistent depreciation treatment across ERP and EAM systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Class (ANLKL); IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: size_capacity_tier
attributes.description: Standardised size and capacity tier classification for the asset class used in fleet sizing models and capital budgeting (e.g., ultra_class for 300T+ haul trucks, large for 150-299T, medium for 90-149T). Enables fleet mix optimisation and benchmarking across mine sites.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Sizing; ICMM Fleet Management Guidelines; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: target_availability_pct
attributes.description: Target physical availability percentage for assets of this class expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 for 85%). Physical availability is the proportion of scheduled time the equipment is mechanically available for operation. Used as the benchmark for OEE calculations and maintenance performance KPIs.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar OEE Metrics; Infor EAM KPI Framework; ICMM Mining Equipment Performance Standards

attributes.name: target_mtbf_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) Hours
attributes.description: Target Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) in operating hours for assets of this class. MTBF is the average operating time between unplanned mechanical failures. Used to set maintenance performance benchmarks, evaluate reliability improvement initiatives, and support predictive maintenance model calibration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Reliability KPIs; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 14224 Reliability Data Collection; ICMM Asset Management

attributes.name: target_mttr_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) Hours
attributes.description: Target Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) in hours for assets of this class. MTTR measures the average time required to restore equipment to operational status following an unplanned failure. Used to benchmark maintenance crew efficiency and spare parts availability strategies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Reliability KPIs; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 14224 Reliability Data Collection

attributes.name: target_oee_pct
attributes.description: Target Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) percentage for assets of this class, representing the combined product of availability, utilisation, and performance rate (e.g., 65.00 for 65%). OEE is the primary productivity benchmark for mining equipment classes used in production reporting and capital justification.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar OEE; ICMM Mining Equipment Performance; ISO 22400 Manufacturing Operations Management KPIs

attributes.name: target_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Target utilisation percentage for assets of this class expressed as a percentage of available hours actually used for productive work (e.g., 75.00 for 75%). Distinct from availability — utilisation measures productive use of available time. Used in fleet sizing models and production planning.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Infor EAM Utilisation KPI; ICMM OEE Framework

attributes.name: telematics_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets of this class are equipped with telematics and real-time monitoring capability integrated with Caterpillar MineStar or OSIsoft PI System. Determines data availability for real-time OEE tracking, predictive maintenance, and fuel consumption monitoring.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: useful_life_operating_hours
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset class expressed in total operating hours as defined by OEM specifications and mine engineering standards (e.g., 80,000 hours for a large haul truck, 120,000 hours for a SAG mill). Drives depreciation schedules, LOM capital replacement planning, and fleet renewal strategies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Accounting; IFRS 16 Leases; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

products.name: fleet_assignment
products.description: Tracks the operational assignment of mobile fleet assets to specific mine areas, pits, benches, or processing circuits. Records assignment start and end dates, assigned shift, operating location, task type (haulage, drilling, dozing), and the responsible supervisor. Sourced from MineStar Fleet Management System.

attributes.name: fleet_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fleet assignment record in the MineStar Fleet Management System. Primary key for the fleet_assignment data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mobile fleet asset (haul truck, drill, dozer, grader, loader, etc.) being assigned. Links to the equipment master register sourced from Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: During construction and commissioning phases, production equipment is assigned to support project activities (haul road construction, pre-stripping, commissioning support). Business process: project e

attributes.name: mine_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine area, pit, bench, or processing circuit to which the fleet asset is operationally assigned. Links to the mine location/area master.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: primary_fleet_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the responsible supervisor or shift boss accountable for this fleet assignment. Links to the workforce/employee master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine production schedule that this fleet assignment supports. Links to the production schedule in mine.production_schedule.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Each fleet assignment moves or processes a specific saleable product. Dispatch systems track product per assignment for production reconciliation, grade control, and stockpile management. Material_typ

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which this fleet assignment is active. Links to the shift schedule master to identify day/night shift, shift date, and crew rotation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Fleet assignments occur within specific tenement areas. Mining operations must track which licence area work is performed in for expenditure reporting, compliance with tenement conditions, and allocat

attributes.name: assignment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The actual elapsed duration of the fleet assignment in minutes, calculated from assignment start to end timestamps. Stored as a business field for shift reporting and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis without requiring real-time computation.

attributes.name: assignment_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fleet asset completed or was released from its operational assignment. Null if the assignment is still active. Used to calculate assignment duration and shift utilisation.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the fleet assignment, generated by MineStar Fleet Management System. Used for cross-system referencing, dispatch communications, and operational reporting.

attributes.name: assignment_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the fleet asset commenced its operational assignment at the designated mine area or task. This is the principal real-world event time for the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fleet assignment. 'planned' indicates a future assignment not yet commenced; 'active' indicates the equipment is currently deployed; 'completed' indicates the assignment has concluded; 'cancelled' indicates the assignment was voided before commencement; 'suspended' indicates a temporary halt due to breakdown, weather, or safety hold.

attributes.name: bench_level
attributes.description: The specific bench elevation or level within the pit to which the fleet asset is assigned, expressed as a mine elevation reference (e.g., RL 450, Bench 12). Used for spatial tracking and production reconciliation.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: delay_code
attributes.description: The standardised delay classification code recorded when the fleet asset experienced a non-productive delay during the assignment (e.g., mechanical breakdown, waiting for blast, road block, operator break). Sourced from MineStar delay recording. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product with delay_code and delay_description]

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes of recorded delays experienced by the fleet asset during this assignment. Used in conjunction with delay_code for availability and utilisation analysis and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) reporting.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: The mine location code identifying where material is being delivered (ROM pad, waste dump, crusher, stockpile, processing plant). Used for material tracking and haulage cycle analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned by the MineStar dispatch system to determine the order in which fleet assets are assigned to tasks. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used for optimising fleet utilisation and meeting production targets.

attributes.name: distance_travelled_km
attributes.description: The total distance in kilometres travelled by the mobile fleet asset during this assignment, sourced from MineStar GPS telematics. Used for haulage cycle analysis, tyre management, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: The number of engine operating hours accumulated by the fleet asset during this assignment, sourced from MineStar telematics. Used for maintenance scheduling, MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) calculation, and asset lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Infor EAM

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: The category of mobile fleet equipment being assigned. Denormalised from the equipment master for operational reporting and dispatch efficiency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: haul_truck|drill|dozer|excavator|loader|grader|water_cart|conveyor|crusher — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Infor EAM

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: The actual volume of diesel fuel consumed in litres by the fleet asset during this assignment period, sourced from MineStar telematics or fuel management system. Used for OPEX (Operating Expenditure) tracking and fuel efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: idle_time_minutes
attributes.description: The total number of minutes the fleet asset was in an idle state (engine running but not performing productive work) during this assignment. Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis and identifying productivity improvement opportunities.

attributes.name: is_planned_assignment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fleet assignment was pre-planned in the mine production schedule (True) or was an ad-hoc/reactive dispatch by the shift supervisor (False). Used to measure schedule adherence and dispatch planning effectiveness.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: minestar_assignment_ref
attributes.description: The native assignment reference or dispatch ID from the Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System. Used for traceability and reconciliation back to the source system of record.

attributes.name: payload_tonnes
attributes.description: The actual payload weight in metric tonnes carried or processed during this fleet assignment, as recorded by on-board payload monitoring systems. Applicable primarily to haul truck assignments. Used for production reconciliation and truck factor analysis.

attributes.name: pit_name
attributes.description: The name or code of the open-cut pit or underground mine area to which the fleet asset is assigned. Provides operational context for dispatch and production reporting.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: planned_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The planned duration of the fleet assignment in minutes as per the mine production schedule or dispatch plan. Used to measure schedule adherence and identify variance between planned and actual assignment durations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled end date and time for the fleet assignment as per the mine production schedule or dispatch plan. Used to measure schedule adherence.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled start date and time for the fleet assignment as per the mine production schedule or dispatch plan. Used to measure schedule adherence and dispatch efficiency.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fleet assignment record was first captured in the data platform. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 45001

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fleet assignment record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The calendar date of the shift during which this fleet assignment occurs. Used as the primary date dimension for daily production reporting and shift-based performance analysis.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The shift classification during which the fleet assignment is active. Typically day or night shift in a 12-hour rotation. Used for shift-based production reporting and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: source_location_code
attributes.description: The mine location code identifying where material is being loaded or work is being performed (dig face, blast block, stockpile). Used for material tracking and production reconciliation in MineStar.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: supervisor_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the shift supervisor regarding this fleet assignment, including any special instructions, safety observations, or operational exceptions. Sourced from MineStar dispatch comments.

attributes.name: target_payload_tonnes
attributes.description: The target or design payload weight in metric tonnes for the fleet asset during this assignment, based on equipment specifications and mine planning targets. Used to measure payload efficiency and identify overloading or underloading.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The primary operational task type assigned to the mobile fleet asset during this assignment. Classifies the nature of work being performed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: haulage|drilling|dozing|blasting_support|loading|grading|water_cart|ancillary — promote to reference product]

products.name: oee_record
products.description: Periodic OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) composite metric records capturing the multiplicative product of availability rate, performance rate, and quality rate for each asset per shift or production period. Distinct from utilisation_record which tracks raw time-based utilisation only. Includes planned operating time, actual operating time, ideal cycle time, total pieces produced, and reject count where applicable (e.g., crusher throughput vs spec). OEE percentage = Availability × Performance × Quality. Sourced from MineStar, OSIsoft PI, and production reconciliation systems. Used for fleet performance benchmarking, bottleneck identification, and OPEX reporting against budget.

attributes.name: oee_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OEE composite metric record. Primary key for the oee_record data product in the equipment domain.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Performance Module; Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining fleet or fixed plant asset (e.g., haul truck, drill, shovel, crusher, conveyor) for which this OEE record is computed. Sourced from Infor EAM asset register and Caterpillar MineStar equipment master.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Module; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost centre responsible for this asset during the OEE period. Used for OPEX allocation and budget vs actual reporting against fleet performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: OEE targets and performance vary by product line in multi-product mining operations (iron ore lump vs fines circuits, different coal products). Production reporting and continuous improvement initiati

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this OEE record was captured. Links to the shift schedule master to derive shift type, crew, and duration context.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the asset is deployed. Enables site-level OEE benchmarking and multi-site fleet performance comparison.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: OEE metrics are tracked by tenement for performance reporting and expenditure commitment validation. Real mining operations report productivity by licence area to demonstrate compliance with minimum e

attributes.name: actual_cycle_time_sec
attributes.description: The measured average time per production unit (e.g., haul cycle, crusher pass) achieved during the period. Compared against ideal_cycle_time_sec to derive Performance Rate. Sourced from MineStar dispatch and OSIsoft PI process historian.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: actual_operating_time_hrs
attributes.description: Actual hours the asset was in productive operation during the period, after deducting unplanned downtime and breakdowns. Core input to OEE Availability Rate calculation. Sourced from MineStar equipment health and OSIsoft PI historian.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the production supervisor or engineer who approved this OEE record in the reconciliation workflow. Supports audit trail requirements for OPEX reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; Infor EAM; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: availability_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of actual operating time to planned operating time, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9250 = 92.50%). First component of the OEE composite metric. Calculated as actual_operating_time_hrs / planned_operating_time_hrs. Stored as a raw rate for precision; percentage display handled in reporting layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; Caterpillar MineStar OEE Module; ICMM Equipment Performance

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for production supervisors or engineers to record contextual notes about this OEE record, such as reasons for low availability, abnormal operating conditions, or data quality caveats.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Notes; Caterpillar MineStar Shift Reports

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this OEE record was first created in the data platform, either by automated ingestion from MineStar/OSIsoft PI or by manual entry. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the primary operational system from which this OEE record was sourced or reconciled. Supports data lineage tracing and audit of production reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: distance_travelled_km
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by mobile fleet assets (e.g., haul trucks, dozers) during the period, in kilometres. Used for tyre wear analysis, fuel efficiency benchmarking, and haul road condition assessment. Not applicable to fixed plant assets.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Fleet Management System (FMS)

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Total engine running hours accumulated by the asset during the period. Used for maintenance scheduling, MTBF calculation, and asset lifecycle management in Infor EAM. Sourced from MineStar equipment health telematics.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_l
attributes.description: Total diesel fuel consumed by the asset during the period, measured in litres. Used for fuel efficiency analysis, OPEX cost allocation, and carbon emissions reporting. Sourced from MineStar fuel management or SAP MM fuel issue records.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_t_per_l
attributes.description: Ratio of actual throughput in tonnes to fuel consumed in litres during the period. Key OPEX efficiency metric for haul trucks and mobile fleet. Enables benchmarking across fleet and identification of underperforming units.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; ICMM Sustainability Reporting; ISO 14001

attributes.name: ideal_cycle_time_sec
attributes.description: The theoretical minimum time required to produce one unit (e.g., one haul cycle, one crusher pass) under optimal conditions. Used as the benchmark denominator in OEE Performance Rate calculation. Sourced from engineering design specifications or MineStar baseline models.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Mine Engineering Standards

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OEE record has been through the production reconciliation process and validated against shift reports and source system data. Unreconciled records are provisional and should not be used for OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PS Production Reconciliation

attributes.name: load_count
attributes.description: Total number of discrete load cycles (e.g., truck loads, shovel passes) completed by the asset during the period. Used for cycle time analysis and Performance Rate validation. Sourced from MineStar dispatch system.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Dispatch; Fleet Management System (FMS)

attributes.name: oee_rate
attributes.description: The composite OEE metric expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75.00%), calculated as the multiplicative product of availability_rate × performance_rate × quality_rate. This is the primary KPI for fleet performance benchmarking, bottleneck identification, and OPEX reporting. Stored as a pre-reconciled rate from the production reconciliation system.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; Caterpillar MineStar OEE Module; ICMM Equipment Performance; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: oee_target_rate
attributes.description: The budgeted or contractually agreed OEE target rate for this asset type and period, expressed as a decimal. Used for variance analysis between actual OEE and planned OEE in OPEX reporting and fleet performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budgeting; ICMM Equipment Performance; Mine Planning Standards

attributes.name: payload_avg_t
attributes.description: Average payload per load cycle in dry metric tonnes during the period. Used to assess truck loading efficiency against rated payload capacity. Sourced from MineStar payload monitoring system (VIMS/PLM).
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Fleet Management System (FMS)

attributes.name: performance_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of actual production speed to ideal production speed during operating time, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8750 = 87.50%). Second component of the OEE composite metric. Calculated as (ideal_cycle_time_sec × total_units_produced) / actual_operating_time_hrs. Stored as raw rate.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; Caterpillar MineStar OEE Module; ICMM Equipment Performance

attributes.name: period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time marking the end of the production period for which OEE is calculated. Combined with period_start_timestamp to derive total period duration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time marking the beginning of the production period (shift or sub-shift interval) for which OEE is calculated. Principal business event timestamp for this record. Sourced from MineStar shift dispatch or OSIsoft PI historian.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hrs
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was taken out of service for scheduled preventive maintenance, inspections, or planned shutdowns during the period. Excluded from planned operating time in OEE Availability calculation.

attributes.name: planned_operating_time_hrs
attributes.description: Total scheduled hours the asset was planned to be in productive operation during the period, excluding planned maintenance windows and scheduled downtime. Core input to OEE Availability Rate calculation. Sourced from MineStar shift schedule.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 KPIs for Manufacturing Operations Management; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Calendar date associated with this OEE record, representing the production day. Used for daily and monthly OEE trend reporting and OPEX period alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Production Scheduling; ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: quality_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of good units produced to total units produced, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9900 = 99.00%). Third component of the OEE composite metric. Calculated as (total_units_produced - reject_unit_count) / total_units_produced. For mobile fleet assets where quality is not applicable, this defaults to 1.0000.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2; LabWare LIMS; ICMM Equipment Performance

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this OEE record was formally reconciled and approved in the production reconciliation system. Null if is_reconciled is false.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this OEE record, formatted as OEE-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used for cross-system referencing between MineStar, OSIsoft PI, and SAP PM reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Infor EAM

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this OEE record within the production reconciliation workflow. Draft records are provisional; approved records are used for OPEX reporting and fleet benchmarking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Infor EAM

attributes.name: reject_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of production units that did not meet quality specification during the period (e.g., crusher throughput below grade spec, off-spec concentrate batches). Core input to OEE Quality Rate calculation. Applicable primarily to fixed plant assets; set to zero for mobile fleet where quality is not directly measured.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Quality Control; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: speed_avg_kmh
attributes.description: Average travel speed of the mobile asset during the period, in km/h. Used for haul road performance analysis, speed compliance monitoring, and Performance Rate benchmarking. Sourced from MineStar telematics.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) Speed Compliance

attributes.name: throughput_actual_t
attributes.description: Actual mass of material (ore or waste) processed or moved by the asset during the period, measured in dry metric tonnes. Primary quantitative production outcome for the period. Sourced from MineStar payload monitoring or OSIsoft PI belt scale historian.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System; JORC Code

attributes.name: throughput_target_t
attributes.description: Planned or budgeted throughput in dry metric tonnes for this asset during the period. Used for production variance analysis and OEE Performance Rate benchmarking against mine plan.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: total_units_produced
attributes.description: Total count of production units (e.g., haul cycles completed, tonnes crushed, loads dispatched) achieved during the period. Used in Performance Rate and Quality Rate calculations. Sourced from MineStar dispatch or OSIsoft PI throughput counters.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: unplanned_downtime_hrs
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was unavailable due to unplanned breakdowns, mechanical failures, or unscheduled stoppages during the period. Key driver of Availability Rate degradation. Sourced from Infor EAM work order records.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Management; ISO 22400-2; ICMM OEE Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this OEE record was most recently modified, including reconciliation updates, corrections, or status changes. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake

products.name: downtime_event
products.description: Records each individual equipment downtime event including unplanned breakdowns, planned maintenance windows, standby, and weather delays. Captures start and end timestamps, downtime category, downtime reason code, responsible crew, and impact on production. Used to calculate MTBF and MTTR and to drive maintenance prioritisation.
products.reference: MineStar Equipment Health / Infor EAM Downtime

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment downtime event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order / Downtime Event Entity

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific piece of mining fleet or fixed plant equipment (e.g., haul truck, drill, shovel, conveyor) that experienced the downtime event. Sourced from Infor EAM asset register and Caterpillar MineStar.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Asset Register; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Equipment downtime during commissioning and ramp-up phases impacts project schedules and handover readiness. Business process: commissioning performance tracking, defect management, and project milest

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.corrective_action. Business justification: Equipment downtime events (especially safety-related failures) trigger corrective actions to prevent recurrence and improve reliability. This captures the HSE continuous improvement cycle. While work_

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Downtime events have direct cost implications (lost production, maintenance costs) that must be allocated to cost centres for variance analysis and cost performance reporting in mining operations.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift crew or maintenance team responsible for managing or responding to this downtime event. Used for crew-level performance analysis and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Crew / Shift Assignment; Infor EAM

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident ID
attributes.description: Reference to the associated HSE incident record in IsoMetrix when is_safety_related is True. Links the downtime event to the formal safety investigation and regulatory reporting workflow. Null when no safety incident is associated.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix — HSE Incident Management; ISO 45001; MSHA

attributes.name: primary_downtime_reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (operator, supervisor, or maintenance technician) who initially reported or logged the downtime event. Supports accountability tracking and communication workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Employee Master; Infor EAM — Notification Originator

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Unplanned downtime repairs often trigger emergency parts procurement; linking downtime events to purchase orders enables cost tracking, procurement response time analysis, and maintenance cost allocat

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which the downtime event commenced. Used to analyse downtime distribution across day, afternoon, and night shifts and to support crew performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Shift Schedule; Caterpillar MineStar Dispatch

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the downtime event occurred (e.g., open pit, underground, processing plant).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Plant / Functional Location; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: tertiary_downtime_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or maintenance superintendent who approved the closure of this downtime event and the return of the equipment to service. Supports governance, audit trail, and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Approval; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 55000 (Asset Management Governance)

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Infor EAM maintenance work order raised in response to or associated with this downtime event. Null for non-maintenance downtime categories such as weather or standby.

attributes.name: actual_repair_hours
attributes.description: Actual number of labour hours expended to complete the repair or maintenance activity for this downtime event. Recorded upon event closure. Used to calculate Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) and to benchmark against estimated_repair_hours for continuous improvement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Actual Hours; ISO 22400 (MTTR); SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: component_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the specific equipment component or sub-assembly that failed or required attention (e.g., engine assembly, hydraulic pump, front suspension, conveyor idler, crusher liner). Aligned with the equipment Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP S/4HANA MM and Infor EAM component hierarchy.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Component Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA MM — Bill of Materials (BOM); ISO 14224

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the specific equipment component or sub-assembly that failed or was serviced during this downtime event. Complements component_code with a plain-language label for reporting and communication purposes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Component Description; SAP S/4HANA MM BOM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this downtime event record was first created in the source system (Infor EAM or Caterpillar MineStar) and ingested into the silver layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Record Audit; Caterpillar MineStar; ISO 55000

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the maintenance_cost field (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Supports multi-currency operations across international mine sites.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the downtime event was first detected. Operator_report indicates the equipment operator raised the fault. SCADA_alarm indicates detection via OSIsoft PI System or PLC alarm. FMS_alert indicates detection via Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System. Condition_monitoring indicates detection via predictive maintenance sensors. Scheduled_inspection indicates detection during a planned inspection round. Third_party_report indicates detection reported by a contractor or external party.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System (SCADA); Infor EAM — Condition Monitoring

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the downtime event type. Unplanned breakdown indicates an unexpected mechanical or electrical failure. Planned maintenance covers scheduled preventive or corrective maintenance windows. Standby covers equipment waiting for work assignment. Weather delay covers stoppages due to adverse environmental conditions. Operational delay covers delays caused by operational constraints such as blasting exclusion zones. Process delay covers upstream or downstream process bottlenecks.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Downtime Category; ISO 22400 (OEE Definitions); Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: downtime_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised reason code identifying the specific cause of the downtime event (e.g., engine failure, tyre change, hydraulic leak, conveyor belt tear, electrical fault). Sourced from Infor EAM failure code library and Caterpillar MineStar reason code catalogue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine_failure|tyre_change|hydraulic_leak|conveyor_belt_tear|electrical_fault|structural_damage|operator_error|fuel_system|cooling_system|brake_system — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Failure Code Library; Caterpillar MineStar Reason Codes; ISO 14224 (Reliability Data Collection)

attributes.name: downtime_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record. Open indicates the event has been logged but resolution has not commenced. In_progress indicates maintenance or corrective action is underway. Resolved indicates the equipment has been returned to service. Cancelled indicates the event was logged in error. Pending_approval indicates the event record is awaiting supervisory sign-off.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Status; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed duration of the downtime event expressed in whole minutes, calculated as the difference between end_timestamp and start_timestamp. Stored as a business field to support direct reporting and MTTR calculations without requiring timestamp arithmetic at query time. Null if end_timestamp is not yet recorded.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 — Mean Time To Repair (MTTR); Infor EAM; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the equipment was returned to operational service and the downtime event concluded. Null if the event is still open or in progress. Used in conjunction with start_timestamp to calculate actual downtime duration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar — Equipment Health; Infor EAM; ISO 22400

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event resulted in or had the potential to cause an environmental impact (e.g., hydraulic fluid spill, dust emission exceedance, tailings pump failure). True triggers environmental notification and reporting obligations under ISO 14001 and site Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) conditions.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix — Environmental Monitoring; ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Systems); EIS Conditions

attributes.name: estimated_repair_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of labour hours required to complete the repair or maintenance activity associated with this downtime event, as assessed at the time of event creation. Used for maintenance scheduling, resource planning, and comparison against actual repair duration to improve future estimates.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Estimated Hours; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the downtime event as recorded by the operator or maintenance technician at the time of reporting. Captures contextual details not covered by structured fields, including observed symptoms, environmental conditions, and initial diagnosis. Sourced from Infor EAM notification text or Caterpillar MineStar operator notes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Notification Long Text; Caterpillar MineStar Operator Notes

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the downtime event, formatted as DT-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used for cross-referencing with Infor EAM work orders, MineStar dispatch logs, and SAP PM notifications. Supports traceability across operational systems.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Downtime Notification Reference; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Describes the specific manner in which the equipment failed or the mechanism of the downtime (e.g., fatigue fracture, corrosion, overheating, wear, contamination, misalignment). Aligned with ISO 14224 failure mode taxonomy and used in Reliability Centred Maintenance (RCM) analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fatigue_fracture|corrosion|overheating|wear|contamination|misalignment|vibration|leakage|blockage|electrical_short — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14224 — Reliability and Maintenance Data Collection; Infor EAM RCM Module

attributes.name: functional_location_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA PM or Infor EAM functional location code identifying the specific physical location or system hierarchy node where the equipment was positioned at the time of the downtime event (e.g., pit bench, crusher circuit, conveyor section). Supports spatial analysis of downtime patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Functional Location; Infor EAM — Asset Hierarchy

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event was caused by or resulted in a safety incident, near-miss, or equipment condition that posed a risk to personnel. True triggers mandatory notification to the Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) team and may require IsoMetrix incident reporting. Supports Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) and Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix — HSE Incident Management; ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety); MSHA Regulations

attributes.name: maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Total direct cost incurred to resolve this downtime event, including labour, parts, and consumables as captured in Infor EAM and SAP S/4HANA CO. Expressed in the site operating currency. Used for Operating Expenditure (OPEX) tracking, cost-per-hour analysis, and maintenance budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Object; Infor EAM — Work Order Cost; IFRS (Operating Expenditure)

attributes.name: maintenance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance activity associated with this downtime event. Corrective maintenance addresses failures after they occur. Preventive maintenance is time-based scheduled work. Predictive maintenance is triggered by condition monitoring data. Condition-based maintenance is triggered by measured parameter thresholds. Emergency maintenance addresses safety-critical failures requiring immediate response. Null for non-maintenance downtime categories.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Maintenance Type Classification; ISO 14224; ISO 55000 (Asset Management)

attributes.name: oee_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of how this downtime event impacts the Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation. Availability losses arise from unplanned breakdowns and planned maintenance. Performance losses arise from reduced speed or throughput. Quality losses arise from off-spec production. Used to decompose OEE into its three constituent factors for targeted improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 — Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE); Caterpillar MineStar; ICMM

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the downtime event to drive maintenance resource allocation and response urgency. Critical indicates immediate safety or production-stopping impact. High indicates significant production impact requiring same-shift response. Medium indicates moderate impact with next-shift response acceptable. Low indicates minor impact with scheduled response acceptable.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Priority; SAP S/4HANA PM Priority Classification

attributes.name: production_impact_hours
attributes.description: Estimated or actual number of production hours lost as a direct consequence of this downtime event. Accounts for the impact on the production schedule and is used to quantify the effect on Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and Life of Mine (LOM) plan adherence. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar productivity tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar — Productivity Tracking; ISO 22400 (OEE); ICMM Reporting

attributes.name: production_tonnes_lost
attributes.description: Estimated tonnage of ore or material (Run of Mine — ROM) that was not moved or processed as a direct result of this downtime event. Used to quantify the financial and operational impact of equipment unavailability on the mine production schedule.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar — Productivity Tracking; Mine Production Schedule (Deswik/Hexagon MinePlan)

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions taken to resolve the downtime event and return the equipment to service. Recorded by the maintenance technician upon event closure. Supports knowledge management, recurring fault analysis, and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) improvement.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Completion Notes; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: return_to_service_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the equipment was formally cleared and returned to operational service following resolution of the downtime event. May differ from end_timestamp if post-repair inspection or commissioning steps are required before the equipment is released to operations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Work Order Completion; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigation for this downtime event. Not_required for minor or routine events. Pending indicates RCA has been triggered but not yet commenced. In_progress indicates investigation is underway. Completed indicates findings have been documented and corrective actions assigned. Mandatory for critical and high-priority events per site maintenance governance standards.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — RCA Workflow; ISO 14224; ICMM Maintenance Excellence Framework

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift during which the downtime event commenced (day, afternoon, or night). Stored directly on the event to support shift-level reporting without requiring a join to the shift master when shift_id is unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Shift Classification; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the equipment became unavailable or the downtime event commenced. This is the principal real-world event time used for Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) calculations. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar or OSIsoft PI System historian.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar — Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 22400 (MTBF/MTTR)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this downtime event record was most recently modified in the source system or silver layer. Used for change data capture, incremental load processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM — Record Audit; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: related_downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on downtime_event (related_downtime_event_id)

products.name: telemetry_event
products.description: High-frequency telemetry and sensor readings from onboard equipment systems including GPS position, engine hours, speed, payload weight, tyre pressure, hydraulic pressure, fuel level, coolant temperature, and engine RPM. Each record represents a single sensor snapshot or event trigger at sub-minute frequency. Sourced from MineStar, Wenco, Modular Mining, and OSIsoft PI System via SCADA/IoT integration. Supports real-time equipment health monitoring, geofence compliance, predictive maintenance trigger detection, and operator behaviour analysis. Distinct from fuel_consumption which records discrete dispensing events at much lower frequency.
products.reference: MineStar Equipment Health / OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: telemetry_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for telemetry_event

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master equipment or fleet asset record that generated this telemetry event. Links to the equipment master register in the Equipment domain.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the operator assigned to and operating the equipment at the time of this telemetry event. Used for operator behaviour analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which this telemetry event was recorded. Enables shift-level aggregation of equipment performance and utilisation metrics.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the equipment was operating when this telemetry event was captured.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geofence zone in which the equipment was located at the time of the telemetry event. Used for geofence compliance monitoring, blast exclusion zone enforcement, and haulage route adherence.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; GIS (Geographic Information System); MSHA Mine Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by the equipment's external temperature sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Used for equipment performance normalisation and heat stress risk assessment under ISO 45001.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Real-time Monitoring; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: battery_voltage_v
attributes.description: Onboard electrical system battery voltage in volts at the time of the telemetry event. Low voltage readings indicate potential electrical system faults and are used to trigger preventive maintenance actions in Infor EAM.
