attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance

attributes.name: brake_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service brake was applied at the time of the telemetry event. Used for operator behaviour analysis, brake wear monitoring, and safety compliance reporting under ISO 45001.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: coolant_temperature_c
attributes.description: Engine coolant temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of the telemetry event. A critical health indicator; values exceeding thresholds trigger predictive maintenance alerts and potential equipment shutdown.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System Real-time Monitoring

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assessment flag applied during silver layer processing to indicate the reliability of this telemetry record. Suspect or invalid records may result from sensor malfunction, communication dropout, or out-of-range values. Used to filter records in analytics and predictive maintenance models.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Altitude of the equipment above mean sea level in metres at the time of the telemetry event. Used for bench-level positioning, grade resistance calculations, and mine design alignment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative engine operating hours recorded on the equipment odometer at the time of this telemetry event. Primary driver for preventive maintenance scheduling and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) calculations in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance; MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)

attributes.name: engine_load_pct
attributes.description: Engine load as a percentage of maximum rated capacity at the time of the telemetry event. Indicates whether the equipment is operating within design parameters. Used for OEE and fuel consumption analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)

attributes.name: engine_rpm
attributes.description: Instantaneous engine speed in revolutions per minute at the time of the telemetry event. Used for engine load analysis, fuel efficiency monitoring, and predictive maintenance trigger detection.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: equipment_status
attributes.description: The operational state of the equipment at the moment of this telemetry event as reported by the Fleet Management System (FMS). Supports Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and utilisation calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating|idle|standby|down|tramming|loading|dumping — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) at which the sensor snapshot or event trigger was recorded by the onboard telematics system. Sub-minute frequency. This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from ingestion audit timestamps.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the nature of the telemetry event. Periodic snapshots are time-driven; threshold breach, engine, geofence, payload, and fault code events are trigger-driven. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: periodic_snapshot|threshold_breach|engine_event|geofence_event|payload_event|fault_code_event — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: fault_code
attributes.description: Diagnostic fault or alarm code generated by the equipment's onboard diagnostic system (OBD/J1939) at the time of the event. Null for periodic snapshots with no active fault. Used to trigger work orders in Infor EAM and predictive maintenance workflows.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Work Orders; SAE J1939 Diagnostic Standard

attributes.name: fault_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the fault code raised at the time of this telemetry event. Critical and high severity faults may trigger immediate equipment shutdown or dispatch of maintenance crew. Null when no fault is active.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAE J1939

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_rate_lph
attributes.description: Instantaneous fuel burn rate in litres per hour as reported by the onboard fuel flow sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Used for OPEX (Operating Expenditure) monitoring and All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) calculations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost); OPEX (Operating Expenditure)

attributes.name: fuel_level_pct
attributes.description: Current fuel tank level expressed as a percentage of total tank capacity at the time of the telemetry event. Used for fuel management, dispatch planning, and refuelling schedule optimisation. Distinct from discrete fuel dispensing events recorded in fuel_consumption.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: geofence_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment was in breach of an active geofence boundary at the time of this telemetry event. True when the equipment has entered a restricted or exclusion zone without authorisation. Supports safety compliance and HSE reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; IsoMetrix HSE Incident Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Compass bearing of the equipment direction of travel in degrees (0–360) at the time of the telemetry event. Used for directional analysis and geofence zone entry/exit detection.

attributes.name: hydraulic_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Hydraulic system pressure in kilopascals at the time of the telemetry event. Used for monitoring hydraulic system health on shovels, drills, and haul trucks. Anomalies indicate potential hydraulic failure.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this telemetry record was received and loaded into the lakehouse silver layer from the source system (MineStar, Wenco, Modular Mining, or OSIsoft PI). Used for data latency monitoring and pipeline audit.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal degrees latitude of the equipment position at the time of the telemetry event. Sourced from onboard GPS unit. Used for geofence compliance, haulage route analysis, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; GIS (Geographic Information System); WGS84

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal degrees longitude of the equipment position at the time of the telemetry event. Sourced from onboard GPS unit. Used for geofence compliance, haulage route analysis, and GIS integration.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; GIS (Geographic Information System); WGS84

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Cumulative distance travelled by the equipment in kilometres as recorded on the onboard odometer at the time of the telemetry event. Used for tyre life management, component replacement scheduling, and haulage distance reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: payload_weight_t
attributes.description: Instantaneous payload weight in metric tonnes as measured by the onboard payload monitoring system at the time of the telemetry event. Used for haulage productivity analysis, truck factor compliance, and ROM (Run of Mine) tonnage tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; ROM (Run of Mine)

attributes.name: signal_quality
attributes.description: Quality classification of the wireless or satellite communication signal at the time the telemetry event was transmitted. Used to assess data reliability and identify underground or remote areas with poor connectivity.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system or IoT integration platform that produced this telemetry event record. Supports data lineage and multi-source reconciliation across MineStar, Wenco, Modular Mining, and OSIsoft PI.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; SCADA Integration

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: Instantaneous travel speed of the equipment in kilometres per hour at the time of the telemetry event. Used for speed limit compliance monitoring, operator behaviour analysis, and haulage cycle time analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; MSHA Mine Safety and Health Administration speed compliance

attributes.name: transmission_gear
attributes.description: Current transmission gear position of the equipment at the time of the telemetry event. Used for operator behaviour analysis, ramp grade compliance, and drivetrain health monitoring.

attributes.name: tyre_pressure_front_left_kpa
attributes.description: Tyre pressure of the front-left tyre in kilopascals at the time of the telemetry event. Tyre pressure monitoring is critical for haul truck safety and tyre life management on large mining vehicles.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: tyre_pressure_front_right_kpa
attributes.description: Tyre pressure of the front-right tyre in kilopascals at the time of the telemetry event. Tyre pressure monitoring is critical for haul truck safety and tyre life management on large mining vehicles.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: tyre_pressure_rear_left_kpa
attributes.description: Tyre pressure of the rear-left tyre in kilopascals at the time of the telemetry event. Rear tyres on haul trucks carry the majority of loaded payload weight and are subject to higher wear and failure risk.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: tyre_pressure_rear_right_kpa
attributes.description: Tyre pressure of the rear-right tyre in kilopascals at the time of the telemetry event. Rear tyres on haul trucks carry the majority of loaded payload weight and are subject to higher wear and failure risk.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

products.name: fuel_consumption
products.description: Records discrete fuel dispensing events and periodic fuel usage measurements per asset. Each record represents a single refuelling transaction or shift-end fuel measurement. Captures fuel type (diesel, LNG, biodiesel blend), quantity dispensed in litres, fuel burn rate (L/hr), odometer or engine hours at fill, dispensing location (fuel bay, field refuelling), tank truck ID, and operator. Sourced from MineStar, Fuel Management Systems (FMS), and tank farm SCADA. Used for OPEX cost allocation to fleet, C1 cash cost per tonne reporting, carbon emissions accounting (Scope 1), and fuel theft detection.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fuel dispensing event or shift-end fuel measurement record in the silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP cost centre to which the fuel cost is allocated. Supports OPEX cost allocation to fleet and C1 cash cost per tonne reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator or driver who was assigned to the asset at the time of the fuelling event. Used for operator-level fuel efficiency analysis and accountability.

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Fuel spills during dispensing are reportable environmental incidents. Fuel transactions involved in spills, overfills, or contamination events must link to the incident record for regulatory reporting

attributes.name: primary_fuel_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining fleet or fixed plant asset (haul truck, drill, shovel, dozer, etc.) that consumed the fuel. Links to the equipment master register in the equipment domain.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Fuel transactions reference bulk fuel purchase orders (contracts with fuel suppliers); linking enables reconciliation of dispensed fuel against contracted supply, invoice verification, and fuel cost a

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which the fuelling event occurred. Enables shift-level fuel cost allocation and OPEX reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Fuel consumed during capital development projects (mine construction, infrastructure) is capitalized and tracked against WBS elements for project cost control and capitalization accounting.

attributes.name: anomaly_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason the transaction was flagged as an anomaly (e.g., 'Quantity exceeds tank capacity', 'Location outside mine boundary', 'Duplicate transaction within 30 minutes'). Populated only when is_anomaly_flagged is True.

attributes.name: authorised_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the supervisor or fuel controller who authorised the dispensing event. Required for fuel theft detection controls and audit compliance.

attributes.name: co2e_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Calculated Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions in kilograms of CO2 equivalent for this fuel consumption event, derived by applying the applicable emissions factor for the fuel type to the quantity dispensed. Used for GRI and ICMM carbon reporting.
attributes.references: GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ICMM; ISO 14001; GHG Protocol Scope 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel consumption record was first created in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of data pipeline latency.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the fuel cost amounts (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Required for multi-jurisdiction mining operations where fuel is procured in different currencies.

attributes.name: dispensing_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location where fuel was dispensed (fuel bay, ROM pad field refuelling point, tank farm). Links to the site location master.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: dispensing_method
attributes.description: Physical method by which fuel was delivered to the asset: fixed_bay (permanent fuel bay infrastructure), bowser (mobile tank truck field refuelling), drum (manual drum dispensing for remote equipment), or pipeline (direct pipeline connection at processing plant).
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: emissions_factor_kg_per_litre
attributes.description: The greenhouse gas emissions factor applied to this transaction, in kg CO2e per litre, specific to the fuel type. Captured at transaction time to preserve the factor version used for regulatory reporting and audit purposes.
attributes.references: GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ICMM; ISO 14001; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: engine_hours_at_fill
attributes.description: Cumulative engine hours recorded on the asset at the time of the fuelling event. Used to calculate fuel consumption per engine hour, track MTBF intervals, and schedule preventive maintenance in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; Infor EAM; MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)

attributes.name: fuel_burn_rate_l_per_hr
attributes.description: Instantaneous or average fuel consumption rate in litres per engine hour at the time of the fuelling event or measurement period. Sourced from MineStar telematics. Used for OEE analysis and fleet fuel efficiency benchmarking.

attributes.name: fuel_docket_number
attributes.description: Physical or electronic docket/receipt number issued at the point of dispensing. Used for three-way reconciliation between FMS records, physical dockets, and SAP purchase orders.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi Procurement; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel dispensed: diesel (standard ultra-low sulphur diesel), LNG (liquefied natural gas for LNG-powered haul trucks), biodiesel B20 blend (20% biodiesel), biodiesel B100 (pure biodiesel), or HVO (hydrotreated vegetable oil). Drives emissions factor selection for Scope 1 carbon accounting.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ICMM

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal latitude of the fuelling event location as recorded by MineStar telematics or the FMS. Used for GIS-based fuel consumption heat mapping and field refuelling route optimisation.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: WGS84 decimal longitude of the fuelling event location as recorded by MineStar telematics or the FMS. Used in conjunction with gps_latitude for spatial analysis of fuel consumption patterns.

attributes.name: is_anomaly_flagged
attributes.description: Boolean flag set to True when the fuel transaction has been identified as a potential anomaly by automated detection rules (e.g., quantity dispensed exceeds tank capacity, fill rate outside normal range, location mismatch). Triggers investigation workflow for fuel theft detection.

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the mine site where the fuelling event occurred (e.g., PILBARA-01, HUNTER-VALLEY-02). Supports multi-site OPEX reporting and C1 cash cost benchmarking across operations.

attributes.name: odometer_km_at_fill
attributes.description: Cumulative distance travelled in kilometres recorded on the asset at the time of the fuelling event. Applicable to mobile fleet (haul trucks, light vehicles). Null for fixed plant or tracked equipment without odometers.

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed_litres
attributes.description: Volume of fuel dispensed during this transaction, measured in litres to three decimal places. The primary quantitative fact for OPEX cost allocation, C1 cash cost per tonne calculation, and Scope 1 emissions accounting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or transaction identifier from the originating source system (MineStar, FMS, PI System, or Infor EAM). Retained for data lineage, deduplication, and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; Infor EAM

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this fuel consumption record was ingested: MineStar Fleet Management, a standalone Fuel Management System (FMS), OSIsoft PI System SCADA, Infor EAM, or manual entry. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; Infor EAM

attributes.name: tank_capacity_litres
attributes.description: Maximum rated fuel tank capacity of the asset in litres. Used to calculate fill percentage and validate that dispensed quantity does not exceed physical tank capacity.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: tank_level_after_litres
attributes.description: Fuel level in the asset's onboard tank immediately after the dispensing event, in litres. Used with tank_level_before_litres to validate dispensed quantity and detect discrepancies indicative of fuel theft.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: tank_level_before_litres
attributes.description: Fuel level in the asset's onboard tank immediately before the dispensing event, in litres. Used with tank_level_after_litres to validate dispensed quantity and detect fuel theft or leakage anomalies.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System SCADA Integration

attributes.name: total_fuel_cost
attributes.description: Total monetary cost of fuel dispensed in this transaction (quantity_dispensed_litres × unit_cost_per_litre), in the site operating currency. Used for OPEX cost allocation to fleet and C1 cash cost per tonne reporting. Note: this is a transaction-level cost capture, not a derived aggregate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; IFRS; OPEX (Operating Expenditure); C1 (C1 Cash Cost)

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned by the Fuel Management System (FMS) or MineStar to identify this dispensing event or measurement. Used for reconciliation with source systems and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the fuel transaction record. Confirmed transactions are included in OPEX and emissions reporting. Voided or disputed records are excluded from cost allocation until resolved.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the fuel dispensing event commenced or the shift-end measurement was recorded. This is the principal real-world event time used for time-series analysis and Scope 1 emissions accounting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; OSIsoft PI System; ISO 14001

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the fuel record: a discrete refuelling event at a fuel bay (refuel), a periodic shift-end fuel measurement (shift_measurement), a manual tank dip reading (tank_dip), a field refuelling by bowser (field_refuel), or a bulk fuel transfer between storage tanks (bulk_transfer).

attributes.name: unit_cost_per_litre
attributes.description: Contracted or spot price paid per litre of fuel at the time of the transaction, in the site operating currency. Confidential commercial pricing data. Used for OPEX cost allocation and C1 cash cost per tonne calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi Procurement; AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost); C1 (C1 Cash Cost)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this fuel consumption record in the silver layer. Tracks corrections, status changes, and anomaly flag updates for audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; IFRS; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Infor EAM work order number to which this fuel consumption is charged, if the fuelling is associated with a specific maintenance or operational work order. Enables work-order-level OPEX tracking.

products.name: utilisation_record
products.description: Shift-level or daily utilisation records per asset capturing scheduled hours, operating hours, idle hours, standby hours, and utilisation percentage. Distinguishes physical availability from utilisation to support fleet sizing decisions and LOM planning. Sourced from MineStar FMS and reconciled against shift reports.

attributes.name: utilisation_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shift-level or daily utilisation record. Primary key for the utilisation_record data product in the equipment domain.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining fleet or fixed plant asset (e.g., haul truck, drill, shovel, conveyor) for which this utilisation record applies. Sourced from Infor EAM asset register.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Equipment utilization hours drive cost allocation to cost centres for mining cost accounting, unit cost calculation, and AISC reporting. Essential for cost per tonne analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary equipment operator assigned to the asset during this shift or utilisation period. Sourced from MineStar operator assignment records.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Equipment utilisation is tracked per product campaign in multi-product mining operations. Asset performance reporting and production planning require product-segmented utilisation analysis to optimize

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift during which this utilisation record was captured. Links to the shift master for crew, date, and shift-type context.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the asset was deployed during this utilisation period.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the shift supervisor or production controller who approved this utilisation record after reconciliation. Provides accountability for official production reporting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the utilisation record was formally approved by the shift supervisor or production controller. Marks the record as authoritative for inclusion in production and fleet performance reports.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for shift supervisor or production controller notes explaining anomalies, reconciliation adjustments, or contextual information about the utilisation record (e.g., blast delay reason, equipment swap details).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this utilisation record was first created in the source system (MineStar FMS or manual entry). Audit trail field for data lineage and reconciliation tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 8601

attributes.name: cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of complete operational cycles (e.g., load-haul-dump cycles for trucks, drill-hole completions for drills) performed by the asset during the period. Used for productivity rate analysis and equipment wear modelling.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: System or method from which this utilisation record was sourced (e.g., MineStar FMS automated telemetry, manual shift report entry, SCADA, OSIsoft PI System). Supports data lineage and quality assessment.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: delay_hours
attributes.description: Hours lost to operational delays not attributable to maintenance (e.g., blast delays, traffic management, shift change, fuelling, operator fatigue breaks). Captured separately to support delay category analysis.

attributes.name: distance_travelled_km
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by the asset during the utilisation period in kilometres, sourced from MineStar GPS telematics. Used for tyre life management, road condition analysis, and haulage productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was unavailable for production due to planned or unplanned maintenance, breakdowns, or inspections. Used in MTBF and MTTR calculations and physical availability reporting.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Total engine-on hours recorded by the asset's onboard telematics during the period. Used for maintenance scheduling, component life tracking, and MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) calculations in Infor EAM.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: fuel_burn_rate_lph
attributes.description: Average fuel consumption rate in litres per operating hour during the period. Benchmarked against OEM specifications to identify engine inefficiency, overloading, or operator behaviour issues.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEM equipment specifications

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: Total volume of diesel or other fuel consumed by the asset during the utilisation period, measured in litres. Used for OPEX (Operating Expenditure) tracking, fuel burn rate benchmarking, and emissions reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OSIsoft PI System; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Hours the asset was powered on and available but not performing productive work (e.g., waiting for trucks, queuing at crusher). Key metric for identifying operational inefficiencies and fleet sizing opportunities.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard

attributes.name: is_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this utilisation record has been reconciled against the corresponding shift report. Unreconciled records are flagged for review before inclusion in official production reporting.

attributes.name: oee_score
attributes.description: Composite OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) score for the asset during the period, expressed as a percentage. Combines availability, performance, and quality dimensions. Sourced from MineStar or calculated during silver layer processing.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard; ICMM Mining Principles

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Actual hours the asset was actively engaged in productive work (e.g., hauling, drilling, loading) during the period. Core numerator for utilisation percentage calculation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard

attributes.name: operating_zone
attributes.description: Mine area or operational zone where the asset was primarily deployed during the period (e.g., pit bench level, ROM pad, processing plant, waste dump). Supports spatial productivity analysis and fleet allocation optimisation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: payload_tonnes
attributes.description: Total material payload moved by the asset during the utilisation period in dry metric tonnes. Applicable to haul trucks and loaders. Key productivity metric for ROM (Run of Mine) material movement tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time marking the end of the utilisation measurement period (shift end or day end). Used with period_start_timestamp to validate that hours components sum correctly.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 8601

attributes.name: period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time marking the beginning of the utilisation measurement period (shift start or day start). Conforms to ISO 8601 with timezone offset for multi-timezone mine operations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 8601

attributes.name: physical_availability_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of scheduled hours during which the asset was mechanically available (not in maintenance downtime). Calculated as ((scheduled_hours - downtime_hours) / scheduled_hours) * 100. Distinct from utilisation — measures mechanical readiness.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM; ISO 14224

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Hours the asset was unavailable due to scheduled preventive maintenance activities. Subset of downtime_hours. Used to distinguish planned versus unplanned downtime for maintenance strategy analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance

attributes.name: primary_delay_category
attributes.description: The dominant category of delay or downtime that most impacted utilisation during the period (e.g., blast exclusion, fuelling, shift change, mechanical breakdown, weather, traffic). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blast_exclusion|fuelling|shift_change|mechanical_breakdown|weather|traffic|operator_fatigue|waiting_for_instructions|road_conditions|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ICMM Mining Principles

attributes.name: reconciliation_variance_hours
attributes.description: Difference in total hours between the MineStar FMS automated record and the manually submitted shift report. Non-zero values trigger investigation. Supports data quality management and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: Calendar date for which this utilisation record applies. Used for daily aggregation, trend analysis, and LOM (Life of Mine) planning.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 8601

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of the utilisation record indicating its data quality and approval state. Records progress from draft through reconciliation against shift reports to approved status.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Infor EAM

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the utilisation record indicating whether it represents a single shift, a daily roll-up, or a weekly summary. Determines the time horizon of the hours captured.

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the asset was scheduled to be available for production during the shift or day, as defined in the mine production schedule. Denominator for physical availability calculations.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: shift_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the paper or digital shift report against which this utilisation record was reconciled. Provides audit traceability between MineStar FMS data and manual shift supervisor records.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift during which utilisation was recorded (e.g., day, night, afternoon, rotating). Supports shift-pattern analysis and crew productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: standby_hours
attributes.description: Hours the asset was available and ready for deployment but not assigned to a task (e.g., awaiting operator, weather hold, blast exclusion zone). Distinguishes planned non-productive time from idle time.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard

attributes.name: unplanned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Hours the asset was unavailable due to unexpected breakdowns or corrective maintenance. Subset of downtime_hours. High values indicate reliability issues and drive MTBF and MTTR analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14224 Reliability and Maintenance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this utilisation record was last modified, including reconciliation adjustments or corrections. Supports change tracking and silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; ISO 8601

attributes.name: use_of_availability_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of operating hours to available hours (scheduled minus downtime), expressed as a percentage. Measures how effectively the operations team uses the mechanically available asset. Complements physical availability to form the OEE framework.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard

attributes.name: utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of operating hours to scheduled hours expressed as a percentage. Primary KPI for fleet productivity and LOM (Life of Mine) planning. Calculated as (operating_hours / scheduled_hours) * 100.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) standard; ICMM Mining Principles

products.name: payload_cycle
products.description: Individual truck payload cycle records capturing each load-haul-dump cycle for haul trucks and loaders. Includes load location, dump location, payload weight (tonnes), cycle time, queue time, travel time, and operator. Sourced from MineStar Payload Management. Used for haulage productivity analysis and ROM tonnage reconciliation.

attributes.name: payload_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual truck payload cycle record (load-haul-dump event) as captured by Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Haulage cycles generate costs allocated to cost centres based on material type (ore, waste) and destination for mining cost accounting and cost per tonne reporting.

attributes.name: dump_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination location where the truck dumped its load during this cycle (e.g., ROM pad, crusher, waste dump, stockpile). Links to the mine operations location master.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator (employee) who performed this payload cycle, linking to the workforce domain for operator performance analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: load_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the spatial location (bench, face, or dig block) where the truck was loaded during this cycle, linking to the mine operations location or mining block master.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: primary_payload_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the haul truck or loader asset that performed this payload cycle, linking to the equipment master register in the equipment domain.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Each haul cycle transports a specific saleable product. Production reconciliation, grade control, and stockpile accounting require product-level cycle tracking. Material_type and commodity are denorma

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this payload cycle was executed, enabling shift-level productivity aggregation and ROM tonnage reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payload cycle record was first created in the data platform, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the payload cycle was completed, typically recorded as the moment the truck completed the dump and cleared the dump point in MineStar.

attributes.name: cycle_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned by MineStar Payload Management to uniquely identify this load-haul-dump cycle for cross-system reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: cycle_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the payload cycle commenced, typically recorded as the moment the truck arrived at the load point or the loading sequence began in MineStar.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payload cycle record. Completed indicates a full load-haul-dump sequence was executed. Partial indicates the cycle was interrupted. Aborted indicates the cycle was terminated before dump. Cancelled indicates the cycle was voided.

attributes.name: cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time for the complete load-haul-dump cycle in minutes, from arrival at the load point to completion of the dump. Sourced from MineStar cycle time tracking. Key input for haulage productivity analysis and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; OEE Standard

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality status of this payload cycle record as assessed during ingestion into the Silver layer. Valid indicates the record passed all quality checks. Suspect indicates anomalies detected (e.g., payload outside expected range). Invalid indicates the record failed quality checks. Corrected indicates the record was manually reviewed and adjusted.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; JORC Code 2012 Data Quality

attributes.name: dump_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or code of the dump destination (e.g., ROM Pad 1, Primary Crusher, Waste Dump North, Stockpile A). Used for material routing analysis and ROM tonnage reconciliation.

attributes.name: dump_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes taken to complete the dump operation at the dump point during this cycle, from arrival at the dump to departure. Used to identify dump point congestion and assess dump efficiency.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: Volume of diesel fuel consumed in litres during this payload cycle as recorded by the truck's on-board fuel monitoring system integrated with MineStar. Used for fuel cost allocation, OPEX tracking, and carbon emissions reporting.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; ISO 14001

attributes.name: haul_distance_empty_m
attributes.description: Distance in metres travelled by the truck empty from the dump point back to the load point during this cycle, as recorded by MineStar GPS/telematics. Used for total cycle distance calculation and fuel consumption analysis.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; GIS Standards

attributes.name: haul_distance_loaded_m
attributes.description: Distance in metres travelled by the truck from the load point to the dump point while carrying a full load during this cycle, as recorded by MineStar GPS/telematics. Used for haulage cost modelling and route optimisation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; GIS Standards

attributes.name: haul_time_loaded_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes the truck spent travelling from the load point to the dump point while carrying a full load during this cycle. Used for haulage route analysis and cycle time optimisation.

attributes.name: load_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or code of the load point where the truck was loaded (e.g., pit bench designation, dig block identifier, ROM pad zone). Used for spatial haulage analysis and ore source tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: load_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes taken to load the truck at the dig face or load point during this cycle, from first bucket to last bucket. Used to assess loader productivity and number of passes per load.

attributes.name: minestar_cycle_code
attributes.description: The native cycle identifier assigned by Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management system at the source. Retained for traceability and reconciliation back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: number_of_passes
attributes.description: The number of bucket or dipper passes (swings) made by the loading unit to fill the truck to the target payload during this cycle. Used to assess loader efficiency and optimise pass-matching strategy.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the equipment operator who performed this payload cycle as recorded in MineStar at the time of the cycle. Retained for operational reporting and shift reconciliation where the operator ID may not be immediately resolvable.

attributes.name: ore_grade_indicator
attributes.description: The estimated or assigned grade classification of the material hauled in this cycle (e.g., high-grade, medium-grade, low-grade, cut-off-grade) as determined by the grade control model at the time of loading. Used for ore quality tracking and mill feed grade management.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: overload_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the truck was loaded beyond its rated payload capacity (overloaded) during this cycle as determined by MineStar payload monitoring. True indicates an overload event. Used for truck health monitoring, tyre management, and compliance with OEM load limits.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: payload_measurement_method
attributes.description: The method used to measure the payload weight for this cycle. Onboard scale uses the truck's integrated weighing system. Strut pressure uses suspension strut pressure sensors. Load cell uses a fixed weighbridge. Estimated indicates a calculated value. Manual indicates a manually entered value. Affects data quality confidence for ROM reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: payload_variance_tonnes
attributes.description: The difference between the actual payload weight and the target payload weight in metric tonnes (actual minus target). Positive values indicate overloading; negative values indicate underloading. Used for truck health monitoring and haulage efficiency analysis. Note: this is a raw recorded field from MineStar, not a derived KPI.

attributes.name: payload_weight_tonnes
attributes.description: The measured weight of material loaded onto the truck during this cycle, expressed in metric tonnes as recorded by the on-board payload measurement system (OBMS) in MineStar. This is the principal quantitative fact for the cycle and the primary input to ROM tonnage reconciliation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this payload cycle was executed, used for daily production reporting, ROM tonnage reconciliation against the Life of Mine (LOM) plan, and shift-based aggregation.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; JORC Code 2012; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes the truck spent waiting in queue at the load point before loading commenced during this cycle. Used to identify loader bottlenecks, optimise truck-shovel matching, and reduce non-productive time.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; Fleet Management System (FMS)

attributes.name: return_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes the truck spent travelling empty from the dump point back to the load point during this cycle. Used for haulage route analysis and cycle time component breakdown.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production shift during which this cycle occurred (day, night, or afternoon). Used for shift-comparative productivity analysis and fatigue risk management.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: target_payload_tonnes
attributes.description: The planned or nominal target payload weight in metric tonnes for this truck model and material type as configured in MineStar. Used to calculate payload variance and assess overloading or underloading against truck rated capacity.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Payload Management; OEM Truck Specifications

attributes.name: truck_fleet_number
attributes.description: Human-readable fleet identification number assigned to the haul truck or loader (e.g., HT-042, LD-017) as registered in the Fleet Management System (FMS). Used for operational reporting and shift reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payload cycle record was last modified in the data platform, used for change tracking and incremental data processing.

products.name: drill_activity
products.description: Records individual drill rig activity events including drill hole collar position, hole depth, penetration rate (m/hr), bit type, drill pattern reference, rock hardness index, and drill status. Sourced from MineStar and drill monitoring systems. Supports drill-and-blast planning and geology grade control integration.

attributes.name: drill_activity_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual drill rig activity event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the drill_activity data product.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drill rig asset record in the equipment master register. Links this activity to the specific drill rig (e.g., rotary blast hole drill, DTH drill) that performed the activity.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Drilling operations target specific commodities (gold, iron ore, coal). Geological reporting, resource estimation, and mine planning require commodity linkage for drill activities. Essential for explo

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Drilling activities (production or development) are costed to specific cost centres for mine cost accounting, metres drilled cost analysis, and AISC calculation.

attributes.name: drill_hole_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual drill hole associated with this activity, as assigned in the drill pattern or geology system. Used to link drill activity to assay results, blast design, and geological models.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: drill_pattern_id
attributes.description: Reference to the drill pattern design record that governs the spatial layout, burden, spacing, and sub-drill parameters for this activity. Sourced from Hexagon MinePlan or Deswik drill-and-blast design.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: mining_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining block or bench where this drill activity occurred. Supports grade control integration and production reconciliation against the mine plan.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Geology Modeling; Geovia GEMS Mine Design

attributes.name: operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the drill rig operator who performed this activity. Used for workforce productivity tracking, competency compliance, and shift attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Drilling operations require activity-specific risk assessments covering ground conditions, blast proximity, overhead services, and geotechnical hazards. Each drill activity must reference its governin

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift record during which this drill activity was performed. Enables shift-based production reporting and operator attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Drilling activities occur within specific tenement boundaries and directly contribute to statutory expenditure commitments. Real mining operations must report drilling meterage and costs by tenement f

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Development drilling for mine construction or expansion is capitalized and tracked against capital project WBS elements for project cost control and capitalization accounting.

attributes.name: activity_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the drill rig completed the activity event. Used to calculate activity duration and productive drilling time per shift.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: activity_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the drill activity event, sourced from MineStar or the drill monitoring system. Used for cross-system traceability and drill-and-blast planning references.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: activity_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the drill rig commenced the activity event (e.g., start of collar setup, start of drilling). Principal real-world event timestamp sourced from MineStar telemetry.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: activity_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the drill activity event. Tracks progression from planned through execution to completion or cancellation. Used for real-time production monitoring and drill-and-blast scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the drill activity by its operational purpose. Distinguishes blast hole drilling from grade control, geotechnical, exploration, and dewatering activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blast_hole|pre_split|grade_control|geotechnical|exploration|dewatering — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: actual_depth_m
attributes.description: The actual total depth drilled in metres for this activity, as recorded by the drill monitoring system or MineStar. Compared against planned depth to assess drill execution accuracy and identify refusal or over-drill events.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: air_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: The average air pressure applied during drilling in kilopascals, sourced from drill monitoring sensors or OSIsoft PI historian. Used for DTH and rotary drill performance analysis and equipment health monitoring.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: bench_level
attributes.description: The mine bench level designation where this drill activity was performed (e.g., 'BL_1050', 'RL_980'). Used for spatial organisation of drill activities within the open pit or underground mine design.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: bit_serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number of the specific drill bit used during this activity. Enables bit life tracking, wear analysis, and consumable cost allocation per hole or per shift.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: bit_type
attributes.description: The type of drill bit used during this activity. Bit type selection is driven by rock hardness, hole diameter, and drilling method. Impacts penetration rate, bit life, and consumable cost tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: collar_easting_m
attributes.description: Easting coordinate (X) of the drill hole collar position in metres, referenced to the mine grid coordinate system. Critical for spatial integration with GIS, geological models, and blast design.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; GIS Geographic Information System; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: collar_elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation (Z) of the drill hole collar position in metres above sea level or mine datum. Used for bench level verification, sub-drill calculation, and geological model integration.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: collar_northing_m
attributes.description: Northing coordinate (Y) of the drill hole collar position in metres, referenced to the mine grid coordinate system. Used for spatial positioning in geological models and blast pattern verification.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; GIS Geographic Information System; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drill activity record was first captured in the system of record. Audit trail field for data lineage and silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; IFRS International Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: deviation_from_plan_m
attributes.description: The measured deviation of the actual drill hole collar position from the planned collar position in metres. Indicates drill execution accuracy and is used for blast design quality assurance and fragmentation outcome prediction.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: drill_method
attributes.description: The drilling method employed for this activity. Rotary and DTH (Down-The-Hole) are common for blast hole drilling; RC (Reverse Circulation) and diamond core are used for grade control and exploration. Drives equipment selection and cost classification.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee; NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Standards

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_litres
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the drill rig during this activity in litres. Sourced from MineStar fuel management or onboard sensors. Used for OPEX tracking, carbon emissions reporting, and equipment efficiency benchmarking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: hole_azimuth_deg
attributes.description: The azimuth bearing of the drill hole in degrees from true north. Used in conjunction with inclination to define the 3D trajectory of the hole for blast design and geological logging.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling

attributes.name: hole_diameter_mm
attributes.description: The diameter of the drill hole in millimetres. Determines explosive charge capacity, blast fragmentation outcomes, and is a key parameter in blast design and drill bit selection.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: hole_inclination_deg
attributes.description: The inclination angle of the drill hole from vertical in degrees. Angled holes are used in pre-split and controlled blasting designs. Sourced from drill monitoring system or survey.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: is_sample_collected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a drill chip or core sample was collected during this activity for assay or geological logging. When true, a corresponding sample record should exist in the LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System).
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee; NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Standards

attributes.name: metres_drilled
attributes.description: Total metres drilled during this activity event. A primary production quantity metric for drill rig productivity reporting, shift targets, and LOM (Life of Mine) progress tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design

attributes.name: penetration_rate_m_per_hr
attributes.description: The rate at which the drill bit advances through rock, measured in metres per hour. A key productivity metric for drill rig performance benchmarking, bit selection optimisation, and rock hardness inference.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian

attributes.name: pit_name
attributes.description: The name or code of the open pit, underground stope area, or mine section where this drill activity was performed. Supports spatial aggregation of drill productivity by mine area.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Geovia GEMS Mine Design

attributes.name: planned_depth_m
attributes.description: The designed total depth of the drill hole in metres as specified in the drill pattern or blast design. Used for variance analysis against actual drilled depth and drill-and-blast planning.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: pulldown_force_kn
attributes.description: The average pulldown (crowd) force applied to the drill bit in kilonewtons during this activity. Influences penetration rate, bit wear, and rock hardness index calculation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: refusal_depth_m
attributes.description: The depth in metres at which the drill rig encountered refusal (inability to advance further due to extremely hard rock or obstruction). Null if no refusal occurred. Used for geotechnical assessment and blast design adjustment.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan Mine Design; Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling

attributes.name: rock_hardness_index
attributes.description: A numeric index representing the hardness of the rock encountered during drilling, derived from drill monitoring parameters (e.g., specific energy, penetration rate, rotary torque). Used for geology grade control integration, blast design optimisation, and comminution planning.
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; Hexagon MinePlan Geology Modeling; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: rock_type
attributes.description: Geological classification of the dominant rock type encountered during drilling (e.g., fresh rock, transitional, oxide, sulphide, waste, ore). Sourced from geological logging or drill monitoring inference. Supports grade control and blast design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fresh|transitional|oxide|sulphide|waste|ore|overburden|gangue — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Geovia GEMS Geological Modeling; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee; Hexagon MinePlan Geology Modeling

attributes.name: rotary_speed_rpm
attributes.description: The average rotary speed of the drill string in revolutions per minute during this activity. A key operational parameter for drill performance optimisation and rock hardness inference.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: sample_reference
attributes.description: The sample identifier assigned to the drill chip or core sample collected during this activity, as registered in LabWare LIMS. Enables traceability between drill activity and assay results for grade control and resource estimation.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; JORC Joint Ore Reserves Committee

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this drill activity record was sourced. Supports data lineage, quality assessment, and silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; OSIsoft PI System Process Data Historian; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drill activity record was last modified in the source system or silver layer. Supports incremental load detection and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: water_encountered
attributes.description: Indicates whether groundwater or surface water was encountered during drilling. Relevant for blast hole charging decisions, dewatering planning, and geotechnical risk assessment.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix HSE Incident Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: preceding_drill_activity_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on drill_activity (preceding_drill_activity_id)

products.name: inspection
products.description: Pre-start and periodic equipment inspection records completed by operators, maintainers, and supervisors as required by mining safety regulations (e.g., WHS Act, MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57). Captures inspection type (pre-start, periodic, post-incident, statutory), checklist items per equipment class, defect findings with photo evidence references, severity rating (critical/major/minor), pass/fail status, corrective action required flag, and inspector identity with competency verification. Critical for regulatory compliance — pre-start inspections are legally mandated before equipment operation in most mining jurisdictions. Linked to HSE incident workflows and maintenance work order generation. Sourced from IsoMetrix, Infor EAM, and mobile inspection apps.

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment inspection record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete, lifecycle-managed business event (pre-start or periodic inspection) with regulatory standing.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset (haul truck, drill, shovel, conveyor, processing plant unit, etc.) that was inspected. Links to the equipment master register sourced from Infor EAM and Caterpillar MineStar. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE / MASTER_RESOURCE category.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Pre-commissioning and commissioning inspections are project deliverables and handover requirements. Business process: handover certification, acceptance testing, and punch list closure require linking

attributes.name: checklist_id
attributes.description: Reference to the versioned checklist template applied during this inspection, specific to the equipment class (e.g., haul truck pre-start checklist v3.2). Ensures traceability of which checklist version was in force at the time of inspection.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; Infor EAM; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.corrective_action. Business justification: Failed equipment inspections generate corrective actions to remediate defects and prevent recurrence. This is a core compliance workflow in mining safety management systems. Inspectors must track that

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Inspection costs (labor, materials) are allocated to cost centres for maintenance budget tracking and compliance cost reporting in mining operations.

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident ID
attributes.description: Reference to an associated HSE incident record in IsoMetrix if this inspection was triggered by or linked to a safety incident (e.g., post-incident inspection). Null for routine pre-start and periodic inspections.

attributes.name: inspection_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor who reviewed and approved the inspection record. Required for statutory and post-incident inspections. Null for self-certified pre-start inspections where supervisor sign-off is not mandated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the person who conducted the inspection (operator, maintainer, or supervisor). Used for competency verification and regulatory accountability. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.risk_assessment. Business justification: Equipment inspections identify hazards (worn components, safety system failures, structural defects) that feed into risk assessments. Inspection findings directly inform residual risk ratings and cont

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the inspection was conducted. Supports site-level compliance reporting and regulatory submissions per jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective maintenance work order generated in Infor EAM as a result of defect findings identified during this inspection. Null if no corrective action was required or work order has not yet been raised.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supervising officer approved the inspection record. Null if not yet approved or approval not required. Supports regulatory audit trails for statutory inspections.

attributes.name: checklist_items_completed
attributes.description: Number of checklist items that were assessed and recorded during this inspection. A value less than checklist_items_total may indicate an incomplete inspection, which is a compliance risk for pre-start and statutory inspections.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; Infor EAM; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: checklist_items_total
attributes.description: Total number of checklist items included in the inspection for this equipment class and inspection type. Used to calculate completion rate and to validate that all mandatory items were assessed.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; Infor EAM; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more defect findings from this inspection require a corrective action to be raised. True triggers work order generation in Infor EAM and/or a corrective action task in IsoMetrix. Critical for HSE compliance workflow integration.
attributes.references: IsoMetrix; Infor EAM; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was first created in the source system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: defect_count_critical
attributes.description: Number of checklist items rated as critical severity during this inspection. Critical defects require immediate equipment shutdown and corrective action before operation can resume. A value greater than zero should result in a fail overall result.

attributes.name: defect_count_major
attributes.description: Number of checklist items rated as major severity during this inspection. Major defects require corrective action within a defined timeframe but may allow conditional operation under specified controls.

attributes.name: defect_count_minor
attributes.description: Number of checklist items rated as minor severity during this inspection. Minor defects are recorded for monitoring and scheduled maintenance but do not prevent equipment operation.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspector completed and submitted the inspection. Used to calculate inspection duration and to confirm the inspection was completed before equipment operation commenced (pre-start compliance).

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment type being inspected. Determines which checklist template applies and which regulatory requirements govern the inspection. Sourced from the equipment master register in Infor EAM and Caterpillar MineStar. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: haul_truck|drill|shovel|excavator|dozer|grader|conveyor|crusher|processing_plant|light_vehicle — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Caterpillar MineStar; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: equipment_grounded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment was taken out of service (grounded) as a result of this inspection. True means the equipment must not be operated until corrective action is completed and a return-to-service inspection is passed. Directly impacts fleet availability and OEE calculations.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001; Caterpillar MineStar; Infor EAM

attributes.name: equipment_hours_at_inspection
attributes.description: Engine or operating hours recorded on the equipment at the time of inspection. Used to determine whether periodic maintenance-based inspections are due and to track equipment utilisation context at the time of the inspection. Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar telematics.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Caterpillar MineStar; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: equipment_tag
attributes.description: Human-readable fleet number or asset tag of the equipment being inspected (e.g., HT-042, DR-007). Denormalized from the equipment master for operational convenience and to support inspection records even when the equipment master FK is temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: inspection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the inspection was captured and submitted. Mobile app refers to field-based digital capture. Paper form indicates a manual record subsequently digitised. Desktop portal is a web-based entry. Integrated OBC (on-board computer) refers to direct capture from Caterpillar MineStar on-board systems.

attributes.name: inspection_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the inspection record as assigned by the source system (IsoMetrix or Infor EAM). Used for cross-system reference, regulatory submissions, and audit trails. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the inspection record. Draft indicates the inspection is in progress or not yet submitted. Submitted means the inspector has completed and lodged the record. Approved indicates supervisor sign-off. Rejected means the record was returned for correction. Cancelled applies to inspections that were voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection by its regulatory or operational trigger. Pre-start inspections are legally mandated before equipment operation in most mining jurisdictions. Periodic inspections occur at scheduled intervals. Post-incident inspections follow a safety event. Statutory inspections are required by specific mining regulations. Return-to-service inspections occur after maintenance or repair.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001; WHS Act (Australia); IsoMetrix

attributes.name: inspector_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the inspector to describe defect findings, operational context, or observations not captured by the structured checklist items. Supports incident investigation and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: inspector_competency_code
attributes.description: Competency or certification code held by the inspector that authorises them to conduct this class of inspection (e.g., operator licence number, statutory inspector certificate). Required for regulatory compliance verification. Sourced from SAP HR competency records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001; WHS Act (Australia)

attributes.name: inspector_role
attributes.description: Role of the person conducting the inspection. Operators conduct pre-start checks. Maintainers conduct post-maintenance checks. Supervisors conduct periodic and statutory inspections. Statutory inspectors are government-appointed or certified inspectors. Third-party inspectors are external contractors.

attributes.name: location_description
