attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific location within the mine site where the inspection was conducted (e.g., ROM pad, pit level 3, crusher feed area). Supplements the site_id with operational granularity for incident investigation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Odometer reading in kilometres recorded at the time of inspection, applicable to mobile equipment such as haul trucks and light vehicles. Null for fixed plant and equipment without odometers. Supports distance-based maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Aggregate pass/fail outcome of the inspection. Pass indicates all checklist items met the required standard. Fail indicates one or more critical or major defects were found that prevent safe operation. Conditional pass indicates minor defects noted but equipment may operate under specified conditions pending corrective action.
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001; IsoMetrix; Infor EAM

attributes.name: photo_evidence_count
attributes.description: Number of photographic evidence items attached to this inspection record to document defect findings. Supports regulatory audit requirements and insurance claims. Photos are stored in the document management system with references captured at the checklist item level.

attributes.name: regulatory_standard
attributes.description: The specific mining safety regulation or standard under which this inspection is mandated or conducted. Enables jurisdiction-specific compliance reporting and regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSHA_30CFR56|MSHA_30CFR57|WHS_ACT|DMIRS_WA|MINES_ACT_QLD|ISO_45001 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57; ISO 45001; WHS Act (Australia); ICMM

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The shift during which the inspection was conducted. Pre-start inspections are typically conducted at the commencement of each shift. Used for shift-level compliance reporting and to correlate inspection outcomes with shift patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; IsoMetrix; MSHA 30 CFR Part 56/57

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this inspection record was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting of ETL pipelines.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this inspection in the originating source system (IsoMetrix, Infor EAM, or mobile app). Enables back-referencing to the source system for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the inspector commenced the inspection. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category. Critical for regulatory compliance — pre-start inspections must be completed before equipment operation commences.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection record was last modified in the source system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks amendments, supervisor approvals, and corrective action updates.

attributes.name: previous_inspection_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on inspection (previous_inspection_id)

products.name: asset_lifecycle_event
products.description: Tracks significant lifecycle milestones for each asset including commissioning, major rebuild (engine, transmission, hydraulic system), component replacement, mid-life refurbishment, relocation between sites, temporary standby/mothballing, change of ownership (lease return, sale), and final decommissioning/disposal. Captures event type, event date, responsible party, cost incurred (CAPEX vs OPEX classification), resulting asset condition rating, and updated remaining useful life estimate. Critical for fixed asset register reconciliation, insurance valuation, and capital planning. Sourced from Infor EAM and finance system (SAP/Oracle).

attributes.name: asset_lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset lifecycle event record in the silver layer. Primary key for the asset_lifecycle_event data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining fleet or fixed plant asset (e.g., haul truck, drill, shovel, conveyor, processing equipment) that this lifecycle event applies to. Links to the equipment master register.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Equipment Master; SAP S/4HANA Fixed Asset Register (FI-AA)

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Major lifecycle events (commissioning, major relocations, decommissioning) occur within capital projects. Business process: asset lifecycle management, project asset tracking, and capitalization decis

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Major lifecycle events (commissioning, decommissioning, major overhauls) can trigger incidents (commissioning accidents, decommissioning spills) or be incident outcomes (asset written off after major

attributes.name: previous_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site from which the asset was relocated, applicable when event_type is 'relocation'. Enables tracking of inter-site asset movements for fleet optimisation and fixed asset register updates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA) Asset Transfer; Infor EAM Location History

attributes.name: primary_asset_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal department, crew, or external contractor responsible for executing the lifecycle event. Links to the workforce or vendor master. Critical for accountability tracking and contractor cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR / Vendor Master (MM); Infor EAM Crew Assignment

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where the asset resides at the time of the lifecycle event. Supports multi-site fleet management and capital planning by site.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM); Infor EAM Site Configuration

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Major lifecycle events (commissioning, major overhauls, decommissioning) may be capitalized and tracked against WBS elements for capital project accounting and asset valuation.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: SAP Plant Maintenance or Infor EAM work order number associated with this lifecycle event. Provides traceability to the originating maintenance work order for audit and cost reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM); Infor EAM Work Order Management

attributes.name: asset_condition_rating
attributes.description: Assessed physical condition of the asset immediately following the lifecycle event, as determined by the maintenance engineer or inspector. Used for insurance valuation, capital planning, and remaining useful life estimation. Ratings: excellent = like-new post-rebuild; good = minor wear; fair = moderate wear requiring monitoring; poor = significant degradation; critical = imminent failure risk.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Condition Assessment; ISO 55001 (Asset Management); ICMM Asset Management Guidelines

attributes.name: asset_hours_at_event
attributes.description: Total cumulative operating hours recorded on the asset at the time of the lifecycle event (e.g., engine hours at rebuild). Used to calculate Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), validate rebuild intervals, and benchmark against OEM recommended service intervals.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; Infor EAM Meter Readings; OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) Standards

attributes.name: book_value_at_event
attributes.description: Net book value of the asset on the fixed asset register at the time of the lifecycle event, in the reporting currency. Used for CAPEX capitalisation decisions, impairment testing, and disposal gain/loss calculations.
attributes.references: IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); IFRS

attributes.name: component_replaced
attributes.description: Description of the specific major component replaced or rebuilt during this lifecycle event (e.g., 'Engine Assembly - CAT 3516C', 'Transmission - Allison 6000 Series', 'Hydraulic Pump Assembly', 'Bucket Assembly'). Applicable for component_replacement and major_rebuild event types.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Component Tracking; SAP S/4HANA Bill of Materials (MM-BOM)

attributes.name: component_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the replaced or installed major component (e.g., engine serial number, transmission serial number). Enables component-level traceability, warranty tracking, and OEM service history management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Component Serial Tracking; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: SAP cost centre code to which the lifecycle event cost is allocated. Enables departmental cost tracking, budget variance analysis, and OPEX/CAPEX reporting by operational area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-CCA); Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_classification
attributes.description: Financial classification of the cost incurred for this lifecycle event. CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) = costs that extend asset life or add capability, capitalised to the fixed asset register; OPEX (Operating Expenditure) = costs expensed in the period. Critical for fixed asset register reconciliation, tax treatment, and financial reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards); SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the event_cost amount (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Required for multi-currency operations across international mining jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: Name of the external party involved in an ownership change event (e.g., lessor name for lease return, buyer name for asset sale, OEM vendor for major rebuild contract). Applicable when event_type is 'ownership_change' or 'major_rebuild'.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was first created in the data platform (silver layer ingestion time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and reconciliation with source systems.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied to the asset following this lifecycle event. May be updated after a major rebuild or change in remaining useful life estimate. Straight_line = equal annual charge; units_of_production = charge based on actual production output; declining_balance = accelerated depreciation.
attributes.references: IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); IFRS

attributes.name: eam_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the lifecycle event as recorded in Infor EAM (e.g., work order number, event reference number). Used for cross-system reconciliation with SAP Fixed Asset Register and insurance systems.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Module; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

attributes.name: event_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this lifecycle event in the reporting currency. Includes labour, materials, contractor fees, and overheads. Used for CAPEX/OPEX tracking, insurance valuation, and All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO); IAS 16; AISC (World Gold Council Standard)

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the lifecycle event occurred or was formally executed (e.g., commissioning date, rebuild completion date, decommissioning date). This is the principal real-world business event date used for fixed asset register updates and insurance valuation.
attributes.references: IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); Infor EAM

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the lifecycle event work was completed and the asset was returned to service or formally closed. Used to calculate event duration and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) impact.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM)

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional technical or operational notes recorded by the maintenance engineer or planner regarding this lifecycle event (e.g., observed failure mode, special conditions, deviations from standard procedure, OEM recommendations).
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Notes; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM) Long Text

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the lifecycle event work commenced (e.g., when the rebuild began, when the asset was powered down for decommissioning). Used for duration calculation and OEE impact analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the lifecycle event. Planned = scheduled but not yet started; in_progress = work underway; completed = event fully executed and closed; cancelled = event voided before execution; on_hold = temporarily suspended pending approval or parts.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order Status; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM) Order Status

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the significant lifecycle milestone for the asset. Commissioning = first entry into service; major_rebuild = engine, transmission, or hydraulic system overhaul; component_replacement = scheduled or unscheduled part swap; mid_life_refurbishment = comprehensive mid-cycle restoration; relocation = transfer between mine sites or operational areas; standby_mothballing = temporary suspension of operations; ownership_change = lease return or sale; decommissioning_disposal = permanent retirement and disposal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commissioning|major_rebuild|component_replacement|mid_life_refurbishment|relocation|standby_mothballing|ownership_change|decommissioning_disposal — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Module; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA); IFRS 16 (Leases); IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment)

attributes.name: hse_clearance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Clearance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) clearance or permit was required to execute this lifecycle event (e.g., confined space entry permit for major rebuild, environmental permit for decommissioning). Supports ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety Management); ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Systems); IsoMetrix HSE Module; MSHA (Mine Safety and Health Administration)

attributes.name: hse_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Permit Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the HSE permit or work clearance certificate issued for this lifecycle event (e.g., Permit to Work number, Isolation Certificate number). Populated when hse_clearance_required is true. Traceable to IsoMetrix HSE system.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety Management); IsoMetrix HSE Incident and Permit Management; MSHA

attributes.name: insurance_valuation
attributes.description: Updated insurance replacement value of the asset following this lifecycle event, in the reporting currency. Revised after major rebuilds, refurbishments, or condition assessments. Used for insurance policy management and asset register reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards); IAS 16; ICMM Asset Management Guidelines

attributes.name: odometer_km_at_event
attributes.description: Total cumulative distance in kilometres recorded on the asset at the time of the lifecycle event. Applicable for mobile mining equipment (haul trucks, light vehicles). Complements operating hours for maintenance interval tracking.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management System; Infor EAM Meter Readings

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_type
attributes.description: Specifies the nature of the ownership change when event_type is 'ownership_change'. Lease_return = asset returned to lessor at end of lease term; sale = asset sold to third party; purchase = asset acquired; internal_transfer = transfer between legal entities within the mining group.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 (Leases); IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

attributes.name: planned_event_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for the lifecycle event as per the maintenance or capital plan. Compared against event_date to measure schedule adherence and support Life of Mine (LOM) capital planning.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance Scheduling; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_months
attributes.description: Updated estimate of the asset's remaining useful life in months following this lifecycle event, as assessed by the maintenance engineer. Revised after major rebuilds, refurbishments, or condition assessments. Critical for capital planning, depreciation schedules, and Life of Mine (LOM) fleet replacement planning.
attributes.references: IAS 16 (Property Plant and Equipment); Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal team, maintenance crew, or external contractor responsible for executing the lifecycle event (e.g., 'OEM Rebuild Team - Caterpillar', 'Site Maintenance Crew A'). Retained for reporting without requiring a join.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Order; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master (MM-LIV)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this lifecycle event record was sourced. Infor_eam = Infor Enterprise Asset Management; sap_pm = SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; minestar = Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health; manual = manually entered record.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM); Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental load detection, change data capture, and audit trail management.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit Standards; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM or contractor warranty for the rebuilt or replaced component expires following this lifecycle event. Used to manage warranty claims and schedule post-warranty maintenance.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Warranty Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance (PM)

products.name: component_register
products.description: Master register of major replaceable components tracked at individual serial number level including engines, transmissions, final drives, hydraulic pumps, GET (ground engaging tools), mill liners, and conveyor drives. Each record represents a serialised component with OEM part number, serial number, currently installed asset, installation date, accumulated hours since last rebuild, condition rating, and rebuild history count. Supports component life tracking, condition-based maintenance triggers, and rebuild/replace decision-making. Sourced from Infor EAM.

attributes.name: component_register_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each serialised component record in the master register. Primary key for the component_register data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent mining asset (haul truck, drill, shovel, conveyor, mill, etc.) on which this component is currently installed. Sourced from Infor EAM equipment master.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Critical components installed during project commissioning (engines, gearboxes, conveyors) are tracked for warranty and as-built documentation. Business process: warranty management, spare parts plann

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Component rebuild and replacement costs are allocated to cost centres for maintenance cost tracking, AISC calculation, and cost per operating hour analysis. Reusing existing cost_centre_code.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Components (engines, transmissions, hydraulics) have OEM suppliers; tracking vendor per component enables targeted parts sourcing, supplier performance analysis, and warranty claims. Real business pro

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the most recent Infor EAM work order under which this component was installed, rebuilt, or last serviced.

attributes.name: component_class
attributes.description: High-level engineering classification grouping components by their functional and failure mode characteristics. Used to apply appropriate condition monitoring strategies and maintenance standards.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: component_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the component (e.g., 'Engine Assembly', 'Final Drive LH', 'SAG Mill Liner Set', 'Hydraulic Pump Main'). Human-readable label used in maintenance planning and reporting.

attributes.name: component_number
attributes.description: Unique business-facing identifier for the component record within the Infor EAM system. Used for cross-referencing with maintenance work orders and procurement records.

attributes.name: component_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the component. Drives inventory availability, maintenance scheduling, and rebuild/replace decision workflows within Infor EAM.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the major replaceable component category. Drives applicable life limits, rebuild standards, and condition monitoring protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engine|transmission|final_drive|hydraulic_pump|get|mill_liner|conveyor_drive|differential|torque_converter|alternator|pump|motor|gearbox|brake_assembly|suspension — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: condition_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent condition assessment was performed for this component. Used to determine assessment currency and trigger re-inspection schedules.

attributes.name: condition_assessment_method
attributes.description: Technique used to determine the current condition rating of the component. Supports traceability of condition data and selection of appropriate monitoring strategies.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: condition_rating
attributes.description: Current assessed condition rating of the component based on inspection, oil analysis, vibration monitoring, or visual assessment. Drives condition-based maintenance (CBM) decisions and rebuild/replace recommendations.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to rebuild_cost and replacement_cost fields (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Supports multi-currency operations across international mining sites.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS International Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: eam_component_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this component record within Infor EAM. Enables data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the Silver layer data product and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: hours_at_installation
attributes.description: Accumulated hours recorded on this component at the time of its most recent installation onto the parent asset. Used to calculate hours accrued during the current installation period.

attributes.name: hours_since_new
attributes.description: Accumulated operating hours on this component since it was manufactured new. Includes all installation periods across its full lifecycle. Key metric for life-to-date tracking and OEM warranty assessment.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: hours_since_rebuild
attributes.description: Accumulated operating hours on this component since its most recent rebuild or remanufacture. Primary metric for condition-based maintenance triggers and rebuild interval management.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this component was most recently installed onto the parent asset. Used to calculate time-in-service and trigger scheduled replacement intervals.

attributes.name: is_critical_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is classified as safety-critical or production-critical under the site's critical equipment register. Critical components require enhanced inspection frequencies and mandatory hold points per ISO 45001.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management; MSHA Mine Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal inspection or condition monitoring event performed on this component. Used to track inspection compliance and schedule next inspection.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which this component was originally manufactured. Used for age-based life assessments, warranty eligibility determination, and calendar-based replacement planning.

attributes.name: max_rebuild_limit
attributes.description: OEM or engineering-approved maximum number of rebuilds permitted for this component type before mandatory condemnation and replacement. Enforces safe life limits.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: OEM model or specification number for this component. Distinguishes variants within the same component type (e.g., different engine ratings or transmission ratios) for compatibility verification.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory inspection or condition monitoring event for this component. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling in Infor EAM and ensures compliance with site inspection regimes.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) catalogue part number for this component. Used for procurement, warranty claims, and interchangeability verification against approved parts lists.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: oil_sample_reference
attributes.description: Laboratory reference number for the most recent oil or fluid analysis sample taken from this component. Links to LabWare LIMS for detailed oil analysis results used in condition-based maintenance decisions.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS Sample Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the specific mounting position on the parent asset where this component is installed (e.g., 'LH_FRONT', 'DRIVE_1', 'MILL_FEED_END'). Enables position-specific wear pattern analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: rebuild_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred for the most recent rebuild of this component in the site operating currency. Used for rebuild/replace economic analysis and OPEX reporting. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA PM/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM (Plant Maintenance); IFRS International Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: rebuild_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this component has been rebuilt or remanufactured over its lifetime. Used in rebuild/replace decision analysis and to assess cumulative fatigue against OEM rebuild limits.

attributes.name: rebuild_replace_decision
attributes.description: Current engineering or maintenance decision on the disposition of this component at end of its current service life. Informs CAPEX/OPEX planning and component exchange pool management.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this component register record in the Silver layer. Supports incremental data loading, audit trails, and change detection for downstream consumers.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: remaining_life_hours
attributes.description: Estimated remaining operating hours before this component reaches its target life limit or requires rebuild/replacement. Calculated as target_life_hours minus hours_since_rebuild. Drives proactive maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date on which this component was most recently removed from the parent asset. Null if the component is currently installed. Used to calculate actual service life per installation.

attributes.name: replacement_cost
attributes.description: Current estimated cost to replace this component with a new OEM unit. Used in rebuild/replace decision analysis and CAPEX budget planning. Sourced from Pronto Xi procurement catalogue.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi Procurement; SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); IFRS International Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number uniquely identifying this physical component unit. Enables full traceability across its entire lifecycle including multiple installations and rebuilds.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical warehouse bin, yard, or storage location where this component is held when not installed (e.g., 'WAREHOUSE-A-B12', 'REBUILD-SHOP-FLOOR'). Sourced from Pronto Xi inventory management.
attributes.references: Pronto Xi Procurement and Inventory; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: target_life_hours
attributes.description: OEM or site-defined target operating hours for this component before scheduled replacement or rebuild. Basis for component life planning and budget forecasting within the Life of Mine (LOM) plan.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Caterpillar MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM or remanufacturer warranty for this component expires. Ensures warranty claims are lodged within valid periods and informs make-vs-buy decisions for repairs.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle Management; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: parent_component_register_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on component_register (parent_component_register_id)

products.name: tyre_record
products.description: Dedicated tyre management records for haul truck and mobile equipment tyres including tyre serial number, OEM brand and compound, size specification (e.g., 40.00R57), position on vehicle (LF, RF, LR, RR for rigid trucks; steer/drive for articulated), installation date, removal date, removal reason (worn, damaged, rotated, scrapped), accumulated hours and kilometres, tread depth measurements at each inspection, TKPH rating compliance, cost per hour, and disposal method. Tyre costs represent 10-15% of mobile fleet OPEX in open-cut mining. Supports tyre life forecasting, rotation optimisation, and vendor performance comparison. Sourced from tyre management systems (Klinge, Kal Tire TOMS) and Infor EAM.

attributes.name: tyre_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tyre lifecycle record in the tyre management system. Primary key for the tyre_record data product.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mobile equipment unit (haul truck, articulated dump truck, grader, or other mobile plant) on which this tyre is or was installed. Links to the equipment master register.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Tyre costs are significant in mining operations and tracked by cost centre for cost per tonne analysis, AISC calculation, and maintenance budget management.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Tyres are high-cost consumables procured from specific vendors; linking enables vendor performance tracking (cost-per-hour by supplier), warranty claims, and procurement optimization. Real business pr

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Infor EAM work order associated with the tyre installation or removal event, enabling traceability to the maintenance activity.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Orders; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: accumulated_hours
attributes.description: Total engine/operating hours accumulated on this tyre across its entire service life (including prior fitments if retreaded or rotated). Sourced from Caterpillar MineStar or Infor EAM. Key metric for tyre life forecasting and TKPH compliance.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; Kal Tire TOMS; ICMM Good Practice Guide

attributes.name: accumulated_km
attributes.description: Total kilometres travelled by the tyre across its entire service life. Sourced from fleet management telematics. Used alongside accumulated_hours for tyre life benchmarking and rotation scheduling.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management; Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: application_code
attributes.description: TRA/ISO application category code indicating the equipment type the tyre is designed for: E=Earthmover/Off-the-Road, L=Loader, G=Grader, C=Compactor, IND=Industrial. Drives TKPH rating selection and procurement.

attributes.name: axle_position
attributes.description: Axle group on which the tyre is mounted (front, rear, tag/pusher, or all for single-axle equipment). Complements position_code for load distribution and wear analysis.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System

attributes.name: compound_grade
attributes.description: OEM-designated rubber compound or product line grade (e.g., E4, L5, VSDP, XLDD2). Indicates the tyre construction and application suitability for specific haul road conditions.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; TRA (Tire and Rim Association)

attributes.name: cost_per_hour
attributes.description: Calculated cost per operating hour in the operating currency, derived from purchase_cost divided by accumulated_hours at removal or current point in service. Key performance indicator for tyre vendor comparison and OPEX benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); ICMM Good Practice Guide; Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used for end-of-life tyre disposal. Null if tyre is still in service. Supports environmental compliance reporting under ISO 14001 and regulatory waste management obligations. Retreaded tyres re-enter service and generate a new tyre_record.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; IsoMetrix Environmental Monitoring

attributes.name: eam_asset_number
attributes.description: Infor EAM asset number assigned to this tyre as a tracked asset. Provides the cross-reference key between the tyre management system (Kal Tire TOMS / Klinge) and the Infor EAM asset register for maintenance cost allocation.

attributes.name: haul_road_condition
attributes.description: Assessed condition rating of the primary haul road on which this tyre operated at time of removal. Contextualises tyre wear and damage patterns; poor haul road conditions are a leading cause of premature tyre failure in open-cut mining.
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guide; Caterpillar MineStar Fleet Management

attributes.name: inflation_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Most recently recorded tyre inflation pressure in kilopascals (kPa) at the last inspection. Correct inflation is critical for tyre life, fuel efficiency, and safety. Compared against OEM-recommended cold inflation pressure.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; OEM tyre specification sheets; ISO 45001

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the tyre was fitted to the vehicle at the current position. Start of the active service period for accumulated hours and kilometres tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Orders; Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: is_retreaded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tyre currently in service is a retreaded carcass (True) or a new tyre (False). Retreaded tyres typically have different cost profiles and performance expectations.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical tyre inspection including tread depth measurement, visual damage check, and pressure verification. Drives inspection scheduling compliance.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Infor EAM Preventive Maintenance; ISO 45001

attributes.name: load_rating_kg
attributes.description: Maximum static load capacity in kilograms as specified by the OEM for this tyre at the recommended inflation pressure. Used to validate tyre fitment against vehicle gross vehicle mass (GVM) requirements.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); OEM tyre specification sheets

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the mine site where this tyre is or was in service. Enables multi-site tyre performance benchmarking and fleet-wide OPEX analysis across the mining portfolio.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: oem_brand
attributes.description: Tyre manufacturer brand name (e.g., Bridgestone, Michelin, Goodyear, Titan). Used for vendor performance comparison and procurement decisions.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Standardised position code indicating where the tyre is mounted on the vehicle (e.g., LF=Left Front, RF=Right Front, LR=Left Rear, RR=Right Rear for rigid trucks; steer/drive/tag for articulated trucks). Used for rotation optimisation and wear pattern analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LF|RF|LRI|LRO|RRI|RRO|steer|drive_left|drive_right|tag — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; Caterpillar MineStar

attributes.name: purchase_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase cost of the tyre in the operating currency. Used as the basis for cost per hour (CPH) and cost per kilometre calculations. Represents a significant component of mobile fleet Operating Expenditure (OPEX) at 10-15% of total.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM (Materials Management); Pronto Xi Procurement; ICMM Good Practice Guide

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP or Pronto Xi purchase order number under which this tyre was procured. Enables traceability from tyre record back to procurement contract and vendor invoice for cost allocation and warranty claims.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: recommended_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: OEM-recommended cold inflation pressure in kilopascals (kPa) for this tyre size and load rating. Reference value for pressure compliance checks and deviation alerting.
attributes.references: OEM tyre specification sheets; TRA (Tire and Rim Association)

attributes.name: recorded_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tyre record was first created in the system, representing the record audit creation time. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Kal Tire TOMS; ISO 8601

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the tyre was removed from the vehicle. Null if the tyre is currently in service. Combined with installation_date to calculate service duration.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Work Orders; Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for tyre removal from service. Drives failure mode analysis, vendor performance benchmarking, and haul road condition assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: worn|damaged|rotated|scrapped|puncture|sidewall_failure|heat_separation|scheduled_change|bead_damage|cut — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; ICMM Good Practice Guide

attributes.name: retread_count
attributes.description: Number of times this tyre carcass has been retreaded. Tracks carcass reuse for cost optimisation and quality assurance. OEM carcass inspection standards typically limit retreads to 1-2 cycles for large OTR tyres.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; TRA (Tire and Rim Association)

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number stamped on the tyre sidewall. Used as the primary physical identifier for tyre tracking across its full lifecycle from receipt to disposal.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; ISO 10012

attributes.name: size_specification
attributes.description: Standard tyre size designation in OEM format (e.g., 40.00R57, 27.00R49, 37.00R57). Encodes width, aspect ratio, and rim diameter per TRA/ETRTO standards. Critical for procurement and fitment compatibility.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); ETRTO (European Tyre and Rim Technical Organisation)

attributes.name: speed_rating_kmh
attributes.description: Maximum permissible operating speed in kilometres per hour as specified by the OEM. Relevant for haul road speed limit compliance and tyre selection for high-speed haulage applications.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); OEM tyre specification sheets

attributes.name: tkph_actual
attributes.description: Calculated actual TKPH value based on the haul truck payload, haul road distance, and cycle time recorded by Caterpillar MineStar. Compared against tkph_rating to assess thermal overload risk.
attributes.references: Caterpillar MineStar Productivity Tracking; TRA TKPH Guidelines

attributes.name: tkph_rating
attributes.description: OEM-specified Tonne-Kilometres Per Hour (TKPH) rating for the tyre, representing the maximum thermal load the tyre can sustain. Compliance with TKPH rating is critical to prevent heat-related tyre failures in open-cut mining haul cycles.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); Bridgestone/Michelin TKPH Guidelines; ICMM Good Practice Guide

attributes.name: tread_depth_current_mm
attributes.description: Most recent tread depth measurement in millimetres recorded at the last inspection. Used to assess remaining tyre life and trigger rotation or replacement decisions.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System; ICMM Good Practice Guide

attributes.name: tread_depth_new_mm
attributes.description: Original tread depth in millimetres when the tyre was new, as specified by the OEM. Baseline reference for calculating tread wear percentage and remaining tread life.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); OEM tyre specification sheets

attributes.name: tread_depth_removal_mm
attributes.description: Tread depth in millimetres measured at the time of tyre removal. Null if tyre is still in service. Used to determine whether the tyre reached its designed wear limit or was removed prematurely.
attributes.references: Kal Tire TOMS; Klinge Tyre Management System

attributes.name: tyre_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tyre. Tracks whether the tyre is actively mounted, held in the tyre bay, undergoing repair/retread, scrapped, or disposed. Supports inventory management and lifecycle cost analysis.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Asset Lifecycle; Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: tyre_type
attributes.description: Tyre construction category indicating internal structure. Radial is standard for large haul trucks; bias ply used on some older or smaller equipment; solid and foam-filled used in specific underground or loader applications.
attributes.references: TRA (Tire and Rim Association); Kal Tire TOMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this tyre record, capturing inspection results, status changes, or measurement updates. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Infor EAM; Kal Tire TOMS; ISO 8601

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM or supplier warranty for this tyre expires. Enables timely warranty claims for premature failures and supports procurement negotiations with tyre vendors.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Warranty Management; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: retreaded_from_tyre_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tyre_record (retreaded_from_tyre_record_id)

products.name: dispatch_instruction
products.description: Real-time operator dispatch instructions issued by the FMS dispatcher or automated dispatch optimisation engine (MineStar Dispatch, Wenco, Modular) to haul trucks, loaders, and ancillary fleet. Each record represents a single routing decision capturing instruction type (load, dump, park, fuel, standby, queue, relocate), source location (shovel face, ROM pad, waste dump), target location, assigned haul route, estimated travel time, issuing dispatcher or algorithm ID, issue timestamp, operator acknowledgement timestamp, and compliance outcome (complied, overridden, timed-out). Drives real-time fleet productivity, truck-shovel match factor optimisation, and queue time minimisation.

attributes.name: dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dispatch instruction record. Primary key for the dispatch instruction entity.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining fleet or fixed plant asset (haul truck, loader, shovel, ancillary equipment) to which this dispatch instruction is assigned.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Equipment dispatch during construction phases (material movement for haul road construction, pre-stripping, infrastructure development) supports project execution. Business process: project logistics

attributes.name: haul_route_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned haul route that the equipment must follow from source to target location. Null for non-haulage instructions (park, standby, fuel).

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site where this dispatch instruction was executed. Supports multi-site fleet management and reporting.

attributes.name: primary_dispatcher_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the human dispatcher who issued this instruction. Null if the instruction was generated by an automated dispatch optimization algorithm.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this dispatch instruction was issued and executed.

attributes.name: target_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination location for this dispatch instruction (e.g., crusher, ROM pad, waste dump, parking area, fuel station).

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Dispatch instructions route equipment within specific tenement areas. Real mining dispatch systems track which licence area work is assigned to for compliance with tenement conditions, cost allocation

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin location for this dispatch instruction (e.g., shovel face, ROM pad, waste dump, stockpile, fuel station).

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment operator acknowledged receipt of the dispatch instruction via the in-cab terminal or mobile device. Null if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: actual_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual total cycle time in minutes including loading, hauling, dumping, and return travel. Used for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation and productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: actual_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes taken by the equipment to travel from source to target location. Used for dispatch optimization model calibration and route performance analysis.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatch instruction was completed (e.g., load delivered, dump completed, equipment parked). Null if not yet completed.

attributes.name: compliance_outcome
attributes.description: Final compliance outcome indicating whether the operator followed the dispatch instruction as issued. Critical for truck-shovel match factor optimization and operator performance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dispatch instruction record was first created in the Fleet Management System (FMS) database. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: dispatch_algorithm_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the automated dispatch optimization engine or algorithm that generated this instruction (e.g., MineStar Dispatch, Wenco, Modular). Null if issued by a human dispatcher.

attributes.name: dispatch_zone
attributes.description: Operational zone or area within the mine site where this dispatch instruction applies (e.g., Pit 3, ROM Area, Waste Dump North). Used for zone-based dispatch optimization.

attributes.name: estimated_cycle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated total cycle time in minutes including loading, hauling, dumping, and return travel. Used for truck-shovel match factor optimization and queue time minimization.

attributes.name: estimated_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes for the equipment to travel from source to target location along the assigned haul route, calculated by the dispatch optimization engine based on route distance, grade, and equipment performance characteristics.

attributes.name: expected_payload_tonnes
attributes.description: Expected payload weight in tonnes that the equipment will carry for this dispatch instruction. Used for truck-shovel match factor calculation and production forecasting.

attributes.name: fuel_level_percent
attributes.description: Fuel level of the equipment as a percentage of tank capacity at the time the dispatch instruction was issued. Used to trigger fuel dispatch instructions.

attributes.name: haul_route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or code of the assigned haul route (e.g., Route P3-C1, Haul Road 12A).

attributes.name: instruction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the dispatch instruction, typically generated by the Fleet Management System (FMS) dispatcher or automated dispatch optimization engine.

attributes.name: instruction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispatch instruction. Tracks progression from issuance through operator acknowledgement to final compliance outcome. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|acknowledged|in_progress|completed|overridden|timed_out|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: instruction_type
attributes.description: Type of routing decision or operational command issued to the fleet asset. Defines the primary action the operator must execute. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: load|dump|park|fuel|standby|queue|relocate|maintenance|emergency — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_emergency_dispatch
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this dispatch instruction was issued as an emergency response (e.g., equipment breakdown, safety incident, production bottleneck). Emergency dispatches override normal dispatch optimization rules.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatch instruction was issued by the dispatcher or automated dispatch optimization engine. Primary business event timestamp for real-time fleet productivity tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dispatch instruction record was last updated in the Fleet Management System (FMS) database. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Type of material being hauled or handled in this dispatch instruction. Critical for production reconciliation and material movement tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ore|waste|overburden|coal|concentrate|tailings|fuel|water — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the operator or dispatcher for why the dispatch instruction was overridden or not followed. Null if instruction was complied with.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for dispatch instruction override. Used for root cause analysis of dispatch compliance issues. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|equipment_failure|road_condition|weather|operational_priority|dispatcher_override|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of this dispatch instruction (1=highest priority, 10=lowest priority). Used to sequence instructions when multiple tasks are pending for the same equipment.

attributes.name: queue_time_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes that the equipment spent waiting in queue at the source or target location. Critical metric for queue time minimization and dispatch optimization.

attributes.name: road_condition
attributes.description: Condition of the haul road at the time the dispatch instruction was issued. Affects travel time, safety, and route selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: good|fair|poor|wet|icy|under_maintenance|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the source location (e.g., Pit 3 Shovel 12, ROM Pad A, Waste Dump North).

attributes.name: start_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operator began executing the dispatch instruction (e.g., started moving toward source location). Null if not yet started.

attributes.name: target_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the target location (e.g., Primary Crusher, ROM Pad B, Waste Dump East, Parking Bay 5).

attributes.name: timeout_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatch instruction expired due to operator non-compliance or system timeout. Null if instruction did not time out.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time the dispatch instruction was issued. Impacts travel time estimates and route selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|fog|dust|snow|wind|extreme_heat — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: superseded_dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dispatch_instruction (superseded_dispatch_instruction_id)

products.name: equipment_shutdown_scope
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a specific asset in a planned maintenance shutdown event. It captures the shutdown-specific planning and execution data for each asset participating in the shutdown, including criticality ranking, sequencing constraints, planned versus actual downtime, readiness gates, and inspection requirements. Each record links one asset to one shutdown plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific shutdown participation.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, planned maintenance shutdowns involve multiple assets (crushers, conveyors, mills, haul trucks) that must be taken offline for maintenance, and each asset participates in multiple shutdowns throughout its operational lifecycle. Shutdown coordinators actively manage asset-shutdown scope items as operational records, tracking each asset's criticality ranking, sequencing constraints, planned versus actual downtime, readiness gates, and inspection requirements specific to each shutdown event. This is a true operational many-to-many relationship where the association itself (the scope item) carries substantial business data and is actively managed throughout the shutdown planning and execution process.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific mining asset included in this shutdown scope

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the planned maintenance shutdown event

attributes.description: Actual duration in hours that this asset was unavailable during shutdown execution, measured from isolation to return-to-service

attributes.name: actual_labour_hours

attributes.name: asset_criticality_for_shutdown
attributes.description: Criticality classification indicating whether this asset is on the shutdown critical path, near-critical (within float tolerance), or non-critical for overall shutdown duration

attributes.name: asset_readiness_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this asset within the shutdown workflow, tracking progression through readiness gates from pre-shutdown preparation to return-to-service

attributes.name: asset_shutdown_priority

attributes.name: completion_percentage

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Current completion status of work on this asset within the shutdown, tracking whether work is complete, in progress, or deferred to a future shutdown

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for work on this asset including labour, materials, and contractor services, contributing to total shutdown cost

attributes.name: estimated_labour_hours

attributes.name: isolation_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: planned_asset_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration in hours that this specific asset will be unavailable during the shutdown, used for production loss calculations and resource planning

attributes.name: post_shutdown_commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when post-shutdown commissioning and performance testing was completed, authorizing return-to-service

attributes.description: Date when the pre-shutdown inspection was completed for this asset, establishing baseline condition and confirming scope

attributes.name: pre_shutdown_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset requires a formal pre-shutdown inspection to assess condition and finalize work scope before shutdown commencement

attributes.name: return_to_service_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this asset was returned to operational service after shutdown work completion and commissioning, marking the end of asset-specific downtime

attributes.name: scope_item_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the scope item within the shutdown, used for work package tracking and communication (e.g., SD2024-001, SD2024-002)

products.name: asset_crew_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of mining assets to work crews across shifts and time periods. It captures which crews are authorized to operate which assets, the period of assignment, primary responsibility designation, utilization targets, and maintenance accountability. Each record links one asset to one crew for a specific time period with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship. Essential for shift planning, production accountability, equipment utilization tracking, and maintenance responsibility allocation.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, assets are operated by multiple crews across different shifts (day crew, night crew, maintenance crew), and crews operate multiple assets simultaneously (a production crew may operate 3 haul trucks, 1 excavator, 1 dozer). The assignment relationship is actively managed by operations planners and shift supervisors, with specific assignment periods, primary responsibility designation, utilization targets, and maintenance accountability tracked for each asset-crew pairing.

attributes.name: asset_crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each asset-crew assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the mining asset being assigned to the crew

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the crew assigned to operate or maintain the asset

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this crew's assignment to this asset ended or is planned to end. Null for currently active assignments. Used for assignment history and planning future crew rotations.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this crew was assigned operational or maintenance responsibility for this asset. Supports historical tracking of asset-crew assignments across roster changes and operational reconfigurations.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this asset-crew assignment. Active = currently operational, Planned = scheduled future assignment, Suspended = temporarily inactive, Completed = historical assignment ended. Used for operational planning and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew has maintenance responsibility for this asset (true) or purely operational responsibility (false). Maintenance crews are accountable for preventive maintenance tasks, pre-start inspections, and minor repairs during their shift.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes specific to this asset-crew assignment, such as special operating instructions, crew-specific asset configurations, or temporary restrictions.

attributes.name: primary_operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew is the primary operator responsible for this asset (true) or a secondary/backup crew (false). Used to determine accountability for production targets and asset care. An asset may have one primary crew per shift pattern.

attributes.name: shift_pattern_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shift pattern during which this crew operates this asset (e.g., DAY, NIGHT, SWING). An asset may be assigned to different crews for different shift patterns. Critical for 24/7 operations planning.

attributes.name: utilization_target_pct
attributes.description: Target equipment utilization percentage for this asset when operated by this crew, expressed as a percentage (0.00-100.00). Used for crew performance measurement and production planning. Varies by crew type and shift pattern.

products.name: asset_stakeholder_concern
products.description: This association product represents the community engagement relationship between mining assets and community stakeholders. It captures stakeholder concerns about specific assets (haul trucks affecting village roads, drill rigs near sacred sites, conveyors creating dust), engagement activities, mitigation measures, and escalation status. Each record links one asset to one stakeholder with attributes that exist only in the context of this concern relationship. Serves as the operational register for managing community impacts of individual equipment and infrastructure.. Existence Justification: Mining operations actively manage community stakeholder concerns about specific assets as an operational business process. A single asset (e.g., haul truck) can generate concerns from multiple stakeholders (village affected by road traffic, indigenous group concerned about cultural sites, environmental NGO monitoring dust), and a single stakeholder can have concerns about multiple assets (community concerned about both haul trucks and drill rigs operating near their land). Community relations teams create, track, and manage these concern records with engagement schedules, mitigation plans, and escalation status specific to each asset-stakeholder combination.

attributes.name: concern_resolved_date

attributes.description: Required frequency of engagement with this stakeholder specifically about this asset, based on concern severity and stakeholder expectations. Identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: last_engagement_date

attributes.name: mitigation_measures

attributes.name: mitigation_status

products.name: asset_contract_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the service contract coverage relationship between mining equipment assets and procurement contracts. It captures which assets are covered under which service or maintenance contracts, including coverage periods, service level agreements, response time commitments, and coverage type. Each record links one asset to one contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific coverage arrangement. This enables tracking of multi-vendor service agreements across the fleet, contract compliance monitoring, SLA performance measurement, and ensures assets receive appropriate maintenance coverage.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, individual assets (haul trucks, excavators, drills) are covered by multiple service contracts simultaneously - a haul truck may have a maintenance contract, a parts supply agreement, and a telematics monitoring contract all active at once. Conversely, each service contract (especially blanket maintenance or parts supply agreements) covers multiple assets across the fleet. The business actively manages these coverage relationships, tracking which assets are covered under which contracts, with specific SLA commitments, response times, and coverage periods that vary by asset-contract combination.

domains.name: maintenance
domains.description: Manages the full asset maintenance lifecycle including preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance work orders, BOM, spare parts consumption, shutdown planning, and equipment downtime tracking via CMMS (Infor EAM). Owns work execution and cost history against each asset.

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional entity representing a maintenance work order in Infor EAM. Captures all types of maintenance activities — preventive (PM), corrective (CM), predictive (PdM), and condition-based — against a specific asset. Tracks work order number, type, priority, status, originating source (CMMS, SCADA alert, operator request), planned vs actual start/finish dates, estimated vs actual labour hours, work centre, trade/craft required, safety permit references, shutdown flag, and completion codes. Includes full cost summary: labour cost, parts/materials cost, contractor cost, equipment hire cost, total estimated vs actual cost (OPEX), cost centre, GL account code, SAP CO order reference, cost variance, and approval status. SSOT for work execution history and maintenance cost reporting against each asset. Supports AISC/C1 cost allocation. Sourced from Infor EAM and SAP CO.
