attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this PM schedule record in the source CMMS system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

products.name: asset_bom
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) for a maintainable asset, defining the hierarchical assembly structure of components and sub-assemblies. Each BOM line captures parent asset, child component, part number, quantity, unit of measure, position/tag number, criticality rating, and whether the component is a rotable spare. Sourced from Infor EAM and SAP PM. Supports spare parts planning, kitting for shutdowns, and failure mode analysis. Distinct from the equipment master (owned by equipment domain) — this entity owns the maintainable component structure.
products.reference: Infor EAM BOM / SAP PM Equipment BOM

attributes.name: asset_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset bill of materials record. Primary key for the asset BOM entity.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Bill of materials for new/modified assets are established during capital projects. Mining operations link BOMs to projects to trace design basis, spare parts provisioning decisions, engineering change

attributes.name: parent_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent maintainable asset that this BOM line belongs to. Links to the equipment asset master.

attributes.name: primary_component_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the child component or sub-assembly asset that is part of the parent asset structure. Links to the equipment asset master or component register.

attributes.name: spare_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.spare_part. Business justification: asset_bom has part_number (STRING) but no FK to spare_part master. One spare_part can appear in many asset BOMs. Adding spare_part_id FK enables linking BOM components to the authoritative spare_part

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of this component within the BOM structure. Level 1 represents top-level assemblies, with increasing numbers for deeper sub-assemblies.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM record. Active=currently in use, Superseded=replaced by newer version, Obsolete=no longer applicable, Pending=awaiting approval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: criticality_rating
attributes.description: Business criticality classification of the component based on impact to asset availability, safety, and production. Critical components require priority spare parts stocking and expedited maintenance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the component unit cost. Standard codes include USD, AUD, CAD, ZAR.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM configuration becomes effective. Supports engineering change management and as-built configuration tracking.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this BOM configuration remains effective. Null for current active configurations. Used for historical BOM version tracking.

attributes.name: engineering_change_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the engineering change order that introduced or modified this BOM line. Used for change traceability and configuration management.

attributes.name: environmental_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this component could result in environmental incidents such as spills, emissions, or contamination. Requires enhanced monitoring per ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.

attributes.name: interchangeable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component can be substituted with alternative parts from different manufacturers or specifications without affecting asset performance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this BOM record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this BOM record was last updated. Used for audit trail, data quality monitoring, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: material_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification of materials used in the component, including grades, alloys, and compliance standards. Critical for mining equipment operating in harsh environments.

attributes.name: mean_time_between_failures
attributes.description: Average operating time in hours between component failures. Key reliability metric used for preventive maintenance scheduling and spare parts planning.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair
attributes.description: Average time in hours required to repair or replace this component. Used for shutdown planning and downtime estimation.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or internal part number for the component. Used for procurement, inventory management, and spare parts identification.

attributes.name: position_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical location identifier or tag number for the component within the parent asset assembly. Used for maintenance work instructions and field identification.

attributes.name: quantity_required
attributes.description: Number of units of this component required per parent asset assembly. Supports fractional quantities for consumables and bulk materials.

attributes.name: rotable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is a rotable spare that can be repaired, refurbished, and reused across multiple parent assets. True for high-value repairable components, False for consumables.

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure of this component poses a direct safety risk to personnel or operations. Safety critical components require enhanced inspection and maintenance protocols per Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) regulations.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of components within the same BOM level and parent asset. Used for assembly instructions and kitting sequences.

attributes.name: serialized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual instances of this component are tracked by unique serial numbers for warranty, maintenance history, and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that originated this BOM data. Infor EAM and SAP PM are primary Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) sources.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the component quantity. EA=Each, M=Meter, KG=Kilogram, L=Liter, M2=Square Meter, M3=Cubic Meter. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|M|KG|L|M2|M3|SET|PAIR|BOX|ROLL — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Standard warranty period in months provided by the manufacturer for this component. Used for warranty claim management and lifecycle costing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this BOM record. Used for audit trail and data quality accountability.

products.name: spare_part
products.description: Master record for a maintainable spare part or consumable stocked for maintenance purposes. Captures part number, description, manufacturer, OEM part number, unit of measure, criticality classification (insurance/critical/non-critical), lead time, reorder point, minimum/maximum stock levels, storage location, hazardous material flag, interchangeable part references, and warranty expiry date. Distinct from general procurement inventory — this is the maintenance-specific view of parts required to sustain asset reliability. Supports spare parts criticality analysis, obsolescence management, and rotable pool tracking. Sourced from Infor EAM and Pronto Xi.
products.reference: Infor EAM Parts / Pronto Xi Item Master

attributes.name: spare_part_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the spare part record. Primary key for the spare part master data.

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset class or equipment type that this spare part is primarily used for (e.g., haul trucks, crushers, conveyors).

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Initial spare parts provisioning is a capital project deliverable. Mining operations link spare parts to projects to track first-fill inventory, warranty spares, project-funded stock, and OEM recommen

attributes.name: chemical_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.chemical_register. Business justification: Spare parts containing hazardous chemicals (lubricants, hydraulic fluids, solvents, batteries). Required for chemical inventory management, SDS tracking, and regulatory reporting (NOHSC, GHS) in Minin

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Spare parts are cataloged by commodity application (copper circuit components, iron ore crushing wear parts, coal handling equipment). Essential for commodity-specific maintenance cost allocation, inv

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Spare parts inventory is valued and posted to specific GL accounts for inventory accounting, balance sheet reporting, and inventory valuation - required for SAP MM-FI integration.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or primary supplier for procurement of this spare part.

attributes.name: bill_of_materials_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this spare part is itself composed of sub-components tracked as a BOM structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the spare part master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_classification
attributes.description: Classification of spare part criticality based on impact to operations: insurance (strategic stock for catastrophic failure), critical (required for production continuity), non-critical (routine consumables).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard unit cost. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AUD|USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|ZAR|CLP|BRL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dimensions
attributes.description: Physical dimensions of the spare part (length x width x height) in standard units. Supports storage planning and handling logistics.

attributes.name: economic_order_quantity
attributes.description: Optimal order quantity that minimizes total inventory costs including ordering costs and holding costs.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Classification of hazardous material type (e.g., flammable, corrosive, toxic, explosive) per regulatory standards. Populated only if hazardous_material_flag is true.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the spare part is classified as hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures.

attributes.name: interchangeable_part_number
attributes.description: Reference to alternative or substitute part numbers that can be used interchangeably. Supports obsolescence management and supply chain flexibility.

attributes.name: last_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when this spare part was last issued from inventory for maintenance work. Used for consumption pattern analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the spare part master record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent procurement transaction for this spare part. Used for usage analysis and obsolescence detection.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from order placement to delivery. Used for reorder point calculations and planning.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or supplier who produces the spare part.

attributes.name: material_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification of material composition or grade (e.g., steel grade, alloy type, polymer specification). Critical for quality assurance and compatibility.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Maximum inventory quantity allowed to avoid overstocking, obsolescence risk, and excessive capital tie-up.

attributes.name: minimum_stock_level
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity to be maintained at all times to prevent stockouts and ensure operational continuity.

attributes.name: obsolescence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status indicating availability and support: active (fully supported), obsolete (no longer available), phase-out (limited availability), discontinued (manufacturer ceased production).

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's original part number as specified by the OEM. Used for cross-referencing and procurement.

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the spare part (e.g., mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, structural, consumable, lubricant, wear part).

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the spare part including its function, specifications, and application context.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Internal part number assigned by the organization for inventory and maintenance tracking. Unique business identifier for the spare part.

attributes.name: part_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the spare part master record: active (available for use), inactive (not in use), pending (awaiting approval), blocked (restricted from use).

attributes.name: part_type
attributes.description: Type classification indicating lifecycle management approach: rotable (reusable after repair), repairable (can be refurbished), consumable (single-use), expendable (disposable).

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Inventory level threshold that triggers a replenishment order. Calculated based on lead time demand and safety stock requirements.

attributes.name: serial_number_tracking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this spare part are tracked by unique serial numbers for traceability and warranty management.

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Maximum storage duration in months before the part degrades or becomes unusable. Critical for consumables, lubricants, and rubber components.

attributes.name: standard_unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of measure for inventory valuation and maintenance cost estimation. Excludes freight and taxes.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Warehouse or storage bin location code where the spare part is physically stored. Supports warehouse management and picking operations.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for inventory tracking and consumption reporting (e.g., EA=Each, KG=Kilogram, L=Litre, M=Metre). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|SET|BOX|ROLL|PAIR — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when manufacturer warranty coverage expires for this spare part. Used for warranty claim management and cost recovery.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Unit weight of the spare part in kilograms. Used for logistics planning, freight cost calculation, and handling requirements.

products.name: parts_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of spare parts and materials issued or consumed against a maintenance work order. Captures work order reference, part number, quantity requested, quantity issued, unit cost, total cost, issue date, store location, requisition number, and whether the part was a rotable return. Provides the SSOT for maintenance material cost tracking and supports OPEX reporting, spare parts demand forecasting, and AISC cost allocation.
products.reference: Infor EAM Parts Issue / Material Consumption

attributes.name: parts_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the parts consumption transaction record.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the asset or equipment for which the part was consumed during maintenance.

attributes.name: chemical_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.chemical_register. Business justification: Parts consumption tracking chemical usage (lubricants, cleaning agents, solvents). Required for chemical usage reporting, inventory reconciliation, and regulatory threshold monitoring (NOHSC, EPA) in

attributes.name: primary_parts_issued_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stores employee who issued the part.

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Parts issued to work orders are often received from specific purchase orders. Mining operations track this for warranty claim validation (parts must be from approved PO), cost allocation to correct GL

attributes.name: spare_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to maintenance.spare_part. Business justification: parts_consumption currently has part_number (STRING) but no FK to spare_part master. One spare_part can be consumed many times across work orders. Adding spare_part_id FK enables JOIN to spare_part ma

attributes.name: supplier_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.counterparty. Business justification: Parts consumption records track supplier for each part issue. Mining operations need this link for supplier invoice reconciliation, warranty claims (linking consumption to supplier contracts), supplie

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Parts consumed on capital projects are charged to WBS elements for capitalization and project cost tracking - required for proper accounting of materials in asset under construction.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order against which this part was consumed.

attributes.name: work_order_task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific task within the work order where this part was consumed, if applicable.

attributes.name: aisc_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parts consumption cost is included in the All-In Sustaining Cost calculation for the mine site.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the part issued, used for traceability and quality control.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin or shelf location within the store from which the part was picked.

attributes.name: core_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a core charge applies to this part, requiring return of the old component.

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: Cost centre to which the parts consumption cost is allocated for financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the parts consumption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost values (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the parts consumption cost is posted.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the part was issued from stores and consumed against the work order.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the part was issued from stores, including time of day.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the parts consumption record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: System-generated material document number from the ERP system recording the goods movement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the parts consumption transaction.

attributes.name: opex_category
attributes.description: Classification of the parts consumption cost within the OPEX structure (maintenance, operations, sustaining, growth, exploration).

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Unique part number or material code identifying the spare part or consumable item issued.

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the part issued from stores and consumed against the work order.

attributes.name: quantity_requested
attributes.description: Quantity of the part originally requested for the work order.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Material requisition number or document reference that authorized the part issue.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumption transaction has been reversed or cancelled.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for reversing or cancelling the parts consumption transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: rotable_return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the part is a rotable component that was returned for repair or refurbishment after removal.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the individual part issued, used for tracking serialized components.

attributes.name: store_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse or store location from which the part was issued.

attributes.name: store_location_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the warehouse or store location from which the part was issued.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the parts consumed, calculated as quantity issued multiplied by unit cost.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of inventory transaction (issue, return, adjustment, transfer, scrap).

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the part at the time of issue, used for calculating total consumption cost.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the part quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters).

attributes.name: warranty_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part consumption is covered under warranty and may be claimed from the supplier or manufacturer.

products.name: labour_record
products.description: Transactional record of labour time booked against a maintenance work order by internal tradespeople or external contractors. Captures worker ID, source type (employee/contractor), trade/craft, work order reference, task reference, date worked, start time, end time, regular hours, overtime hours, hourly rate, total labour cost, work description, contractor company (if applicable), purchase order reference, and performance rating. Consolidates all human resource cost tracking against maintenance work orders — both internal workforce and contracted services. Sourced from Infor EAM timesheet module, SAP HR/CO, and contractor management systems. Supports maintenance cost tracking, workforce utilisation analysis, contractor performance evaluation, and OPEX reporting.
products.reference: Infor EAM Labour Booking / SAP PM Confirmation

attributes.name: labour_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labour record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contractor_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.counterparty. Business justification: External contractor labor is a major maintenance cost in mining. Labour records denormalize contractor_company; structured FK enables contractor invoice reconciliation, contractor safety performance t

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the maintenance crew or team to which the worker was assigned during this labour booking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the worker who performed the labour. May be employee number or contractor identifier depending on source type.
attributes.references: SAP HR Personnel Master, Contractor Management System

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.training_record. Business justification: Labour records verify workers have required HSE training (confined space, working at heights, LOTO) before task assignment. Critical for competency verification and permit-to-work compliance in Mining

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Labour on capital projects is charged to WBS elements for project cost tracking and capitalization - required for proper accounting of internal labour in asset construction.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order against which this labour time was booked.

attributes.name: work_order_task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific task within the work order that this labour was performed against. Nullable if labour is booked at work order header level.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the labour timesheet entry. Approved entries are posted to cost accounting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the supervisor or manager who approved this labour record.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the labour record was approved.

attributes.name: cost_centre
attributes.description: The cost centre to which this labour cost is allocated for financial reporting and OPEX tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labour record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the labour cost (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the worker completed work on this task.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this labour cost is posted.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The hourly labour rate applied to this record. May be standard employee rate or contractor rate.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Rate Master, Contractor Agreement

attributes.name: labour_cost
attributes.description: Total labour cost for this record, calculated as (regular_hours * hourly_rate) + (overtime_hours * overtime_rate).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labour record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours booked against this labour record.

attributes.name: overtime_rate
attributes.description: The hourly overtime rate applied to overtime hours. Typically a multiplier of the regular hourly rate.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Rate Master, Contractor Agreement

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Supervisor assessment of the quality and efficiency of the labour performed. Used for contractor performance evaluation and workforce management.

attributes.name: permit_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the safety permit or work permit under which this labour was performed, if applicable.

attributes.name: purchase_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order under which contractor labour services were procured. Applicable for contractor labour only.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular working hours booked against this labour record, excluding overtime.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shift during which the labour was performed (e.g., Day, Night, Swing).

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labour was performed by an internal employee or an external contractor.

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the worker started work on this task.

attributes.name: timesheet_entry_number
attributes.description: Unique timesheet entry number from the source system (Infor EAM or SAP HR) for traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Infor EAM Timesheet Module, SAP HR Time Management

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Total labour hours booked (regular hours plus overtime hours).

attributes.name: trade_craft
attributes.description: The trade or craft skill of the worker performing the labour (e.g., Electrician, Fitter, Boilermaker, Diesel Mechanic, Welder).

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the labour was performed.

attributes.name: work_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work performed by the worker during this labour booking.

attributes.name: worker_name
attributes.description: Full name of the worker who performed the labour.

products.name: equipment_downtime
products.description: Transactional record capturing planned and unplanned equipment downtime events for maintainable assets. Records asset ID, downtime start and end timestamps, downtime duration (hours), downtime category (planned maintenance, unplanned breakdown, standby, operational delay), primary failure code, secondary failure code, work order reference, production impact (tonnes lost), and responsible work centre. SSOT for OEE, MTBF, and MTTR calculations. Sourced from Infor EAM and Caterpillar MineStar.
products.reference: Infor EAM Downtime / MineStar Equipment Health

attributes.name: equipment_downtime_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment downtime event record. Primary key for the equipment downtime transactional entity.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintainable asset that experienced the downtime event. Links to the asset master register in the equipment domain.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Planned downtime for project tie-ins or equipment cutover is tracked against the capital project. Mining operations link downtime events to projects for production loss attribution, project performanc

attributes.name: grievance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to community.grievance. Business justification: Unplanned equipment failures trigger community complaints through emergency flaring, alarm activation, extended operating hours, or environmental releases. Link supports integrated incident investigat

attributes.name: hse_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Downtime events caused by HSE incidents (emergency shutdowns, safety isolations, environmental releases). Critical for production loss attribution, incident cost calculation, and LTIFR/TRIFR reporting

attributes.name: orebody_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to geology.orebody. Business justification: Downtime events are attributed to specific orebodies to calculate production loss tonnage by ore source, enabling accurate mine planning adjustments and orebody-specific availability metrics for produ

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.saleable_product. Business justification: Downtime events in mining are attributed to specific product campaigns (iron ore fines vs lump, copper concentrate grades). Critical for product-specific OEE calculation, production planning, and unde

attributes.name: tsf_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tailings.tsf. Business justification: Downtime events for TSF equipment (pumps, conveyors, thickeners). Critical for tracking TSF operational availability, production impact (inability to deposit tailings), and reliability metrics for reg

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance work order associated with this downtime event, if applicable. Null for unplanned breakdowns without immediate work order creation.

attributes.name: action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the corrective action taken to restore the equipment to operational status (e.g., repair, replace, adjust, clean, reset). Used for maintenance strategy analysis and cost tracking.

attributes.name: actual_repair_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost in local currency incurred to repair or resolve the downtime event, including labour, parts, contractor services, and equipment hire. Captured upon work order completion and cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the failure or downtime event (e.g., wear and tear, operator error, design defect, inadequate maintenance, environmental factors). Used for reliability improvement and preventive maintenance optimization.

attributes.name: cost_centre
attributes.description: Financial cost centre to which the downtime-related costs (labour, parts, production loss) are allocated. Used for financial reporting and departmental cost control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this downtime event record was first created in the source system. Represents the initial data capture moment for audit and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the downtime event distinguishing between planned maintenance activities, unplanned equipment failures, operational delays, and other causes. Critical for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculation.

attributes.name: downtime_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the downtime event measured in hours, calculated as the difference between downtime end and start timestamps. Used for OEE availability percentage, MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), and production loss calculations.

attributes.name: downtime_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the equipment was restored to operational status and became available for production. Represents the end of the downtime period. Null for ongoing downtime events.

attributes.name: downtime_event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the downtime event, typically auto-generated by CMMS or FMS. Used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: downtime_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the equipment became unavailable or non-operational. Represents the beginning of the downtime period. Critical for MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) and availability calculations.

attributes.name: downtime_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record indicating whether the event is ongoing, under repair, resolved and equipment returned to service, or administratively closed.

attributes.name: downtime_type
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the downtime event providing granular categorization within the downtime category (e.g., mechanical failure, electrical failure, hydraulic failure, scheduled inspection, component replacement).

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the downtime event resulted in an environmental impact such as spill, emission, or breach of environmental controls requiring regulatory notification.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in local currency to repair or resolve the downtime event, including labour, parts, and contractor costs. Captured at the time of work order creation or initial assessment.

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature of the failure, symptoms observed, and conditions leading to the downtime event. Captured by operators or maintenance technicians for detailed incident documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this downtime event record was last updated or modified in the source system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization control.

attributes.name: location_code

products.name: shutdown_plan
products.description: Master record for a planned maintenance shutdown or major overhaul event at a mine site or processing plant, including all scope items and work packages. Header captures shutdown name, type (annual shutdown, major overhaul, statutory inspection), planned and actual start/end dates, scope description, responsible superintendent, total planned duration and cost (CAPEX/OPEX), shutdown status, and project code. products.name: functional_location

attributes.name: event_description

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the reliability event, typically following a standardized numbering scheme for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reliability event. Tracks progression from identification through investigation, action assignment, implementation, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_investigation|action_assigned|in_progress|completed|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reliability event. attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability Data Collection, SAE JA1011 RCM

attributes.name: failure_mode

attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created the reliability event record in the system.

products.name: deposition
products.description: Records tailings deposition events and periodic volumetric capacity surveys for TSFs. products.name: water_balance
products.description: Periodic water balance calculations and decant operation records for TSFs and associated water management infrastructure. For water balance: captures all inflows (process water, rainfall, runoff, groundwater ingress), outflows (evaporation, seepage, decant return, spillway discharge), storage volumes, pond levels, freeboard, and reconciliation against design assumptions. For decant operations: captures decant event date, decant structure used (penstock, decant tower, pump), volume decanted, water quality at point of decant, destination (process water return, evaporation pond, treatment plant), and compliance with water licence conditions. SSOT for TSF water management including return water quality. Supports water licence compliance, TSF operational planning, and GISTM Requirement 12 (management of water).

attributes.name: balance_reconciliation_variance_percent
attributes.description: Balance reconciliation variance expressed as a percentage of total inflow. Provides a normalized measure of water balance accuracy. Acceptable variance thresholds are typically defined in operational procedures.

attributes.name: closing_storage_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of water stored in the TSF pond at the end of the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Derived from pond level survey and storage-elevation relationship.

attributes.name: crest_elevation_m
attributes.description: Current elevation of the TSF embankment crest at the time of the balance period, measured in meters above a defined datum. Used to calculate freeboard and assess storage capacity.

attributes.name: decant_return_outflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of water returned from the TSF to the process plant or water storage via decant structures during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Primary mechanism for water recovery and freeboard management.

attributes.name: design_freeboard_m
attributes.description: Minimum required freeboard specified in the TSF design for the current operational stage, measured in meters. Used to assess compliance with design criteria and trigger operational responses.

attributes.description: Volume of water lost from the TSF pond through evaporation during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Calculated from evaporation rate and pond surface area.

attributes.description: Volume of groundwater ingress into the TSF pond during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Typically estimated from piezometric monitoring and seepage models.

attributes.name: opening_storage_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of water stored in the TSF pond at the start of the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Derived from pond level survey and storage-elevation relationship.

attributes.name: other_inflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of any other water sources entering the TSF during the balance period not captured in standard inflow categories, measured in cubic meters. May include emergency water transfers or unplanned sources.

attributes.name: other_outflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of any other water losses from the TSF during the balance period not captured in standard outflow categories, measured in cubic meters. May include emergency releases or unplanned discharges.

attributes.name: process_water_inflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of process water discharged to the TSF from mineral processing operations during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Includes tailings slurry water and any additional process water streams.

attributes.name: rainfall_inflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of direct rainfall onto the TSF pond surface during the balance period, calculated from rainfall depth and pond area, measured in cubic meters.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who reviewed and validated the water balance calculation. Ensures quality control and technical oversight of water management data.

attributes.name: runoff_inflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of surface water runoff from the TSF catchment area entering the pond during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Includes runoff from embankment slopes and upstream catchment if not diverted.

attributes.name: seepage_outflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of water lost through seepage from the TSF embankment and foundation during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Estimated from piezometric data, seepage collection systems, and geotechnical models.

attributes.name: spillway_discharge_outflow_m3
attributes.description: Volume of water discharged through the TSF spillway during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Typically occurs during extreme rainfall events when pond capacity is exceeded.

attributes.name: storage_change_m3
attributes.description: Net change in water storage volume during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Calculated as closing storage minus opening storage. Should reconcile with total inflow minus total outflow.

attributes.name: total_inflow_m3
attributes.description: Sum of all water inflows to the TSF during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Calculated as process water + rainfall + runoff + groundwater + other inflows.

attributes.name: total_outflow_m3
attributes.description: Sum of all water outflows from the TSF during the balance period, measured in cubic meters. Calculated as evaporation + seepage + decant return + spillway discharge + other outflows.

attributes.name: water_licence_compliance_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the water balance period operations complied with water licence conditions including discharge limits, return water quality, and reporting requirements.

products.name: closure_plan

attributes.description: Maximum potential acidity that could be generated if all sulphide minerals in the material were to oxidise, expressed as kilograms of sulphuric acid equivalent per tonne.

attributes.name: mercury_concentration_mg_per_kg
attributes.description: Total mercury content in the material, measured in milligrams per kilogram, critical heavy metal for environmental risk assessment.

attributes.name: metal_leaching_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for metal leaching potential from the material: low, moderate, high, or very high, based on leachate test results and regulatory thresholds.

attributes.name: nag_ph
attributes.description: Final pH value from the Net Acid Generation test, indicating the acid-generating potential of the material after oxidation.

attributes.name: net_acid_generation_kg_h2so4_per_tonne
attributes.description: Net acid generation potential of the material, expressed as kilograms of sulphuric acid equivalent per tonne of material, calculated from NAG test results.

attributes.name: net_acid_producing_potential_kg_h2so4_per_tonne
attributes.description: Net acid producing potential calculated as the difference between Maximum Potential Acidity (MPA) and Acid Neutralisation Capacity (ANC), expressed as kilograms of sulphuric acid equivalent per tonne.

attributes.name: neutralisation_potential_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of Acid Neutralisation Capacity (ANC) to Maximum Potential Acidity (MPA), used to classify ARD risk: NPR less than 1 indicates Potentially Acid Forming (PAF), NPR greater than 3 indicates Non-Acid Forming (NAF), and NPR between 1 and 3 indicates Uncertain (UC).

attributes.name: nickel_concentration_mg_per_kg
attributes.description: Total nickel content in the material, measured in milligrams per kilogram, relevant for nickel mining operations and environmental assessment.

attributes.name: particle_size_d10_mm
attributes.description: Particle size distribution metric representing the diameter at which 10% of the sample mass is finer, measured in millimetres.

attributes.name: particle_size_d50_mm
attributes.description: Median particle size (D50) representing the diameter at which 50% of the sample mass is finer, measured in millimetres.

attributes.name: particle_size_d90_mm
attributes.description: Particle size distribution metric representing the diameter at which 90% of the sample mass is finer, measured in millimetres.

attributes.name: paste_ph
attributes.description: pH measurement of a paste formed by mixing the material with distilled water, indicating current acidity or alkalinity of the material.

attributes.name: permeability_m_per_s
attributes.description: Hydraulic conductivity of the material, representing the rate at which water can flow through the material under a hydraulic gradient, measured in metres per second.

attributes.name: plastic_limit_percent
attributes.description: Moisture content at which the material transitions from semi-solid to plastic state, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: plasticity_index
attributes.description: Difference between the liquid limit and plastic limit of the material, indicating the range of moisture content over which the material exhibits plastic behaviour.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the material sample was collected from the facility or dump.

attributes.name: sample_location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific location within the facility or dump where the sample was collected, including depth, zone, or lift reference.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of the density of the material to the density of water, dimensionless value used in geotechnical design and volume calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D854 Specific Gravity of Soil Solids

attributes.name: sulphide_content_percent
attributes.description: Total sulphide mineral content in the material, expressed as a percentage by weight, key indicator for Acid Rock Drainage (ARD) potential.

attributes.name: sulphur_content_percent
attributes.description: Total sulphur content in the material, expressed as a percentage by weight, used in conjunction with sulphide content for ARD assessment.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory characterisation test was completed.

attributes.name: test_method
attributes.description: Specific laboratory test method or standard applied for characterisation, such as NAG (Net Acid Generation), ANC (Acid Neutralisation Capacity), paste pH, SPLP (Synthetic Precipitation Leaching Procedure), kinetic column test, or physical property test standard.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: Category of characterisation testing performed: physical properties, geochemical analysis, Acid Rock Drainage (ARD) and Metal Leaching (ML) assessment, or combined testing.

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited laboratory that performed the characterisation testing.

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the geochemist, geotechnical engineer, or competent person who validated the characterisation results.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date when the characterisation results were validated and approved for use in design and planning.

attributes.name: waste_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory waste classification assigned to the material based on characterisation results and jurisdictional waste classification frameworks.

attributes.name: zinc_concentration_mg_per_kg
attributes.description: Total zinc content in the material, measured in milligrams per kilogram, relevant for environmental risk assessment.

Linking to material master enables chemical consumption tracking, inventory plannin

domains.name: hse
domains.description: Manages health, safety, and environmental compliance including incident reporting, LTIFR/TRIFR tracking, risk assessments, environmental monitoring, permit conditions, PPE tracking, and regulatory submissions. products.name: incident
products.description: Master record of all health, safety, and environmental incidents and their investigations at mine sites. Tracks regulatory submission deadlines for MSHA and state authority notifications. Sourced from IsoMetrix HSE event management. SSOT for ALL HSE incident records and their formal investigations.

products.name: health_surveillance
products.description: Records of occupational health surveillance, fitness-for-work assessments, and exposure monitoring for mine workers. Covers audiometric testing, spirometry, personal noise dosimetry (dB TWA), airborne dust sampling (respirable silica, coal dust, DPM in mg/m³), blood lead levels, heat stress assessments, fatigue alertness testing (PVT), and pre-employment/periodic medical examinations. Captures worker reference, test/monitoring type, hazard type discriminator (noise, dust, chemical, biological, ergonomic), measurement value, units, exceedance flags against OEL/PEL/action levels, exposure duration, fitness classification, occupational physician recommendation, restrictions, hearing protection requirements, and follow-up actions. Supports MSHA health and noise standards, Coal Mine Health and Safety Act, and ISO 45001 worker health monitoring.
products.reference: MSHA 30 CFR Part 70/71 / ISO 45001 Clause 8.1 / Occupational Health Standards

products.name: emergency_response_plan
products.description: Master register of emergency response plans (ERPs) and drill/exercise records for mine sites. Covers scenarios such as underground entrapment, explosives incidents, tailings dam failure, chemical spills, fire, and medical emergencies. Records plan type, site applicability, scenario description, response procedures, assembly points, emergency contacts, equipment resources, last review date, and approval status. Includes drill and exercise records capturing drill type, scenario tested, participants, date, duration, performance observations, debrief findings, and improvement actions. Tracks drill frequency compliance against ERP requirements and regulatory mandates. SSOT for emergency preparedness and drill compliance. Supports ISO 45001 Clause 8.2 and MSHA emergency response requirements.

products.description: Master reference table for investigation. Referenced by investigation_id.

attributes.name: investigation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for investigation

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or HSE authority who approved and signed off on the investigation report.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assigned as the primary investigator responsible for leading the investigation.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HSE incident that triggered this investigation.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining site or facility where the investigated event occurred.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the investigation was completed and findings were finalized.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation report was formally approved by management.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation was formally closed after all corrective actions were verified.

attributes.name: contributing_factors
attributes.description: Description of additional factors that contributed to the incident or event but were not the primary cause.

attributes.name: corrective_actions_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required as a result of this investigation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this investigation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost impact (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Classification level of the investigation data for access control and information security purposes.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of operational downtime caused by the incident being investigated.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident had an environmental impact requiring investigation under ISO 14001 or environmental regulations.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact
attributes.description: Estimated total financial impact of the incident including damage, downtime, remediation, and investigation costs.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the key findings from the investigation.

attributes.name: immediate_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the immediate or direct cause(s) that led to the incident or event.

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation was formally initiated.

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the investigation was formally initiated.

attributes.name: investigation_method
attributes.description: The structured investigation methodology or framework applied to analyze the event.

attributes.name: investigation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the investigation, formatted as INV-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current state of the investigation in its workflow lifecycle.

attributes.name: investigation_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee names or identifiers who are part of the investigation team.

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation based on the triggering event or purpose.

attributes.name: is_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident is recordable under MSHA or OSHA regulations for LTIFR/TRIFR tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this investigation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key lessons learned from the investigation that should be shared across the organization for continuous improvement.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the specific location within the site where the event occurred (e.g., pit level, processing plant area, haul road section).

attributes.name: recommendations

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: The date when regulatory authorities were notified of the investigation findings, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings require notification to regulatory authorities such as MSHA or environmental agencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the regulatory authority for this investigation or incident report.

attributes.name: report_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full investigation report document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the underlying root cause(s) identified through systematic analysis.

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: Severity rating assigned to the investigation based on actual or potential consequences of the triggering event.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: The planned or required date by which the investigation should be completed.

attributes.name: related_investigation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on investigation (related_investigation_id)

products.name: hazard
products.description: Master reference table for hazard. Referenced by hazard_id.

attributes.name: hazard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for hazard

attributes.name: affected_job_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the job roles, occupations, or worker categories that are exposed to or may encounter this hazard during their work activities (e.g., 'drill operators', 'blasters', 'maintenance technicians', 'haul truck drivers').

attributes.name: affected_work_areas
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the specific work areas, zones, or operational locations within the mine site where this hazard is present or may be encountered (e.g., 'underground stopes', 'processing plant', 'haul roads', 'maintenance workshop').

attributes.name: control_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The primary level of control applied to manage this hazard according to the hierarchy of controls: elimination (remove hazard), substitution (replace with less hazardous), engineering controls (isolate people from hazard), administrative controls (change work practices), or personal protective equipment (PPE).

attributes.name: control_measures
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific control measures, safeguards, or mitigation strategies implemented to reduce or eliminate the risk associated with this hazard.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this hazard record was first created in the HSE management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this hazard definition and its associated controls became effective and applicable in the organization's health and safety management system.

attributes.name: emergency_response_procedure
attributes.description: Summary or reference to the emergency response procedures, first aid measures, or incident response protocols to be followed if an incident involving this hazard occurs.

attributes.name: exposure_limit
attributes.description: The maximum permissible exposure level or threshold limit value for this hazard, including units of measure (e.g., '0.05 mg/m³ for respirable crystalline silica', '85 dBA for noise'). Applicable primarily to chemical, physical, and environmental hazards.

attributes.name: gri_disclosure_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable GRI disclosure standard or indicator related to this hazard, used for sustainability and ESG reporting (e.g., 'GRI 403: Occupational Health and Safety').

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the hazard into major categories: physical (noise, vibration, radiation), chemical (dust, fumes, gases), biological (bacteria, viruses), ergonomic (repetitive strain, manual handling), psychosocial (stress, fatigue), or environmental (spills, emissions).

attributes.name: hazard_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the hazard type for reporting and classification purposes. Follows organizational hazard coding taxonomy.

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the hazard, including its nature, potential sources, and circumstances under which it may be encountered in mining operations.

attributes.name: hazard_name
attributes.description: The common business name or title of the hazard used for identification and communication across the organization.

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Specific sub-classification or detailed type of hazard within the broader category (e.g., 'Silica Dust', 'Ground Instability', 'Heavy Equipment Operation', 'Confined Space').

attributes.name: is_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether incidents involving this hazard must be reported to external regulatory authorities such as MSHA, state mining departments, or environmental agencies. True if reportable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_incident_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent recorded incident, injury, or near-miss event associated with this hazard. Used for trend analysis and control effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating
attributes.description: The probability or frequency with which the hazard is expected to cause harm, ranging from almost certain (expected to occur frequently) to rare (may occur only in exceptional circumstances).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this hazard record was last updated or modified. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required or recommended frequency for monitoring, inspecting, or reassessing this hazard to ensure controls remain effective and exposure remains within acceptable limits.

attributes.name: permit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a work permit, hot work permit, confined space entry permit, or other authorization is required before work involving this hazard can commence. True if permit is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: ppe_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of personal protective equipment required when working in the presence of this hazard (e.g., 'hard hat', 'safety glasses', 'respirator', 'hearing protection', 'high-visibility vest', 'steel-toed boots').

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation of applicable mining safety regulations, standards, or legal requirements that govern the management of this hazard (e.g., MSHA 30 CFR Part 56, state mining acts, ISO standards).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review or reassessment of this hazard and its control measures to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk level derived from the combination of severity and likelihood, used to prioritize control measures and management attention. Extreme and high risks require immediate action.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: The potential severity of harm or consequence if the hazard materializes, rated from catastrophic (fatality or permanent total disability) to minor (first aid injury).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hazard record. Active indicates the hazard is currently recognized and managed; under review indicates reassessment is in progress; retired indicates the hazard is no longer present; superseded indicates the hazard definition has been replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific safety training or competency certification is required for workers who may be exposed to this hazard. True if training is mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: parent_hazard_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on hazard (parent_hazard_id)

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Single source of truth for all commodity buyers, offtake counterparties, and trading partners including steel mills, smelters, energy companies, and commodity traders. Manages customer profiles, credit limits, delivery destinations, contract terms, and commercial relationship hierarchies.

products.name: counterparty

Single source of truth for counterparty identity, legal entity details (ABN/ACN, DUNS number), country of incorporation, registered address, credit rating, KYC status, commercial classification, and operational preferences (preferred commodity grades, vessel sizes, loading ports, communication language, reporting format, invoice delivery method, relationship manager assignment). Includes counterparty-specific commercial and logistics preferences that drive tailored account management. Primary anchor entity for the customer domain in mining commodity sales.

attributes.name: communication_language

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd

attributes.name: credit_rating

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: incoterm_preference

attributes.name: tax_identification_number

products.name: counterparty_hierarchy
products.description: Defines the corporate ownership and commercial relationship hierarchy among counterparties, capturing parent-subsidiary relationships, group structures, and ultimate beneficial ownership. Enables consolidated credit exposure, group-level reporting, and offtake volume aggregation across related entities such as a steel group with multiple mill subsidiaries.

attributes.name: counterparty_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty hierarchy relationship record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: child_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the subsidiary, child entity, or lower-level counterparty in the hierarchy relationship. References the counterparty entity that is owned or controlled by the parent.

attributes.name: parent_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent, holding company, or higher-level counterparty in the hierarchy relationship. References the counterparty entity that owns or controls the child.

attributes.name: primary_ultimate_parent_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the ultimate beneficial owner or top-level parent entity in the corporate group structure. Used for consolidated credit exposure and group-level reporting across all subsidiaries.

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child counterparty should be included in consolidated financial reporting and group-level credit exposure calculations for the parent entity.

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the parent exercises control over the child counterparty. Direct control is through direct ownership; indirect is through intermediary entities; joint is shared control with other parties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_aggregation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit exposure from this child counterparty should be aggregated with the parent for group credit limit monitoring and risk assessment purposes.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship became effective. Supports temporal analysis of corporate structure changes and historical credit exposure reporting.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship ended or is scheduled to end. Null for currently active relationships. Used for historical analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the organizational hierarchy tree, with 1 representing the ultimate parent and increasing numbers representing deeper subsidiary levels. Enables depth-based queries and reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty hierarchy relationship record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier for the child counterparty in this relationship. 20-character alphanumeric code used for global entity identification in financial transactions.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership or control that the parent counterparty holds in the child counterparty. Used to determine consolidation requirements and credit exposure allocation.

attributes.name: relationship_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the hierarchical relationship, including special arrangements, control mechanisms, or commercial considerations relevant to credit and trading decisions.

attributes.name: relationship_source
attributes.description: Source of information used to establish the hierarchical relationship. Indicates the reliability and verification level of the relationship data.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchical relationship. Active relationships are used for credit aggregation and group reporting; inactive relationships are historical.

attributes.name: relationship_type

attributes.name: verification_date

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification status of the hierarchical relationship data. Verified relationships have been confirmed through reliable sources; unverified relationships require validation.
