attributes.description: Target ash content percentage for coal blends. Lower ash content increases energy value and reduces waste (typical range 8-25%).

attributes.name: target_energy_content_kcal_kg
attributes.description: Target calorific value for coal blends measured in kilocalories per kilogram. Critical for thermal coal pricing and power generation efficiency (typical range 4500-7000 kcal/kg).

attributes.name: target_fe_grade_percent
attributes.description: Target iron content percentage for iron ore blends, typically 58-67% Fe. Critical for meeting customer specifications and pricing.

attributes.name: target_moisture_percent
attributes.description: Target moisture content percentage for the blended product. Critical for shipping weight calculations and product quality (typical range 2-10%).

attributes.name: target_phosphorus_percent
attributes.description: Target phosphorus content percentage for iron ore blends. Low phosphorus is critical for high-grade steel production (typical range 0.02-0.10%).

attributes.name: target_silica_percent
attributes.description: Target silica content percentage for iron ore and mineral blends. Lower silica is preferred for steel-making (typical range 2-8%).

attributes.name: target_specification_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the product specification that this blend is designed to meet, including grade parameters, moisture limits, and quality tolerances.

attributes.name: tolerance_range_percent
attributes.description: Allowable deviation from target specification expressed as percentage (e.g., ±2% for Fe grade). Defines acceptable quality variance for the blend.
attributes.references: Product Specification Standard, Quality Control Procedures

products.name: blend_component
products.description: Association entity defining the individual source product components within a product blend recipe, including the component product reference, target blend ratio (%), minimum ratio (%), maximum ratio (%), and the specific grade parameter contribution of that component to the final blend. Enables blend recipe management and supports real-time blend tracking at ROM pad and port stockpile operations. Carries its own business data beyond the parent blend record.
products.reference: Blend Optimisation Models / Caterpillar MineStar Stockpile Management

attributes.name: blend_component_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product blend component record. Primary key.

attributes.name: blend_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product blend recipe that this component belongs to. Links to the product_blend master entity.

attributes.name: primary_blend_saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source product that serves as a component in this blend. Links to the product master entity representing the individual mineral product (e.g., iron ore fines from specific pit, lump ore from specific source).

attributes.name: blending_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this component when multiple blend recipes are being executed simultaneously. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by blend optimization systems.

attributes.name: component_availability_status
attributes.description: Current availability status of this component product for blending operations. Indicates whether the component is readily available, constrained, or unavailable for production planning.

attributes.name: component_cost_per_tonne
attributes.description: The unit cost per tonne of this component product. Used for blend cost optimization and product margin analysis. Represents internal transfer price or production cost.

attributes.name: component_grade_al2o3_pct
attributes.description: The alumina (Al2O3) grade percentage of this component product. Represents the alumina content contribution to the blend. Monitored for product specification compliance.

attributes.name: component_grade_fe_pct
attributes.description: The iron (Fe) grade percentage of this specific component product. Represents the Fe content contribution that this component brings to the final blend. Critical for calculating blended Fe grade for iron ore products.

attributes.name: component_grade_p_pct
attributes.description: The phosphorus (P) grade percentage of this component product. Critical impurity parameter for steel-making iron ore products. Managed to meet customer specifications.

attributes.name: component_grade_s_pct
attributes.description: The sulfur (S) grade percentage of this component product. Critical impurity parameter for steel-making iron ore products. Managed to meet customer specifications.

attributes.name: component_grade_sio2_pct
attributes.description: The silica (SiO2) grade percentage of this component product. Represents the gangue content that this component contributes to the blend. Important for managing impurity levels in final product.

attributes.name: component_loi_pct
attributes.description: The loss on ignition (LOI) percentage of this component product. Represents volatile content and combined water. Important for calculating true mineral content and meeting product specifications.

attributes.name: component_moisture_pct
attributes.description: The typical moisture content percentage of this component product. Used to calculate dry weight contributions and manage moisture limits in the final blend for shipping and handling.

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: Ordering sequence of this component within the blend recipe. Used for display and processing order in blend execution systems.

attributes.name: component_size_fraction
attributes.description: The size fraction classification of this component product (e.g., fines, lump, pellet). Defines the physical form and particle size distribution of the component material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fines|lump|pellet|concentrate|ROM|crushed|screened — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: component_source_location
attributes.description: The mine site, pit, or processing plant location from which this component product originates. Enables traceability and source tracking for blend components.

attributes.name: component_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this blend component record. Indicates whether the component is actively used in production, temporarily suspended, or retired from the blend recipe.

attributes.name: component_stockpile_code
attributes.description: The ROM pad or port stockpile code where this component material is stored. Links blend recipe to physical inventory locations for operational execution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this blend component record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this component is valid in the blend recipe. Supports time-based blend recipe versioning and seasonal blend variations.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this component is valid in the blend recipe. Null for currently active components. Supports blend recipe lifecycle management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: is_critical_component
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component is critical to the blend recipe and cannot be substituted. True if the component is essential for meeting product specifications; False if alternative components may be used.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this blend component record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this blend component record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: maximum_blend_ratio_pct
attributes.description: The maximum allowable percentage contribution of this component to the blend. Defines the upper bound of acceptable blend variance for operational flexibility and quality control.

attributes.name: minimum_blend_ratio_pct
attributes.description: The minimum allowable percentage contribution of this component to the blend. Defines the lower bound of acceptable blend variance for operational flexibility and quality control.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about this blend component. May include special handling instructions, quality considerations, or operational constraints.

attributes.name: quality_variance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: The allowable percentage variance in component quality parameters (grade, moisture, etc.) from the specified values. Defines acceptable quality fluctuation for operational flexibility.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this component can be substituted with an alternative product if unavailable. True if substitution is permitted within defined quality parameters; False if this specific component must be used.

attributes.name: target_blend_ratio_pct
attributes.description: The target percentage contribution of this component to the final blend by weight. Represents the ideal ratio for achieving desired product specifications. Must sum to 100% across all components in a blend.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this blend component record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: specification_revision
products.description: Tracks the version history and change management of product specifications over time, recording the previous specification values, new specification values, reason for change (process improvement, market requirement, regulatory update, customer request), change approval authority, effective date, and whether existing offtake agreements are impacted. Ensures full auditability of specification changes and supports commercial renegotiation when specifications are tightened or relaxed.
products.reference: ISO 9001 Document Control / SAP S/4HANA Change Management

attributes.name: specification_revision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each product specification revision record. Primary key for the product specification revision entity.

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral product whose specification is being revised (iron ore fines, lump, copper concentrate, thermal coal, lithium hydroxide, nickel matte).

attributes.name: superseded_revision_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous product specification revision that this revision replaces. Enables full version history tracking and audit trail of specification evolution over time. Nullable for the initial specification revision.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name and title of the individual or committee who authorized this specification revision (e.g., Chief Operating Officer, Technical Director, Product Steering Committee). Establishes accountability and governance compliance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specification revision was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from draft to approved status and triggers implementation planning.

attributes.name: change_reason_category
attributes.description: Primary business driver for this specification revision. Process improvement indicates internal operational enhancement, market requirement indicates competitive positioning, regulatory update indicates compliance mandate, customer request indicates specific buyer need, cost optimization indicates economic efficiency, quality enhancement indicates product performance improvement.

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why this specification revision was initiated, including business context, stakeholder input, and expected benefits. Supports audit trail and commercial renegotiation justification.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact estimate (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD). Ensures consistent financial reporting and currency conversion.

attributes.name: cost_impact_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated change in operating expenditure (OPEX) or capital expenditure (CAPEX) resulting from this specification revision, expressed in the reporting currency. Positive values indicate cost increases, negative values indicate savings. Used for financial planning and pricing adjustments.
attributes.references: Financial Reporting Standards, Cost Accounting Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specification revision record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which customers were formally notified of this specification revision. Used to track compliance with contractual notice periods and manage customer expectations.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal notification to customers is required under contract terms (typically 30-90 days advance notice for material specification changes). True if notification is mandatory, false if change is immaterial.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this specification revision becomes binding for production, quality control, and commercial contracts. Aligns with offtake agreement terms and customer notification periods.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this specification revision is superseded or ceases to be valid. Nullable for currently active revisions with no planned end date.

attributes.name: grade_parameter_changes
attributes.description: Detailed listing of changes to mineral grade specifications (e.g., Fe min/max, Cu grade, ash content, sulfur limits, phosphorus limits, alumina, silica). Structured as parameter name, old value, new value, and tolerance. Critical for assay compliance and pricing adjustments.
attributes.references: JORC Code, ISO 10251 Copper Concentrate Standard

attributes.name: impacted_contract_count
attributes.description: Number of active offtake agreements, sales contracts, or customer commitments that are affected by this specification revision. Used for prioritizing commercial engagement and risk assessment.

attributes.name: implementation_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document link to the detailed implementation plan for this specification revision (e.g., project code, work breakdown structure (WBS) reference, change request number). Links to project management systems for tracking execution.

attributes.name: impurity_limit_changes
attributes.description: Changes to maximum allowable levels of deleterious elements (e.g., phosphorus, sulfur, arsenic, lead, mercury, cadmium). Critical for steel-making quality, environmental compliance, and penalty clauses in offtake agreements.
attributes.references: ISO 4701 Iron Ores Phosphorus Content, Environmental Protection Standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who last modified this specification revision record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this specification revision record was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: moisture_limit_change
attributes.description: Change to maximum allowable moisture content specification (e.g., from 8.0% to 7.5%). Impacts shipping weight calculations, cargo stability, and customer acceptance criteria per Incoterms.
attributes.references: ISO 3087 Iron Ores Moisture Content, Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: new_specification_summary
attributes.description: Snapshot of the key specification parameters in this revision (e.g., Fe content 62.5-64.0%, moisture max 7.5%, size 0-10mm). Defines the new quality standards for production, assay validation, and customer acceptance.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification revision affects existing offtake agreements and may require commercial renegotiation, customer notification, or pricing adjustments. True if contracts are impacted, false if change is within existing tolerance bands.

attributes.name: packaging_standard_change
attributes.description: Change to packaging, containerization, or bulk handling specifications (e.g., bulk vessel shipment, ISO container, super sacks, drums). Impacts logistics costs, handling procedures, and customer receiving facilities.

attributes.name: previous_specification_summary
attributes.description: Snapshot of the key specification parameters from the prior revision (e.g., Fe content 62.0-63.5%, moisture max 8.0%, size 0-10mm). Enables before-and-after comparison and impact analysis for existing contracts.

attributes.name: pricing_adjustment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification revision necessitates a change in product pricing, premium/discount structures, or penalty clauses in sales contracts. True if pricing renegotiation is required, false if existing pricing remains valid.
attributes.references: Sales and Marketing Standards, Contract Management

attributes.name: production_process_impact
attributes.description: Description of changes required in mining, processing, or beneficiation operations to meet the new specification (e.g., adjusted crusher settings, modified flotation reagents, tighter blending controls). Informs operational planning and capital expenditure (CAPEX) requirements.

attributes.name: quality_control_procedure_update
attributes.description: Reference to updated quality control procedures, sampling protocols, or assay methods required to verify compliance with the new specification (e.g., increased sampling frequency, new analytical method for trace elements). Links to Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) procedures.
attributes.references: ISO 3082 Sampling Standards, ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_impact
attributes.description: Description of how this specification revision relates to regulatory requirements (e.g., new environmental limits on heavy metals, updated export standards, revised safety data sheet requirements). Links to specific regulations or standards.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management, REACH Regulation, Export Control Standards

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential or coded identifier for this specification revision (e.g., REV-001, V2.3, 2024-R05). Used for version tracking and reference in commercial documentation.

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this specification revision. Draft indicates work in progress, under review indicates pending approval, approved indicates ready for implementation, active indicates currently in force, superseded indicates replaced by newer revision, withdrawn indicates cancelled before activation.

attributes.name: size_distribution_change
attributes.description: Change to particle size specifications (e.g., lump 6-31mm, fines 0-6mm, concentrate -150 micron 80%). Affects downstream processing efficiency, handling characteristics, and customer blending requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3082 Iron Ores Sampling and Sample Preparation

attributes.name: technical_review_committee
attributes.description: Name of the cross-functional committee or working group that reviewed and validated the technical feasibility of this specification revision (e.g., Product Quality Committee, Technical Services Team). Ensures multi-disciplinary input from geology, processing, quality, and commercial functions.

attributes.name: technical_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the technical review committee completed their assessment of this specification revision. Precedes formal approval and marks completion of technical due diligence.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the individual who initiated this specification revision record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

products.name: test_specification
products.description: This association product represents the testing requirements between saleable products and analytical methods. It captures the mandatory quality control and certification requirements that govern which analytical methods must be applied to each saleable product, including test frequency, sampling protocols, acceptance criteria, and regulatory compliance requirements. Each record links one saleable product to one analytical method with attributes that define how that specific product must be tested using that specific method.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, each saleable product requires multiple analytical methods for complete quality characterization (e.g., iron ore fines need Fe assay via XRF, moisture via LECO, size distribution via sieve analysis, and impurity testing via ICP-MS). Conversely, each analytical method applies to multiple products (e.g., XRF pressed pellet method is used for iron ore, copper concentrate, and nickel matte). The laboratory actively manages product test specifications that define which tests are mandatory, at what frequency, with what acceptance criteria, and under which regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: test_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this product-method testing requirement. Primary key.

attributes.name: analytical_method_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Test Specification - Analytical Method Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the analytical method that must be applied

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Test Specification - Saleable Product Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the saleable product that requires testing

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Pass/fail criteria or acceptable range for analytical results when this method is applied to this product. Defines the quality thresholds that must be met for the product to be released for sale or shipment.

attributes.name: approved_for_export_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this method applied to this product are acceptable for inclusion in export quality certificates and customs documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product test specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this testing requirement became active and must be enforced for this product-method combination.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this testing requirement was superseded or retired. Null for currently active requirements.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is mandatory for product release and certification, or optional/supplementary. Mandatory tests must pass before product can be shipped.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in this product test specification record.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Citation of the regulatory standard, customer contract clause, or internal quality policy that mandates this test for this product. Examples: JORC Code requirement, customer specification clause, export permit condition.

attributes.name: retest_required_on_failure
attributes.description: Indicates whether a failed test result requires automatic retesting using the same method, or whether failure triggers immediate product hold.

attributes.name: sample_size_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum sample mass or volume required for this test on this product, measured in kilograms or liters. Ensures sufficient material for reliable analysis.

attributes.name: sampling_protocol
attributes.description: Specific sampling procedure and protocol that must be followed when collecting samples of this product for analysis using this method. May reference standards like ISO 3082 for iron ore sampling or ASTM D2234 for coal sampling.

attributes.name: test_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency at which this analytical method must be applied to this saleable product. Driven by quality control requirements, customer contract specifications, and regulatory mandates.

products.name: product_approved_vendor_material
products.description: This association product represents the commercial supply agreement between a saleable mineral product and an approved vendor. It captures negotiated pricing, delivery terms, quality specifications, and approval status for each vendor-product combination. Each record links one saleable product to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this supply relationship. This is the operational SSOT for vendor-product sourcing decisions, governing which vendors are qualified to supply which products under what commercial terms.. Existence Justification: Mining operations maintain approved vendor lists (AVL) for procurement materials and supplies, where multiple vendors can be qualified to supply the same product (competitive sourcing strategy), and each vendor supplies multiple product types. The procurement team actively manages vendor-product approvals with negotiated pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and approval status that are specific to each vendor-product combination. This is an operational business process with relationship data that belongs to neither the product nor the vendor alone.

attributes.name: product_approved_vendor_material_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product_approved_vendor_material

attributes.name: approved_vendor_material_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each vendor-product approval record. Primary key.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Vendor Material - Supply Vendor Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the approved vendor supplying the product

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Vendor Material - Saleable Product Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the saleable mineral product being sourced

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor was approved to supply this product. Used for audit trail and approval lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor approval for this product expires and requires renewal. Triggers recertification workflows.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this vendor for supplying this specific product. Pending: under evaluation, Approved: qualified to supply, Suspended: temporarily not allowed, Expired: approval period ended, Rejected: failed qualification.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the master supply contract or framework agreement governing this vendor-product relationship.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor-product approval record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard delivery lead time in calendar days from order placement to delivery for this vendor-product combination. Critical for production planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity in tonnes that this vendor requires for this product. Vendor-specific constraint that may differ from the product's general minimum order quantity.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vendor-product approval record.

attributes.name: negotiated_unit_price
attributes.description: Contracted price per unit (typically per tonne) negotiated with this vendor for this specific product. Varies by vendor-product combination based on volume commitments, payment terms, and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred supplier for this product based on price, quality, reliability, or strategic relationship. Used to prioritize sourcing decisions when multiple approved vendors exist.

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: End date until which the negotiated unit price remains valid. Triggers renegotiation when approaching expiry.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Start date from which the negotiated unit price is valid for this vendor-product combination.

attributes.name: quality_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific quality specification document or agreement governing this vendor's supply of this product. May differ from the general product specification.

products.name: specification_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the versioned specification assignment between saleable products and their technical specifications. It captures the temporal validity and version control of specifications applied to commercial products. Each record links one saleable_product to one product_specification with effective dates, version tracking, and customer-specific specification flags that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, a single saleable product can have multiple specifications simultaneously (customer-specific specs for premium customers vs standard market specs) and over time (version upgrades as processing improves or market requirements change). Conversely, a single specification can apply to multiple saleable products (e.g., a standard moisture specification applying to multiple iron ore grades, or a generic copper concentrate specification applying to products from different mines). The business actively manages these specification assignments with version control, temporal validity, and customer-specific variations for contract compliance.

attributes.name: specification_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each product specification assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: saleable_product_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Specification Assignment - Saleable Product Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the saleable mineral product variant

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Specification Assignment - Product Specification Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the technical product specification

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specification assignment. Draft: under review, Active: in commercial use, Superseded: replaced by newer version, Retired: no longer valid.

attributes.name: contractual_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the sales contract, offtake agreement, or commercial document that mandates this specific specification assignment. Links specification to contractual obligations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this specification assignment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification assignment is customer-specific (true) or applies to general market sales (false). Enables differentiated specifications for different customer segments.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this specification assignment becomes valid for the saleable product. Critical for contract compliance and version control.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this specification assignment remains valid. Null indicates an open-ended assignment. Enables specification versioning and temporal tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this specification assignment record.

attributes.name: specification_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the specification assignment following semantic versioning. Tracks which version of the specification applies to the product during this period.

domains.name: tenement
domains.description: Manages the land access and mineral rights portfolio including exploration licences, mining leases, native title agreements, heritage clearances, surface rights, and royalty agreements. Tracks tenement boundaries via GIS, renewal obligations, expenditure commitments, and regulatory conditions.
domains.references: Local Mining Acts, GRI Mining Sector

products.name: tenement
products.description: Master register of all mineral tenements held or applied for by the company, including exploration licences, mining leases, prospecting licences, and retention licences. SSOT for tenement identity, licence type, status, jurisdiction, granted commodities, area (hectares), grant/expiry dates, and lifecycle status (application, granted, suspended, surrendered, expired, forfeited). Each record represents one tenement with its unique statutory identifier.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the tenement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Tenements are primary cost objects in mining operations. Each tenement is assigned to a cost centre for operational cost tracking, AISC calculation, and unit cost reporting. Essential for monthly mana

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Tenements are evaluated as profit-generating assets. Assignment to profit centres enables segment P&L reporting, asset-level profitability analysis, and investment decision support. Required for IFRS

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each tenement requires an accountable manager for operational oversight, expenditure approval, regulatory correspondence, and delegation of authority. Real business process: tenement management accoun

attributes.name: annual_expenditure_commitment
attributes.description: The minimum annual expenditure amount (in local currency) that must be spent on exploration or development activities to maintain the tenement in good standing. Failure to meet this commitment may result in forfeiture.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement application was submitted to the regulatory authority. Establishes priority in jurisdictions with first-in-time rules.

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: The total surface area of the tenement measured in hectares. Defines the spatial extent of the mineral rights.

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: The latitude coordinate of the tenement centroid in decimal degrees. Used for approximate location reference and spatial queries.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: The longitude coordinate of the tenement centroid in decimal degrees. Used for approximate location reference and spatial queries.

attributes.name: coordinate_system
attributes.description: The coordinate reference system (CRS) or projection used for the tenement boundary (e.g., 'GDA2020 MGA Zone 50', 'NAD83 UTM Zone 11N'). Critical for accurate spatial representation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the tenement is located (e.g., AUS, CAN, USA, ZAF).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tenement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Summary of key environmental conditions or restrictions imposed on the tenement by the regulatory authority (e.g., 'No clearing within 100m of watercourses', 'Seasonal access restrictions during breeding season'). Free-text field for recording compliance obligations.

attributes.name: expenditure_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the annual expenditure commitment (e.g., AUD, CAD, USD, ZAR).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement licence term ends unless renewed. Critical for tracking renewal obligations and avoiding forfeiture.

attributes.name: gis_boundary_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the GIS spatial dataset defining the tenement boundary coordinates. Enables integration with GIS systems for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: grant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tenement was officially granted by the regulatory authority, marking the commencement of the licence term.

attributes.name: granted_commodities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of minerals or commodities for which the tenement grants exploration or extraction rights (e.g., 'Iron Ore, Gold, Copper', 'Lithium, Nickel'). Defines the scope of permitted mineral activities.

attributes.name: heritage_clearance_status
attributes.description: The status of cultural heritage clearance for the tenement. Not Required: no heritage survey needed; Cleared: heritage survey completed with no restrictions; Survey Required: heritage assessment not yet conducted; Restricted Areas Identified: heritage sites present requiring protection; Pending: clearance process underway.
attributes.references: Heritage Protection Act (jurisdiction-specific), ICMM Cultural Heritage Standard

attributes.name: holder_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the entity or individual registered as the holder of the tenement. May be the company itself or a subsidiary.

attributes.name: holder_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage ownership interest held by the registered holder in this tenement. Relevant for joint ventures or partial interests. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: joint_venture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tenement is held under a joint venture arrangement with one or more partners. True if joint venture; False if sole ownership.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The state, province, or territory in which the tenement is registered and governed (e.g., 'Western Australia', 'Queensland', 'British Columbia'). Determines the applicable mining legislation and regulatory authority.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent physical or regulatory inspection of the tenement. Used to track compliance monitoring and site visit schedules.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty payee indicating the type of entity receiving the payment (e.g., government authority, private landowner, native title holder, joint venture partner).

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual due date by which the royalty payment must be remitted to the payee, as specified in the royalty agreement terms.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this royalty payment for tracking and reconciliation purposes with payee and finance systems.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty payment indicating its progression through calculation, approval, remittance, and reconciliation stages. attributes.name: production_period_end_date

attributes.name: production_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the production period for which this royalty payment is calculated. Defines the beginning of the reporting period covered by this payment.

attributes.name: production_tonnage
attributes.description: Total tonnage of mineral commodity produced or sold during the production period that is subject to royalty calculation, measured in metric tonnes.

attributes.name: regulatory_return_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory royalty return or report submitted to government authorities (e.g., Mining Rehabilitation Fund return, state royalty return) that includes this payment.

attributes.name: royalty_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the royalty is calculated: revenue-based (percentage of sales revenue), profit-based (percentage of net profit), tonnage-based (per tonne rate), or fixed fee.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Applicable royalty rate percentage applied to the production value or tonnage to calculate the royalty amount. Rate is determined by the royalty agreement terms and may vary by commodity, grade, or production volume.

products.name: application

attributes.name: fee_currency

attributes.name: grant_date

attributes.name: hearing_scheduled_date

attributes.name: heritage_clearance_required_flag

attributes.name: jurisdiction

attributes.name: mineral_sought

attributes.name: native_title_clearance_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether native title clearance or Indigenous Land Use Agreement (ILUA) is required before the application can be granted, based on the location and applicable native title claims.

attributes.name: native_title_clearance_status
attributes.description: The current status of native title clearance or ILUA negotiation for this application.

attributes.name: objection_grounds

attributes.name: objection_lodgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the objection was formally lodged with the regulatory authority. Null if no objection received.

attributes.name: objection_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any formal objections have been lodged against this application by third parties, native title claimants, environmental groups, or other stakeholders.

attributes.name: objection_resolution
attributes.description: The outcome of the objection process: whether the objection was upheld (application refused or modified), dismissed (application proceeds), settled (parties reached agreement), withdrawn by objector, or still pending.

attributes.name: objection_resolution_date

attributes.name: objector_name

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The final disposition of the application after regulatory review and decision-making process.

attributes.name: priority_date
attributes.description: The date from which the applicant's priority rights are calculated, which may differ from lodgement date in cases of renewals, conversions, or transfers. Critical for determining precedence over competing applications.

attributes.name: refusal_reason

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The name of the government department, ministry, or agency responsible for processing and deciding on this tenement application (e.g., Department of Mines, Ministry of Natural Resources).

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: A description of the reason the applicant withdrew the application, if applicable. Null if application was not withdrawn.

products.name: transfer
products.description: Records all transfers, assignments, and changes of ownership or interest in tenements. attributes.name: transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tenement transfer transaction. Primary key for the tenement transfer record.

attributes.name: primary_transferee_party_counterparty_id

attributes.name: transfer_counterparty_id

attributes.name: completion_date

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value paid or payable by the transferee to the transferor for the transferred interest. Excludes contingent payments and royalties unless explicitly included in the transfer agreement.

attributes.name: consideration_currency_code

attributes.name: contingent_payment_flag

attributes.name: due_diligence_completion_date

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: environmental_approval_flag

attributes.name: native_title_consent_date

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_name

attributes.name: transfer_date

attributes.name: transferee_legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the transferee party as registered with the regulatory authority. Captured for regulatory notification and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: transferor_retained_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership interest retained by the transferor after the transfer. For full assignments this is 0.00; for partial assignments this reflects the remaining interest.

products.name: holder
products.description: Association entity recording the legal ownership structure of each tenement at any point in time, supporting temporal queries on historical and current interests. Captures joint venture participant identity, percentage interest held, operator/non-operator designation, effective date, end date, registration status with the mining registrar, and source transaction reference (transfer, farm-in, dilution). Supports multi-party JV management, interest reconciliation, regulatory notifications of ownership changes, and annual return lodgement to the mining registrar. SSOT for 'who owns what percentage of which tenement at any given date'.
products.reference: JV Ownership Register / Tenement Holder Register

attributes.name: holder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tenement holder record. Primary key for this association entity tracking ownership interests in tenements over time.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company, joint venture participant, or individual) holding an ownership interest in the tenement. Links to the party master for counterparty details.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenement (exploration licence, mining lease, or other mineral right) for which ownership is being recorded.

attributes.name: annual_return_lodgement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership interest has been included in the most recent annual return lodged with the mining registrar. True if reported; False if not yet reported. Used to track compliance with annual reporting obligations.

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_disclosed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ultimate beneficial owner of this interest has been disclosed to the mining registrar, as required by anti-money laundering and transparency regulations. True if disclosed; False if not yet disclosed or not required.

attributes.name: consideration_amount
attributes.description: Monetary consideration paid for this ownership interest transfer. Used for financial reporting, tax calculations, and asset valuation. Null if no consideration (e.g., initial grant, inheritance, or corporate restructure). Confidential commercial information.

attributes.name: consideration_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the consideration amount. Examples: AUD (Australian Dollar), USD (United States Dollar), CAD (Canadian Dollar). Null if no consideration amount.

attributes.name: contributing_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this holder is contributing to ongoing expenditure commitments and operations. True if actively funding; False if carried or diluted. Used for cost allocation and expenditure commitment tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tenement holder record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: dilution_trigger_event
attributes.description: Description of the event or milestone that triggered a dilution of this holders interest. Examples include failure to contribute to expenditure, decision not to participate in development, or automatic dilution clause in joint venture agreement. Null if no dilution has occurred.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ownership interest became legally effective. Typically the date of transfer registration, farm-in completion, or initial grant. Used for temporal queries on historical ownership structures.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ownership interest ceased or was transferred. Null for current active holdings. Used to track historical ownership changes, dilutions, and exits from joint ventures.

attributes.name: free_carried_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of this holders interest that is free-carried (not required to contribute to costs) through a specified stage or milestone. Common in farm-in agreements where one party funds exploration in exchange for equity. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: free_carried_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which the free-carried interest applies. After this date, the holder must contribute pro-rata to costs or face dilution. Null if free-carried arrangement is perpetual or not applicable.

attributes.name: joint_venture_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture agreement document that governs this ownership interest and the relationship between multiple holders. Used to link to contract management systems and legal repositories.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tenement holder record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about this ownership interest, such as special conditions, disputes, pending legal matters, or historical context. Used for operational reference and audit trail.

attributes.name: notification_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mining registrar acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the ownership change notification. Used to confirm regulatory compliance and avoid penalties for late notification.

attributes.name: notification_lodged_date
attributes.description: Date on which notification of this ownership change was lodged with the mining registrar or regulatory authority. Required for compliance with mining legislation that mandates timely notification of ownership transfers.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this holder is the designated operator of the tenement. True if this party manages day-to-day operations and regulatory compliance; False if non-operator (passive investor). Only one holder per tenement should be operator at any given time.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage interest held by this party in the tenement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 45.50 for 45.5%). Used for royalty calculations, cost allocation, and regulatory reporting. Must sum to 100.00 across all holders for a given tenement and effective period.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for this holder record, often used in regulatory filings, joint venture agreements, and mining registrar notifications. May be a registration number or transaction reference.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this ownership interest was formally registered with the mining registrar. May differ from effective_date if there is a lag between transaction completion and official registration.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current status of this ownership interest with the mining registrar. Registered indicates formal acceptance; Pending indicates lodged but not yet approved; Lodged indicates submitted for processing; Rejected indicates application denied; Cancelled indicates ownership revoked; Transferred indicates interest moved to another party.

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this holder has a royalty obligation attached to their interest. True if holder must pay royalties on production; False if no royalty applies. Used for revenue forecasting and financial modeling.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate of royalty payable on production or revenue from this tenement interest. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 2.50 for 2.5%). Null if no royalty applies. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: stamp_duty_amount
attributes.description: Amount of stamp duty or transfer tax paid on this ownership transfer. Used for financial reporting and tax reconciliation. Null if no stamp duty applies or not yet paid.

attributes.name: stamp_duty_paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether stamp duty or transfer tax has been paid on this ownership transfer. True if paid; False if not yet paid or not applicable. Required for registration in many jurisdictions.
attributes.references: State Revenue Office, Stamp Duty Legislation

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the source transaction document or system record that created this ownership change. May be a contract number, transfer deed reference, or internal transaction identifier. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction that created or modified this ownership interest. Initial Grant for original tenement award; Transfer for sale/purchase; Farm-In for earning interest through expenditure; Farm-Out for divesting interest; Dilution for reduced percentage due to other parties earning in; Acquisition for corporate takeover; Divestment for sale; Merger for corporate combination; Relinquishment for voluntary surrender. attributes.description: Reference number of the transfer deed or instrument that legally transferred this ownership interest. Required for mining registrar lodgement and audit trail. Null if this is an initial grant rather than a transfer.

products.name: programme_of_work
products.description: Records approved programmes of work (PoW), mining proposals, and activity notifications submitted to regulatory authorities for planned exploration or mining activities on a tenement. Captures PoW reference number, submission date, approval date, planned activity type (drilling, clearing, bulk sampling, road construction), proposed disturbance area in hectares, estimated expenditure, environmental management commitments, approval conditions, validity period, and completion/close-out status. Prerequisite: heritage_clearance must be obtained before PoW approval for ground-disturbing activities. Required before commencing any ground-disturbing activity under mining regulations (e.g., WA Mining Act 1978 s.20). Supports expenditure commitment evidence and regulatory audit trails.

products.name: tenement_recovery_target
products.description: This association product represents the planning linkage between recovery targets and the tenements that supply ore to those targets. It captures which tenements contribute ore to which recovery targets in the Life of Mine plan. Each record links one recovery target to one tenement with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship, enabling tenement-specific recovery performance tracking and variance analysis.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, recovery targets are set at the processing circuit level and can receive ore from multiple tenements with different ore characteristics, while a single tenement can supply ore to multiple recovery targets (different circuits, time periods, or ore types). The business actively manages these linkages in Life of Mine planning to track which tenements feed which processing targets, with tenement-specific recovery rates and throughput allocations that vary by the tenement-target combination.

products.name: contract_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of procurement contracts to mineral tenements for cost tracking and financial reporting. It captures the commercial relationship between a tenement and a contract, including allocation percentages, cost centre assignments, and time-bound effectiveness periods. Each record links one tenement to one contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship, enabling accurate cost attribution and contract compliance monitoring across the mining portfolio.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, a single procurement contract (e.g., drilling services, equipment hire, site services) is routinely allocated across multiple active tenements based on where the work is performed or resources are consumed. Conversely, each tenement draws from multiple contracts simultaneously (drilling, equipment, consumables, services). The business actively manages these allocations with specific percentages, cost centres, and time periods to ensure accurate cost attribution and financial reporting at the tenement level.
