attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the position, typically used in SAP HR and workforce planning systems. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each approved position.

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the position's responsibilities, accountabilities, and key performance indicators. May reference formal position description documents.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the position. Active: filled and operational; Vacant: approved but unfilled; Frozen: temporarily suspended; Planned: future position for LOM planning; Closed: permanently eliminated.

attributes.name: roster_pattern
attributes.description: Standard roster or shift pattern for the position (e.g., 2-weeks-on-1-week-off, 8-days-on-6-days-off, day-shift-only, 12-hour-rotating). Used for fatigue management and workforce planning.

attributes.name: succession_plan_status
attributes.description: Current state of succession planning for this position. Critical for statutory roles and key leadership positions to ensure continuity.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as defined in the organizational structure (e.g., Mine Superintendent, Geologist, Maintenance Planner, HSE Coordinator).

attributes.name: workforce_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workforce engagement model for this position. FIFO: Fly-In Fly-Out roster; Residential: permanent site-based.

products.name: roster
products.description: Roster pattern master defining scheduled work rotation cycles used across mine operations including FIFO (fly-in fly-out), DIDO (drive-in drive-out), and residential arrangements. Captures roster name, cycle length (e.g. 8/6, 14/7, 28/14, 4/3), shift pattern (day-only, day-night rotating, continental), site, applicable department, fatigue risk rating, maximum consecutive shifts, and effective dates. Foundation for shift scheduling, fatigue management compliance, and mobilisation planning.

attributes.name: roster_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the roster pattern. Primary key.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the department or operational unit to which this roster pattern applies (e.g., Mining Operations, Processing, Maintenance, Geology). Links to the organizational structure.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mine site or operational location where this roster pattern is applied. Links to the site master data.

attributes.name: accommodation_type
attributes.description: Type of accommodation provided or required for workers on this roster pattern. Camp Single for individual camp rooms, Camp Shared for shared camp rooms, Hotel for commercial accommodation, Self-Arranged for worker-sourced accommodation, Not Applicable for residential rosters.

attributes.name: allowance_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the standard allowance or loading applicable to this roster pattern (e.g., FIFO_ALLOW, REMOTE_ALLOW, SHIFT_LOAD). Links to payroll allowance master data for compensation calculations.

attributes.name: annual_leave_accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which annual leave accrues per day worked under this roster pattern, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0833 for 1/12th of a day per day worked). Used for payroll integration and leave balance calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll, Local Labor Law

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this roster pattern was formally approved for use. Supports audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this roster pattern for operational use. Supports governance and accountability tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory or industry framework governing this roster pattern (e.g., 'MSHA Part 46', 'ISO 45001', 'National Employment Standards Australia', 'Fair Work Act'). Supports audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: MSHA Regulations, ISO 45001, Local Labor Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this roster pattern record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_length_days
attributes.description: Total number of days in one complete roster rotation cycle (e.g., 14 for an 8/6 roster, 21 for a 14/7 roster, 7 for a 4/3 roster). Used to calculate roster recurrence and workforce planning.

attributes.name: days_off
attributes.description: Number of consecutive rest days in the roster cycle (e.g., 6 in an 8/6 roster, 7 in a 14/7 roster, 14 in a 28/14 roster).

attributes.name: days_on
attributes.description: Number of consecutive working days in the roster cycle (e.g., 8 in an 8/6 roster, 14 in a 14/7 roster, 28 in a 28/14 roster).

attributes.name: demobilisation_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to demobilise workers from this roster pattern, including handover, travel arrangements, and exit procedures. Supports workforce transition planning.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this roster pattern becomes active and available for workforce scheduling. Supports temporal roster management and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this roster pattern remains active. Null indicates the roster is currently active with no planned end date. Supports roster lifecycle management and historical analysis.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_rating
attributes.description: Assessed fatigue risk level associated with this roster pattern based on shift length, consecutive days worked, and recovery time. Used for health and safety compliance and workforce wellbeing monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, MSHA Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this roster pattern record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: maximum_consecutive_shifts
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive shifts an employee can work under this roster pattern before mandatory rest, as defined by safety regulations and fatigue management policies.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, MSHA Regulations

attributes.name: minimum_rest_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of rest hours required between consecutive shifts under this roster pattern, ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety standards.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, MSHA Regulations

attributes.name: mobilisation_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days required to mobilise workers onto this roster pattern, including travel arrangements, accommodation booking, and induction scheduling. Critical for workforce planning and project ramp-up.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or operational notes related to this roster pattern (e.g., 'Requires pre-approval for overtime', 'Seasonal roster for wet season operations', 'Pilot program for new shift pattern').

attributes.name: overtime_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers on this roster pattern are eligible for overtime payments. True if overtime applies, False if roster includes all-in compensation or salary arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll, Local Labor Law

attributes.name: roster_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the roster pattern (e.g., FIFO_8_6, DIDO_14_7, RES_4_3). Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: roster_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the roster pattern (e.g., 'Fly-In Fly-Out 8 Days On 6 Days Off', 'Drive-In Drive-Out 14/7 Day Shift', 'Residential 4 On 3 Off Continental').

attributes.name: roster_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the roster pattern. Active indicates in use, Inactive indicates temporarily suspended, Pending indicates awaiting approval or implementation, Retired indicates permanently discontinued.

attributes.name: roster_type
attributes.description: Classification of the roster arrangement. FIFO (Fly-In Fly-Out) for air-transported workers, DIDO (Drive-In Drive-Out) for road-commuting workers, Residential for permanent on-site or local workers, Casual for irregular schedules, Contractor for third-party labor.

attributes.name: shift_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard duration of each shift in hours (e.g., 12.0 for twelve-hour shifts, 10.0 for ten-hour shifts, 8.0 for eight-hour shifts). Supports fatigue risk assessment and payroll calculations.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift rotation pattern within the roster cycle. Day Only for single day shifts, Night Only for single night shifts, Day-Night Rotating for alternating day/night, Continental for 12-hour rotating shifts, Split Shift for multiple shifts per day, Flexible for variable scheduling.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport used for worker mobilisation and demobilisation under this roster pattern. Charter Flight for dedicated aircraft, Commercial Flight for scheduled airlines, Bus for road transport, Private Vehicle for self-drive, Not Applicable for residential rosters.

products.name: shift_schedule
products.description: Shift schedule header and individual worker-to-shift assignment records for mine operations. Header captures scheduled start/end datetime, shift type (day/night/afternoon), crew designation, site location, department, planned headcount, and roster cycle reference. Assignment detail lines capture individual employee or contractor assignment to the shift including assignment status (scheduled, confirmed, swapped, absent), role on shift, crew, actual start/end times, hours worked, overtime flag, and fatigue management override approvals. Serves as both the operational shift plan and the transactional time-and-attendance record of who worked when. Supports fatigue risk management per ISO 45001, MSHA compliance, and payroll hours integration.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift schedule record. Primary key for the shift schedule entity.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated crew or work team assigned to this shift.

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational department or functional area (e.g., drilling, haulage, processing, maintenance) for which this shift is scheduled.

attributes.name: drill_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.drill_program. Business justification: Drilling shifts are scheduled to support specific drill programs for resource allocation, production tracking, and cost attribution. Essential for workforce planning and program progress monitoring.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that created this shift schedule record.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or system account that last modified this shift schedule record.

attributes.name: primary_shift_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee assigned as the shift supervisor or shift boss responsible for this shift.

attributes.name: roster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the roster cycle or rotation pattern this shift belongs to (e.g., 4-on-3-off, 7-on-7-off, FIFO rotation).

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site or operational location where this shift is scheduled.

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Actual number of workers who reported for duty on this shift. Updated after shift commencement for attendance tracking.

attributes.name: actual_production_tonnes
attributes.description: Actual production achieved during the shift measured in tonnes. Updated after shift completion for performance analysis.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes about the shift schedule, including special instructions, operational constraints, or administrative remarks.

attributes.name: created_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: equipment_availability_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of planned equipment that was available and operational during the shift. Key metric for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation.

attributes.name: fatigue_override_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fatigue management override has been approved by authorized personnel (True/False). Used when operational requirements necessitate deviation from standard fatigue limits.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_assessment_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether fatigue risk assessment has been completed for this shift (True/False). Required for ISO 45001 fatigue management compliance.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed fatigue risk level for the shift based on roster patterns, consecutive shifts, and hours worked (low, moderate, high, critical).

attributes.name: incident_count
attributes.description: Number of safety incidents, near-misses, or reportable events that occurred during the shift. Used for Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) and Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) calculations.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift schedule record is currently active and valid (True) or has been logically deleted or superseded (False).

attributes.name: last_modified_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this shift schedule record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: payroll_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of shift hours integration with SAP HR payroll system (pending, submitted, approved, rejected, processed).

attributes.name: payroll_submission_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when shift hours were submitted to the payroll system for processing.

attributes.name: planned_headcount
attributes.description: Target number of workers planned to be assigned to this shift. Used for capacity planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: production_area
attributes.description: Specific production area, pit, underground level, or processing plant section where the shift crew will operate (e.g., North Pit, Level 5 West, Concentrator Plant 2).

attributes.name: production_target_tonnes
attributes.description: Planned production target for the shift measured in tonnes of ore or material to be moved. Used for shift performance tracking.

attributes.name: safety_briefing_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandatory pre-shift safety briefing has been completed (True/False). Required for MSHA and ISO 45001 compliance.

attributes.name: safety_briefing_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the pre-shift safety briefing was conducted. Required for regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_hours
attributes.description: Planned duration of the shift in hours (e.g., 8.00, 10.00, 12.00). Used for shift planning and fatigue management calculations.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_datetime
attributes.description: Planned end date and time for the shift in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: scheduled_start_datetime
attributes.description: Planned start date and time for the shift in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: shift_handover_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting key information to be handed over from the previous shift or to the next shift (equipment status, incidents, production issues, safety concerns).

attributes.name: shift_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the shift schedule, typically a human-readable shift number or code used operationally (e.g., DAY-001, NIGHT-045).

attributes.name: shift_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification of the shift based on operational criticality (critical, high, normal, low). Used for resource allocation and contingency planning.

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift schedule (draft, scheduled, confirmed, in_progress, completed, cancelled, suspended). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|scheduled|confirmed|in_progress|completed|cancelled|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift based on time of day or rotation pattern (day, night, afternoon, swing, rotating).

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Recorded or forecasted weather conditions relevant to the shift (e.g., clear, rain, high wind, extreme heat). Important for open-pit operations and safety planning.

products.name: fatigue_record
products.description: Fatigue risk assessment record for individual workers capturing cumulative hours worked, days on-site, sleep opportunity hours, fatigue risk score, assessment method (Fatigue Risk Management System - FRMS), assessor, assessment datetime, outcome (fit/unfit/restricted), and any corrective actions taken. Supports ISO 45001 and MSHA fatigue management compliance.

attributes.name: fatigue_record_id
attributes.description: Primary key for fatigue_record

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the HSE incident that triggered this fatigue assessment, if applicable (for post-incident assessments).

attributes.name: primary_fatigue_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor being assessed for fatigue risk.

attributes.name: roster_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the roster cycle (e.g., 14 days on / 7 days off) within which this assessment occurred.

attributes.name: shift_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shift assignment for which the fatigue assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: assessment_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the fatigue risk assessment was conducted.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: assessment_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the fatigue assessment was conducted (e.g., mine gate, pre-start area, occupational health clinic, control room).
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fatigue Risk Management System (FRMS) Assessment Method
attributes.description: Method or tool used to assess fatigue risk, such as Fatigue Risk Management System (FRMS), biomathematical modeling, self-report questionnaire, supervisor observation, fitness for work testing, or actigraphy device.
attributes.value_regex: FRMS|Biomathematical Model|Self-Report|Supervisor Observation|Fitness for Work Test|Actigraphy
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guidance on Occupational Health Risk Assessment

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the fatigue assessment determining the worker's fitness status: Fit for Work, Unfit for Work, Restricted Duties, or Referred for Medical Review.
attributes.value_regex: Fit for Work|Unfit for Work|Restricted Duties|Referred for Medical Review
attributes.references: MSHA Part 56 Health and Safety Standards

attributes.name: assessment_trigger
attributes.description: Event or condition that triggered the fatigue assessment: Scheduled Pre-Start, Random Check, Supervisor Concern, Self-Report, Post-Incident, or Extended Hours Threshold.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's fatigue status is compliant with regulatory and company fatigue management policies: Compliant, Non-Compliant, or Exemption Granted.
attributes.references: MSHA Part 56 Health and Safety Standards

attributes.name: consecutive_days_on_site
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days the worker has been on-site without a rest day, used to assess cumulative fatigue risk.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions taken in response to the fatigue assessment, such as mandatory rest period, shift reassignment, transportation to accommodation, or referral to occupational health services.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fatigue assessment record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: cumulative_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked by the individual over the assessment period (typically 7, 14, or 28 days) leading up to the assessment.
attributes.references: MSHA Part 56 Health and Safety Standards

attributes.name: exemption_approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or authority who approved the fatigue policy exemption.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Justification for granting an exemption to fatigue management policy (e.g., emergency response, critical maintenance, senior management approval).
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_level
attributes.description: Categorical classification of fatigue risk level based on the risk score: Low, Moderate, High, or Severe.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_score
attributes.description: Quantitative fatigue risk score calculated by the assessment method, typically on a scale (e.g., 0-100) where higher values indicate greater fatigue risk.
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guidance on Occupational Health Risk Assessment

attributes.name: follow_up_due_datetime
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time for the required follow-up assessment or medical review.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up fatigue assessment or medical review is required based on this assessment outcome.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fatigue assessment record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the assessor regarding observations, worker comments, or contextual information relevant to the fatigue assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: previous_assessment_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent prior fatigue assessment for this worker, used to track assessment frequency and trend analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: previous_fatigue_risk_score
attributes.description: Fatigue risk score from the most recent prior assessment, enabling trend comparison.
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guidance on Occupational Health Risk Assessment

attributes.name: sleep_opportunity_hours
attributes.description: Estimated or reported hours of sleep opportunity available to the worker in the 24-hour period prior to assessment.
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guidance on Occupational Health Risk Assessment

attributes.name: time_of_day_category
attributes.description: Classification of the time of day when the assessment occurred, relevant for circadian rhythm considerations (Day Shift, Night Shift, Swing Shift, Circadian Low Point).
attributes.value_regex: Day Shift|Night Shift|Swing Shift|Circadian Low Point
attributes.references: ICMM Good Practice Guidance on Occupational Health Risk Assessment

attributes.name: work_restriction_description
attributes.description: Description of any work restrictions or limitations imposed as a result of the fatigue assessment (e.g., no heavy equipment operation, reduced shift length, mandatory rest break).
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

products.name: competency
products.description: Competency framework master and individual worker attainment records for the mine workforce. Framework level defines competency name, type (statutory, operational, safety, technical), applicable role/position, required proficiency level, governing body (MSHA, state mining regulator), validity period, and renewal requirements. Attainment detail records capture individual employee or contractor competency holdings including attainment date, expiry date, assessment method, assessor, certificate number, issuing body, current status (current, expiring, expired, suspended), and evidence reference. Serves as the SSOT for both what competencies exist and who holds them. Supports MSHA statutory ticket tracking (shotfirer, SSE, OCE), competency gap analysis, expiry alerting, and ISO 45001 training compliance.

attributes.name: competency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the competency record. Serves as the primary key for both framework-level competency definitions and individual worker attainment records.

attributes.name: competency_assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee or contractor who conducted the competency assessment. Null for third-party certifications or framework definitions.

attributes.name: competency_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the individual employee or contractor who holds this competency attainment. Null for framework-level competency definitions that are not yet attained by any worker.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the mine site for which this competency attainment is valid. Null for portable competencies or framework definitions.

attributes.name: applicable_role
attributes.description: The job role, position, or position family to which this competency applies (e.g., Haul Truck Operator, Shotfirer, Surface Supervisor, Mill Operator). May be a comma-separated list for competencies applicable to multiple roles.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the worker was assessed for this competency: written_exam, practical_assessment, on_job_observation, simulation, portfolio (evidence-based), interview, third_party_certification (external body). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written_exam|practical_assessment|on_job_observation|simulation|portfolio|interview|third_party_certification — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: The numeric score or result achieved in the competency assessment (e.g., exam percentage, practical assessment grade). Null for pass/fail assessments without numeric scoring.

attributes.name: attainment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker successfully attained or was awarded this competency. Null for framework-level definitions.

attributes.name: attainment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the competency attainment: current (valid and in-date), expiring_soon (within alert threshold), expired (past expiry_date), suspended (temporarily invalid), revoked (permanently withdrawn), pending_renewal (renewal in progress).

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate, ticket, or license number issued by the governing body or training provider as evidence of competency attainment. Critical for statutory ticket tracking and MSHA compliance.

attributes.name: competency_category
attributes.description: Hierarchical grouping or discipline area for the competency (e.g., Mining Operations, Processing, Maintenance, HSE, Geology, Engineering). Supports competency framework navigation and gap analysis reporting.

attributes.name: competency_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the competency. Used for external reference and integration with training systems, MSHA reporting, and SAP HR competency catalogs.

attributes.name: competency_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the competency (e.g., Shotfirer Certificate, Surface Supervisor Examination, Haul Truck Operation Level 3, First Aid CPR).

attributes.name: competency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the competency by purpose: statutory (legally mandated certificates), operational (production skills), safety (HSE training), technical (specialized equipment or process), leadership (supervisory), environmental (environmental management).

attributes.name: cost_per_attainment
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to attain this competency, including training fees, assessor costs, travel, and lost production time. Used for training budget planning and OPEX allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competency record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for cost_per_attainment (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD, ZAR).

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the supporting evidence or documentation for this competency attainment (e.g., file path, document management system ID, training record reference). Supports audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: expiry_alert_days
attributes.description: The number of days before expiry_date at which an alert should be triggered to initiate renewal. Supports proactive competency management and compliance risk mitigation.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this competency attainment expires and must be renewed. Calculated from attainment_date + validity_period_months. Null for lifetime competencies or framework definitions.

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority, industry body, or certification organization that defines or mandates this competency (e.g., MSHA, State Mining Inspectorate, ICMM, internal company standard). Critical for statutory competency tracking.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The organization or authority that issued the certificate or credential (e.g., State Mining Inspectorate, MSHA, Registered Training Organization, internal company training department).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competency record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail for competency lifecycle management.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which this competency attainment was last verified or audited for currency and validity. Supports periodic competency audits and ISO 45001 compliance.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is mandatory for the applicable role (True) or optional/recommended (False). Mandatory competencies trigger compliance alerts if not held.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this competency or attainment (e.g., restrictions, exemptions, special arrangements).

attributes.name: pass_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum score or threshold required to pass the competency assessment. Used to determine attainment success and identify workers requiring reassessment.

attributes.name: prerequisite_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of competency codes or IDs that must be held before this competency can be attained. Supports competency pathway modeling and training sequencing.

attributes.name: renewal_method
attributes.description: The method by which the competency is renewed: reassessment (full practical reassessment), refresher_training (attend training course), continuing_education (accumulate CPD points), reexamination (written or practical exam), automatic (no action required).

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competency must be renewed or reassessed upon expiry (True) or is a one-time attainment (False).

attributes.name: required_proficiency_level
attributes.description: The minimum proficiency or mastery level required for the competency: awareness (general understanding), basic (can perform with supervision), intermediate (can perform independently), advanced (can train others), expert (subject matter expert).

attributes.name: site_specific_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is specific to a particular mine site (True) or is portable across all company sites (False). Site-specific competencies require retraining on site transfer.

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: The total number of training hours completed to attain this competency. Used for MSHA annual training hour reporting and training cost allocation.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: The name of the training organization, Registered Training Organization (RTO), or internal training department that delivered the training leading to this competency attainment.

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the competency remains valid once attained. Null indicates no expiry (lifetime competency). Used to calculate expiry dates and trigger renewal alerts.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who conducted the last verification or audit of this competency attainment.

products.name: training_course
products.description: Training course catalogue defining all available training programs for mine workforce including induction, statutory safety training, equipment operation, first aid, and technical skills. Captures course name, course code, delivery mode (classroom, online, on-the-job), duration, provider, linked competencies, regulatory requirement flag, and MSHA/ISO 45001 compliance mapping.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course was formally approved for delivery. Used for audit trails and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who approved this training course for inclusion in the catalogue. Typically a training manager, HSE manager, or competent person.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method used to assess participant competency upon course completion. Written exam is theory-based testing; practical demonstration is hands-on skill assessment; simulation uses equipment simulators; observation is workplace-based assessment; portfolio is evidence-based review; none indicates no formal assessment.

attributes.name: certificate_validity_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months that the certification remains valid before refresher or recertification training is required. Used to trigger training renewal notifications and maintain compliance. Nullable for courses with no expiry.

attributes.name: certification_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful completion of this course results in a formal certificate or credential being issued to the participant. True for statutory, regulatory, and competency-based training.

attributes.name: competency_framework_code
attributes.description: Code linking this training course to the organizational competency framework or national qualifications framework. Used to map training outcomes to required competencies for roles and positions.

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Standard cost charged per participant for delivery of this training course. Includes instructor fees, materials, facility hire, and assessment costs. Used for training budget planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the training course type. Induction covers site orientation and onboarding; safety statutory includes MSHA-mandated and regulatory training; equipment operation covers mobile equipment and machinery; technical skills includes trade and specialist competencies; leadership covers supervisory and management development; compliance includes HSE and legal requirements; emergency response covers first aid and crisis management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: induction|safety_statutory|equipment_operation|technical_skills|leadership|compliance|emergency_response — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the training course for identification and scheduling purposes. Used across training management systems and employee records.

attributes.name: course_content_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the topics, modules, and learning outcomes covered in the training course. Used for course selection, training needs analysis, and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: course_materials_provided
attributes.description: Description of training materials, resources, and equipment provided to participants, such as manuals, workbooks, personal protective equipment, or access to online learning platforms.

attributes.name: course_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the training course as it appears in the training catalogue and on certificates.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course in the catalogue. Active courses are available for scheduling; inactive courses are temporarily unavailable; under review courses are being updated or audited; retired courses are no longer offered; pending approval courses are awaiting accreditation or management sign-off.

attributes.name: course_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the course is an initial qualification, periodic refresher, mandatory recertification, advanced level, or specialized competency training.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per participant. Used for multi-currency training budgets and financial reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the training is delivered. Classroom is instructor-led in-person; online is e-learning or virtual; blended combines classroom and online; on-the-job is workplace-based practical training; simulation uses equipment simulators; field practical is hands-on training at operational sites.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total duration of the training course measured in working days. Used for multi-day courses and workforce planning. Nullable for courses under one day.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training course measured in hours, including classroom time, practical exercises, and assessments. Used for scheduling, resource planning, and MSHA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this training course becomes available in the catalogue and can be scheduled for delivery. Used for version control and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training course is retired or superseded by a new version. Nullable for courses with no planned end date. Used for training record integrity and historical reporting.

attributes.name: iso_45001_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course supports ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System requirements for worker competence, awareness, and participation. True for courses aligned with ISO 45001 clauses 7.2 and 7.3.

attributes.name: language_of_delivery
attributes.description: Primary language in which the training course is delivered, using ISO 639-3 three-letter language codes. Used for workforce planning and ensuring training accessibility for diverse workforces.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training course record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course content, delivery method, and effectiveness were last reviewed and validated. Used to ensure training remains current with regulations, technology, and operational practices.

attributes.name: learning_objectives
attributes.description: Specific, measurable learning objectives that participants will achieve upon successful completion of the training course. Used for competency mapping and training effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: linked_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of competency codes or identifiers that this training course develops or certifies. Used to track which competencies are satisfied upon successful course completion.

attributes.name: maximum_participants
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants that can be enrolled in a single delivery of this training course. Determined by classroom capacity, equipment availability, or instructor-to-student ratio requirements.

attributes.name: msha_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this course satisfies MSHA Part 48 training requirements for new miner training, annual refresher training, or task training. True for courses that meet MSHA standards and are reported to MSHA.

attributes.name: next_review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the training course. Used to trigger course audits, content updates, and compliance verification.

attributes.name: pass_mark_percentage
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required to successfully complete the training course and receive certification. Nullable for courses without formal assessment.

attributes.name: prerequisite_courses
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of course codes that must be completed before a worker can enroll in this training course. Used to enforce training pathways and competency progression.

attributes.name: provider_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation or registration number of the training provider issued by relevant regulatory or industry body. Required for statutory and compliance training courses.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity delivering the training course. May be internal training department, external Registered Training Organization (RTO), equipment manufacturer, or industry association.

attributes.name: refresher_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic refresher training is required to maintain competency or certification. True for MSHA annual refresher, first aid recertification, and time-limited competencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is mandated by mining regulations, occupational health and safety law, or industry standards. True for MSHA Part 48 training, statutory safety training, and ISO 45001 required competencies.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended participants for this training course, such as new hires, equipment operators, supervisors, contractors, or specific job roles. Used for course assignment and workforce planning.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the training course content and curriculum. Incremented when course materials, learning objectives, or assessment methods are updated. Used for training record accuracy and audit trails.

products.name: training_enrolment
products.description: Training enrolment, completion, and site/role induction record for individual workers. Captures enrolment date, scheduled training date, completion date, training outcome (pass/fail/incomplete), score, trainer/assessor, delivery location, hours completed, certificate issued flag, and for inductions: induction type (site general, area-specific, task-specific, contractor), modules completed, and induction certificate reference. Covers all training events from formal courses through mandatory pre-access site inductions required under MSHA Part 46/48 and state mining regulations. Provides the transactional audit trail for training compliance, induction verification at site access gates, and ISO 45001 workforce competency requirements.

attributes.name: training_enrolment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training enrolment record. Primary key for the training enrolment entity.

attributes.name: previous_enrolment_training_enrolment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous training enrolment record that this refresher training is renewing or updating.

attributes.name: primary_training_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the worker enrolled in the training. Links to the worker master record.

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mine site where the training or induction was conducted.

attributes.name: tertiary_training_assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the assessor who evaluated the worker's competency.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the training course or program. Links to the training course catalog.

attributes.name: access_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when site or area access clearance was granted to the worker following induction completion.

attributes.name: access_clearance_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether site or area access clearance was granted to the worker upon successful completion of the induction.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score achieved by the worker in the training assessment, typically as a percentage.

attributes.name: attendance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of training sessions attended by the worker, calculated as attended hours divided by required hours.

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the training certificate expires and requires renewal or refresher training.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the training certificate was issued to the worker.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a training certificate was issued to the worker upon successful completion.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the training certificate issued to the worker.

attributes.name: competency_level_achieved
attributes.description: Level of competency achieved by the worker upon completion of the training.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the worker completed the training course or induction.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for this training enrolment, including course fees, materials, and travel expenses.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the training cost amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training enrolment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was delivered (site name, training center, online platform).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method or format used to deliver the training to the worker.

attributes.name: enrolment_date
attributes.description: Date when the worker was enrolled in the training course.

attributes.name: enrolment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the training enrolment in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: induction_modules_completed
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of specific induction modules completed by the worker.

attributes.name: induction_type
attributes.description: Type of site induction completed by the worker, categorizing the scope and level of access granted.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training enrolment record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: mandatory_training_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training is mandatory for the worker's role or site access under regulatory or company policy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations recorded by the trainer, assessor, or training coordinator regarding this enrolment.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the training assessment, typically as a percentage.

attributes.name: refresher_training_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrolment is for refresher or recertification training rather than initial training.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory requirement or standard that this training fulfills (e.g., MSHA Part 46, MSHA Part 48, ISO 45001).

attributes.name: scheduled_training_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the training session or course commencement.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed by the worker for this enrolment.

attributes.name: training_hours_required
attributes.description: Total number of training hours required to complete the course or meet regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: training_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome or result of the training assessment.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity that provided the training (internal department, external training company, contractor).

products.name: medical_fitness
products.description: Occupational health and medical fitness assessment record for mine workers including drug and alcohol (D&A) testing. Captures assessment type (pre-employment, periodic, return-to-work, task-specific, drug/alcohol screening), assessment date, examining physician, fitness outcome (fit/fit with restrictions/unfit), restriction details, next review date, D&A test result and method, noise-induced hearing loss (NIHL) monitoring status, and biological monitoring results. Supports MSHA medical surveillance, site D&A testing programs, and ISO 45001 health monitoring requirements.

products.name: payroll_record
products.description: Payroll processing record capturing the periodic pay calculation for each employee including base pay, allowances (site allowance, FIFO allowance, leading hand allowance), overtime, deductions, superannuation, and net pay. Captures pay period, pay run reference, SAP HR payroll area, payment method, and payroll status. Integrates with SAP FI/CO for cost centre posting.

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payroll processing record. Primary key for the payroll record entity.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Payroll costs are the largest component of Mining OPEX and must be allocated to cost centres for financial reporting, AISC calculation, management accounting, and budget variance analysis. Payroll_rec

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contractor for whom this payroll record was generated. Links to the worker master data in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was approved for payment. Critical audit field for payroll governance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the payroll officer or manager who approved this payroll record for payment. Used for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The employee's bank account number to which net pay is transferred via electronic funds transfer. Confidential financial information.

attributes.name: bank_bsb_code
attributes.description: The six-digit BSB code identifying the bank branch for electronic funds transfer. Used in Australian banking systems.

attributes.name: base_pay_amount
attributes.description: The base salary or wage amount for the pay period, excluding allowances, overtime, and other variable pay components. Calculated based on contracted hours and hourly or annual rate.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus payment included in this payroll record. May include safety bonuses, production bonuses, or annual incentive payments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system. Audit field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record (e.g., AUD for Australian Dollar, USD for US Dollar).

attributes.name: fifo_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance paid to workers on FIFO rosters to compensate for travel and time away from home. Common in remote mining operations.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Court-ordered or statutory deduction from the employee's pay for child support, debt repayment, or other legal obligations.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross pay for the pay period, calculated as the sum of base pay, all allowances, overtime, bonuses, and other earnings before any deductions.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular hours worked during the pay period, excluding overtime. Used as the basis for base pay calculation for hourly workers.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was last updated or modified. Audit field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: leading_hand_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Additional allowance paid to workers in supervisory or leading hand roles who coordinate small teams or work groups.

attributes.name: leave_hours_paid
attributes.description: Total number of leave hours paid during the pay period, including annual leave, sick leave, and other paid time off.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: The final take-home pay amount for the employee, calculated as gross pay minus total deductions. This is the amount paid to the employee.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll officers to record notes, exceptions, adjustments, or special circumstances related to this payroll record.

attributes.name: other_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all other voluntary or mandatory deductions not otherwise categorized, such as health insurance premiums, salary sacrifice arrangements, or loan repayments.

attributes.name: overtime_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime pay calculated for the pay period based on overtime hours worked and applicable overtime rates.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period, eligible for overtime pay rates (typically time-and-a-half or double-time).

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the end of the earnings calculation window.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the beginning of the earnings calculation window.

attributes.name: pay_run_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned to the payroll batch or pay run in which this record was processed. Used for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the net pay was or will be disbursed to the employee. Represents the actual payment transaction date.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the net pay is disbursed to the employee. Electronic funds transfer (EFT) is the most common method in modern payroll systems.

attributes.name: payroll_area
attributes.description: SAP HR payroll area code representing the organizational grouping for payroll processing (e.g., by site, region, or pay frequency). Determines pay calendar and processing rules.

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the payroll record. Tracks the record through the payroll lifecycle from draft calculation to final payment.

attributes.name: shift_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance paid for working non-standard shifts such as night shift, afternoon shift, or rotating rosters.

attributes.name: site_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance paid to workers assigned to remote or challenging mine sites. Compensates for site-specific conditions and living arrangements.

attributes.name: superannuation_amount
attributes.description: Employer superannuation (pension) contribution made on behalf of the employee. Mandatory in jurisdictions such as Australia under the Superannuation Guarantee.

attributes.name: tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay as required by tax legislation. Remitted to the tax authority on behalf of the employee.

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions applied to the gross pay, including tax, superannuation, union dues, garnishments, and other deductions.

attributes.name: union_dues_amount
attributes.description: Union membership dues deducted from the employee's pay as authorized by the employee. Remitted to the relevant labor union.

products.name: employment_agreement

Governs employment conditions across the mine workforce.

attributes.name: agreement_name

attributes.name: agreement_number

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lodgement_date

attributes.name: maximum_consecutive_shifts

attributes.name: nominal_expiry_date

attributes.name: notes

products.name: workforce_project_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between contractor and capital_project. It captures the formal engagement agreement under which a contractor provides services to a specific capital project. Each record links one contractor to one capital_project with contract-specific terms, financial arrangements, scope definition, and performance obligations that exist only in the context of this contractual relationship.. Existence Justification: In mining capital projects, contractors are engaged through formal contracts to deliver specific scopes of work (civil, electrical, mechanical, commissioning). A single contractor can hold multiple contracts across different capital projects simultaneously, and each capital project engages multiple contractors for different work packages. The business actively manages these contracts as distinct operational entities with contract-specific terms, financial arrangements, scope definitions, and performance obligations.

products.name: position_competency_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the competency requirements matrix between positions and competencies in the mine workforce. It captures which competencies are required for which positions, at what proficiency level, and with what criticality. Each record links one position to one competency with attributes that define the requirement parameters including mandatory status, proficiency expectations, verification frequency, and effective dates. This enables competency gap analysis, succession planning, training needs assessment, and regulatory compliance tracking for statutory roles.. Existence Justification: In mining workforce management, positions require multiple competencies (e.g., a Mine Supervisor position requires shotfirer certificate, first aid, risk assessment, and supervisory competencies), and each competency is required by multiple positions (e.g., first aid is required for field operators, supervisors, emergency response roles, and statutory positions). HR and operations teams actively manage competency requirement matrices that define which competencies are mandatory for which positions, at what proficiency levels, with what criticality ratings, and with specific verification frequencies for compliance auditing.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns all financial management data including general ledger, cost centre accounting, CAPEX/OPEX budgeting, AISC and C1 cash cost reporting, NPV/IRR project valuations, DCF models, and IFRS 6 exploration accounting. Supports external regulatory financial disclosures via SAP FI/CO.

products.name: cost_centre
products.description: Master register of SAP CO cost centres used to track and allocate operational and capital expenditure across mine sites, processing plants, and corporate functions. Each cost centre captures responsible manager, organisational hierarchy position, activity type, valid-from/to dates, and cost centre category (production, service, overhead). Provides the cost allocation hierarchy feeding AISC and C1 cash cost calculations and supports activity-based costing for per-tonne cost build-up.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key identifying each cost centre record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the cost_centre master data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Cost Centre Master Data

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Cost centres roll up to profit centres in the organizational hierarchy. The profit_centre_code should be replaced with FK to profit_centre.profit_centre_id to enable joining to profit centre master da

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The primary activity type associated with this cost centre for activity-based costing (e.g., 'DRILL_HOURS', 'HAUL_TONNES', 'PROCESS_TONNES', 'MAINT_HOURS'). Drives per-tonne and per-hour cost rate calculations feeding C1 cash cost build-up. Corresponds to SAP CO activity type (LSTAR). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRILL_HOURS|HAUL_TONNES|PROCESS_TONNES|MAINT_HOURS|BLAST_METRES|LAB_SAMPLES|ADMIN_HOURS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-ABC Module — LSTAR field; C1 Cash Cost Methodology

attributes.name: aisc_component
attributes.description: Classification of this cost centre's costs within the World Gold Council All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) framework components. Enables automated AISC cost build-up from cost centre actuals. 'gna' = General and Administrative costs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|gna|royalties|sustaining_capex|reclamation|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Guidance Note (June 2013, updated 2018); ICMM Cost Reporting Framework

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost centre to receiving cost objects. 'direct' — costs charged directly; 'assessment' — allocated via SAP CO assessment cycle; 'distribution' — allocated via SAP CO distribution cycle; 'activity_allocation' — allocated based on activity quantities; 'none' — no secondary allocation performed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Module — Allocation Cycles; Activity-Based Costing (ABC) Methodology

attributes.name: budget_annual
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost centre for the current fiscal year, expressed in the cost centre's reporting currency. Used as the baseline for monthly budget vs. actual variance reporting and OPEX/CAPEX governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Module; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements; ICMM Cost Reporting Framework

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which the annual budget amount applies. Enables year-on-year budget comparison and multi-year LOM cost planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — GJAHR field; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI business area associated with this cost centre, used for cross-company-code reporting and segment-level balance sheet preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — GSBER field

attributes.name: c1_cost_component
attributes.description: Classification of this cost centre within the Brook Hunt / CRU C1 cash cost methodology components. Enables automated C1 per-pound or per-tonne cost build-up from cost centre actuals for commodity benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|site_admin|transport|royalties|treatment_refining|excluded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Brook Hunt C1 Cash Cost Methodology; CRU Cost Reporting Standards; ICMM Cost Reporting Framework

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: The primary mineral commodity produced or supported by this cost centre (e.g., 'iron_ore', 'copper', 'lithium'). Enables commodity-level cost disaggregation for C1 cash cost and AISC reporting by product. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|silver|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SEC S-K 1300 Mining Disclosure Rules; ICMM Cost Reporting Framework

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code representing the legal entity to which this cost centre is assigned for statutory financial reporting and IFRS consolidation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — BUKRS field; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area to which this cost centre belongs, defining the organisational scope for internal cost accounting and management reporting. Typically aligned to a legal entity or mining group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — KOKRS field; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: cost_centre_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost centre by its primary function in the mining cost structure. 'production' covers direct mining and processing activities contributing to AISC and C1 cash cost; 'service' covers internal service providers (e.g., maintenance workshops); 'overhead' covers indirect mine-site costs; 'administration' covers corporate functions; 'investment' covers CAPEX project cost centres.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — KOSAR field; ICMM Cost Reporting Framework; AISC/C1 Cost Methodology

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the cost centre in SAP CO, used across all financial postings, purchase orders, and work orders to identify the responsible organisational unit. Aligns with SAP CO cost centre number (KOSTL).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — KOSTL field; IFRS IAS 1 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: cost_centre_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the cost centre (e.g., 'Pit 3 Drilling Operations', 'SAG Mill Processing', 'Corporate Finance'). Corresponds to SAP CO KTEXT (short description) field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — KTEXT field

attributes.name: cost_centre_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost centre. 'active' — open for postings; 'inactive' — temporarily suspended; 'locked' — blocked for new postings pending review; 'pending_approval' — awaiting authorisation; 'closed' — permanently decommissioned following mine closure or restructure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — SPERRZ (lock indicator) field; Mine Rehabilitation and Closure Standards

attributes.name: cost_centre_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Centre Type (Operating Expenditure / Capital Expenditure)
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost centre primarily captures Operating Expenditure (OPEX) or Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), or functions as a shared service or IFRS 6 exploration cost centre. Drives treatment in AISC and C1 cash cost calculations and IFRS 6 exploration accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; AISC/C1 Cost Methodology

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element group assigned to this cost centre, defining which primary cost elements (e.g., labour, materials, energy, depreciation) are permissible for posting. Supports structured cost build-up for AISC and C1 reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Module — Cost Element Group (KSTAR); AISC/C1 Cost Methodology

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost centre master record was first created in the source SAP CO system. Provides audit trail for master data governance and change management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — ERDAT/ERZET fields; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost centre's primary reporting currency (e.g., 'AUD', 'USD', 'ZAR'). Determines the currency in which budgets, actuals, and cost rates are maintained in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — WAERS field; ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organisational department code to which this cost centre belongs (e.g., 'DRILL', 'BLAST', 'HAUL', 'PROCESS', 'MAINT', 'HSE', 'FINANCE'). Supports departmental cost reporting and headcount allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR/CO Module — Organisational Management

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Broad functional classification of the cost centre within the mining value chain. Used for cross-site functional cost benchmarking and AISC component attribution (e.g., mining, processing, G&A). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|exploration|maintenance|logistics|hse|administration|finance|sales|rehabilitation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Framework; AISC/C1 Cost Methodology; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: gl_account_group
attributes.description: SAP FI General Ledger (GL) account group associated with this cost centre, defining the chart of accounts range permissible for postings. Ensures correct financial statement classification under IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — KTOKS field; IFRS IAS 1; IFRS 6 Exploration Accounting

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: The standard hierarchy node or cost centre group to which this cost centre belongs in SAP CO, defining its position in the organisational cost reporting tree (e.g., mine site > department > function). Feeds AISC and C1 per-tonne cost roll-up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Standard Hierarchy (SETKZ); ICMM Cost Reporting Framework

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost centre used for reporting and allocation base purposes only, with no actual cost postings permitted. Statistical cost centres track quantities (e.g., tonnes mined) used as allocation bases for activity-based costing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Statistical Cost Centre (KOSAR = 'S')

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost centre master record in SAP CO. Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and master data audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — AEDAT/AEZET fields; ISO 8601

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this cost centre is locked against actual postings in SAP CO. When True, no new financial transactions can be posted. Corresponds to SAP CO SPERRZ field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — SPERRZ field

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the cost centre's business purpose, scope of activities, and cost allocation rationale. Supports AISC and C1 cash cost build-up documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — LTEXT field

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP MM/PM plant code associated with this cost centre, linking cost accounting to physical plant operations for maintenance work orders, material consumption, and asset depreciation postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PM Module — WERKS field

attributes.name: responsible_manager
attributes.description: Full name of the manager accountable for costs posted to this cost centre. Used for budget accountability, variance reporting, and management sign-off on monthly cost reviews. Corresponds to SAP CO VERAK field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — VERAK field; ICMM Responsible Business Principles

attributes.name: responsible_manager_personnel_no
attributes.description: SAP HR personnel number of the manager responsible for this cost centre, enabling system-driven workflow approvals, budget notifications, and organisational reporting linkage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module — PERNR field

attributes.name: site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the mine site or operational facility to which this cost centre is physically or organisationally assigned (e.g., 'PILBARA01', 'OLYMPIC_DAM', 'CORP_PERTH'). Enables site-level cost aggregation for AISC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ICMM Cost Reporting Framework; AISC Methodology

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cost centre master record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: user_responsible
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person responsible for maintaining and updating this cost centre master record. Corresponds to SAP CO VERAK (user responsible) field for data stewardship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — VERAK field

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element linked to this cost centre for CAPEX project cost tracking. Applicable to investment cost centres supporting mine development, plant construction, or major sustaining capital projects.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module — POSID field; IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; CAPEX Governance Framework

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which this cost centre is active and available for financial postings in SAP CO. Corresponds to SAP CO DATAB (valid from) field. Supports Life of Mine (LOM) planning and project phase cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — DATAB field; IFRS 6 Exploration Accounting

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: The date after which this cost centre is no longer active for financial postings. Corresponds to SAP CO DATBI (valid to) field. Null indicates an open-ended cost centre with no planned closure date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — DATBI field

products.name: general_ledger_account
products.description: Chart of accounts master data sourced from SAP FI, defining every GL account used across the mining enterprise including revenue accounts, OPEX accounts, CAPEX accounts, exploration expenditure accounts (IFRS 6), and balance sheet accounts. Provides the financial classification backbone for all journal entries and cost postings.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GL account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts (SKA1/SKB1)

attributes.name: account_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the GL account (SAP WAERS). Mining enterprises operating across multiple jurisdictions (Australia, USA, Canada, South Africa) may maintain accounts in local currencies (AUD, USD, CAD, ZAR) with group currency translation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.WAERS; ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP account group (KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account. Groups accounts by functional category (e.g., revenue, OPEX, CAPEX, exploration, balance sheet). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|opex|capex|exploration|balance_sheet|intercompany|tax|depreciation|provisions — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1.KTOKS; IFRS 6; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: account_long_description
attributes.description: Extended description of the GL account providing full business context, including the nature of costs or revenues captured (e.g., 'OPEX — Drill and Blast Consumables — Open Pit'). Supports financial reporting and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_name
