attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as defined in the chart of accounts (SAP field TXT20/TXT50). Used in financial reports, trial balances, and cost postings across mining operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKAT.TXT50; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP GL account number (SAKNR) from the chart of accounts, uniquely identifying the account within the company code. Used in all journal entries and cost postings across the mining enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1.SAKNR; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting; blocked accounts are temporarily suspended; accounts marked for deletion are pending removal from the chart of accounts after period-end.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type (GVTYP) classifying the GL account as balance sheet or profit and loss. Determines how the account is treated during fiscal year-end closing and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1.GVTYP; IFRS IAS 1; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: aisc_cost_category
attributes.description: Mapping of the GL account to the World Gold Council AISC cost category framework, enabling AISC and C1 cash cost reporting. Categories include mining, processing, site G&A, sustaining CAPEX, royalties, and by-product credits. Used for commodity cost benchmarking across iron ore, copper, coal, lithium, and nickel operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: c1_mining|c1_processing|c1_site_ga|royalties|by_product_credits|sustaining_capex|corporate_ga|reclamation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard 2018; ICMM; CIM Cost Estimation Guidelines

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Alternative Account Number (Country Chart of Accounts)
attributes.description: SAP alternative account number (ALTKT) from a country-specific or group chart of accounts. Used in mining companies operating across multiple jurisdictions to map local statutory accounts to the group chart of accounts for consolidated IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.ALTKT; IFRS IAS 27; SEC S-K 1300; SAMREC

attributes.name: balance_sheet_category
attributes.description: For balance sheet GL accounts, the IFRS balance sheet category (e.g., property plant and equipment, mineral rights, exploration assets, inventory, provisions for rehabilitation). Supports IFRS financial statement presentation and mine closure liability accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ppe|mineral_rights|exploration_assets|inventory|trade_receivables|trade_payables|rehabilitation_provision|deferred_tax — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; IFRS IAS 37 Provisions; IFRS 6; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: changed_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID (USNAM) of the person who last modified this GL account master record. Required for SOX internal controls, financial audit trails, and segregation of duties compliance in the mining finance function.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1.USNAM; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Audit

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: SAP chart of accounts key (KTOPL) to which this GL account belongs. A mining enterprise may operate multiple charts of accounts across jurisdictions (e.g., Australian GAAP, IFRS, US GAAP for SEC reporting).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI T004.KTOPL; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: commitment_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchase order commitments and funds reservations are tracked against this GL account in SAP CO. When true, uncommitted CAPEX and OPEX budget balances are visible, supporting mine budget control and CAPEX approval workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Commitment Management; CAPEX/OPEX Budgeting; ICMM

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code (BUKRS) to which this GL account is assigned. Represents the legal entity within the mining group (e.g., a specific mine site entity, holding company, or joint venture entity).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.BUKRS; IFRS IAS 27 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: cost_centre_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account require a cost centre assignment in SAP CO. When true, all OPEX postings must be assigned to a cost centre (e.g., drill and blast, haulage, processing plant, maintenance) for mine cost centre accounting and AISC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; AISC World Gold Council Standard; ICMM

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost element category (KATYP) indicating whether this is a primary cost element (linked to a P&L GL account, e.g., OPEX, CAPEX) or a secondary cost element (internal allocations, activity types). Critical for mine cost centre accounting and AISC/C1 cash cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO CSKA.KATYP; AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) World Gold Council Standard; CIM Cost Estimation Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this GL account record was first created in the source SAP FI system. Provides audit trail for chart of accounts governance and financial control compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Audit; ISO 45001

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: SAP deletion flag (XLOEV) indicating the GL account has been marked for deletion from the chart of accounts. Accounts with this flag set will be removed during the next chart of accounts reorganisation run. Retained for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1.XLOEV; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account became active and available for postings. Used to track the introduction of new accounts during chart of accounts restructuring, mine commissioning, or new project setup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account was deactivated or closed. Null for currently active accounts. Used to manage account lifecycle during mine closure, asset disposal, or chart of accounts rationalisation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS IAS 1; Mine Rehabilitation and Closure Accounting

attributes.name: expenditure_classification
attributes.description: Mining-specific classification of the GL account as Operating Expenditure (OPEX), Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), exploration expenditure (IFRS 6), rehabilitation provision, sustaining CAPEX, or growth CAPEX. Drives AISC and C1 cash cost reporting and LOM financial modelling.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; AISC World Gold Council; ICMM; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group (FSTAG) controlling which fields are required, optional, or suppressed when posting to this GL account. Determines mandatory entry of cost centre, WBS element, profit centre, or other account assignment objects for mining cost control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.FSTAG; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: Classification of the GL account within the financial statement structure (e.g., Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement). Supports IFRS-compliant financial reporting and SEC S-K 1300 mining disclosure requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: income_statement|balance_sheet|cash_flow_operating|cash_flow_investing|cash_flow_financing|equity_statement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; SEC S-K 1300; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area (FKBER) classifying the GL account by business function for segment reporting (e.g., mining operations, mineral processing, exploration, administration, sales). Supports IFRS 8 Operating Segments disclosure for mining companies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining_operations|mineral_processing|exploration|administration|sales_marketing|logistics|hse|rehabilitation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO FKBER; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: ifrs6_exploration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for exploration and evaluation expenditure under IFRS 6. When true, costs posted to this account are subject to IFRS 6 impairment testing and disclosure requirements. Relevant for junior and major mining companies with active exploration programs.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; SEC S-K 1300; NI 43-101

attributes.name: interest_calculation_flag
attributes.description: SAP interest calculation indicator (XZPMO) specifying whether interest is calculated on balances in this GL account. Relevant for intercompany loan accounts, rehabilitation provision accounts, and deferred tax accounts in mining group structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.XZPMO; IFRS IAS 37 Provisions; IFRS IAS 23 Borrowing Costs

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this GL account master record in SAP FI. Supports change management tracking, SOX compliance, and chart of accounts version control for the mining enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKA1; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Audit

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: SAP line item display flag (XKRES) indicating whether individual journal entry line items are stored and displayable for this account. When true, full drill-down to individual postings is available, supporting audit and cost analysis for mining operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.XKRES; Internal Audit; MSHA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: SAP open item management flag (XOPVW) indicating whether individual line items posted to this account must be cleared against each other (e.g., GR/IR clearing accounts, bank clearing accounts). Critical for accounts payable and procurement reconciliation in mining supply chain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.XOPVW; IFRS IAS 1; Pronto Xi Procurement Integration

attributes.name: planning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cost planning is blocked for this GL account in SAP CO (XSPEP). When true, budget planning entries cannot be made against this account, used to control CAPEX and OPEX budget planning integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO SKB1.XSPEP; CAPEX/OPEX Budgeting Controls

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct postings to this GL account are blocked (SAP XSPEB). When true, no journal entries can be posted to this account, typically used for accounts under review, year-end closing accounts, or accounts pending reclassification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.XSPEB; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: profit_centre_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are relevant for SAP Profit Centre Accounting (PCA). When true, all postings are distributed to profit centres representing individual mine sites or commodity business units, enabling site-level profitability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account (SAP XINTB) that is automatically updated from a subledger (accounts payable, accounts receivable, asset accounting). Reconciliation accounts cannot be posted to directly and are critical for financial integrity in mining ERP environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.XINTB; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is used to record mine rehabilitation and closure provisions under IFRS IAS 37. Rehabilitation provision accounts are subject to annual actuarial review and are disclosed in the notes to financial statements and environmental impact statements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 37 Provisions Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; ISO 14001; EIS (Environmental Impact Statement); ICMM

attributes.name: royalty_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is designated for recording mineral royalty payments to government or private landowners. Royalty accounts are separately tracked for AISC reporting, tax deductibility assessment, and regulatory disclosure under mining tenement agreements.
attributes.references: AISC World Gold Council Standard; JORC Code 2012; Australian Minerals Resource Rent Tax; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: SAP sort key (ZUAWA) defining the default assignment field populated when posting to this GL account (e.g., document date, posting date, purchase order number, cost centre). Controls how line items are sorted in account statements and financial reports.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: SAP tax category (MWSKZ) controlling whether the GL account is relevant for input tax (GST/VAT on purchases), output tax (GST/VAT on sales), or not tax-relevant. Critical for mining royalty and resource rent tax compliance across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.MWSKZ; IFRS IAS 12 Income Taxes; Australian GST Act

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: SAP tolerance group (TOLGR) assigned to the GL account, defining acceptable variance limits for payment differences and clearing transactions. Used in accounts payable and receivable processing for mining procurement and commodity sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI SKB1.TOLGR; Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: wbs_element_relevance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Relevance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account require a WBS element assignment in SAP PS (Project System). When true, costs must be assigned to a project WBS element, typically for CAPEX projects, mine development, or exploration programs tracked under IFRS 6.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS WBS; IFRS 6; CAPEX Project Accounting; JORC Code 2012

products.name: profit_centre
products.description: SAP CO profit centre master representing autonomous business units within the mining group (e.g., individual mine sites, commodity business units, processing operations) used for internal profitability reporting. Enables segment-level P&L reporting aligned to IFRS 8 operating segments and commodity-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profit centre. Primary key.

attributes.name: aisc_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit centre is included in All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) reporting for external disclosures.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The SAP business area code used for cross-company code reporting and segment analysis.

attributes.name: c1_cost_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit centre reports C1 cash cost metrics for commodity margin analysis.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the profit centre was formally closed or decommissioned.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The primary mineral commodity associated with this profit centre (e.g., iron ore, copper, coal, lithium, nickel). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|silver|zinc|bauxite|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI company code representing the legal entity to which this profit centre is assigned for financial reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The SAP Controlling Area to which this profit centre belongs. Controlling areas represent organizational units for cost and profit management.

attributes.name: cost_centre_group
attributes.description: The cost centre group or hierarchy to which this profit centre's cost centres roll up for cost allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the profit centre is domiciled (e.g., AUS, CAN, CHL).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this profit centre record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the profit centre's local reporting currency (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: exploration_accounting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit centre applies IFRS 6 exploration and evaluation asset accounting.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The functional currency as defined by IAS 21 for this profit centre's primary economic environment.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or jurisdiction where the profit centre operates (e.g., Western Australia, Queensland, South America).

attributes.name: hierarchy_node
attributes.description: The hierarchical node or path representing this profit centre's position in the organizational profit centre hierarchy.

attributes.name: ifrs_segment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Segment Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit centre is a reportable operating segment under IFRS 8.

attributes.name: jorc_resource_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) Resource Category
attributes.description: The highest JORC resource classification category applicable to this profit centre's mineral resources (measured, indicated, inferred), if the profit centre is a mine site.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this profit centre record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this profit centre record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lom_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the Life of Mine plan document or system record associated with this profit centre, if applicable.

attributes.name: profit_centre_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the profit centre in SAP CO. Used for reporting and integration with external systems.

attributes.name: profit_centre_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the profit centre's business scope, operations, and responsibilities.

attributes.name: profit_centre_name
attributes.description: The full business name of the profit centre (e.g., 'Iron Ore Mine Site A', 'Copper Processing Plant B', 'Lithium Business Unit').

attributes.name: profit_centre_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the profit centre indicating whether it is operational, suspended, or closed.

attributes.name: profit_centre_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit centre by operational function (e.g., mine site, processing plant, commodity business unit, corporate function, exploration division, logistics hub).

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: The ore reserve classification (proved or probable) for this profit centre's economically mineable reserves, per JORC or equivalent standards.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: The operating segment code aligned to IFRS 8 segment reporting requirements. Used for external financial disclosures.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or acronym for the profit centre used in reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this profit centre became active and operational for financial reporting.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this profit centre is valid. Null for open-ended profit centres.

products.name: wbs_element
products.description: Work Breakdown Structure element master from SAP PS representing the hierarchical project cost structure for CAPEX projects including mine development, plant construction, exploration programs, and rehabilitation works. Each WBS element captures approved budget, committed costs, actual spend, and project phase classification. Critical for CAPEX tracking and LOM financial planning.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the WBS element. Primary key.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent project definition under which this WBS element is organized.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the default cost centre for posting costs when this WBS element is used for account assignment.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee or contractor who is the accountable project manager or work package owner for this WBS element.

attributes.name: parent_wbs_element_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parent Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element ID
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent WBS element in the hierarchical structure. Null for top-level WBS elements.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the profit centre for internal profitability analysis and segment reporting.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative actual costs posted to this WBS element from invoices, payroll, material issues, and other financial transactions. Used for spend tracking and CAPEX reporting.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date when work on this WBS element was completed. Null if work is still in progress. Used for project closure and lessons learned analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date when work commenced on this WBS element. Used for schedule variance analysis and project performance reporting.

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: The name of the person or department who requested or initiated the project or work package represented by this WBS element.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total approved budget allocated to this WBS element, representing the authorized spending limit for CAPEX or OPEX. Critical for financial control and variance analysis.

attributes.name: asset_under_construction_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether costs posted to this WBS element are capitalized as an Asset Under Construction per IFRS 16 and IAS 16. True for CAPEX projects that will be settled to fixed assets, false for OPEX or expensed projects.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total value of purchase orders, contracts, and other commitments issued against this WBS element but not yet invoiced. Used for funds reservation and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The primary mineral commodity associated with this WBS element project: iron_ore, copper, coal, lithium, nickel, gold, or other. Used for commodity-specific CAPEX tracking and All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code (legal entity) to which this WBS element belongs. Used for financial consolidation and IFRS reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: The SAP controlling area for management accounting and cost control purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WBS element record was first created in SAP PS.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all financial values associated with this WBS element (budget, actuals, commitments).

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The operational functional area this WBS element supports: mining operations, mineral processing, exploration programs, infrastructure development, mine rehabilitation, or logistics and supply chain.

attributes.name: ifrs6_exploration_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this WBS element represents exploration and evaluation expenditure subject to IFRS 6 accounting treatment. True for pre-feasibility exploration programs, false for development or production projects.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: investment_program
attributes.description: The strategic investment program or portfolio to which this WBS element belongs (e.g., Mine Expansion 2024, Sustaining Capital FY25, Exploration Campaign Q3). Used for portfolio-level CAPEX tracking and NPV/IRR analysis.

attributes.name: jorc_reserve_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) Reserve Category
attributes.description: The JORC Code reserve classification associated with the ore body or resource being developed by this project: proved (highest confidence), probable (lower confidence), or not_applicable for non-mining projects. Used for reserve reporting and SEC S-K 1300 compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who last updated this WBS element record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WBS element record was last modified in SAP PS.

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: The unique code identifying the mine site or operational location where this WBS element work is being performed (e.g., IRONORE01, COPPERMINE02). Used for site-level CAPEX and OPEX aggregation.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial budget amount approved at project inception, before any subsequent budget revisions or supplements. Used for baseline variance reporting.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled completion date for this WBS element. Used for milestone tracking and LOM financial planning.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled start date for work on this WBS element, as defined in the project plan. Used for Life of Mine (LOM) scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: planning_plant
attributes.description: The SAP plant code representing the physical mine site, processing facility, or operational location where the work will be performed.

attributes.name: project_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the project type: CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) for mine development and plant construction, OPEX (Operating Expenditure) for sustaining activities, exploration for resource discovery programs, rehabilitation for mine closure works, sustaining for ongoing maintenance capital, or expansion for growth projects.

attributes.name: settlement_rule_exists
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a settlement rule has been configured to allocate costs from this WBS element to assets, cost centres, or other receivers. True if settlement is configured, false otherwise.

attributes.name: system_status
attributes.description: The SAP system-controlled status of the WBS element lifecycle: created (initial), released (active for posting), technically_completed (work finished but financially open), closed (final settlement complete), or locked (posting blocked).

attributes.name: user_status
attributes.description: User-defined status field for business-specific workflow states (e.g., awaiting_approval, in_execution, on_hold, under_review). Configurable per company requirements.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code identifying the WBS element in SAP PS. Typically hierarchical (e.g., P-12345.01.02). Used in all project reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: wbs_element_description
attributes.description: Full business description of the WBS element, detailing the scope of work, deliverable, or project phase it represents.

attributes.name: wbs_element_type
attributes.description: Classification of the WBS element by its functional purpose: planning (for scheduling), account_assignment (for cost posting), billing (for revenue recognition), or statistical (for reporting only).

attributes.name: wbs_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this WBS element within the project structure. Level 1 is the top-level project, subsequent levels represent sub-phases or work packages.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who created this WBS element record in the system.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: SAP FI journal entry header representing every financial posting in the general ledger including accruals, reversals, intercompany eliminations, IFRS 6 exploration capitalisation entries, and period-end adjustments. Captures document type, posting date, fiscal period, company code, and reference document. The primary transactional record for all financial movements.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry header record in the general ledger system. Primary key for all financial postings.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Journal entries can be cost centre specific for management accounting. The cost_center code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master data.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who created this journal entry. Used for audit trail, segregation of duties monitoring, and user activity analysis.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.processing_plant. Business justification: Plant-specific journal entries (accruals, inventory adjustments, depreciation) reference the plant for cost centre derivation and financial reporting. Enables plant-level P&L and balance sheet reporti

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Journal entries can be profit centre specific for segment reporting. The profit_center code should be replaced with FK to profit_centre.profit_centre_id to enable joining to profit centre master data.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entries can be project-related and posted to WBS elements. The wbs_element code should be replaced with FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining to project master data.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number when this journal entry relates to asset accounting transactions (acquisitions, depreciation, retirements). Links to the asset register for CAPEX capitalization and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: The subnumber of the fixed asset for tracking components or sub-assets within a main asset. Used for detailed asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area for cross-company code reporting. Represents business segments that span multiple legal entities, such as global copper operations or integrated iron ore value chain.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry was cleared. Populated when open items are settled. Used for aging analysis and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing entry if this journal entry has been cleared (e.g., invoice cleared by payment). Used for open item management and reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code within the mining group to which this journal entry belongs. Represents the smallest organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for external reporting purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this journal entry was originally posted (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD, CLP for Chilean Peso, ZAR for South African Rand). All line items in this entry share this currency.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the original source document (invoice, receipt, contract). May differ from posting date. Used for document tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text description at the header level providing context for this journal entry. Used for explanatory notes, period-end adjustments, and manual posting descriptions.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned by SAP FI to this journal entry. Used for audit trails and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classifies the journal entry by its business purpose: SA (General Ledger Document), AB (Accounting Document), KR (Vendor Invoice), DR (Customer Invoice), DZ (Payment Document), KA (Customer Document), KG (Vendor Credit Memo), KN (Net Customer Document), KZ (Payment Request), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Transfer Posting), WA (Goods Issue), WE (Goods Receipt), ZP (Payment Posting). Controls number ranges and posting rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|KR|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when this journal entry was physically entered into the SAP system. Used for audit trail and user activity tracking.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: The time of day when this journal entry was entered into the system. Stored in HH:MM:SS format. Used for detailed audit trails.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert the document currency to the company code local currency at the time of posting. Used for multi-currency consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when this journal entry was posted. Typically 1-12 for regular periods, 13-16 for special closing periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this journal entry is posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and IFRS compliance.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area for cost-of-sales accounting. Classifies costs by function: mining operations, processing, logistics, sales and marketing, administration. Used for functional P&L presentation under IFRS.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between different company codes within the mining group. True for intercompany postings requiring elimination entries during consolidation.

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: The internal order number for tracking specific cost collection objects such as maintenance campaigns, exploration programs, or overhead cost pools. Used for detailed OPEX analysis.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifies the ledger to which this entry is posted: 0L (Leading Ledger - IFRS), 1L (Local GAAP), 2L (Management Reporting), 3L (Tax Ledger), 9L (Consolidation Ledger). Supports parallel accounting under IFRS and local standards.
attributes.references: SAP FI New General Ledger - RLDNR

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of this journal entry converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate. Used for statutory financial statements and IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Local Currency Amount - DMBTR

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company code's local currency. All amounts are converted to this currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material master number when this journal entry relates to inventory movements, ROM stockpile valuations, or concentrate sales. Links to material master for commodity tracking.

attributes.name: parked_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is parked (saved but not yet posted). True for parked documents awaiting approval, False for posted documents. Used for workflow and approval processes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the accounting date that determines which fiscal period the entry affects. Critical for period-end close and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls the type of posting at the line item level: 01-49 (Debit postings), 50-99 (Credit postings). Determines account type, debit/credit indicator, and field status.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source document (purchase order, invoice, contract). Used to link journal entries back to originating business transactions.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this entry reverses another entry, False otherwise. Used for accrual reversals and error corrections.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original entry: 01 (Reversal in Current Period), 02 (Reversal in Next Period), 03 (Incorrect Posting), 04 (Accrual Reversal), 05 (Other). Used for financial control and audit purposes.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Maintains audit trail for reversed transactions.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner when intercompany_indicator is True. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation elimination entries.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of this journal entry in the original transaction currency. Sum of all debit or credit line items in document currency.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit and credit line items within a SAP FI journal entry, capturing GL account, cost centre, profit centre, WBS element, amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, and assignment text. Provides the granular financial posting detail required for cost allocation, AISC calculation, and regulatory financial reporting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be cost centre specific for management accounting. The cost_centre_code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master data.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a GL account. The gl_account_code should be replaced with FK to general_ledger_account.general_ledger_account_id to enable joining to account master data including ac

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent journal entry header. Links this line item to its containing journal entry document.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be profit centre specific for segment reporting. The profit_centre_code should be replaced with FK to profit_centre.profit_centre_id to enable joining to profit centre master d

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be project-related and posted to WBS elements. The wbs_element_code should be replaced with FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining to project master data.

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the line item converted to the local reporting currency of the operating entity. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP FI Local Currency

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the line item in the original transaction currency. Represents the value before any currency conversion.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number for asset-related postings (CAPEX, depreciation, disposals). Links the line item to a specific asset in the asset register.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Accounting; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: The subnumber identifying a specific component or sub-asset within a main asset. Used for detailed asset tracking and partial disposals.

attributes.name: assignment_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional assignment or reference information. Often used to capture invoice numbers, purchase order references, or other cross-reference identifiers.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated. Determines the due date for payment or receipt of funds.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area code representing a distinct line of business or commodity type (e.g., iron ore, copper, coal). Enables financial reporting by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP FI Business Area; IFRS 8 Operating Segments

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date when this line item was cleared or settled against another document. Null if the item remains open.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing document that settled this line item. Provides traceability to payment or receipt transactions.

attributes.name: customer_code
attributes.description: The customer master code for accounts receivable postings. Identifies the buyer or customer associated with this line item.
attributes.references: SAP SD Customer Master; Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental accounting classification for double-entry bookkeeping.
attributes.references: Double-Entry Accounting Principles; IFRS Conceptual Framework

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area code representing the business function (e.g., mining, processing, logistics, administration). Used for cost of sales and functional expense reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Functional Area; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: The internal order number for cost collection and allocation. Used for tracking specific cost objects such as maintenance campaigns or exploration programs.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing additional detail about the nature or purpose of this line item posting. Enhances auditability and understanding of the transaction.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document. Determines the ordering of line items within a single journal entry.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the local reporting currency (e.g., USD, AUD). Identifies the currency used for statutory and management reporting.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material master number for inventory-related postings. Links the line item to a specific material or commodity (e.g., iron ore concentrate, diesel fuel, reagents).
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions. Critical for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this line item was posted to the general ledger. Critical for audit trail and financial period cutoff verification.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date; IAS 10 Events After the Reporting Period

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or units associated with this line item. Used for inventory valuation and unit cost calculations.
attributes.references: SAP FI Quantity Field; IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: reference_key_1
attributes.description: First reference key field for linking to source documents or external systems. Commonly used for invoice numbers, contract references, or shipment identifiers.

attributes.name: reference_key_2
attributes.description: Second reference key field for additional cross-referencing. Provides flexibility for multi-dimensional traceability to source transactions.

attributes.name: reference_key_3
attributes.description: Third reference key field for extended cross-referencing requirements. Supports complex traceability scenarios across multiple systems.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal document that reversed this line item. Null if the item has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this line item has been reversed. True if the posting has been reversed by a subsequent reversal document.

attributes.name: tax_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this line item in local currency. Derived from the tax code and base amount.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Calculation; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this line item. Determines the tax treatment, rate, and GL accounts for tax posting (e.g., GST, VAT, sales tax).
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Configuration; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner code for intercompany transactions. Identifies the counterparty legal entity within the corporate group for consolidation and elimination purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Trading Partner; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction currency (e.g., USD, AUD, EUR). Identifies the currency in which the original transaction was denominated.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., MT for metric tonnes, L for litres, KG for kilograms). Standardizes quantity reporting across materials.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; SAP UOM

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date for cash management and liquidity planning. Represents the effective date when funds are available or debited.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: The vendor master code for accounts payable postings. Identifies the supplier or contractor associated with this line item.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master; Procurement Standards

products.name: capex_budget
products.description: Capital expenditure budget master capturing approved CAPEX allocations by WBS element, project phase, mine site, and fiscal year. Tracks original approved budget, budget revisions, committed costs, actual spend, and forecast-to-complete. Supports LOM capital planning, NPV/IRR project valuations, and board-approved capital allocation governance.

attributes.name: capex_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each CAPEX budget record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the capex_budget data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: asset_class_id
attributes.description: FK to equipment.asset_class

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: FK to project.capital_project

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: CAPEX budgets are tracked and reported by cost centre. The cost_centre_code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master data including hierarchy, r

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: CAPEX budgets post to specific GL accounts in the chart of accounts. The gl_account_code should be replaced with FK to general_ledger_account.general_ledger_account_id to enable joining to account mas

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: FK to mine.mine_site

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.processing_plant. Business justification: Capital budgets are allocated to specific processing plants for expansion, sustaining capex, and asset replacement projects. Enables plant-level capex tracking, project portfolio management, and capit

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: CAPEX budgets should be allocated to profit centres for investment planning and approval by business segment. Opex_budget already has profit_centre_id; capex_budget should have the same dimension for

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: CAPEX budgets are allocated to WBS elements in SAP PS. The wbs_element_code should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id for referential integrity and to enable joining to WBS hie

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure posted to this WBS element in SAP FI/CO as at the reporting date. Represents invoiced and goods-receipted costs capitalised to the asset under construction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IAS 16; IFRS 6

attributes.name: aisc_contribution_usd
attributes.description: The sustaining CAPEX component of this budget expressed in USD per unit of production, contributing to the AISC metric reported to investors. Applies only to sustaining capital categories per World Gold Council AISC guidance.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Guidance Note 2018; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: The delegated authority level that approved this CAPEX budget, reflecting the company's capital delegation of authority (DOA) framework. Determines the governance tier for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Capital Governance Framework; ASX Corporate Governance Principles; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAPEX budget was formally approved by the board or delegated capital authority. Required for capital governance audit trails and regulatory financial disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; ASX Listing Rules; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Original board-approved CAPEX budget amount for this WBS element in the reporting currency. Represents the baseline capital allocation against which variances are measured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS/CO Module; IAS 16; IFRS 6

attributes.name: budget_revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number indicating how many times the original approved budget has been formally revised (0 = original approval, 1 = first revision, etc.). Supports audit trail of capital budget changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Internal Capital Governance Framework

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the CAPEX budget record. Tracks the approval lifecycle from initial draft through board approval, revision cycles, and project closure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Internal Capital Governance Framework

attributes.name: capex_category
attributes.description: Classification of the CAPEX type: Sustaining (maintaining existing assets), Growth (expanding capacity), Exploration (IFRS 6 qualifying expenditure), Rehabilitation (mine closure obligations), or IT (technology infrastructure). Drives AISC reporting and NPV/IRR modelling.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; IAS 16; World Gold Council AISC Guidance; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: capitalisation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset under construction is expected to be or was transferred to a fixed asset and capitalised in SAP AM. Triggers commencement of depreciation under IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA AM Module; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total value of purchase orders and contracts committed against this CAPEX budget line in SAP MM/PS. Represents legally obligated spend not yet invoiced. Critical for available budget calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PS Module; IAS 37 Provisions

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Contingency allowance included within the approved budget to cover unforeseen scope, geotechnical, or market risks. Reported separately to the board to distinguish base estimate from risk provision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; AACE International Recommended Practice; ICMM Capital Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CAPEX budget record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget record (e.g., 'AUD', 'USD', 'ZAR'). Supports multi-currency capital reporting for international mining operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: discount_rate_pct
attributes.description: Weighted average cost of capital (WACC) or hurdle rate applied in the DCF model for NPV calculation, expressed as a percentage. Approved by the board for capital project evaluation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 36; CIM Valuation Standards; ICMM Capital Reporting

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert budget amounts from the transaction currency to the group reporting currency (e.g., USD to AUD). Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables at the time of budget approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 1–12) within the fiscal year for which this budget line applies. Supports monthly capital phasing and cash flow forecasting in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) for which this CAPEX budget is approved and tracked. Aligns with the company's financial reporting calendar in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: forecast_at_completion_amount
attributes.description: Total projected cost at project completion, calculated as actual spend plus forecast to complete. Key metric for capital overrun/underrun reporting to the board and NPV/IRR sensitivity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; PMI PMBOK; ICMM Capital Reporting

attributes.name: forecast_to_complete_amount
attributes.description: Estimated remaining expenditure required to complete the project scope from the current reporting date. Used in earned value management and LOM capital cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management

attributes.name: irr_pct
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return of the capital project expressed as a percentage, derived from the approved DCF model. Used alongside NPV for capital project ranking and board investment approval.
attributes.references: CIM Valuation Standards; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: is_lom_capital
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPEX budget line is included in the approved Life of Mine capital plan. True = included in LOM plan; False = ad hoc or supplementary capital not in the LOM baseline.

attributes.name: is_sustaining_capex
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget is classified as sustaining CAPEX for AISC reporting purposes per World Gold Council guidance. True = sustaining capital included in AISC; False = growth or non-sustaining capital.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Guidance Note 2018; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this CAPEX budget record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data loading and change tracking in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: lom_plan_year
attributes.description: The Life of Mine plan year in which this CAPEX budget is scheduled, enabling alignment of capital expenditure with the long-term mine production schedule and NPV/IRR modelling horizon.
attributes.references: Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101

attributes.name: npv_amount
attributes.description: Net Present Value of the capital project calculated using the approved discount rate in the DCF model. Key investment decision metric used in board capital allocation governance and project ranking.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 36; CIM Valuation Standards; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101

attributes.name: opex_capex_split_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Expenditure / Capital Expenditure (OPEX/CAPEX) Split Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total project cost classified as CAPEX (versus OPEX) for accounting and tax purposes. Relevant for mixed-nature projects where capitalisation criteria under IAS 16 or IFRS 6 apply to only a portion of spend.
attributes.references: IAS 16; IFRS 6; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the capital project to which this budget line belongs, as defined in SAP PS. Used to group WBS elements under a single capital initiative (e.g., pit expansion, processing plant upgrade).

attributes.name: project_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual completion date of the capital project or WBS phase. Drives capital phasing in LOM plans and determines the depreciation commencement date under IAS 16.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; IAS 16; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: The lifecycle phase of the capital project to which this budget applies. Supports IFRS 6 exploration accounting and LOM capital phasing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Exploration|Feasibility|Construction|Commissioning|Operations|Closure — promote to reference product if additional phases are required]
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date of the capital project or WBS phase. Used in LOM capital scheduling and NPV/IRR discounted cash flow modelling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Deswik Mine Planning

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: Most recent board-approved revised budget amount after formal budget revision cycles (e.g., mid-year reforecast). Null if no revision has been approved. Supports variance analysis against original budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Internal Capital Governance Framework

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for the most recent budget revision (e.g., scope change, geotechnical risk materialisation, commodity price impact on equipment costs). Required for capital governance audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Internal Capital Governance Framework

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this CAPEX budget record was extracted (e.g., 'SAP-S4HANA-PROD'). Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SAP S/4HANA

products.name: opex_budget
products.description: Operating expenditure budget master capturing approved OPEX allocations by cost centre, GL account, mine site, and fiscal period. Tracks original budget, revised budget, actual spend, and variance. Supports C1 cash cost and AISC reporting by providing the budgeted cost baseline against which actual mining, processing, and sustaining capital costs are measured.

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OPEX budget record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the opex_budget data product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP HR employee identifier of the individual who formally approved this OPEX budget record. Supports segregation of duties and audit trail requirements under IFRS and SOX-equivalent controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; IFRS IAS 1; SOX-equivalent internal controls

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: OPEX budgets are allocated by cost centre. The cost_centre_code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master data including hierarchy, responsible m

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: OPEX budgets are allocated by GL account. The gl_account_code should be replaced with FK to general_ledger_account.general_ledger_account_id to enable joining to account master data including account

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP HR employee identifier of the person accountable for managing and approving this OPEX budget line. Supports budget ownership governance and approval workflow tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR; ICMM Governance Framework

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to processing.processing_plant. Business justification: Operating budgets are set at plant level for cost control, variance reporting, and AISC forecasting. Links financial planning to operational assets for budget vs actual analysis and cost centre perfor

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: OPEX budgets roll up to profit centres for segment reporting. The profit_centre_code should be replaced with FK to profit_centre.profit_centre_id to enable joining to profit centre master data.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: OPEX budgets can be project-related and allocated to WBS elements. The wbs_element_code should be replaced with FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining to project master data.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual operating expenditure incurred against this budget line for the fiscal period, sourced from SAP FI/CO actuals postings. Used to calculate budget variance and support C1 and AISC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; CO-OM; IFRS IAS 1; ICMM AISC Reporting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this OPEX budget record was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to approved status in the budget lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS IAS 1; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: budget_cycle_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the budget planning cycle (e.g., AOP-2024, MYR-2024-Q2) during which this OPEX budget was prepared and submitted. Supports multi-cycle budget management including Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and mid-year reviews.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Internal Budget Governance; ICMM

attributes.name: budget_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the OPEX budget line providing business context, justification, or notes entered by the budget owner. Supports budget review and audit processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Internal Budget Governance

attributes.name: budget_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by this OPEX budget record. Defines the temporal boundary for expenditure allocation and variance measurement.

attributes.name: budget_quantity
attributes.description: The budgeted quantity of the resource or activity associated with this OPEX line (e.g., tonnes of ore processed, litres of fuel, hours of labour). Used in unit cost calculations for C1 and AISC reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; ICMM C1 Cash Cost Reporting

attributes.name: budget_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the OPEX budget record in SAP S/4HANA CO, used for cross-system traceability and audit referencing. Corresponds to the SAP internal order or cost centre budget document number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)

attributes.name: budget_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by this OPEX budget record. May align with the fiscal period start or represent a sub-period budget window for project-based expenditure.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the OPEX budget record within the budget approval lifecycle. Controls editability and reporting inclusion (e.g., only approved budgets are used in C1 and AISC baseline calculations).

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Identifies the version of the budget record, distinguishing the original approved budget from subsequent revisions and forecasts. Supports budget lifecycle tracking and variance analysis against baseline. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: original|revised_1|revised_2|revised_3|forecast|reforecast|final — promote to reference product if more versions are required]

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The value of purchase orders and contracts committed against this OPEX budget line but not yet invoiced or posted as actuals. Supports available budget calculation and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-PO; CO-OM Commitment Management; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The primary mineral commodity associated with this OPEX budget line. Enables commodity-level cost reporting and supports C1 cash cost per tonne calculations by commodity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|silver|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC; ICMM; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the operating expenditure type. Used to segment OPEX into functional areas for C1 cash cost and AISC reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|maintenance|administration|hse|logistics|exploration|rehabilitation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM (International Council on Mining and Metals); GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement; AISC reporting standards

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element code providing a secondary classification of the expenditure nature (e.g., wages, fuel, reagents, explosives). Bridges the GL account to cost object controlling for granular OPEX analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OPEX budget record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the budget record lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS IAS 1; ISO 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget record (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Supports multi-currency mining operations and foreign exchange reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert budget amounts from the transaction currency to the group reporting currency. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables for the applicable fiscal period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS IAS 21; SEC Mining Disclosure Rules S-K 1300

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12) within the fiscal year to which this OPEX budget record applies. Supports monthly budget phasing and period-level variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; IFRS IAS 34 Interim Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this OPEX budget record belongs. Used for annual budget cycle management and year-over-year variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS IAS 1; IFRS 6 Exploration

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The latest forecast of total OPEX spend for the fiscal period, incorporating actuals to date plus projected remaining spend. Used in rolling forecast cycles and AISC guidance updates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; ICMM AISC Reporting; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: is_capitalised
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of this OPEX budget line has been reclassified as capital expenditure (CAPEX) under IFRS 6 or IAS 16. True if capitalised; False if fully expensed as OPEX. Critical for IFRS 6 exploration accounting compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_lom_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Life of Mine (LOM) Plan Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OPEX budget line is included in the Life of Mine (LOM) plan financial model. True if included in LOM; False if excluded (e.g., one-off or non-recurring items). Supports NPV and DCF modelling.
attributes.references: JORC (Joint Ore Reserves Committee); CIM; Deswik LOM Planning; ICMM

attributes.name: last_revised_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent budget revision was applied to this record. Tracks the recency of budget amendments for governance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the mine site or operational location to which this OPEX budget applies. Enables site-level cost reporting and benchmarking across the mining portfolio.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Caterpillar MineStar; JORC (Joint Ore Reserves Committee)

attributes.name: opex_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the OPEX budget line according to industry cost reporting frameworks. C1 cash cost covers direct mining and processing costs; AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) includes sustaining capital and corporate overhead. Critical for external cost disclosure to investors and regulators.
attributes.references: ICMM AISC Reporting Guidelines; World Gold Council AISC Standard; SEC S-K 1300; CIM (Canadian Institute of Mining)

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initially approved OPEX budget amount in the reporting currency for the specified cost centre, GL account, mine site, and fiscal period. Represents the baseline against which actual spend and revisions are measured.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS IAS 1; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the budget_quantity field (e.g., t = tonnes, kt = kilotonnes, L = litres, h = hours, kWh = kilowatt-hours). Ensures dimensional consistency in unit cost calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: t|kt|Mt|L|kL|h|kWh|MWh|m3|kg — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; ICMM

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: The most recently approved revised OPEX budget amount after formal budget amendments. Null if no revision has been made. Used in variance analysis to compare against actual spend.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this OPEX budget record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks silver layer and reconciliation between planning and financial systems.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA; Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this OPEX budget record. Used for change data capture in the Databricks silver layer and incremental load processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; Databricks Lakehouse Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the revised (or original if no revision) budget amount and the actual spend amount for the fiscal period. Positive value indicates underspend; negative value indicates overspend. Stored as a pre-computed field to support period-end reporting without recalculation overhead.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; IFRS IAS 1; ICMM Cost Reporting; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The budget variance expressed as a percentage of the budget amount ((budget - actual) / budget * 100). Enables proportional variance analysis and exception reporting across cost centres and mine sites.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; IFRS IAS 1

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Transactional record of internal cost allocations, assessments, and distributions between cost centres, profit centres, and WBS elements executed via SAP CO allocation cycles. Captures sender/receiver cost objects, allocation basis (activity rates, statistical key figures, percentages), cycle run date, and allocated amounts. Covers shared services distribution, equipment hourly rate charges, processing plant throughput-based apportionment, and overhead absorption. Essential for accurate per-tonne cost build-up feeding AISC and C1 cash cost calculations.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each cost allocation transaction record in the SAP CO allocation cycle. Primary key for the cost_allocation data product in the finance domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: allocation_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO allocation cycle definition (assessment or distribution cycle) under which this allocation was executed. Links to the cycle configuration that defines sender/receiver rules and allocation basis.

attributes.name: receiver_profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Cost allocations can be received by profit centres. The receiver_profit_centre code should be replaced with FK receiver_profit_centre_id → profit_centre.profit_centre_id to enable joining to profit ce

attributes.name: receiver_wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Cost allocations can be received by WBS elements (project cost objects). The receiver_wbs_element code should be replaced with FK receiver_wbs_element_id → wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining

attributes.name: sender_cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Cost allocations originate from a sender cost centre. The sender_cost_centre code and name should be replaced with FK sender_cost_centre_id → cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to sender cos

attributes.name: activity_rate
attributes.description: The planned or actual cost rate per unit of activity (e.g., cost per equipment hour, cost per tonne processed) used to calculate the allocated amount. Supports equipment hourly rate charging and processing plant throughput-based apportionment in AISC and C1 cost build-up.
