attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code when the allocation basis is an activity rate (e.g., 'EQUIP_HR' for equipment hours, 'PROC_T' for processing tonnes, 'DRILL_M' for drilling metres). Drives the activity price calculation and links to the planned activity rate for variance analysis.

attributes.name: aisc_component
attributes.description: Classification of the allocated cost into the World Gold Council / ICMM All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) reporting component. Enables automated AISC build-up from cost allocation transactions: mining costs, processing costs, G&A, royalties, sustaining capital, and by-product credits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|general_and_admin|royalties|sustaining_capital|by_product_credit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; World Gold Council AISC Standard; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of costs allocated from the sender to the receiver cost object in the controlling area currency. This is the primary financial outcome of the allocation transaction and feeds directly into AISC and C1 cash cost per-tonne calculations and OPEX/CAPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; IFRS (IAS 1); ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: allocated_amount_usd
attributes.description: The allocated cost amount translated to US Dollars (USD) using the exchange rate applicable at the cycle run date. Required for AISC and C1 cash cost reporting in USD per ounce or USD per tonne as per ICMM and investor disclosure standards.
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; SEC S-K 1300; IFRS (IAS 21 Foreign Currency)

attributes.name: allocation_basis_type
attributes.description: Method used to determine the allocation quantity or proportion. Activity rate charges based on confirmed activity quantities (e.g., equipment hours); statistical key figure uses operational metrics (e.g., tonnes processed, headcount); percentage applies a fixed split; fixed amount allocates a predetermined sum; equivalence number uses weighted ratios.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the allocation basis value (e.g., 'HR' for hours, 'T' for tonnes, 'PCT' for percentage, 'KWH' for kilowatt-hours). Aligns with SAP unit of measure codes and supports per-tonne cost build-up for AISC and C1 cash cost calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ISO 80000 (Quantities and Units)

attributes.name: allocation_basis_value
attributes.description: The quantity or rate value of the allocation basis used to compute the allocated amount. For activity rate allocations this is the confirmed activity quantity (e.g., machine hours); for statistical key figure allocations this is the operational metric value (e.g., tonnes of ore processed); for percentage allocations this is the percentage applied.

attributes.name: allocation_document_number
attributes.description: SAP CO allocation document number uniquely identifying the posting document generated during the allocation cycle run. Corresponds to the CO document number in SAP S/4HANA CO module and serves as the business-facing reference for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the cost accountant describing the purpose, basis, or special circumstances of the allocation (e.g., 'Q3 processing plant overhead absorption based on ROM tonnes', 'Equipment fleet hourly rate recharge to open pit operations'). Supports audit review and period-end close documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS (IAS 1 Disclosure Requirements)

attributes.name: allocation_run_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocation was executed against actual costs (actual run), planned costs (plan run for budget allocation modelling), or as a simulation (test run without posting). Supports both actual AISC reporting and budget/forecast cost allocation modelling.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the allocation document. Posted indicates confirmed CO posting; reversed indicates a reversal document has been generated; simulated indicates a test run without actual posting; error indicates a failed cycle run requiring correction; cancelled indicates a voided allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SAP CO allocation method used. Assessment transfers primary and secondary costs using assessment cost elements; distribution reallocates primary costs; activity allocation charges based on activity rates; template allocation uses formula-based rules; periodic reposting corrects prior postings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assessment|distribution|activity_allocation|template_allocation|periodic_reposting — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: c1_cost_component
attributes.description: Classification of the allocated cost into the Brook Hunt / CRU C1 Cash Cost reporting component. C1 cash cost is the industry-standard direct cash cost measure used for copper, nickel, and other base metals. Components include mining, processing, site G&A, transport, royalties, and treatment/refining charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mining|processing|site_general_admin|transport|royalties|treatment_refining — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; CRU C1 Cash Cost Methodology

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the mineral commodity to which the allocated cost is attributed (e.g., 'FE' for iron ore, 'CU' for copper, 'COAL' for coal, 'LI' for lithium, 'NI' for nickel). Enables commodity-level cost reporting and per-tonne cost build-up for AISC and C1 calculations by commodity.
attributes.references: ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; JORC Code; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code of the legal entity under which the allocation is posted. Supports legal entity-level financial reporting, intercompany cost allocation identification, and IFRS consolidated financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS (IAS 1); GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code within which the allocation cycle was executed. The controlling area defines the organisational scope for management accounting and cost centre hierarchies. Required for multi-entity mining groups operating across multiple SAP controlling areas.

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Classification of the allocated cost as Operating Expenditure (OPEX), Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), sustaining capital, or exploration cost. Drives AISC component classification (OPEX feeds C1 cash cost; sustaining capital feeds AISC; exploration feeds IFRS 6 capitalisation decisions).
attributes.references: IFRS 6 (Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources); ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element (secondary cost element for assessments, primary cost element for distributions) under which the allocation is posted. Determines the cost category in the chart of accounts and drives AISC cost component classification (mining, processing, G&A, sustaining capital).

attributes.name: cost_element_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the SAP CO cost element (e.g., 'Equipment Hourly Rate Charge', 'Processing Plant Overhead Absorption', 'Shared Services Assessment'). Provides human-readable cost category context for reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost allocation record was first created in the Silver layer data product, sourced from the SAP CO document creation timestamp. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and incremental load processing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the controlling area currency in which the allocated amount is denominated (e.g., 'AUD' for Australian Dollar, 'USD' for US Dollar, 'ZAR' for South African Rand). Supports multi-currency mining operations across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: cycle_run_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the SAP CO allocation cycle was executed and postings were generated. Used to sequence allocation runs within a fiscal period and reconcile with period-end close activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS (IAS 1 Period Reporting)

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the allocated amount from the controlling area currency to USD at the cycle run date. Sourced from SAP FI exchange rate tables and aligned with the rate type used for management reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this allocation was posted. Aligns with SAP posting period and supports monthly OPEX and CAPEX cost build-up for AISC and C1 reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) in which this cost allocation was posted. Used for annual financial reporting, AISC and C1 cash cost period aggregation, and IFRS 6 exploration cost capitalisation tracking.

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation crosses legal entity boundaries (True) or is within the same legal entity (False). Intercompany allocations require elimination in consolidated IFRS financial statements and may have transfer pricing implications under OECD guidelines.
attributes.references: IFRS (IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements); OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation document is a reversal of a prior allocation posting (True) or an original allocation (False). Reversal records carry negative amounts and are linked to the original document number for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS (IAS 1 Correction of Errors)

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the mine site or operation to which the allocated cost belongs. Supports site-level cost reporting, multi-site AISC benchmarking, and regulatory financial disclosures by operation as required under SEC S-K 1300 and JORC reporting.
attributes.references: JORC Code; SEC S-K 1300; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: original_document_number
attributes.description: For reversal allocation records, the SAP CO document number of the original allocation being reversed. Enables audit trail linkage between original and reversal postings for period-end reconciliation and financial control.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date of the allocation document in SAP FI/CO. Determines the fiscal period in which the cost is recognised and may differ from the cycle run date when allocations are posted retroactively during period-end close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; IFRS (IAS 1 Accrual Basis)

attributes.name: receiver_cost_centre
attributes.description: SAP CO cost centre code of the receiving cost object that absorbs the allocated costs. Represents the mine pit, processing circuit, exploration project, or operational department receiving the cost charge.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: receiver_cost_centre_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the receiving cost centre (e.g., 'Open Pit Mining Operations', 'Copper Flotation Circuit', 'Lithium Exploration'). Provides human-readable context for the allocation destination.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost allocation record was last modified in the Silver layer data product (e.g., following a reversal, status update, or data correction). Supports change data capture and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse pipeline.

products.name: cost_performance_report
products.description: Unit cost performance reporting record capturing both AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) and C1 cash cost metrics per mine site, commodity, and reporting period. AISC includes mining OPEX, processing, G&A, sustaining CAPEX, royalties, and by-product credits per World Gold Council standards. C1 captures direct cash costs excluding sustaining CAPEX and overheads. Stores report type, production volume, cost components breakdown, per-unit cost result, and variance to budget/prior period. The primary cost disclosure metrics for investor reporting and peer benchmarking.
products.reference: World Gold Council AISC Standard / Industry AISC Framework

attributes.name: cost_performance_report_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cost_performance_report

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost centre responsible for the cost accumulation reported. Aligns cost performance data to the organisational cost structure for management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Centre Accounting

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Cost performance reports aggregate costs from specific GL accounts. This link allows drilling down from AISC/C1 summary metrics to the underlying GL account detail. Consistent with pattern where all c

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: AISC/C1 cost performance reports are typically prepared by profit centre, as each mine site is a profit centre. This link allows aggregating cost performance across the profit centre hierarchy and com

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site for which this cost performance report is generated. Enables site-level AISC benchmarking and multi-site portfolio cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre Hierarchy; JORC Code

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Cost performance reports may track project-specific costs via WBS elements, particularly for sustaining capital projects that contribute to AISC. This link allows reporting AISC by project phase or WB

attributes.name: aisc_guidance_high
attributes.business_glossary_term: All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) Guidance High (USD per Unit)
attributes.description: Upper bound of the published AISC cost guidance range for the reporting period or full year, as disclosed in investor guidance documents. Together with aisc_guidance_low defines the guidance band for performance assessment.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; ASX Listing Rules; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: aisc_guidance_low
attributes.business_glossary_term: All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) Guidance Low (USD per Unit)
attributes.description: Lower bound of the published AISC cost guidance range for the reporting period or full year, as disclosed in investor guidance documents. Used to assess whether actual AISC performance is within the guided range.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; ASX Listing Rules; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance manager or CFO who approved this cost performance report for publication or investor disclosure. Required for SOX and internal audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow Approval; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost performance report was formally approved by the authorised finance approver. Provides the audit trail required for SOX compliance and regulatory financial disclosure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302

attributes.name: budget_unit_cost
attributes.description: Budgeted per-unit AISC or C1 cost for the reporting period as approved in the annual operating plan. Used as the benchmark for variance analysis against actual unit cost results. Sourced from SAP CO planning versions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Planning; World Gold Council AISC Standard; ICMM Cost Reporting

attributes.name: byproduct_credit
attributes.description: Revenue credit from by-product commodity sales (e.g., silver credits in a gold operation, molybdenum credits in a copper operation) deducted from gross costs to arrive at net AISC and C1 cost. A negative value reduces the reported unit cost.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; Brook Hunt C1 Framework; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: Primary commodity for which the unit cost metrics are reported. AISC and C1 cost benchmarks are commodity-specific; gold uses World Gold Council standards while copper uses Brook Hunt C1 framework. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gold|copper|iron_ore|coal|lithium|nickel|silver|zinc|cobalt|manganese — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; Brook Hunt C1/C2/C3; JORC Code

attributes.name: cost_variance_driver
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary driver(s) explaining the variance between actual and budget unit cost. Examples include grade underperformance, unplanned maintenance downtime, reagent price escalation, or FX movement. Used in management commentary and investor disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Variance Analysis; ICMM Cost Reporting; ASX Listing Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost performance report record was first created in the system. Provides the data lineage audit trail for the silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; IFRS IAS 1; Databricks Delta Lake Audit

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which cost components are reported prior to USD conversion (e.g., AUD for Australian operations, ZAR for South African operations). Enables multi-currency cost consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number (1–12 for monthly, 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year as maintained in SAP S/4HANA CO. Enables period-over-period cost variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this cost performance report belongs, as defined in SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variant. Used for annual AISC trend analysis and year-on-year variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fx_rate_to_usd
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert local currency cost components to USD for the reporting period. Sourced from SAP FI currency translation tables. Critical for cross-jurisdiction AISC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; World Gold Council AISC Standard

attributes.name: ga_cost
attributes.description: Site-level general and administrative overhead costs allocated to the reporting period, including site management, administration, and corporate services. Included in AISC but excluded from C1 cash cost per World Gold Council methodology.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO-OPA Overhead Accounting

attributes.name: head_grade
attributes.description: Average grade of ore fed to the processing plant during the reporting period, expressed in the commodity-appropriate unit (e.g., g/t for gold, % for copper). Head grade is a key cost driver — lower grades increase unit AISC by reducing production volume from the same processing throughput.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; LabWare LIMS Assay Results

attributes.name: is_guidance_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual unit cost result falls within the published AISC or C1 guidance range for the period. True when unit_cost_result is between aisc_guidance_low and aisc_guidance_high. Used in investor reporting and board performance dashboards.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; ASX Listing Rules Continuous Disclosure

attributes.name: mining_opex
attributes.description: Direct mining operating costs for the period including drilling, blasting, loading, hauling, and ROM pad management. A core component of both AISC and C1 cost calculations. Sourced from SAP CO cost centre actuals for mining cost centres.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: prior_period_unit_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Period Unit Cost (USD per Unit)
attributes.description: Per-unit AISC or C1 cost from the immediately preceding reporting period of the same type (e.g., prior quarter for quarterly reports). Enables period-on-period trend analysis and investor disclosure of cost trajectory.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; ASX Listing Rules Quarterly Reporting; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: processing_opex
attributes.description: Direct mineral processing and beneficiation costs for the period including comminution, flotation, leaching, SX-EW, and reagent consumption. Sourced from SAP CO processing plant cost centres.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: production_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production volume field. Commodity-specific: troy ounces (oz) for gold and silver, dry metric tonnes (dmt) for iron ore and coal, pounds (lb) for copper and nickel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oz|troy_oz|dmt|wmt|lb|t|kg — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; London Metal Exchange (LME) Commodity Standards

attributes.name: production_volume
attributes.description: Total quantity of payable commodity produced during the reporting period, expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the commodity (e.g., troy ounces for gold, dry metric tonnes for iron ore, pounds for copper). Used as the denominator in per-unit AISC and C1 cost calculations.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; JORC Code; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Metallurgical recovery rate achieved during the reporting period, expressed as a percentage of valuable mineral extracted from the ore feed. Recovery rate directly impacts production volume and therefore unit AISC. Sourced from metallurgical balance reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; World Gold Council AISC Standard; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: refining_and_transport_cost
attributes.description: Costs incurred for off-site refining, smelting, and transportation of concentrate or doré to the point of sale. Included in C1 cash cost for base metals and in AISC for precious metals. Covers both CIF and FOB delivery terms.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; Brook Hunt C1 Framework; Incoterms 2020 (CIF/FOB)

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the cost performance report, used in investor disclosures, management reporting packs, and peer benchmarking submissions. Follows the format CPR-YYYY-MM-SiteCode.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA; World Gold Council AISC Standard

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cost performance report, controlling whether it is eligible for external disclosure or investor reporting. Draft reports are work-in-progress; published reports are locked for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; IFRS 6 Exploration Accounting; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost reporting methodology applied. AISC follows World Gold Council standards including sustaining CAPEX and G&A. C1 captures direct cash costs only. C2 and C3 represent broader cost boundary definitions used in copper and base metals benchmarking.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard 2018; Brook Hunt C1/C2/C3 Cost Framework

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this cost performance record. Together with reporting_period_start defines the cost accumulation window for AISC and C1 calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: First calendar date of the reporting period covered by this cost performance record. Used to align cost metrics with production volumes and financial period boundaries in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 34 Interim Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI Period Management

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the reporting period — monthly for operational management, quarterly for ASX/SEC investor disclosures, and annual for full-year AISC benchmarking against peers.
attributes.references: ASX Listing Rules; SEC S-K 1300; World Gold Council AISC Standard

attributes.name: royalty_cost
attributes.description: Government and private royalties payable on mineral production during the reporting period. Included in both AISC and C1 cost calculations. Sourced from SAP FI accounts payable royalty accruals.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; IFRS IFRIC 20; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: strip_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of waste material (overburden) moved to ore mined during the reporting period. A key open-pit cost driver — higher strip ratios increase mining OPEX per unit of ore processed and directly inflate AISC. Sourced from mine production reconciliation.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; Hexagon MinePlan; SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: sustaining_capex
attributes.description: Capital expenditure required to sustain current production levels, including equipment replacement, tailings storage facility (TSF) raises, and mine infrastructure maintenance. Included in AISC but excluded from C1 cash cost. Sourced from SAP PS project actuals.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; SAP S/4HANA PS Project System; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: total_cost_usd
attributes.description: Aggregate of all cost components (mining OPEX, processing OPEX, G&A, sustaining CAPEX, royalties, refining and transport) less by-product credits for the reporting period, expressed in USD. This is the numerator used to compute the per-unit AISC or C1 cost.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: unit_cost_result
attributes.description: Calculated per-unit AISC or C1 cash cost expressed in USD per production unit of measure (e.g., USD/oz for gold, USD/lb for copper, USD/dmt for iron ore). This is the primary cost disclosure metric for investor reporting and peer benchmarking. Computed as total_cost_usd divided by production_volume.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; Brook Hunt C1 Framework; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cost performance report record was last modified. Tracks restatements, corrections, or updates to cost components following period-end close adjustments in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; IFRS IAS 8 Accounting Policies Changes and Errors; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: variance_to_budget_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance of actual unit cost result against the budget unit cost for the period. Positive values indicate cost overrun; negative values indicate cost underperformance. Calculated as ((unit_cost_result - budget_unit_cost) / budget_unit_cost) * 100.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Variance Analysis; ICMM Cost Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: variance_to_prior_period_pct
attributes.description: Percentage variance of actual unit cost result against the prior period unit cost. Used in quarterly investor reports and management commentary to explain cost movement drivers.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Standard; ASX Listing Rules; SEC S-K 1300

products.name: project_valuation
products.description: NPV/IRR project valuation record capturing discounted cash flow (DCF) model outputs for mining investment decisions including greenfield mine development, brownfield expansions, acquisition targets, and divestment assessments. Stores key assumptions (commodity price deck, production profile, mine life, CAPEX/OPEX estimates, discount rate, country risk premium), calculated outputs (NPV, IRR, payback period, breakeven commodity price), and sensitivity/scenario analysis parameters. Versioned per study stage (scoping, PFS, DFS, BFS) to support stage-gate capital governance and JORC/NI 43-101 economic assessments.

attributes.name: project_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the project valuation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mining project (greenfield, brownfield, acquisition, or divestment) being valued. Links to the project master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; JORC 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost centre responsible for funding and tracking this valuation study.

attributes.name: aisc_usd
attributes.description: All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) per unit of payable metal/mineral produced, expressed in USD per applicable unit. Extends C1 to include royalties, sustaining CAPEX, corporate G&A, and reclamation costs. Used for investor reporting and project economics benchmarking.
attributes.references: World Gold Council AISC Reporting Standard 2018; ICMM; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the valuation was formally approved by the investment committee or board, triggering capital allocation and project sanction decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Capital Governance Framework; ASX Listing Rules

attributes.name: breakeven_price_usd
attributes.description: The commodity price at which the project NPV equals zero at the applied discount rate, expressed in USD per applicable unit. Represents the minimum long-term commodity price required for the project to be economically viable.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; CIM Valuation Standards

attributes.name: c1_cash_cost_usd
attributes.description: C1 cash cost per unit of payable metal/mineral produced, expressed in USD per applicable unit. Represents direct cash costs of mining, processing, and site administration, excluding royalties, depreciation, and sustaining capital. Industry-standard cost metric for benchmarking.
attributes.references: World Gold Council Cost Reporting Standard; Brook Hunt C1 Cost Methodology; ICMM

attributes.name: capex_total_musd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure (CAPEX) estimate for the project over its full life, expressed in million USD. Includes initial development CAPEX, sustaining CAPEX, and closure CAPEX as modelled in the DCF. Sourced from SAP PS capital budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS/CO; JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; IFRS 6

attributes.name: commodity_price_usd
attributes.description: Long-term real commodity price assumption used as the base case in the DCF model, expressed in USD per applicable unit (e.g., USD/tonne for iron ore, USD/lb for copper). This is a proprietary price deck assumption and is commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: LME; World Bank Commodity Price Forecasts; JORC 2012 Table 1 Section 4

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Primary commodity being evaluated in this valuation model. Determines the applicable price deck, benchmark index, and market demand assumptions used in the DCF. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|silver|zinc|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC 2012; NI 43-101; London Metal Exchange (LME) Commodity Classification

attributes.name: country_risk_premium_pct
attributes.description: Additional risk premium added to the base discount rate to reflect sovereign, political, and regulatory risk in the jurisdiction where the project is located, expressed as a percentage. Used in cross-border acquisition and greenfield valuations.
attributes.references: Damodaran Country Risk Premium Methodology; IFRS 13; World Bank Governance Indicators

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this valuation record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail start point for data lineage and regulatory disclosure purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; GRI 207 Tax; Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the DCF model financial outputs (NPV, CAPEX, OPEX) are expressed (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD). Enables multi-currency consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: discount_rate_pct
attributes.description: Nominal or real discount rate (Weighted Average Cost of Capital — WACC) applied to future cash flows in the DCF model, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 8.00 for 8%). The primary driver of NPV sensitivity.
attributes.references: IFRS 13; JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; DCF Valuation Best Practice

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The reference date as of which all DCF model inputs (commodity prices, exchange rates, cost estimates) are expressed. Used to align valuations across different study dates for comparability.
attributes.references: IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement; JORC 2012 Table 1

attributes.name: head_grade_pct
attributes.description: Average feed grade of the ore reserve used in the DCF production profile, expressed as a percentage (e.g., % Fe for iron ore, % Cu for copper). Directly drives revenue calculations in the DCF model.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 14; Geovia GEMS

attributes.name: inflation_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual general inflation rate assumption applied in nominal DCF models to escalate costs and revenues over the mine life, expressed as a percentage. Only applicable when price_basis is nominal.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; World Bank Inflation Forecasts

attributes.name: irr_pct
attributes.description: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) of the project under the base case assumptions, expressed as a percentage. The discount rate at which the project NPV equals zero. Used alongside NPV for investment ranking and hurdle rate comparison.
attributes.references: IFRS 13; JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; CIM Valuation Standards

attributes.name: mine_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated total operating life of the mine in years as modelled in the DCF, derived from the LOM (Life of Mine) plan. Directly determines the number of cash flow periods in the NPV calculation.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1 Section 4; NI 43-101 Section 22; Deswik LOM Scheduling

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording key assumptions, caveats, material changes from the prior version, or qualifications relevant to the interpretation of this valuation. Supports audit trail and regulatory disclosure documentation.

attributes.name: npv_base_musd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Present Value (NPV) Base Case (Million USD)
attributes.description: Net Present Value (NPV) of the project under the base case commodity price, production, and cost assumptions, expressed in million USD. The primary investment decision metric for capital allocation and stage-gate approval.
attributes.references: IFRS 13; JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; CIM Valuation Standards

attributes.name: npv_high_musd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Present Value (NPV) High Case (Million USD)
attributes.description: NPV under the upside/high commodity price and cost scenario, expressed in million USD. Used in sensitivity analysis to quantify project value upside under favourable market conditions.

attributes.name: npv_low_musd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Present Value (NPV) Low Case (Million USD)
attributes.description: NPV under the downside/low commodity price and cost scenario, expressed in million USD. Used in sensitivity analysis to quantify project value at risk under adverse market conditions.

attributes.name: opex_unit_usd
attributes.description: Steady-state operating expenditure (OPEX) per tonne of ore processed, expressed in USD/t. Represents the all-in operating cost assumption in the DCF model, excluding royalties and sustaining capital.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22

attributes.name: ore_reserve_category
attributes.description: JORC/NI 43-101 resource and reserve classification underpinning the production profile used in the DCF model. Proved and Probable are Ore Reserves; Measured, Indicated, and Inferred are Mineral Resources. Determines the confidence level and regulatory disclosure requirements of the valuation.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 14; SAMREC 2016; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: payback_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years from first production (or initial CAPEX commitment) required to recover the total initial capital investment from undiscounted project cash flows. Used as a liquidity and risk metric alongside NPV and IRR.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; Internal Capital Governance Framework

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the qualified person (QP) or financial analyst responsible for preparing this valuation study. For JORC/NI 43-101 disclosures, the QP must be a competent person as defined by the applicable standard.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Section 1; NI 43-101 Section 5 Qualified Person; CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: price_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity price deck and cost estimates in the DCF model are expressed in real (constant purchasing power) or nominal (inflated) terms. Critical for correct interpretation of NPV and IRR outputs.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; CIM Valuation Standards

attributes.name: production_rate_mtpa
attributes.description: Steady-state annual ore production throughput assumption used in the DCF model, expressed in million tonnes per annum (Mtpa). Derived from the mine production schedule and processing plant design capacity.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; Hexagon MinePlan Production Schedule; Deswik

attributes.name: recovery_rate_pct
attributes.description: Metallurgical recovery rate assumed in the DCF model, expressed as a percentage of valuable mineral extracted from the ore feed. Determines payable metal/mineral production volume and directly impacts revenue projections.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 13; LabWare LIMS Metallurgical Testwork

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Government or private royalty rate applied to revenue or profit in the DCF model, expressed as a percentage. Jurisdiction-specific and commodity-specific; a material cost item in project economics.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 22; Applicable State/Federal Mining Royalty Legislation

attributes.name: strip_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of waste (overburden) tonnes to ore tonnes mined, as modelled in the LOM plan. A key driver of mining OPEX in open-cut operations. Higher strip ratios increase unit mining costs and reduce project economics.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; Hexagon MinePlan; Deswik LOM Scheduling

attributes.name: study_stage
attributes.description: Stage-gate study phase at which this valuation was produced. Scoping = order-of-magnitude; PFS = Pre-Feasibility Study; DFS = Definitive Feasibility Study; BFS = Bankable Feasibility Study; Update = periodic refresh. Drives accuracy expectations and capital governance approval thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scoping|pfs|dfs|bfs|update — promote to reference product if additional stages are required]
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Section 4; NI 43-101 Section 3; CIM Definition Standards 2014

attributes.name: tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: Corporate income tax rate applied in the DCF model for the project jurisdiction, expressed as a percentage. Drives post-tax NPV and IRR calculations. May differ from statutory rate due to mining-specific tax concessions.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 12 Income Taxes; NI 43-101 Section 22; Applicable Jurisdiction Tax Legislation

attributes.name: total_ore_reserve_mt
attributes.description: Total ore reserve tonnage (Proved + Probable) underpinning the LOM production schedule in the DCF model, expressed in million tonnes. Sourced from the JORC/NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate.
attributes.references: JORC 2012 Table 1; NI 43-101 Section 14; Geovia GEMS Resource Estimation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this valuation record, supporting audit trail requirements and change management governance.

attributes.name: valuation_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this valuation study, used in stage-gate governance documentation and board submissions (e.g., VAL-PILBARA-2024).

attributes.name: valuation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the valuation study (e.g., 'Pilbara Iron Ore Expansion DFS 2024'), used in reports and presentations.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the valuation record within the stage-gate capital governance workflow. Draft = work in progress; Under Review = submitted for technical/financial review; Approved = board or investment committee approved; Superseded = replaced by a newer version; Archived = retained for audit trail.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investment decision context: greenfield (new mine development), brownfield (expansion of existing operation), acquisition (target company or asset purchase), divestment (asset sale assessment), or exploration (early-stage resource discovery). Drives applicable discount rate and risk premium selection.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; JORC 2012

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer version of this valuation within the same study stage, enabling tracking of iterative model updates (e.g., commodity price deck revisions, CAPEX re-estimates) without creating a new study stage record.

products.name: royalty_obligation
products.description: Master record of all royalty obligations payable to government authorities, landowners, and native title holders on mineral production. Captures royalty type (ad valorem, specific, profit-based), applicable commodity, royalty rate, calculation basis, payment schedule, and accrued liability. Supports regulatory financial disclosure and SAP FI accounts payable accruals.
products.reference: State Mining Royalty Legislation / SAP FI Accruals

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each royalty obligation record in the mining finance system. Primary key for the royalty_obligation data product.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Royalty obligations are tracked by cost centre for AISC and C1 cost reporting. The cost_centre_code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master dat

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Royalty obligations post to specific GL accounts. The gl_account_code should be replaced with FK to general_ledger_account.general_ledger_account_id to enable joining to account master data including

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Royalty obligations should be allocated to profit centres for segment reporting. Royalties are typically mine-site-specific (profit centre = mine site), and this link allows reporting royalty expense

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Financial royalty obligations originate from specific tenements. Direct link enables reconciliation between contractual royalty agreements and financial liability records, supporting audit trail and e

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Royalty obligations can be project-related and charged to WBS elements. The wbs_element code should be replaced with FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining to project master data.

attributes.name: accrued_liability_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative royalty liability accrued in the current accounting period but not yet paid, as recorded in SAP FI accounts payable. Used for IFRS balance sheet reporting and period-end accrual journals.
attributes.references: IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: aisc_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty obligation is included in the AISC (All-In Sustaining Cost) calculation for the mine site. AISC is a key industry cost metric used in external financial reporting and investor disclosures per ICMM and World Gold Council guidance.
attributes.references: AISC; ICMM; World Gold Council; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: c1_cost_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty obligation is included in the C1 cash cost calculation. C1 is the direct cash cost of production per unit and is a standard industry cost reporting metric used in investor and analyst reporting.
attributes.references: C1 Cash Cost; ICMM; CIM; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The financial basis on which the royalty is calculated. Gross revenue uses total sales value; net revenue deducts allowable costs; FOB (Free on Board) uses the value at the mine gate; CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) includes shipping costs; net smelter return deducts processing costs; net profit is used for profit-based royalties.

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: The mineral commodity to which this royalty obligation applies, such as iron ore, copper, coal, lithium, or nickel. Determines the applicable royalty rate schedule and regulatory reporting category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|silver|zinc|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this royalty obligation record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the royalty obligation is denominated and payable (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Used for SAP FI foreign currency revaluation and IFRS financial reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the nature of any active dispute, audit finding, or legal challenge relating to this royalty obligation. Populated only when dispute_flag is true. Confidential due to legal sensitivity.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty obligation is currently subject to a formal dispute, audit, or legal challenge with the payee or regulatory authority. When true, accruals may require additional provisioning under IFRS.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this royalty obligation becomes legally binding and royalty accruals commence. Aligns with the commencement of mining operations or the execution of the royalty agreement.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this royalty obligation expires or is terminated. Null for open-ended obligations tied to the life of the mine (LOM). Used for LOM financial planning and IFRS decommissioning provisions.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; JORC; SAP S/4HANA FI; LOM Plan

attributes.name: exemption_basis
attributes.description: The legal or regulatory basis for any royalty exemption, such as a state agreement provision, development phase concession, or rehabilitation credit. Populated only when exemption_flag is true.
attributes.references: JORC; State Mining Acts; ICMM; IFRS 6

attributes.name: exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty obligation has been granted a full or partial exemption by the relevant government authority (e.g., during mine development, rehabilitation, or under a state agreement). Affects accrual calculations.

attributes.name: governing_legislation
attributes.description: The specific mining act, regulation, or agreement that establishes the legal basis for this royalty obligation (e.g., Mining Act 1978 WA, Mineral Resources Act 1989 QLD). Critical for regulatory compliance and legal review.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (state, territory, or country) whose mining royalty legislation governs this obligation. Determines the applicable royalty rate schedule, calculation basis, and regulatory reporting requirements. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or state code.
attributes.references: JORC; SEC S-K 1300; CIM; SAMREC; MSHA

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the most recent royalty payment remitted to the payee, in the obligation currency. Used for payment trend analysis and SAP FI accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent royalty payment was made to the payee. Used to verify payment compliance, calculate overdue amounts, and support SAP FI accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: mine_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the mine site or tenement area to which this royalty obligation is attached. Links to the operational mine site for production volume tracking and royalty calculation. Used in SAP CO cost centre allocation.

attributes.name: minimum_royalty_amount
attributes.description: The minimum royalty payable per payment period regardless of production volume or commodity price, as stipulated in the royalty agreement or legislation. Ensures a floor payment to the royalty authority. Expressed in the obligation currency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special conditions, or contextual information relating to this royalty obligation that is not captured in structured fields. Used by finance and legal teams for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: obligation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the royalty obligation, used in SAP FI accounts payable and regulatory correspondence. Follows the format ROY-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IFRS 6 Exploration Accounting

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the royalty obligation. Active indicates payments are currently due; suspended indicates a temporary halt; terminated indicates the obligation has ended; pending indicates awaiting regulatory approval; under_review indicates a dispute or audit is in progress.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity to whom royalties are payable, including government authorities, state mining departments, landowners, or native title holders. Used for SAP FI vendor master alignment and regulatory disclosure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master; ICMM; MSHA

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty payee entity. Government includes federal and state mining authorities; landowner refers to private surface or mineral rights holders; native title refers to indigenous land rights holders; joint_venture refers to JV partner royalty arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_due_day
attributes.description: The day of the month (1–31) by which royalty payments must be received by the payee following the end of the reporting period. Used to calculate payment due dates in SAP FI and manage cash flow planning.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which royalty payments must be remitted to the payee. Drives the SAP FI payment run schedule and cash flow forecasting in the finance domain.

attributes.name: price_reference
attributes.description: The commodity price reference used in ad valorem royalty calculations. LME spot uses the London Metal Exchange spot price; Platts index uses the relevant Platts commodity index; contract price uses the actual sales contract price; realized price uses the actual achieved price; benchmark price uses a government-set reference price.

attributes.name: production_volume_basis
attributes.description: The production measurement basis used to calculate royalties. ROM (Run of Mine) tonnes is the raw ore extracted; dry metric tonnes (DMT) and wet metric tonnes (WMT) are standard shipping measures; contained metal is used for metal-in-concentrate royalties; concentrate tonnes applies to processed product royalties.

attributes.name: rate_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which the royalty rate is subject to review or renegotiation by the relevant authority or as stipulated in the royalty agreement. Critical for financial planning and OPEX forecasting.

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the royalty rate. Percent_revenue applies to ad valorem royalties; per_tonne or per_dmt (dry metric tonne) or per_wmt (wet metric tonne) applies to specific/production-based royalties; percent_profit applies to profit-based royalties.

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: The type of reporting period used for royalty calculation and submission to the relevant authority. Determines the period-end accrual schedule in SAP FI and aligns with regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: JORC; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI; GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: The applicable royalty rate expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.075 for 7.5%). For ad valorem royalties this is a percentage of revenue; for specific royalties this is a rate per unit of production. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: JORC; ICMM; IFRS 6; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: royalty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty obligation by calculation methodology. Ad valorem is based on the value of production, specific is a fixed rate per unit of production, profit-based is derived from net profit, production-based is a flat rate per tonne, and hybrid combines multiple methods.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this royalty obligation record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and SAP FI change log alignment.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI vendor master code for the royalty payee, used to process royalty payments through the accounts payable module. Links the obligation to the payee's payment details in SAP.

products.name: exploration_expenditure
products.description: IFRS 6 exploration and evaluation expenditure record capturing costs incurred during mineral exploration including drilling, geophysical surveys, assaying, and feasibility studies. Tracks capitalisation vs expensing decisions per area of interest, impairment trigger assessments, accumulated expenditure by project area, and reclassification to mine development assets upon technical feasibility and commercial viability determination. Supports area-of-interest accounting policy, IFRS 6 compliance reporting, and ASX continuous disclosure requirements for exploration spend.
products.reference: IFRS 6 Exploration and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: exploration_expenditure_id
attributes.description: Primary key for exploration_expenditure

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: The SAP HR employee identifier of the authorised approver who approved this exploration expenditure for capitalisation or expensing. Supports delegated authority compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module; ICMM Transparency Principles; ASX Corporate Governance Principles

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: IFRS 6 exploration expenditures are tracked by cost centre. The cost_centre_code should be replaced with FK to cost_centre.cost_centre_id to enable joining to cost centre master data and organizationa

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Exploration expenditures post to specific GL accounts with IFRS 6 classification. The gl_account_code should be replaced with FK to general_ledger_account.general_ledger_account_id to enable joining t

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: IFRS 6 exploration expenditure should be allocated to profit centres for segment reporting. Exploration activities are typically organized by geographic region or commodity type, which map to profit c

attributes.name: tenement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tenement.tenement. Business justification: Exploration expenditure must be tracked by tenement for IFRS 6 area-of-interest accounting, capitalization decisions, and impairment testing. Essential for quarterly capitalization review and ensuring

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Exploration projects are tracked via SAP PS WBS elements. The sap_wbs_element code should be replaced with FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enable joining to WBS master data including project hiera

attributes.name: accumulated_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative total of capitalised exploration and evaluation expenditure for this area of interest as at the posting date. Represents the carrying value of the E&E asset on the balance sheet prior to impairment assessment. Critical for IFRS 6 impairment trigger evaluation and JORC resource reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 paragraphs 18-22; AASB 6; ASX Listing Rule 5.8

attributes.name: amount_functional_currency
attributes.description: The exploration expenditure amount translated into the entity's functional currency (typically AUD) using the exchange rate applicable at the transaction date. Used for consolidated IFRS financial reporting and IFRS 6 asset carrying value calculations.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this exploration expenditure was formally approved by the authorised delegate. Required for delegated authority audit trails and period-end capitalisation cut-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ASX Corporate Governance Principles; ICMM

attributes.name: area_of_interest_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the geographic area of interest (AOI) to which this expenditure is attributed. The area of interest is the fundamental unit of account under IFRS 6 for capitalisation and impairment assessment. Aligns with tenement or exploration licence boundaries.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 paragraph 21; JORC Code 2012; ASX Listing Rule 5.8

attributes.name: area_of_interest_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the exploration area of interest (e.g., 'Pilbara North Block', 'Kalgoorlie East Tenement'). Provides human-readable context for financial reporting and ASX continuous disclosure.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ASX Listing Rule 5.8; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: The approved budget amount allocated for this exploration expenditure line or project phase in the functional currency. Used for CAPEX/OPEX budget variance analysis and board-approved exploration programme tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IFRS 6; ASX Listing Rule 5.8

attributes.name: capitalisation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expenditure has been capitalised as an exploration and evaluation (E&E) asset, expensed in the period, is pending accounting review, reclassified to mine development assets upon technical feasibility determination, or written off following impairment. Core IFRS 6 accounting policy field.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction in which the exploration activity was conducted (e.g., AUS, CAN, ZAF). Required for multi-jurisdiction regulatory reporting and IFRS 6 segment disclosure.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IFRS 8; JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this exploration expenditure record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and IFRS 6 period-end reporting cut-off validation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the expenditure amount is denominated (e.g., AUD, USD, CAD). Required for multi-currency consolidation and foreign exchange translation under IAS 21.

attributes.name: expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the exploration expenditure incurred in the transaction currency. This is the primary financial measure for IFRS 6 capitalisation tracking, budget variance analysis, and ASX continuous disclosure of exploration spend.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; ASX Listing Rule 5.8

attributes.name: expenditure_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this exploration expenditure is classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) — to be capitalised as an E&E asset — or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) — to be expensed in the current period. Fundamental to IFRS 6 accounting policy and management reporting.

attributes.name: expenditure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exploration expenditure was incurred or the cost was recognised in the accounting period. Used for period-end accrual cut-off and IFRS 6 capitalisation timing.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: expenditure_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the exploration expenditure, capturing the specific activity, scope, or deliverable (e.g., 'RC drilling programme — 20 holes, 2,400m total, Pilbara North Block'). Supports audit review and ASX continuous disclosure narrative.
attributes.references: IFRS 6; ASX Listing Rule 5.8; JORC Code 2012

attributes.name: expenditure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of exploration expenditure incurred. Determines the appropriate accounting treatment under IFRS 6 and supports granular cost analysis by activity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drilling|geophysical_survey|assaying|geological_mapping|feasibility_study|environmental_study|land_access|administration — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 6 paragraphs 7-9; JORC Code 2012; CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: exploration_stage
attributes.description: The stage of the exploration programme at which this expenditure was incurred, from initial grassroots reconnaissance through to feasibility completion. Determines the likelihood of capitalisation and informs JORC resource classification progression. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grassroots|target_generation|resource_definition|prefeasibility|feasibility|development_ready — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; IFRS 6 paragraph 5; CIM Definition Standards; NI 43-101

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (month number 1–12) within the fiscal year in which this expenditure is recognised. Used for monthly management reporting and period-end close processes in SAP CO.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The financial year in which this exploration expenditure is recognised, expressed as a four-digit integer (e.g., 2024). Aligns with the company's fiscal year calendar as configured in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 1; IFRS 6

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the entity's functional currency into which the transaction currency amount has been translated (e.g., AUD). Supports multi-entity group consolidation under IFRS.

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of any impairment loss recognised against the capitalised exploration and evaluation asset for this area of interest in the functional currency. Recognised in profit or loss per IFRS 6 paragraph 21 when recoverable amount falls below carrying value.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more IFRS 6 impairment indicators are present for this area of interest at the reporting date (e.g., exploration licence expiry, no further exploration planned, resource not commercially viable). Triggers mandatory impairment test under IFRS 6 paragraph 20.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 paragraphs 18-22; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; AASB 6

attributes.name: metres_drilled
attributes.description: The total metres drilled associated with this exploration expenditure record, where the expenditure relates to a drilling programme. Enables cost-per-metre analysis and links financial spend to physical drilling progress reported under JORC.
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; ASX Listing Rule 5.8; CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: mineral_commodity
attributes.description: The primary mineral commodity being targeted by the exploration programme associated with this expenditure (e.g., iron_ore, copper, lithium). Used for commodity-level cost analysis, portfolio management, and segment reporting under IFRS 8. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iron_ore|copper|coal|lithium|nickel|gold|zinc|silver|manganese|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; JORC Code 2012; CIM Definition Standards

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this expenditure was posted to the SAP FI general ledger. May differ from expenditure_date due to accrual adjustments or period-end processing. Used for financial period reconciliation.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Internal project code assigned to the exploration programme under which this expenditure was incurred. Links to the SAP PS project structure and Hexagon MinePlan project hierarchy for integrated cost and schedule tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; Hexagon MinePlan

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP MM or Pronto Xi purchase order number associated with this exploration expenditure. Provides the procurement-to-pay audit trail linking the expenditure to the approved purchase order and goods/services receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Pronto Xi Procurement

attributes.name: reclassification_date
attributes.description: The date on which capitalised exploration and evaluation expenditure was reclassified from E&E assets to mine development assets (or written off) following technical feasibility determination or impairment. Null if reclassification has not occurred.

attributes.name: reporting_standard
attributes.description: The mineral resource reporting standard applicable to this exploration expenditure based on the jurisdiction of the area of interest. Determines the disclosure requirements for resource estimates associated with this spend. Values: JORC (Australia), NI_43-101 (Canada), SAMREC (South Africa), SEC_SK1300 (USA).
attributes.references: JORC Code 2012; NI 43-101; SAMREC Code; SEC S-K 1300

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI document number assigned to this exploration expenditure posting. Serves as the primary cross-reference to the source system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: technical_feasibility_date
attributes.description: The date on which technical feasibility and commercial viability was formally determined for the area of interest, triggering reclassification of E&E assets to mine development assets. Null if technical feasibility has not yet been determined.

attributes.name: technical_feasibility_determined
attributes.description: Indicates whether technical feasibility and commercial viability of extracting the mineral resource has been determined for this area of interest. When True, triggers mandatory reclassification of capitalised E&E assets to mine development assets under IFRS 6 paragraph 17.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this exploration expenditure record was last modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for incremental data processing, change tracking, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: SAP MM vendor master code for the external supplier or contractor who provided the exploration services (e.g., drilling contractor, geophysical survey company, assay laboratory). Links to the SAP vendor master for accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Pronto Xi Procurement

products.name: rehabilitation_provision
products.description: Mine rehabilitation and closure provision master capturing the estimated future cost of mine site rehabilitation, decommissioning, and environmental restoration obligations per mine site. Tracks provision balance, unwinding of discount, revisions to estimates, and actual expenditure drawdowns. Reported under IAS 37 provisions and IFRS financial statements.

attributes.name: rehabilitation_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each mine rehabilitation and closure provision record in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: IAS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.capital_project. Business justification: Closure provisions link to mine development projects for life-of-mine accounting and asset retirement obligation (ARO) tracking. Mining companies establish provisions at project sanction and revise th

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost centre responsible for carrying and managing this rehabilitation provision balance.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI general ledger account under which the rehabilitation provision liability is recorded on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAS 37; IFRS Financial Statements

attributes.name: mine_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site for which this rehabilitation and closure provision is established. Each provision is site-specific.

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Rehabilitation provisions should be allocated to profit centres for segment reporting and balance sheet allocation. Consistent with pattern where all major financial products (journal_entry, cost_allo

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Rehabilitation provisions are often tracked against WBS elements for project-based closure cost accounting. The existing wbs_element_code (STRING) should be replaced with proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_

attributes.name: actual_expenditure_amount
attributes.description: Actual rehabilitation expenditure incurred and drawn down against the provision during the reporting period. Reduces the provision balance and is settled through the SAP FI accounts payable process.
attributes.references: IAS 37 Paragraph 84(c); SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: aisc_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rehabilitation provision charge (unwinding of discount and revisions) is included in the All-In Sustaining Cost (AISC) metric for external commodity cost reporting purposes.
attributes.references: AISC Reporting Standard (World Gold Council); ICMM Reporting Framework

attributes.name: bond_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the regulatory rehabilitation bond instrument. Requires renewal before expiry to maintain regulatory compliance and avoid breach of mining licence conditions.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; State/Territory Mining Acts

attributes.name: bond_instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of financial instrument used to secure the regulatory rehabilitation bond lodged with the government regulator.
attributes.references: ICMM Mine Closure Framework; State/Territory Mining Acts

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: The rehabilitation provision balance at the end of the reporting period after all movements (unwinding of discount, revisions, drawdowns, new provisions) have been applied. Reported on the balance sheet as a non-current liability.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_basis
attributes.description: The methodological basis used to derive the undiscounted rehabilitation cost estimate. Internal_estimate indicates costs prepared by the mine closure team; independent_review indicates a third-party specialist review; regulatory_assessment indicates costs assessed by the environmental regulator; lom_plan_derived indicates costs derived from the Life of Mine (LOM) plan.
attributes.references: IAS 37; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Environmental Impact Statement (EIS)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rehabilitation provision record was first created in the system, providing an audit trail for data governance and IFRS financial reporting integrity.
attributes.references: IAS 37; SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; IFRS Financial Statements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary provision amounts are denominated (e.g., AUD, USD, ZAR). Supports multi-currency operations across international mine sites.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Statements

attributes.name: discount_rate_pct
attributes.description: The pre-tax risk-free discount rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%) applied to discount the undiscounted rehabilitation cost estimate to its present value. Typically based on government bond rates matching the expected closure timeline.

attributes.name: disturbance_area_ha
attributes.description: The total area of land disturbed by mining operations (in hectares) that is subject to rehabilitation obligations. Used as a key driver in estimating per-hectare rehabilitation costs and validating provision adequacy.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Environmental Impact Statement (EIS)

attributes.name: expected_closure_date
attributes.description: The estimated date on which mine operations will cease and full rehabilitation activities are expected to be completed, based on the current Life of Mine (LOM) plan. Drives the discounting period for the provision calculation.
attributes.references: IAS 37; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Life of Mine (LOM) Plan

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this rehabilitation provision record belongs, used for annual financial reporting and IFRS disclosure alignment.
attributes.references: IFRS Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: inflation_rate_pct
attributes.description: The long-term inflation rate assumption (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%) applied to escalate the rehabilitation cost estimate from current-day costs to nominal future costs at the expected closure date.
attributes.references: IAS 37; ICMM Mine Closure Framework; Reserve Bank guidance

attributes.name: last_estimate_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rehabilitation cost estimate was most recently reviewed and updated. IAS 37 requires provisions to be reviewed at each balance sheet date.
attributes.references: IAS 37 Paragraph 59; ICMM Mine Closure Framework

attributes.name: new_provision_amount
attributes.description: Additional provision recognised during the reporting period for new disturbance areas or newly identified rehabilitation obligations at the mine site.
attributes.references: IAS 37 Paragraph 84(b); ICMM Mine Closure Framework

attributes.name: next_estimate_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Cost Estimate Review Date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review of the rehabilitation cost estimate, ensuring compliance with IAS 37 annual review requirements and regulatory bond reassessment cycles.
attributes.references: IAS 37 Paragraph 59; ICMM Mine Closure Framework

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: The rehabilitation provision balance at the start of the reporting period, as carried forward from the prior period closing balance. Used to reconcile provision movements per IAS 37 disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: opex_capex_classification
