attributes.name: risk_threshold_schedule_days
attributes.description: The schedule impact threshold in days above which a risk is escalated to executive management for review and decision.

attributes.name: total_cost_exposure_p50_usd

attributes.name: total_cost_exposure_p80_usd

attributes.name: total_cost_exposure_p90_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Cost Exposure P90 (United States Dollar)

attributes.name: total_risk_count

attributes.name: total_schedule_exposure_p50_days

attributes.name: total_schedule_exposure_p80_days
attributes.description: Total quantified schedule risk exposure at the 80th percentile (P80) in days, used for schedule contingency planning.
attributes.references: PMI Practice Standard for Project Risk Management

attributes.name: total_schedule_exposure_p90_days
attributes.description: Total quantified schedule risk exposure at the 90th percentile (P90) in days, representing a conservative schedule buffer estimate.

products.name: risk_item
products.description: Individual risk or opportunity item within a project risk register. Captures risk ID, risk title, risk category (technical, commercial, geotechnical, regulatory, environmental, HSE, schedule, cost), risk description, likelihood rating, consequence rating, risk score (pre-mitigation and post-mitigation), risk owner, mitigation actions, contingency plan, residual risk status, and last review date. Supports quantitative risk analysis (QRA) and Monte Carlo simulation inputs.

attributes.name: risk_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk or opportunity item within the project risk register. Primary key.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project to which this risk item belongs. Links risk to mine development, plant expansion, or infrastructure project.

attributes.name: primary_risk_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Project risks are vendor-specific (delivery risk, performance risk, financial stability). Business need: risk mitigation planning, vendor performance monitoring, contingency planning for vendor failur

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.risk_register. Business justification: Risk items belong to a risk register. Currently risk_item has risk_register_version (STRING) but no FK to risk_register. This is a clear parent-child relationship - risk items are managed within regis

attributes.name: affected_disciplines
attributes.description: Engineering or functional disciplines impacted by this risk (e.g., civil, mechanical, electrical, process, geotechnical, environmental). Supports cross-functional risk coordination.

attributes.name: affected_wbs_elements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Work Breakdown Structure codes or elements that would be impacted by this risk. Links risk to specific project deliverables or work packages.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the risk was closed. May include risk no longer applicable, risk realized and managed, project phase completed, or risk transferred.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context related to the risk item. May include stakeholder feedback, lessons learned, or special considerations.

attributes.name: consequence_rating_post_mitigation
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the severity of impact if the risk event occurs after mitigation actions have been implemented. Represents residual consequence.

attributes.name: consequence_rating_pre_mitigation
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the severity of impact if the risk event occurs before any mitigation actions are applied. Uses five-point scale from insignificant to catastrophic.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Documented response plan to be executed if the risk event occurs. Outlines specific actions, resources, and responsibilities for managing the realized risk impact.
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, PMI PMBOK Guide

attributes.name: cost_impact_estimate_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost Impact Estimate United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the risk event if it occurs, expressed in US dollars. Used for quantitative risk analysis and contingency budget calculation. Positive value for threats (cost increase), negative value for opportunities (cost savings).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the risk item record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk item was most recently reviewed and assessed. Used to ensure regular risk monitoring and updates.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating_post_mitigation
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the probability that the risk event will occur after mitigation actions have been implemented. Represents residual likelihood.

attributes.name: likelihood_rating_pre_mitigation
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the probability that the risk event will occur before any mitigation actions are applied. Uses five-point scale from rare to almost certain.

attributes.name: mitigation_actions
attributes.description: Detailed description of the actions, controls, or strategies implemented or planned to reduce the likelihood or consequence of the risk. May include preventive measures, detective controls, or corrective actions.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk item. Ensures periodic reassessment of risk status and mitigation effectiveness.

attributes.name: probability_percentage

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk item record is currently active (true) or logically deleted (false). Supports soft delete pattern for data retention.

attributes.name: residual_risk_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the post-mitigation risk level is acceptable to the project. Acceptable indicates risk within tolerance, monitor indicates ongoing surveillance required, escalate indicates senior management attention needed, further action required indicates additional mitigation needed.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the risk type. Categories include technical (engineering, design), commercial (market, pricing), geotechnical (ground conditions, stability), regulatory (permits, compliance), environmental (impact, rehabilitation), HSE (health, safety, environment), schedule (delays, critical path), and cost (budget overruns, CAPEX). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: technical|commercial|geotechnical|regulatory|environmental|hse|schedule|cost — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management, ICMM Risk Management

attributes.name: risk_closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk item was formally closed or retired from active management. Null if risk remains open.

attributes.name: risk_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the risk item for tracking and reference purposes within the risk register.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the risk event, including causes, potential impacts, and context. Provides comprehensive understanding of the risk scenario.

attributes.name: risk_identified_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk item was first identified and entered into the risk register. Tracks risk discovery timeline.

attributes.name: risk_proximity
attributes.description: Timeframe within which the risk event is expected to occur or impact the project. Immediate indicates within current reporting period, near term within 3 months, medium term within 6-12 months, long term beyond 12 months.

attributes.name: risk_response_strategy
attributes.description: Primary strategy selected for managing the risk. For threats: avoid (eliminate), mitigate (reduce), transfer (shift to third party), accept (acknowledge without action). For opportunities: exploit (ensure realization), enhance (increase probability/impact), share (allocate to partner), accept. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: avoid|mitigate|transfer|accept|exploit|enhance|share — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_score_pre_mitigation
attributes.description: Numerical risk score calculated from likelihood and consequence ratings before mitigation. Typically derived from risk matrix (e.g., 1-25 scale). Used for risk prioritization and Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk item. Open indicates newly identified, active indicates under management, mitigated indicates controls implemented, closed indicates risk no longer applicable, accepted indicates risk acknowledged without mitigation, transferred indicates risk passed to third party.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Concise title or name of the risk or opportunity that summarizes the risk event or condition.

attributes.name: risk_trigger_event
attributes.description: Description of the early warning indicator or event that signals the risk is about to occur or has increased in likelihood. Enables proactive risk response activation.

attributes.name: risk_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk item represents a threat (negative impact) or an opportunity (positive impact) to project objectives.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated impact on project schedule if the risk event occurs, measured in calendar days. Positive value indicates delay, negative value indicates acceleration. Used for Monte Carlo schedule simulation.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last updated this risk item record. Supports accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the risk item record was most recently modified. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.name: parent_risk_item_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_item (parent_risk_item_id)

attributes.name: tenement_id

attributes.name: outstanding_punch_items_count

attributes.name: performance_test_date

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date

attributes.name: warranty_period_months

attributes.name: superseded_handover_certificate_id

attributes.name: lesson_description

attributes.name: occurrence_date

domains.name: community
domains.description: Manages stakeholder engagement, community relations, social impact assessments, land compensation agreements, community investment programs, and social licence to operate. Tracks grievance mechanisms, community meetings, and benefit-sharing arrangements.

products.name: stakeholder
products.description: Master register of all community stakeholders engaged by the mining operation, including local communities, indigenous groups, landowners, NGOs, government bodies, and advocacy organisations. Captures stakeholder identity, classification, geographic association, influence level, interest level, engagement status, preferred communication channels, and cultural considerations. Serves as the SSOT for all community-facing parties distinct from commercial counterparties in the customer domain.

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the community stakeholder. Primary key for the stakeholder register.

attributes.name: benefit_sharing_arrangement
attributes.description: Type of benefit-sharing mechanism in place with the stakeholder. May include royalty payments, employment quotas for community members, infrastructure investments, community development funds, or equity participation in mining operations.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for formal communications with the stakeholder organisation or representative.

attributes.name: contact_person_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person or representative for the stakeholder entity. May be a community elder, tribal leader, NGO director, or government official.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for reaching the stakeholder contact person or organisation office.

attributes.name: cultural_considerations
attributes.description: Free-text field documenting important cultural protocols, sensitivities, sacred sites, ceremonial periods, or traditional practices that must be respected during engagement. Critical for indigenous groups and traditional communities.
attributes.references: ILO Convention 169, UN Declaration on Rights of Indigenous Peoples

attributes.name: engagement_frequency_required
attributes.description: Minimum required frequency of formal engagement with the stakeholder based on their influence level, interest level, and regulatory requirements. High-influence indigenous groups may require monthly engagement, while tertiary stakeholders may only need annual updates.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current state of engagement relationship with the stakeholder. Active indicates ongoing engagement, inactive for dormant relationships, pending for newly identified stakeholders awaiting first contact, suspended for temporarily paused engagement, closed for permanently concluded relationships.

attributes.name: fpic_obtained_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) Obtained Date
attributes.description: Date on which Free Prior and Informed Consent was formally obtained from the indigenous stakeholder group. Critical compliance milestone for indigenous engagement.
attributes.references: ILO Convention 169, UN Declaration on Rights of Indigenous Peoples

attributes.name: fpic_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) Status
attributes.description: Status of Free Prior and Informed Consent process for indigenous stakeholders. Not required for non-indigenous stakeholders, pending for identified need, in progress for active consultation, obtained for granted consent, withheld for refused consent.
attributes.references: ILO Convention 169, UN Declaration on Rights of Indigenous Peoples, IFC Performance Standard 7

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Primary geographic location or region where the stakeholder community is based. May include village name, district, province, or traditional land boundaries for indigenous groups.

attributes.name: grievance_mechanism_registered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder has been formally registered in the grievance and complaints management system and informed of their rights to raise concerns.

attributes.name: indigenous_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is an indigenous or aboriginal group with native title or traditional ownership rights. Critical for compliance with indigenous rights frameworks and free prior informed consent protocols.
attributes.references: ILO Convention 169, UN Declaration on Rights of Indigenous Peoples

attributes.name: influence_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the stakeholder's ability to affect project outcomes, regulatory approvals, or social licence to operate. High influence stakeholders can significantly impact operations through regulatory authority, community mobilisation, or media influence.

attributes.name: interest_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the stakeholder's level of concern or interest in mining operations and their outcomes. High interest indicates direct impact on livelihoods, land, or community wellbeing.

attributes.name: land_compensation_agreement_status
attributes.description: Status of land compensation or benefit-sharing agreements with the stakeholder. Not applicable for stakeholders without land claims, in negotiation for active discussions, executed for signed agreements, completed for fully delivered compensation, disputed for contested arrangements.

attributes.name: last_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal engagement activity with the stakeholder, including meetings, consultations, community forums, or site visits.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the stakeholder record was last modified or updated with new information.

attributes.name: media_profile
attributes.description: Assessment of the stakeholder's media presence and ability to influence public opinion. High media profile stakeholders can generate significant press coverage and shape public perception of mining operations.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_engagement_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned engagement activity with the stakeholder. Used for engagement planning and ensuring regular consultation frequency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, historical background, relationship history, or other relevant information about the stakeholder that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: opposition_level
attributes.description: Current stance of the stakeholder toward mining operations. Supportive indicates endorsement, neutral indicates no strong position, concerned indicates reservations but not opposition, opposed indicates disagreement with operations, actively opposed indicates organised resistance or advocacy against the project.

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals represented by this stakeholder entity. For communities, total population count. For organisations, number of members or constituents represented.
attributes.references: GRI Mining and Metals Sector Supplement

attributes.name: postal_address
attributes.description: Full postal address for written correspondence with the stakeholder entity or representative.

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: Stakeholder's preferred method for receiving communications and engagement. In-person meetings and community forums are common for indigenous and local communities, while email and phone may be preferred by NGOs and government bodies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: in_person_meeting|community_forum|phone|email|letter|radio|sms — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: Primary language spoken by the stakeholder community or organisation. Critical for culturally appropriate communication and translation requirements.

attributes.name: proximity_to_operations_km
attributes.description: Distance in kilometers from the stakeholder's primary location to the nearest mine site boundary. Used to assess direct impact zones and prioritise engagement intensity.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the stakeholder was first identified and registered in the stakeholder management system.

attributes.name: social_investment_recipient
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder is a recipient of community investment programs such as education, health, infrastructure, or livelihood support initiatives funded by the mining operation.

attributes.name: social_licence_risk_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Licence to Operate (SLO) Risk Rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the risk this stakeholder poses to the mining operation's social licence to operate. Critical rating indicates stakeholder opposition could halt operations, high indicates significant project delays possible, medium indicates manageable concerns, low indicates supportive or neutral stance.
attributes.references: ICMM Social Licence to Operate Framework

attributes.name: stakeholder_category
attributes.description: Hierarchical classification based on proximity to operations and impact level. Primary stakeholders are directly affected by mining activities, secondary are indirectly affected, key stakeholders have significant influence, tertiary have minimal direct impact.

attributes.name: stakeholder_name
attributes.description: Full legal or registered name of the stakeholder entity or individual. For indigenous groups, traditional community names. For NGOs and government bodies, official registered name.

attributes.name: stakeholder_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the stakeholder entity. Distinguishes between local communities, indigenous groups, individual landowners, non-governmental organisations, government bodies, and advocacy organisations.

attributes.name: traditional_owner_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stakeholder holds traditional ownership or native title rights over land affected by mining operations. Used to identify parties requiring specific consultation and consent protocols.

attributes.name: parent_stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on stakeholder (parent_stakeholder_id)

products.name: stakeholder_contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with a stakeholder organisation or community group. Captures contact name, role/title, organisation affiliation, contact details, language preference, cultural protocols, engagement history summary, and authorisation level for agreements. Supports targeted engagement and relationship management at the individual level.

attributes.name: stakeholder_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stakeholder contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: stakeholder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent stakeholder organisation or community group this contact person is affiliated with.

attributes.name: agreement_signatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person is authorised to sign formal agreements, compensation arrangements, or benefit-sharing contracts on behalf of their organisation.

attributes.name: authorisation_level
attributes.description: Level of authority this contact person holds for signing agreements, making decisions, or representing their organisation in formal negotiations.

attributes.name: compensation_recipient_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person is a recipient of land compensation, resettlement payments, or other financial benefits from the mining operation.
attributes.references: IFC Performance Standard 5, World Bank ESS5

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact person provided consent to be contacted and have their information stored in the stakeholder engagement system.

attributes.name: consent_to_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact person has provided explicit consent to be contacted for engagement purposes. Ensures compliance with privacy and data protection regulations.

attributes.name: contact_family_name
attributes.description: Family name (surname) of the contact person.

attributes.name: contact_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual contact person representing the stakeholder organisation or community group.

attributes.name: contact_given_name
attributes.description: Given name (first name) of the contact person.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current status of the contact person in the stakeholder engagement system. Tracks whether the contact is actively engaged or no longer available.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact person based on their role in stakeholder engagement (e.g., primary liaison, secondary contact, emergency contact, technical advisor, legal representative).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stakeholder contact record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cultural_protocol_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting cultural protocols, customs, or sensitivities to observe when engaging with this contact person (e.g., gender-specific engagement requirements, ceremonial considerations, appropriate meeting times).
attributes.references: ICMM Indigenous Peoples and Mining Position Statement, IFC Performance Standard 7

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contact record is scheduled for review or deletion in accordance with data retention policies and privacy regulations.

attributes.name: employment_status_with_company
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact person is currently or was previously employed by the mining company, or is a contractor. Used to identify potential conflicts of interest or dual relationships.

attributes.name: engagement_history_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of past engagement activities, meetings, and interactions with this contact person. Provides context for relationship continuity.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the contact person. Captured to support culturally appropriate engagement practices and gender-sensitive consultation requirements.
attributes.references: IFC Performance Standard 7, ICMM Indigenous Peoples and Mining Position Statement

attributes.name: grievance_lodged_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact person has lodged a formal grievance or complaint through the grievance mechanism. Used to flag sensitive relationships requiring careful management.
attributes.references: IFC Performance Standard 1, ICMM Community Development Toolkit

attributes.name: indigenous_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact person identifies as a member of an indigenous or traditional community. Used to ensure compliance with Free Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) requirements.
attributes.references: IFC Performance Standard 7, UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP)

attributes.name: influence_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the contact person's level of influence within their community or organisation. Used for stakeholder prioritisation and engagement planning.

attributes.name: interpreter_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an interpreter or translator is required for effective communication with this contact person.
attributes.references: ICMM Indigenous Peoples and Mining Position Statement

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent engagement activity or communication with this contact person. Used to track relationship currency and identify contacts requiring re-engagement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stakeholder contact record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile telephone number for the contact person, used for urgent or field-based communication.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned engagement activity or meeting with this contact person. Supports proactive relationship management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about the contact person that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: office_phone
attributes.description: Office or business telephone number for the contact person.

attributes.name: postal_address
attributes.description: Full postal mailing address for the contact person, used for formal correspondence and document delivery.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Preferred method of communication for this contact person (e.g., email, phone, in-person meetings, postal mail).

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Preferred language for communication with this contact person. Uses ISO 639-1 two-letter language codes (e.g., EN, FR, ES) or full language names for indigenous languages.

products.name: stakeholder_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the formal engagement relationship between mine employees and community stakeholders. It captures which employees are designated to engage with which stakeholders, in what capacity, and over what time period. Each record links one employee to one stakeholder with attributes that define the nature, timing, and status of that engagement relationship.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, community stakeholder engagement is a formal, managed business process where multiple employees engage with each stakeholder in different capacities (e.g., site manager as executive sponsor, community relations officer as primary contact, environmental manager as technical liaison), and each employee engages with multiple stakeholders across different communities and interest groups. The business actively manages these engagement relationships with designated roles, time periods, and primary contact designations to ensure continuity, cultural protocol compliance, and accountability in community relations.

products.name: stakeholder_consultation
products.description: This association product represents the formal consultation and engagement process between a Life of Mine plan and community stakeholders. It captures the regulatory and social licence requirements for stakeholder engagement during mine planning, including consultation dates, consent status, agreement references, and notification methods. Each record links one LOM plan to one stakeholder with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific consultation relationship.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, Life of Mine plans require formal consultation with multiple stakeholder groups (traditional owners, local communities, government bodies, NGOs) to obtain social licence and meet regulatory requirements. Each LOM plan must engage with multiple stakeholders across different phases (feasibility, approval, operation, closure), and each stakeholder participates in consultations for multiple mine plans over time (expansions, amendments, closures). The business actively manages this as a 'Stakeholder Consultation Register' tracking consultation dates, consent status, agreement references, and engagement phases.

attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being procured. Provides human-readable context for the line item on purchase order documents and reports.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: The specific warehouse, stockyard, or storage area within the plant where the material will be received and stored. Used for inventory management and goods receipt posting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the applicable tax rate and tax jurisdiction for this line item. Used for Goods and Services Tax (GST), Value Added Tax (VAT), or sales tax calculation.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: The acceptable percentage by which the vendor may under-deliver below the ordered quantity without requiring approval. Used for goods receipt tolerance checking and automatic PO closure.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Examples include tonnes (T), kilograms (KG), litres (L), metres (M), each (EA), hours (HR) for services.

products.name: procurement_goods_receipt
products.description: Records the physical receipt of materials at a mine site warehouse or ROM pad against a purchase order or inbound delivery. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO/MSEG). Captures GR document number, posting date, delivery note reference, plant, storage location, material, quantity received, unit of measure, batch number, movement type, and quality inspection flag. Triggers inventory update and three-way match for invoice verification.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO - Movement Type 101)

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Primary key for goods_receipt

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Duplicate goods_receipt product requires same cost centre linkage for actual spend tracking, inventory valuation, and AISC calculation. Core to mining cost accounting.

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.delivery_schedule. Business justification: Goods receipt fulfills a delivery schedule line (call-off against blanket PO or schedule agreement). N:1 relationship (many GRs can fulfill one schedule line if partial receipts). Enables tracking of

attributes.name: inbound_delivery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.inbound_delivery. Business justification: Goods receipt records warehouse acceptance of materials from an inbound delivery. One inbound delivery can result in multiple goods receipts if received in batches. N:1 relationship (many GRs per deli

attributes.name: laboratory_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.laboratory_sample. Business justification: Incoming materials (reagents, fuels, consumables) sampled at goods receipt for quality verification before acceptance. Links GR to laboratory QC sample and results. Real process: GR→sample→assay→relea

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mine site, processing plant, or facility where goods are received. Identifies the receiving location at the organizational level.

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this goods receipt is posted. Links the goods receipt to the originating procurement document.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier who delivered the materials. Identifies the counterparty in the goods receipt transaction.

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific purchase order line item for which goods are being received. Enables three-way match validation (PO-GR-Invoice).

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the material or equipment being received. Links to the material catalog.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific warehouse, ROM (Run of Mine) pad, or storage area within the plant where materials are physically stored after receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master (T001L)

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital GRs post to WBS for asset under construction tracking, capex reporting, and project cost control. Essential for capital project accounting in mining.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned to the received materials for traceability and quality control. Critical for tracking ore batches, chemical reagents, and spare parts through the supply chain.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: The shipping document number issued by the carrier for the transported goods. Critical for FOB (Free on Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) shipments in mining commodity trading.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the certificate of analysis provided by the vendor or generated by the laboratory. Documents quality specifications and test results for the received material.
attributes.references: LabWare LIMS - Laboratory Information Management System

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the goods receipt document in the ERP system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the goods receipt record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and processing time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the external delivery note or packing slip provided by the vendor. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the goods receipt transaction. Posted indicates successful inventory update; reversed indicates cancellation; pending inspection indicates awaiting quality clearance; completed indicates full processing including invoice verification.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this goods receipt transaction in the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system. Used for audit trail and three-way match in invoice verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document Number (MSEG-MBLNR)

attributes.name: gr_document_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the goods receipt document was posted. Used in combination with document number for unique identification in SAP systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document Year (MSEG-MJAHR)

attributes.name: gr_line_item_number
attributes.description: The line item sequence number within the goods receipt document. Identifies individual material lines when multiple items are received in a single transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Document Line (MSEG-ZEILE)

attributes.name: gross_weight
attributes.description: The total weight of the received shipment including packaging and containers. Used for freight reconciliation and logistics tracking.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the quality inspection lot created for this goods receipt. Links to laboratory sample management and assay results in LIMS.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the goods receipt document. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the goods receipt record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the document.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the material document. Identifies individual material movements within a single goods receipt document.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The unique material document number generated by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Pronto Xi) upon posting the goods receipt. This is the business identifier for the goods receipt transaction.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Used in combination with material document number for unique identification in SAP systems.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the goods receipt record was last updated. Tracks changes to quantity, status, or other fields after initial creation.

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: A single-character code indicating the direction of the goods movement (e.g., B for goods receipt, H for reversal). Used for system processing logic.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the type of goods receipt transaction (e.g., 101 for GR against PO, 501 for transfer posting). Determines how inventory and financial accounts are updated.

attributes.name: net_weight
attributes.description: The weight of the received materials excluding packaging and containers. Used for inventory valuation and yield calculations in mineral processing.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory in the financial and materials management system. This is the official accounting date for inventory valuation and triggers the three-way match process.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received materials must undergo quality inspection before being released for unrestricted use. When true, materials are placed in quality inspection stock pending LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) assay results.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity originally ordered on the purchase order line. Used to calculate delivery variance and over/under delivery tolerance.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: The physical quantity of material received and accepted at the storage location. This quantity updates inventory levels and is used in the three-way match against purchase order quantity and invoice quantity.

attributes.name: receipt_condition
attributes.description: Condition assessment of the goods upon physical receipt. Indicates whether materials were received in acceptable condition or if there were issues such as damage or quantity discrepancies.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the physical goods were received at the mine site, warehouse, or processing plant. Used for delivery performance tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_person_name
attributes.description: The name of the warehouse or stores personnel who physically accepted and verified the delivered goods. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or comments about the goods receipt transaction. May include observations about packaging condition, delivery delays, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this goods receipt has been cancelled. Links to the offsetting material document.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed or cancelled. When true, the inventory movement has been negated and the original transaction is no longer valid.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The coded reason for reversing the goods receipt (e.g., damaged goods, quantity discrepancy, wrong material delivered). Used for root cause analysis and vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized equipment or high-value assets. Enables individual asset tracking and lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Serial Number Management

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The inventory status category of the received goods. Unrestricted stock is available for use; quality inspection stock awaits testing; blocked stock cannot be used; restricted stock has limited usage.

attributes.name: tare_weight
attributes.description: The weight of packaging, containers, or transport equipment. Calculated as gross weight minus net weight.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the received quantity is measured (e.g., TON for tonnes, KG for kilograms, EA for each, M3 for cubic meters). Must align with material master and purchase order UOM.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific physical location or dock where the delivery vehicle was unloaded (e.g., Dock 3, ROM Pad A, Reagent Bay 2). Used for logistics planning and congestion management.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Total value of the goods receipt in the local currency. Used for inventory valuation and financial accounting. Calculated as quantity received multiplied by material price.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: The valuation category for split-valuation scenarios where the same material is valued differently based on procurement source or quality grade (e.g., domestic vs. imported ore).

attributes.name: vendor_batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number assigned by the vendor to the delivered materials. Used for traceability back to the suppliers production records and quality certificates.

attributes.name: weight_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which weights are measured (e.g., TON for tonnes, KG for kilograms, LB for pounds). Must be consistent across gross, net, and tare weights.

products.name: goods_issue
products.description: Unified material movement ledger recording all stock movements out of, between, and within warehouse locations across the mining operation. Covers consumption issues to cost centres and work orders (SAP movement type 201/261), inter-plant and inter-site stock transfers (movement type 301/311), stock transport orders between mine sites, scrapping, and returns. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIGO/MSEG). Captures document number, posting date, movement type, issuing plant, storage location, receiving plant/storage location (for transfers), receiving cost centre or work order (for consumption), material, quantity, unit of measure, transfer order number, transport reference, and movement status. Serves as the SSOT for all material movements within and between mine sites — no other product in this domain records material movements.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Issue (MIGO - Movement Type 201)

attributes.name: goods_issue_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods issue transaction. Primary key for the goods issue record.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Material consumption posts to cost centres for production cost tracking, AISC calculation, and budget variance analysis. Fundamental to mining operations cost accounting.

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Stock transport orders are a type of purchase order in SAP used for inter-plant transfers. Goods issue can be executed against STO. N:1 relationship (many goods issues against one STO). Converting STR

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Goods issue records movement of a specific material. N:1 relationship (many goods issues for one material). Converting STRING material_number to FK enables proper material master linkage. Material det

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Goods issue originates from a warehouse storage location. N:1 relationship (many goods issues from one location). Converting STRING storage_location_code to FK enables proper inventory location tracki

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital project material issues post to WBS for project cost tracking and asset capitalization. Required for accurate capital project accounting.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for batch-managed materials. Enables traceability of specific production runs or procurement lots.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created the material document. Provides audit trail for transaction origination.

attributes.name: delivery_number
attributes.description: Outbound delivery document number for stock transport orders. Links the goods issue to the logistics execution document.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the physical document or the date the transaction was initiated. May differ from posting date.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the material document was created in the system. Represents when the record was first captured.

attributes.name: entry_time
attributes.description: Time when the material document was created in the system (HH:MM:SS format).

attributes.name: goods_recipient
attributes.description: Name of the person or organizational unit receiving the material. Used for accountability and tracking.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered at the material document header level. Provides additional context for the transaction.

attributes.name: material_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the material document. Represents the sequence of individual material movements within a single document.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number (MBLNR) that uniquely identifies the goods movement transaction in the source system. This is the externally-known business identifier for the goods issue.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Part of the compound key in SAP along with material document number.

attributes.name: movement_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character indicator that further classifies the movement (e.g., B for goods movement for purchase order, F for production order, L for delivery).

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods issue transaction. Indicates whether the movement has been successfully posted, reversed, or is pending.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Custom Status Field

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods movement. Common values include 201 (goods issue to cost center), 261 (goods issue to work order/production order), 301 (plant-to-plant transfer), 311 (storage location to storage location transfer), 551 (scrapping from storage location), 202/262 (reversal of 201/261).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Movement Type Configuration

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the mine site or plant from which the material was issued. Represents the source location for the goods movement.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the goods issue was posted to inventory and financial accounting. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material issued in the base unit of measure. Positive values represent outbound movements; negative values represent reversals.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the goods issue (e.g., planned maintenance, breakdown repair, operational consumption, scrapping due to damage).

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the destination mine site or plant for inter-plant transfers (movement type 301). Null for consumption issues.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the destination storage location for inter-storage-location transfers (movement type 311). Null for consumption issues.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (e.g., delivery note, packing slip, transfer note) associated with the goods issue.

attributes.name: reservation_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the reservation document.

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Material reservation number that pre-allocated the stock for this issue. Links the goods issue to the planning document.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this goods issue has been reversed (true) or is an active transaction (false).

attributes.name: reversal_movement_type
attributes.description: Movement type used for the reversal transaction (e.g., 202 reverses 201, 262 reverses 261). Populated only if the transaction has been reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Movement Type Configuration

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating special stock categories (e.g., E for sales order stock, Q for project stock, K for consignment stock).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the issued quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilograms, L for liters, M for meters, TON for tonnes).

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: Physical location or area within the receiving site where the material is delivered (e.g., workshop bay, crusher station, ROM pad).

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Split valuation type for materials managed with multiple stock types (e.g., own stock vs consignment stock).

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Maintenance or production work order number to which the material is issued for movement type 261. Links material consumption to specific maintenance activities or production runs.

products.name: inventory_balance
products.description: Current and historical stock balance for each material at each storage location and plant, incorporating physical count records, cycle count results, and reconciliation outcomes. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MARD/MCHB/MI01/MI07). Captures material, plant, storage location, batch, unrestricted stock, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, in-transit stock, reorder point, safety stock, maximum stock level. Also records all physical inventory counts including count document number, count date, system quantity, counted quantity, variance quantity, variance value, recount flag, posting status, count cycle assignment, and count frequency category. Serves as the SSOT for real-time inventory visibility, physical count audit trail, stock accuracy KPI reporting, and cycle count compliance — no other product in this domain records stock balances or physical counts.

attributes.name: inventory_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory balance record.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the plant where the material is stored.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material being tracked in inventory.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location within the plant where the material is physically stored.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for batch-managed materials, enabling traceability of material origin and processing history.

attributes.name: blocked_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material blocked from use due to quality issues, damage, or other restrictions.

attributes.name: count_cycle_code
attributes.description: Cycle count assignment code indicating the frequency category for this material and location.

attributes.name: count_frequency_category
attributes.description: Classification of count frequency based on material criticality and ABC analysis, determining how often physical counts are performed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|abc_a|abc_b|abc_c — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity counted during the physical inventory count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory balance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the stock value. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|AUD|CAD|CNY|JPY|ZAR|BRL|CLP — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: in_transit_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently in transit between storage locations or plants.

attributes.name: last_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent physical inventory count was performed for this material and location.

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock at this location.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock at this location.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory balance record was last modified.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material, typically the SAP material number or internal SKU.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material for business user identification.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum allowable stock level for the material at this location to prevent overstocking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: physical_inventory_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the most recent physical inventory count for this material and location.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Status of the physical inventory count posting to the general ledger and material ledger.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material currently under quality inspection and not yet released for use.

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount was required due to significant variance or count discrepancy.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum stock level that triggers a replenishment order to prevent stockouts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master MRP View

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory balance snapshot was captured, enabling historical trend analysis.

attributes.name: stock_accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Calculated stock accuracy percentage for this material and location, used for inventory KPI reporting.

attributes.name: stock_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the stock based on availability and business rules.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location within the plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: system_quantity_at_count
attributes.description: System-recorded quantity at the time of the physical inventory count, used for variance calculation.

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all stock at this location, calculated using standard cost or moving average price.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the stock quantities, such as kilograms, metric tons, liters, or pieces. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|TON|L|M3|EA|PC|M|FT|GAL|LB — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unrestricted_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material available for unrestricted use and consumption in operations.

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Method used to value the inventory, such as standard cost, moving average price, FIFO, or LIFO.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Difference between system quantity and counted quantity, calculated as counted minus system quantity.

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: Monetary value of the variance between system and counted quantities.

products.name: stock_transfer
products.description: Records the movement of materials between plants, storage locations, or mine sites within the same organisation (e.g., transferring spare parts from central warehouse to a remote mine site). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order (STO). Captures transfer order number, sending plant, receiving plant, sending storage location, receiving storage location, material, quantity, transfer date, transport reference, and status.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Transfer Order (STO / ME27)

attributes.name: stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock transfer record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the cost centre that will bear the cost of the stock transfer, if applicable. Used for internal cost allocation and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre Accounting

attributes.name: primary_stock_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific storage location within the sending plant from which the material is being issued (e.g., central warehouse, maintenance stores, ROM pad).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: receiving_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the plant or site to which the material is being delivered. Links to the plant/site master data.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific storage location within the receiving plant where the material will be received and stored (e.g., remote site stores, maintenance workshop, processing plant warehouse).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: sending_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the plant or site from which the material is being dispatched. Links to the plant/site master data.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record being transferred. Links to the material product in the procurement or inventory domain.

attributes.name: actual_receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the material was physically received and goods receipt was posted at the receiving storage location. Null if not yet received.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the material being transferred, if batch management is active for the material. Critical for traceability of consumables, chemicals, explosives, and quality-controlled items.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the logistics carrier, freight company, or internal fleet responsible for transporting the material between locations (e.g., 'Internal Fleet', 'ABC Logistics', 'Mine Haul Trucks').

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or employee identifier of the person who created the stock transfer order in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the stock transfer order record was first created in SAP S/4HANA MM. Audit trail timestamp for record creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD, ZAR). Reflects the company code currency or plant-specific valuation currency.

attributes.name: goods_issue_posted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the goods issue (dispatch) has been posted in SAP MM, reducing inventory at the sending location. True if posted, False if not yet posted.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_posted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the goods receipt has been posted in SAP MM, increasing inventory at the receiving location. True if posted, False if not yet received.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified the stock transfer order. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the stock transfer order record was last updated in SAP S/4HANA MM. Audit trail timestamp for record modification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material being transferred, providing human-readable identification of the item (e.g., 'Hydraulic Pump Assembly', 'Grinding Media Balls 50mm', 'PPE Safety Helmet').

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP MM movement type code (3-digit numeric) that classifies the inventory transaction (e.g., 301 for transfer posting plant to plant, 311 for transfer posting storage location to storage location).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Movement Type Configuration

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The urgency level assigned to the stock transfer order, influencing logistics scheduling and dispatch sequencing. Critical transfers support emergency breakdowns or safety-critical operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Optional code indicating the business reason for the stock transfer (e.g., 'MAINT' for maintenance requirement, 'PROJ' for project demand, 'REBAL' for inventory rebalancing, 'EMERG' for emergency supply).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_code
attributes.description: The SAP storage location code (4-character alphanumeric) within the receiving plant identifying the specific warehouse, bin, or stockpile area where material will be placed upon receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the receiving plant or site requires the material to arrive. Used for planning and logistics scheduling to ensure operational continuity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transfer Order

attributes.name: sending_storage_location_code
attributes.description: The SAP storage location code (4-character alphanumeric) within the sending plant identifying the specific warehouse, bin, or stockpile area from which material is dispatched.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the material item being transferred, if serial number management is active. Used for high-value equipment components, critical spare parts, and serialized assets.

products.name: port_stockpile
products.description: Tracks the inventory balance, quality parameters, and complete tonnage movement history of commodity product held at port stockpile facilities awaiting vessel loading. Captures stockpile ID, port facility, commodity product grade, stockpile type (lump, fines, concentrate), current tonnage, quality parameters (Fe%, moisture, size fraction, Al2O3, SiO2, P), blending instructions, min/max tonnage thresholds, last survey date, and stockpile status. Records all individual movements (stack-in, reclaim, blend, vessel loading) with movement ID, movement type, tonnage, quality at movement, timestamp, equipment used (stacker/reclaimer), operator, source/destination stockpile (for blends), and reference shipment or train number. Serves as the SSOT for port inventory management, stockpile reconciliation, all movement history, and vessel loading planning — no other product in this domain records stockpile movements.

attributes.name: laboratory_sample_id

attributes.name: outbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the vessel shipment record if this movement is part of a vessel loading operation. Nullable for non-loading movements.

attributes.name: primary_port_stockpile_id

attributes.name: shift_report_id

attributes.name: source_stockpile_port_stockpile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the source stockpile for blend or transfer movements. Nullable for stack-in movements from external sources.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the material type being moved (iron ore, copper concentrate, coal, etc.).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or observations recorded by the operator or supervisor during the movement operation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stockpile movement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of delays in minutes for this movement operation, used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation.

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Description of any delays or interruptions encountered during the movement operation, used for root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: fines_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of fine-sized material (typically -6mm) in the stockpile movement, important for product specification compliance.

attributes.name: grade_al2o3_percent
attributes.description: Alumina content percentage of the material at the time of movement, important quality parameter for mineral processing.

attributes.name: grade_fe_percent
attributes.description: Iron content percentage of the material at the time of movement, critical quality parameter for iron ore products.

attributes.name: grade_p_percent

attributes.name: grade_sio2_percent
