attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stockpile movement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lump_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of lump-sized material (typically +6mm) in the stockpile movement, important for product specification compliance.

attributes.name: moisture_percent
attributes.description: Moisture content percentage of the material at the time of movement, affects tonnage calculations and shipping specifications.

attributes.name: movement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stockpile movement operation was completed.

attributes.name: movement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the stockpile movement transaction, used for tracking and reconciliation across systems.

attributes.name: movement_priority
attributes.description: Operational priority level assigned to this movement, used for scheduling and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: movement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stockpile movement operation commenced.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stockpile movement transaction in the operational workflow.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stockpile movement operation was executed or completed in the physical operation.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stockpile movement operation: stack_in (material added to stockpile), reclaim (material removed from stockpile), blend (material transferred for blending), vessel_load (material loaded onto ship), rail_discharge (material received from rail), truck_discharge (material received from truck).

attributes.name: planned_tonnage
attributes.description: Target mass of material planned to be moved in this transaction, measured in metric tonnes. Used for variance analysis against actual tonnage.

attributes.name: tonnage
attributes.description: Total mass of material moved in this transaction, measured in metric tonnes. Critical for stockpile balance reconciliation and inventory management.

attributes.name: train_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the rail train if this movement involves rail discharge to stockpile. Nullable for non-rail movements.

attributes.name: truck_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the haulage truck if this movement involves truck discharge to stockpile. Nullable for non-truck movements.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the vessel being loaded if this movement is a vessel loading operation. Nullable for non-vessel movements.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions during the movement operation, relevant for operational efficiency analysis and safety compliance.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the work order or production order authorizing this stockpile movement operation.

products.name: procurement_vendor_performance
products.description: Tracks and records periodic vendor performance evaluations against key supply metrics for vendors delivering to mining operations. Captures evaluation period, vendor, overall score, delivery score (on-time delivery rate, order fill rate), quality score (rejection rate, NCR count), price score (price variance to contract), service score (responsiveness, issue resolution time), number of POs evaluated, number of rejections, and evaluator. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61). Distinct from procurement domain's strategic supplier evaluation — this product focuses on operational delivery performance metrics measured against actual goods receipts and PO fulfilment. Supports vendor rationalisation, preferred supplier decisions, and supply risk management.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vendor_performance

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master record in SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor performance evaluation was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the manager or executive who approved the vendor performance evaluation and its recommendations.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor performance evaluation was approved.

attributes.name: average_issue_resolution_time_days
attributes.description: The average number of days taken by the vendor to resolve reported issues, complaints, or non-conformances during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: The commodity or material category for which the vendor is being evaluated (e.g., explosives, drilling consumables, steel, fuel, PPE). Aligns with SAP material group classification.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions required from the vendor, including specific performance gaps and expected improvements.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required from the vendor to address performance deficiencies identified during the evaluation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total procurement value (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: delivery_performance_score
attributes.description: The score measuring the vendor's delivery performance, including on-time delivery rate and order fulfillment metrics.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date when the vendor performance evaluation was formally conducted and recorded.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from the evaluator providing additional context, observations, or recommendations regarding the vendor's performance.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the conclusion of the assessment window for vendor KPIs.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the performance evaluation period. Defines the beginning of the assessment window for vendor KPIs.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the vendor performance evaluation record. Tracks the evaluation through draft, approval, and closure stages.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement or category manager who conducted the vendor performance evaluation.

attributes.name: evaluator_role
attributes.description: Job role or title of the person who conducted the evaluation (e.g., Procurement Manager, Category Manager, Supply Chain Lead).

attributes.name: hse_incident_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count
attributes.description: Total number of health, safety, and environmental incidents attributed to the vendor during the evaluation period. Sourced from IsoMetrix HSE incident management system.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety, IsoMetrix HSE

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor invoices that matched purchase orders and goods receipts without discrepancies (three-way match success rate). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI invoice verification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor performance evaluation record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: ncr_count
attributes.description: The total number of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) raised against the vendor during the evaluation period for quality issues.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next vendor performance evaluation. Supports periodic review cycles (e.g., quarterly, semi-annual, annual).

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the scheduled delivery date during the evaluation period. Key delivery performance KPI.

attributes.name: order_fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of purchase order line items completely fulfilled by the vendor without shortages or backorders during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: overall_performance_rating
attributes.description: Composite performance rating summarizing the vendor's overall performance across all evaluation dimensions. Used for contract renewal and preferred supplier decisions.

attributes.name: overall_performance_score
attributes.description: The composite overall performance score for the vendor across all evaluation dimensions, typically expressed as a percentage or weighted average.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: The overall performance rating classification assigned to the vendor based on the evaluation results, used for vendor rationalization and preferred supplier decisions.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has been designated as a preferred supplier based on this performance evaluation. Preferred vendors receive priority in sourcing decisions.

attributes.name: price_performance_score
attributes.description: The score measuring the vendor's price competitiveness and adherence to contracted pricing.

attributes.name: price_variance_percent
attributes.description: The percentage variance between actual invoiced prices and contracted prices during the evaluation period. Positive values indicate overcharges, negative values indicate discounts.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of goods receipts that passed quality inspection without rejection or non-conformance during the evaluation period. Calculated from LabWare LIMS and SAP quality inspection data.

attributes.name: quality_performance_score
attributes.description: The score measuring the vendor's quality performance, including rejection rates and non-conformance records.

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Total number of goods receipts rejected due to quality non-conformance during the evaluation period. Used to calculate quality acceptance rate.

attributes.name: rejection_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of goods receipts rejected due to quality defects or non-conformance during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: responsiveness_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the vendor's responsiveness to inquiries, requests, and communications during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Qualitative score (0-100) assessing the vendor's responsiveness to inquiries, issue resolution, and communication timeliness. Evaluated by procurement and operational teams.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The supply risk level assigned to the vendor based on performance evaluation results, used for supply risk management and mitigation planning.

attributes.name: service_performance_score
attributes.description: The score measuring the vendor's service quality, including responsiveness and issue resolution capabilities.

attributes.name: total_goods_receipt_count
attributes.description: Total number of goods receipts processed for the vendor during the evaluation period. Used to calculate delivery and quality metrics.

attributes.name: total_po_count
attributes.description: The total number of purchase orders issued to the vendor during the evaluation period that were included in this performance assessment.

attributes.name: total_po_line_count
attributes.description: The total number of purchase order line items issued to the vendor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: total_procurement_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all procurement transactions with the vendor during the evaluation period. Represents the vendor's business volume.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Value

attributes.name: total_purchase_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to the vendor during the evaluation period. Provides context for performance metrics.

attributes.name: total_rejection_count
attributes.description: The total number of goods receipts rejected due to quality defects or non-conformance during the evaluation period.

products.name: requisition
products.description: Internal purchase requisition raised by mine site departments or generated automatically by MRP run, requesting procurement of materials or services. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (EBAN). Captures requisition number, requesting cost centre, plant, material or service description, quantity, required delivery date, estimated value, priority (urgent/normal), approval workflow status, approver chain, and conversion status to purchase order. Serves as the SSOT for procurement demand signals. Initiates the formal procurement workflow and provides input to supply planning and material plan execution.

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Requisitions originate from cost centres for budget control, approval workflow, and commitment tracking. Essential for procurement budget management in mining.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Requisitions specify GL account for budget checking, commitment tracking, and cost element classification. Required for financial control and reporting.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Requisition may reference a framework contract for pricing and terms. Converting STRING contract_number to FK enables proper contract governance and pricing lookup. N:1 relationship (many requisitions

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the preferred or assigned vendor for this requisition. Populated when a source of supply is pre-determined or suggested by the requisitioner.

attributes.name: requisitioner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Requisitions are raised by employees. Tracking who requested materials is essential for approval workflows, cost centre validation, budget accountability, and audit trails. Currently stored as text na

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record for stock materials. Null for service requisitions or non-stock materials.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital requisitions link to WBS for project budget control, approval workflow, and commitment reporting. Critical for capital project procurement management.

attributes.name: account_assignment_category
attributes.description: Classification of how the requisition expenditure is assigned for financial accounting purposes. Determines whether costs are tracked against cost centres, capital projects, assets, or sales orders.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition received final approval and became eligible for conversion to purchase order. Null if still pending approval or rejected.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the multi-level approval workflow. Requisitions above certain value thresholds require manager, department head, and executive approvals.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the current or final approver in the approval chain. Identifies the person responsible for authorizing the procurement expenditure.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Twelve-digit fixed asset number when the requisition is for asset procurement or asset-related maintenance. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation.

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the requisition has been converted to a purchase order. Tracks the progression from demand signal to formal procurement commitment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the requisition record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated value. Typically AUD for Australian mining operations, USD for international procurement.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating the requisition line has been marked for deletion. Soft delete mechanism preserving audit trail while excluding from active procurement workflows.

attributes.name: estimated_value
attributes.description: Estimated total value of the requisition line in the requisition currency. Used for budgeting and approval threshold determination.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Twelve-digit internal order number for tracking costs against specific operational activities or maintenance campaigns. Used when account assignment category is internal order.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the requisition record. Tracks changes throughout the requisition lifecycle for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the requisition. Identifies individual material or service requests within a single requisition document.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Nine-character hierarchical code classifying the material or service category. Used for spend analysis, supplier segmentation, and procurement strategy.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the MRP (Material Requirements Planning) controller responsible for material planning. Relevant for requisitions generated automatically by MRP run.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the mine site, processing plant, or facility where the material or service is required. Represents the receiving location.

attributes.name: priority_indicator
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the requisition. Urgent requisitions are expedited for critical operational needs such as equipment breakdowns or safety-critical items.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Three-character code identifying the procurement team responsible for sourcing this requisition. Examples include mining equipment, consumables, services, or contracts teams.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service units being requested. Precision supports fractional quantities for materials measured in decimal units.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when a requisition is rejected. Captures business justification for denial such as budget constraints, alternative sourcing, or specification issues.

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested material or service must be delivered to the requesting location. Drives procurement planning and supplier selection.

attributes.name: requisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was created in the system. Represents the formal initiation of the procurement demand signal.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition as displayed in SAP S/4HANA MM. Ten-digit numeric code used for tracking and reference across procurement workflows.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the requisition in the approval and conversion workflow. Tracks progression from creation through approval to purchase order conversion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|rejected|partially_converted|fully_converted|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the requisition based on procurement scenario: standard purchase, stock transfer between plants, subcontracting with vendor, consignment arrangement, or service procurement.

attributes.name: requisitioner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the requisitioner for communication regarding the requisition status, approvals, and delivery notifications.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being requisitioned. Used when material master does not exist or for additional context.

attributes.name: source_determination_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automatic source determination should be performed to identify preferred vendors or contracts. True triggers sourcing logic in procurement workflow.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where material should be delivered. Examples include warehouse zones, ROM (Run of Mine) pads, or maintenance stores.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the requisitioned quantity is expressed. ISO standard unit codes such as EA (each), KG (kilogram), L (liter), M (meter), TON (tonne).

products.name: framework_agreement
products.description: Long-term supply agreements and framework contracts with vendors for the ongoing provision of operational inputs such as explosives, reagents, fuel, and tyres. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement (EKKO type MK/WK). Captures contract number, vendor, contract type (quantity/value contract, scheduling agreement), commodity category, start date, end date, total contract value, currency, pricing conditions, minimum order quantity, and contract status. Distinct from the procurement domain's contract lifecycle management.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement (ME31K / EKKO type MK)

attributes.name: framework_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for framework_agreement

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Contracts often tied to specific cost centres for budget allocation, spend tracking, and contract performance monitoring. Common in site-specific mining contracts.

attributes.name: primary_framework_contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Framework Contract Owner Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier party with whom this framework agreement is established.

attributes.name: sourcing_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.sourcing_event. Business justification: Links framework agreements to the sourcing events that generated them. Framework agreements may result from formal competitive sourcing processes (RFPs, tenders). This FK captures that relationship wh

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the framework agreement was formally approved by the authorized signatory or procurement governance board.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Approval

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard unit price agreed in the framework agreement for fixed-price contracts, or baseline price for variable pricing mechanisms. Expressed per unit of measure.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the goods or services covered by this framework agreement, such as explosives, reagents, fuel, tyres, spare parts, or professional services. Aligns with procurement category taxonomy.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity or company code on behalf of which this framework agreement is established. Relevant for multi-entity mining groups.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the framework agreement, typically a 10-character alphanumeric code assigned by the procurement system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Number

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the framework agreement. Draft indicates under negotiation, active means in force, suspended means temporarily halted, expired means validity period ended, terminated means cancelled before expiry, closed means completed and archived.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Status

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the framework agreement type. Quantity contracts specify total quantity, value contracts specify total spend, scheduling agreements define delivery schedules, blanket orders allow multiple releases, master agreements set terms for multiple sites, and call-off contracts enable on-demand ordering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Type (EKKO-BSART)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this framework agreement record was first created in the procurement system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Creation Date (EKKO-ERDAT)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the contract value and pricing are denominated (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD, ZAR).

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days from order placement to expected delivery at the designated location, as agreed in the framework agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Planned Delivery Time

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date after which the framework agreement expires and no further orders can be placed unless renewed. Nullable for open-ended agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Validity End (EKKO-KDATE)

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between buyer and seller for delivery under this framework agreement. attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause, such as the delivery destination, port of loading, or place of transfer of risk.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this framework agreement record was last updated in the procurement system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Change Date

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this framework agreement.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered in a single release or call-off against this framework agreement. Nullable if no upper limit per order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Maximum Order Quantity

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered in each release or call-off against this framework agreement. Enforces vendor minimum batch or economic order size.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Minimum Order Quantity

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this framework agreement.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions for invoices under this framework agreement (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which vendor performance under this framework agreement is formally reviewed and documented.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Primary mine site, processing plant, or operational facility for which this framework agreement is intended. Nullable for corporate-wide agreements.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity of units to which the base price applies. For example, if base_price is 100 USD per 10 units, price_unit is 10.

attributes.name: pricing_condition_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which pricing is determined under this framework agreement. Fixed price remains constant, variable price adjusts per order, cost-plus adds margin to vendor cost, index-linked ties to commodity index, market-based uses spot rates, tiered pricing varies by volume.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for day-to-day administration and call-offs against this framework agreement.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this framework agreement. Typically a centralized procurement function or regional procurement office.

attributes.name: renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this framework agreement is eligible for automatic renewal upon expiry. True if renewal clause exists, false otherwise.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to contract end date by which either party must provide notice if they do not wish to renew. Nullable if no renewal clause.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date from which the framework agreement becomes binding and orders can be placed against it.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Validity Start (EKKO-KDATB)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the framework agreement was terminated early, if applicable. Nullable if contract ran to natural expiry or is still active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Termination

attributes.name: termination_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the framework agreement before its natural expiry date.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the framework agreement was terminated early, such as vendor performance issues, business requirement changes, or mutual agreement.

attributes.name: total_contract_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of goods or services committed under this framework agreement for quantity contracts. Nullable for value contracts or service agreements without fixed quantities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Target Quantity (EKKO-KTMNG)

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value committed under this framework agreement for value contracts, or estimated total spend for quantity contracts. Represents the financial ceiling or budget allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Target Value (EKKO-KTWRT)

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the contracted quantity, such as tonnes (MT), litres (L), kilograms (KG), units (EA), or hours (HR). Aligns with material master UOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure (MEINS)

products.name: freight_order
products.description: Unified logistics execution entity managing all freight movements across the mining supply chain — inbound material deliveries from vendors (road/rail/sea), outbound commodity shipments to customers (road/rail/sea), and inter-site transfers. Captures freight order number, direction (inbound/outbound/inter-site), transport mode (road/rail/sea), carrier, vendor (for inbound), customer (for outbound), origin location, destination plant/port, cargo description, commodity product, gross weight/tonnage, volume, dangerous goods flag, freight cost, expected/actual departure and arrival dates, customs clearance status, delivery note reference, tracking reference, and freight status. For sea freight: vessel name, voyage number, bill of lading number, laycan dates, nominated/loaded quantity, loaded quantity, Incoterms (FOB/CIF), freight rate, and shipment status. For inbound: vendor dispatch tracking, carrier ETA, and dangerous goods declaration reference. Serves as the SSOT for end-to-end transport visibility across all logistics legs and directions — no other product in this domain records freight or shipment movements.
products.reference: SAP TM Freight Order / Transport Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

products.name: physical_inventory
products.description: Records scheduled and ad-hoc physical stock counts conducted at mine site warehouses and storage locations to reconcile system inventory balances against actual on-hand quantities. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory (MI01/MI07). Captures count document number, plant, storage location, count date, material, system quantity, counted quantity, variance quantity, variance value, recount flag, and posting status.

attributes.name: physical_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical inventory count document. Primary key for the physical inventory record.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Inventory variance posting requires cost centre for write-off/adjustment allocation and budget impact tracking. Essential for inventory accounting and cost control.

attributes.name: counter_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the person who performed the physical count.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Inventory adjustments post to GL for financial reporting, variance analysis, and audit trail. Required for accurate financial statements and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material being counted in the physical inventory.

attributes.name: warehouse_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.warehouse_location. Business justification: Physical inventory counts are conducted at specific warehouse locations. The physical_inventory table has storage_location_code (STRING) but no FK to warehouse_location. Adding storage_location_id FK

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approval_required_indicator

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who approved the physical inventory variance for posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Workflow

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the material counted, if batch management is active for the material.

attributes.name: book_quantity
attributes.description: The system-recorded inventory quantity (book inventory) at the time of the physical count.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical inventory count was conducted at the storage location.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: The current status of the physical inventory count document in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: count_type

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted during the inventory count process.

attributes.name: counter_name

attributes.name: created_by_user

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the physical inventory count document was created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the variance value (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The unique document number assigned to the physical inventory count in the source system (SAP MI01/MI07).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Document

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the physical inventory count was conducted.

attributes.name: freeze_book_inventory_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the book inventory was frozen at the time of count to prevent movements during counting.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified the physical inventory count document.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the physical inventory count document was last modified.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: The descriptive name of the material being counted.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number generated when the physical inventory variance is posted to update stock levels.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material number (SKU) of the item being counted in the physical inventory.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The mine site or plant code where the physical inventory count was performed.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the inventory variance was posted to the financial and stock accounts.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory variance has been posted to the general ledger and stock accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Posting

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: The code indicating the reason for the inventory variance (e.g., theft, damage, counting error, system error).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory Configuration

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description or notes explaining the reason for the inventory variance.

attributes.name: recount_date
attributes.description: The date on which the recount was performed, if applicable.

attributes.name: recount_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a recount was required or performed due to significant variance or discrepancy.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator

attributes.name: tolerance_exceeded_indicator

attributes.name: variance_quantity

attributes.name: variance_value

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: current_inventory_quantity

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_licence_expiry_date

attributes.name: hazchem_code

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

products.name: material_plan
products.description: Forward-looking material requirements plan for operational inputs aligned to the mine production schedule and life-of-mine (LOM) plan. Captures plan ID, planning period (weekly/monthly/quarterly), material, plant, planned requirement quantity, planned order quantity, planned delivery date, safety stock target, reorder point, source of supply (vendor or contract), MRP controller, and plan status. Serves as the SSOT for forward demand planning of supply chain inputs. Enables proactive procurement and inventory positioning to avoid operational stoppages due to stockouts of critical consumables.
products.reference: SAP MM MRP / Material Requirements Planning (MD01)

attributes.name: material_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for material_plan

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.contract. Business justification: Material planning references contracts for sourcing strategy and supply assurance. Converting STRING contract_number to FK enables proper planning-to-contract alignment. N:1 relationship (many plan li

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or assigned vendor for this material plan. Populated when source_of_supply is vendor or contract.

attributes.name: supply_material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for which this plan is created. Links to the material being planned for procurement or production.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved this material plan. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this material plan record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: criticality_indicator
attributes.description: Business classification of how critical this material is to operations. Critical materials require higher safety stock and expedited procurement to avoid production stoppages.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the planned procurement cost. Typically the local operating currency of the plant or company code.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date when this material plan record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the plan.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days required from order placement to material receipt at the plant. Used to calculate order release dates from planned delivery dates.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master Lead Time

attributes.name: lom_alignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material plan is aligned with the long-term Life of Mine plan. True if the plan supports strategic LOM objectives, false for tactical short-term planning.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The upper limit for inventory holding, used to prevent overstocking and optimize working capital. Relevant for storage capacity constraints and cost control.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this material plan record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: mrp_controller
attributes.description: The person or team responsible for managing the material planning process for this material at this plant. Three-character code identifying the planner.

attributes.name: plan_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this material plan was formally approved by the MRP controller or procurement manager. Null if still in draft status.

attributes.name: plan_creation_date
attributes.description: The date when this material plan record was initially created in the system. Represents the planning run date.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material requirements plan, typically generated by the MRP (Material Requirements Planning) system. Format: MP-YYYYMMDD.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material plan. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval, execution, and closure.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the material must be available at the plant or storage location to meet operational requirements. Used to calculate procurement lead time.

attributes.name: planned_order_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material to be procured or produced to satisfy the planned requirement, adjusted for existing stock, safety stock, and lot-sizing rules. Represents net procurement need.

attributes.name: planned_procurement_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for procuring the planned order quantity, based on current pricing, contracts, or moving average price. Used for budget planning and cost control.

attributes.name: planned_requirement_quantity
attributes.description: The forecasted or calculated quantity of material required for the planning period, derived from production schedules, maintenance plans, or consumption forecasts. Represents gross demand.

attributes.name: planning_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for MRP controller or planner to document special considerations, assumptions, or constraints affecting this material plan. Supports collaborative planning.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the planning period covered by this material plan. Defines the conclusion of the demand forecast window.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the planning period covered by this material plan. Defines the beginning of the demand forecast window.

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: The time bucket granularity for this material plan. Indicates whether the plan is structured on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual basis.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The mine site, processing plant, or operational facility for which this material requirement is planned. Four-character alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: production_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the mine production schedule or processing plant schedule that drives this material requirement. Links demand to operational plans.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: The procurement team or buyer group responsible for executing the purchase orders for this material. Three-character organizational code.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. Calculated based on lead time demand and safety stock requirements.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer stock level maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Critical for operational continuity in mining operations.

attributes.name: source_of_supply
attributes.description: Indicates how the material requirement will be fulfilled: external vendor procurement, existing contract, internal plant transfer, or in-house production.

attributes.name: stockout_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score (0-100) indicating the probability of a stockout occurring during the planning period. Based on demand variability, lead time, and supplier reliability.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the planned quantities are expressed (e.g., KG for kilograms, MT for metric tonnes, EA for each, L for litres). ISO standard unit codes.

products.name: vendor

Captures vendor identity, ABN/registration numbers, business classification (explosives supplier, reagent supplier, OEM, contractor, etc.), prequalification status, insurance certificates, financial standing, payment terms, and approved commodity categories. Serves as the SSOT for vendor identity within the procurement domain. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master and Pronto Xi supplier records.

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Legally binding purchase order issued to a vendor for the supply of mining goods or services. Captures PO number, vendor, delivery address (mine site, ROM pad, processing plant, warehouse), line items, quantities, agreed unit prices, total value, currency, payment terms, delivery terms (FOB/CIF), INCOTERMS, tax codes, and PO status (open, partially delivered, fully delivered, invoiced, closed, cancelled). The primary commercial commitment document in the procurement lifecycle. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM and Pronto Xi.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for purchase_order

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Auto-generated FK linking siloed purchase_order to procurement_vendor

products.name: procurement_contract
products.description: Master procurement contract or framework agreement establishing commercial terms between the mining company and a vendor for the ongoing supply of goods or services. Captures contract number, contract type (blanket order, outline agreement, schedule agreement, service contract), vendor, commodity category, contracted volumes, and contract status. Includes full pricing schedule management: base price per line item, price basis (fixed, CPI-indexed, commodity-indexed), effective and expiry dates per price line, price escalation/de-escalation clauses, price review triggers, and applicable mine site or region. Includes complete amendment lifecycle: amendment number, amendment date, description of change (price adjustment, scope extension, volume change, term extension), commercial impact (value delta), approval authority, and amendment status (proposed, approved, executed). Also captures contract start and end dates, renewal options, performance KPIs, and termination conditions. Supports automated PO pricing via price condition linkage, price variance analysis, contract compliance monitoring, and full audit trail of commercial changes. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM contract management, pricing conditions, and change documents.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement / Framework Contract

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
