attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the contract owner for escalations and contract-related communications.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the procurement professional or contract manager responsible for this contract.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms identifier defining due date calculation and discount conditions (e.g., NET30, 2/10NET30).

attributes.name: performance_kpi_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the performance metrics and service level agreements the vendor must meet under the contract (e.g., on-time delivery rate, quality acceptance rate, response time).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Mine site or processing facility code to which the contract applies. Nullable for enterprise-wide contracts.

attributes.name: price_effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current pricing schedule becomes applicable.

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Contractual terms governing automatic price increases based on index movements, cost changes, or time-based triggers.

attributes.name: price_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current pricing schedule ceases to be valid. Nullable for indefinite pricing.

attributes.name: price_review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled interval for formal price review and renegotiation as stipulated in the contract.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity denominator for the base price (e.g., price per 1 unit, per 100 units, per 1000 units).

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Mechanism governing contract pricing: fixed (locked price), CPI-indexed (Consumer Price Index escalation), commodity-indexed (linked to commodity benchmark), cost-plus (cost recovery plus margin), market-rate (prevailing market price at time of order).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team code responsible for day-to-day contract administration and purchase order releases.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing the contract (e.g., corporate procurement, regional procurement, site-level procurement).

attributes.name: renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the contract includes automatic renewal provisions (True) or requires explicit renegotiation (False).

attributes.name: renewal_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days before contract expiry that renewal or termination notice must be provided to the vendor.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract becomes effective and binding.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the contract was terminated early. Nullable if contract was not terminated.

attributes.name: termination_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required to terminate the contract before its natural expiry date.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or cause for early contract termination (e.g., vendor non-performance, scope change, mine closure, cost reduction initiative).

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value committed under the contract over its full term. Used for budget tracking and contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit for contracted quantities (e.g., tonne, litre, each, hour, metre).

products.name: contract_amendment
products.description: Record of a formal amendment or variation to an existing procurement contract. Captures amendment number, parent contract reference, amendment date, description of change (price adjustment, scope extension, volume change, term extension), commercial impact (value delta), approval authority, and amendment status (proposed, approved, executed). Maintains a complete audit trail of contract lifecycle changes for compliance and commercial governance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM contract change management.
products.reference: SAP MM Contract Amendment / Change Order

attributes.name: contract_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract amendment record. Primary key for the contract amendment entity.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Amendments affecting budget require cost centre linkage for budget revision tracking and approval workflow. Essential for contract change management.

attributes.name: general_ledger_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger_account. Business justification: Amendments affecting GL posting require account linkage for financial reporting and cost element reclassification. Required for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original procurement contract being amended. Links to the framework agreement or purchase order contract that this amendment modifies.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital contract amendments link to WBS for project budget control and change order tracking. Critical for capital project contract management.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract amendment was formally created or initiated. Represents the business event timestamp for the amendment request.

attributes.name: amendment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific changes being made to the parent contract. Includes business rationale, scope of change, and impact summary for audit trail and governance.

attributes.name: amendment_initiator_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the amendment initiator for communication and workflow notifications. Business contact information classified as confidential.

attributes.name: amendment_initiator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee or procurement professional who created and submitted this amendment request. Provides accountability for change initiation.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment identifier within the parent contract lifecycle. Typically formatted as contract_number-A01, A02, etc. to maintain traceability.

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract amendment. Tracks progression through approval workflow from initial draft to final execution or cancellation.

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the amendment based on the nature of the contractual change being made. Determines approval workflow and commercial impact assessment requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_adjustment|scope_extension|volume_change|term_extension|payment_terms_revision|specification_change|delivery_schedule_revision|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: amendment_value_delta
attributes.description: Net change in contract value resulting from this amendment. Positive values indicate contract value increase, negative values indicate reduction. Critical for budget impact assessment and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) tracking.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Organizational level required to approve this amendment based on delegation of authority matrix and amendment value thresholds. Ensures governance compliance.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract amendment received formal approval from the designated authority. Null if amendment is still pending or was rejected.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved this contract amendment. Provides accountability and audit trail for commercial decisions.

attributes.name: attachment_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference or file path to supporting documentation for this amendment. May include revised specifications, vendor quotes, or approval memos.

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary business driver or trigger for the contract amendment. Used for trend analysis and procurement governance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: market_conditions|scope_creep|regulatory_requirement|vendor_request|cost_optimization|quality_issue|force_majeure|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Legal entity code in SAP Financial Accounting (FI) module that is party to this contract amendment. Required for financial reporting and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this contract amendment record was first created in SAP S/4HANA MM. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this amendment. Ensures consistent financial reporting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the amendment terms become legally binding and operationally active. May differ from amendment date to allow for transition planning.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the amendment was formally executed and signed by all parties. Represents legal commitment and triggers operational implementation.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) internal order for tracking costs related to this amendment. Used for project-based cost collection and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this contract amendment record. Tracks data currency and change frequency for governance and compliance.

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date when legal department completed their review of the amendment. Null if legal review is not required or has not yet been completed.

attributes.name: legal_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires review and approval by the legal department before execution. Typically true for high-value or high-risk amendments.

attributes.name: legal_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the legal counsel who reviewed and cleared this amendment. Provides accountability for legal risk assessment.

attributes.name: original_contract_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the parent contract before this amendment. Baseline for calculating commercial impact and value delta.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Functional team or buyer group within the purchasing organization responsible for this amendment. Used for workload distribution and performance tracking.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this contract amendment. Typically aligned to business unit or geographic region.

attributes.name: quantity_delta
attributes.description: Net change in contracted quantity or volume resulting from this amendment. Positive for increases, negative for reductions. Used for supply chain planning and inventory management.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for why the amendment was rejected by approver or vendor. Null if amendment was approved or is still pending. Used for process improvement and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: revised_contract_value
attributes.description: Total contract value after applying this amendment. Calculated as original contract value plus amendment value delta. Represents the new committed procurement spend.

attributes.name: revised_end_date
attributes.description: New contract expiration date after applying term extension. Null if amendment does not modify contract duration. Critical for Life of Mine (LOM) planning and procurement forecasting.

attributes.name: term_extension_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days by which the contract validity period is extended. Null if amendment does not affect contract duration. Used to calculate revised end date.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit for quantity measurements in this amendment. Examples include tonnes, cubic metres, litres, each, or hours depending on commodity category.

attributes.name: vendor_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor formally accepted or signed the amendment. Null if vendor acceptance is not required or has not yet been received.

attributes.name: vendor_acceptance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires formal acceptance or counter-signature from the vendor. True for bilateral amendments, false for unilateral variations permitted under contract terms.

products.name: vendor_prequalification
products.description: Vendor prequalification assessment record capturing the formal evaluation of a vendor's capability, financial standing, HSE compliance, and technical competency before being admitted to the approved vendor list (AVL). Captures prequalification reference, vendor, assessment date, assessment categories (financial health, HSE performance, technical capability, insurance, licences), scores by category, overall outcome (approved, conditional, rejected), expiry date, and reassessment due date. Mandatory for all vendors supplying to mine sites under ICMM and ISO 45001 requirements.

attributes.name: vendor_prequalification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor prequalification assessment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being assessed for prequalification. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the prequalification assessment was formally approved by the authorized approver and vendor was added to or updated in the approved vendor list.

attributes.name: approved_commodity_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of commodity categories or material groups for which the vendor is prequalified to supply. Restricts vendor to specific procurement scopes.

attributes.name: approved_service_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service categories for which the vendor is prequalified to provide. May include drilling, haulage, maintenance, engineering, consulting, etc.

attributes.name: approved_site_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mine sites or plant codes where the vendor is approved to operate. Site-specific HSE inductions and access requirements may apply.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the authorized person who reviewed and approved the prequalification assessment outcome and vendor AVL inclusion.

attributes.name: assessment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all assessment activities were completed and final scoring was determined.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal prequalification assessment was conducted and completed. Primary business event timestamp for this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional observations, comments, or context from the prequalification assessment that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision on the vendor prequalification application. Approved vendors are added to AVL, conditional approvals require remediation, rejected vendors cannot supply.

attributes.name: assessment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the prequalification assessment process was initiated and vendor documentation collection began.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the prequalification assessment. Tracks progression from initiation through final decision and ongoing validity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|under_review|approved|rejected|conditional|expired|suspended — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of prequalification assessment being conducted. Initial assessments are for new vendors, renewals are periodic reassessments, conditional reviews are triggered by performance issues.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement or supply chain professional who conducted the prequalification assessment and scoring.

attributes.name: assessor_role
attributes.description: Job title or functional role of the person who conducted the assessment, such as Procurement Manager, Supply Chain Analyst, or Category Manager.

attributes.name: conditional_approval_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of conditions or deficiencies that resulted in conditional approval status, including specific remediation actions required before full approval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this prequalification assessment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the prequalification approval becomes valid and the vendor is eligible for procurement activities.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the prequalification approval expires and vendor must undergo reassessment to maintain approved vendor list status.

attributes.name: financial_health_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the vendor's financial stability, creditworthiness, and fiscal capacity to fulfill contracts. Based on financial statements, credit ratings, and liquidity analysis.

attributes.name: hse_performance_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score
attributes.description: Score evaluating the vendor's health, safety, and environmental compliance record including LTIFR, TRIFR, incident history, and environmental management systems. Critical for mine site access approval.

attributes.name: insurance_compliance_score
attributes.description: Score assessing adequacy of vendor's insurance coverage including public liability, professional indemnity, workers compensation, and contract-specific insurance requirements.

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Required for vendors with potential environmental impact.

attributes.name: iso_45001_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management System certification. Mandatory for high-risk mining service providers.

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Demonstrates commitment to quality processes and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this prequalification assessment record was last updated. Tracks most recent change for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: licence_certification_score
attributes.description: Assessment of vendor's possession of required business licences, industry certifications, trade qualifications, and regulatory permits necessary for mining operations.

attributes.name: ltifr_rate
attributes.description: Vendor's Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate per million hours worked. Critical HSE metric for mining industry vendor assessment and site access approval.

attributes.name: minimum_threshold_score
attributes.description: Minimum overall score required for vendor approval. Vendors scoring below this threshold are rejected or granted conditional approval with remediation requirements.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Weighted composite score aggregating all assessment category scores to provide a single measure of vendor suitability for approved vendor list inclusion.

attributes.name: prequalification_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number assigned to this prequalification assessment for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: quality_management_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating the vendor's quality management systems, certifications, inspection processes, and track record of delivering conforming products and services.

attributes.name: reassessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic reassessment of vendor prequalification. Typically occurs before expiry date to ensure continuity of approval.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the vendor prequalification was rejected, including specific assessment categories that failed to meet minimum standards.

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Assessment score for the vendor's technical competency, equipment capability, workforce skills, quality management systems, and ability to meet mining industry technical specifications.

attributes.name: trifr_rate
attributes.description: Vendor's Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate per million hours worked. Broader HSE metric capturing all recordable injuries including medical treatment cases.

products.name: vendor_performance
products.description: Periodic vendor performance evaluation record assessing a supplier's delivery, quality, commercial, and HSE performance against contracted KPIs. Captures evaluation period, vendor, commodity category, on-time delivery rate, quality acceptance rate, invoice accuracy rate, HSE incident count, responsiveness score, overall performance rating, and corrective action requirements. Supports supplier relationship management, contract renewal decisions, and preferred supplier designation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM vendor evaluation and IsoMetrix HSE data.

attributes.name: vendor_performance_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vendor_performance

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Auto-generated FK linking siloed vendor_performance to procurement_vendor

products.name: sourcing_event
products.description: Strategic sourcing event record representing a formal competitive tender, RFP, or auction process for a significant procurement category. Captures event reference, event type (RFP, RFT, EOI, reverse auction), commodity category, estimated annual spend, number of vendors invited, evaluation methodology (price/quality weighting), event timeline milestones, awarded vendor, awarded value, savings achieved versus baseline, and event status. Supports category management and procurement governance reporting. Distinct from operational RFQs by its strategic scope and formal evaluation process.

attributes.name: sourcing_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the strategic sourcing event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor who was awarded the contract as a result of this sourcing event.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event award was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal approval is required before awarding this sourcing event (True) or not (False), based on delegation of authority thresholds.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status for the sourcing event award recommendation: not required, pending approval, approved, or rejected.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the approving authority who approved the sourcing event award recommendation.

attributes.name: award_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event was formally awarded to the successful vendor.

attributes.name: awarded_value
attributes.description: Total contract value awarded to the successful vendor, representing the committed spend over the contract term.

attributes.name: baseline_value
attributes.description: Baseline or incumbent contract value used as the reference point for calculating savings achieved through this sourcing event.

attributes.name: commodity_category
attributes.description: Procurement commodity category or spend category that this sourcing event covers (e.g., drilling services, explosives, tyres, fuel, maintenance services, capital equipment).

attributes.name: commodity_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the commodity category for more granular classification of the procurement scope.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Intended duration of the resulting contract in months, defining the commitment period for the awarded vendor.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of contract that will result from this sourcing event (e.g., framework agreement, call-off contract, fixed-price contract, unit-rate contract).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this sourcing event (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: estimated_annual_spend
attributes.description: Estimated total annual spend value for the commodity or service being sourced, used for vendor qualification and internal budgeting.

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the evaluation process was completed and a recommendation was finalized.

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to evaluate vendor responses: price only (lowest price wins), weighted score (price and quality factors), best value (qualitative assessment), or technical compliance (pass/fail then price).

attributes.name: evaluation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal evaluation of vendor responses commenced.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business reference number for the sourcing event, externally visible and used for tracking and communication with vendors.

attributes.name: event_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the event owner for vendor communication and internal coordination.

attributes.name: event_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the procurement professional or category manager who owns and is accountable for this sourcing event.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sourcing event: draft (being prepared), published (released to vendors), open (accepting responses), closed (submission period ended), evaluation (under review), awarded (vendor selected), or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|published|open|closed|evaluation|awarded|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of sourcing event: RFP (Request for Proposal), RFT (Request for Tender), RFQ (Request for Quotation), EOI (Expression of Interest), reverse auction, or sealed bid.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing event record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special conditions, lessons learned, or other relevant information about the sourcing event.

attributes.name: price_weighting_percent
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to price in the evaluation scoring model (0-100). Remaining percentage is allocated to quality, technical, and other non-price factors.

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date when the sourcing event was published and released to invited vendors.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Purchasing group or category team responsible for managing this sourcing event and the resulting contract.

attributes.name: purchasing_organisation
attributes.description: Purchasing organisation or business unit responsible for conducting this sourcing event.

attributes.name: quality_weighting_percent
attributes.description: Percentage weight assigned to quality and technical factors in the evaluation scoring model (0-100).

attributes.name: savings_achieved
attributes.description: Total savings achieved compared to the baseline value, calculated as baseline value minus awarded value. Positive values indicate cost reduction.

attributes.name: savings_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage savings achieved relative to the baseline value, calculated as (savings achieved / baseline value) * 100.

attributes.name: strategic_importance
attributes.description: Strategic importance classification of this sourcing event based on business impact, spend value, and supply risk: critical, high, medium, or low.

attributes.name: submission_close_date
attributes.description: Final date and time by which vendor submissions must be received. No late submissions are accepted after this date.

attributes.name: submission_open_date
attributes.description: Date when vendor submissions are first accepted for this sourcing event.

attributes.name: vendors_invited_count
attributes.description: Total number of vendors invited to participate in this sourcing event.

attributes.name: vendors_responded_count
attributes.description: Total number of vendors who submitted a valid response to the sourcing event.

products.name: sourcing_bid
products.description: Vendor bid submission received in response to a strategic sourcing event (RFP, RFT, EOI). Captures bid reference, sourcing event, bidding vendor, submission date, total bid value, pricing breakdown by line item, technical proposal summary, compliance with specifications, commercial exceptions, evaluation scores (technical, commercial, HSE), and bid status (submitted, shortlisted, preferred, unsuccessful). Enables structured bid evaluation and award decision documentation.

attributes.name: sourcing_bid_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sourcing bid submission record.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id

attributes.name: procurement_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor who submitted this bid.

attributes.name: sourcing_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the strategic sourcing event (RFP, RFT, EOI) for which this bid was submitted.

attributes.name: award_justification
attributes.description: Business justification and rationale for the award recommendation decision, documenting why this bid was selected or rejected.

attributes.name: award_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bid is recommended for contract award (True = recommended, False = not recommended).

attributes.name: bid_bond_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the bid bond or bid security submitted by the vendor, if applicable.

attributes.name: bid_bond_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the bid bond or bank guarantee submitted by the vendor.

attributes.name: bid_bond_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a bid bond or bid security was required for this sourcing event (True = required, False = not required).

attributes.name: bid_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or code assigned to this bid submission by the vendor or procurement system.

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current status of the bid in the evaluation and award workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_evaluation|shortlisted|preferred|unsuccessful|withdrawn|disqualified — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bid_validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which the vendor's bid pricing and terms remain valid and binding.

attributes.name: commercial_evaluation_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the bid based on commercial evaluation criteria (e.g., price competitiveness, payment terms, delivery terms).

attributes.name: commercial_exceptions_summary
attributes.description: Summary of any commercial exceptions, deviations, or alternative terms proposed by the vendor that differ from the sourcing event requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_with_specifications_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bid fully complies with the technical specifications and requirements outlined in the sourcing event (True = compliant, False = non-compliant or partial compliance).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sourcing bid record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the bid value (e.g., USD, AUD, CAD).

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days

attributes.name: disqualification_reason

attributes.name: evaluation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the evaluation of this bid was completed.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes

attributes.name: evaluation_ranking

attributes.name: evaluator_name

attributes.name: hse_evaluation_score

attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the bid based on the vendor's health, safety, and environmental management systems, certifications, and performance history.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Incoterms code proposed by the vendor defining delivery and risk transfer responsibilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: indigenous_participation_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this sourcing bid record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: local_content_percentage

attributes.name: overall_evaluation_score

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: sustainability_certification

attributes.name: technical_evaluation_score
attributes.description: Numerical score assigned to the bid based on technical evaluation criteria (e.g., solution quality, methodology, experience, capability).

attributes.name: technical_proposal_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the vendor's technical approach, methodology, and solution proposed in response to the sourcing event requirements.

attributes.name: total_bid_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the bid across all line items, representing the vendor's proposed total contract value.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the warranty or guarantee period offered by the vendor for goods or services.

products.name: procurement_approved_vendor_material
products.description: Master record of the approved vendor-material commercial relationship, serving as the single source of truth for all vendor-material pricing and supply terms. Captures vendor, material or commodity category, approval status, preferred vendor flag, negotiated unit price, price validity period, price unit, currency, delivery lead time, minimum order quantity, standard order unit, planned delivery time, purchasing organisation, plant assignment, last purchase price, last review date, approval expiry, and source list validity. It captures vendor-specific procurement arrangements, spend tracking, and performance metrics at the cost-centre-vendor level. Each record links one cost centre to one vendor with attributes that track contracted spend limits, payment term overrides, preferred vendor status, and year-to-date actuals used for budget control and vendor performance analysis.. products.description: This association product represents the site-specific authorization and prequalification of vendors to operate on individual mining tenements. It captures the regulatory and operational clearances required for each vendor to provide services or deliver goods to a specific tenement site. Each record links one vendor to one tenement with attributes that exist only in the context of this site-specific authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In mining operations, vendors must be prequalified and authorized on a per-tenement (site) basis due to site-specific safety, regulatory, and operational requirements. Each tenement has multiple approved vendors for different services (explosives, reagents, fuel, equipment), and each vendor is authorized to operate across multiple tenement sites. The business actively manages these site-specific authorizations as operational records, tracking inductions, clearances, approved activities, and site-specific conditions for each vendor-tenement pairing.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `mining_ecm`.`_metrics`.`community_benefit_distribution`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Tracks benefit distributions to communities including monetary payments, in-kind contributions, and benefit-sharing agreement performance"
  source: "`mining_ecm`.`community`.`benefit_distribution`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "benefit_category"
      expr: benefit_category
      comment: "Category of benefit distributed (e.g., royalty, infrastructure, social investment)"
    - name: "benefit_type"
      expr: benefit_type
      comment: "Specific type of benefit within category"
    - name: "distribution_status"
      expr: distribution_status
      comment: "Current status of the distribution (pending, approved, paid, disputed)"
    - name: "distribution_method"
      expr: distribution_method
      comment: "Method used to distribute benefit (cash, in-kind, trust fund, etc.)"
    - name: "calculation_basis"
      expr: calculation_basis
      comment: "Basis for calculating benefit amount (revenue share, production volume, fixed amount)"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of monetary value"
    - name: "distribution_year"
      expr: YEAR(distribution_date)
      comment: "Year of distribution"
    - name: "distribution_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(distribution_date))
      comment: "Quarter of distribution"
    - name: "reporting_period_year"
      expr: YEAR(reporting_period_start_date)
      comment: "Year of reporting period"
    - name: "dispute_raised_flag"
      expr: dispute_raised
      comment: "Whether a dispute was raised on this distribution"
    - name: "receipt_confirmed_flag"
      expr: receipt_confirmation_received
      comment: "Whether receipt confirmation was received from beneficiary"
  measures:
    - name: "total_benefit_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(monetary_value_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monetary value of all benefits distributed"
    - name: "distribution_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of benefit distributions"
    - name: "avg_benefit_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(monetary_value_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average monetary value per distribution"
    - name: "disputed_distribution_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dispute_raised = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of distributions with disputes raised"
    - name: "dispute_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dispute_raised = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of distributions that resulted in disputes"
    - name: "receipt_confirmation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN receipt_confirmation_received = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of distributions with confirmed receipt by beneficiary"
    - name: "total_production_volume"
      expr: SUM(CAST(calculation_period_production_volume AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total production volume used in benefit calculations"
    - name: "total_revenue_basis"
      expr: SUM(CAST(calculation_period_revenue AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue used as basis for benefit calculations"
$$
metric_views.description: Tracks benefit distributions to communities including monetary payments, in-kind contributions, and benefit-sharing agreement performance

      comment: "Total trust fund contribution amounts committed"
    - name: "total_infrastructure_commitment"

      comment: "Total infrastructure contribution amounts committed"
    - name: "avg_employment_quota_pct"

    - name: "avg_local_procurement_target_pct"

      comment: "Average local procurement target percentage across agreements"
    - name: "fpic_compliance_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN free_prior_informed_consent_obtained = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of agreements with FPIC obtained"
    - name: "social_licence_agreement_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN social_licence_to_operate_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of agreements contributing to social licence to operate"
$$
metric_views.description: Tracks benefit-sharing agreements with communities including royalty shares, employment quotas, and infrastructure contributions

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `mining_ecm`.`_metrics`.`community_commitment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Tracks community commitments including regulatory conditions, stakeholder agreements, and social impact mitigation measures"
  source: "`mining_ecm`.`community`.`commitment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "commitment_status"
      expr: commitment_status

    - name: "commitment_type"
      expr: commitment_type
      comment: "Type of commitment (regulatory, voluntary, contractual)"
    - name: "commitment_category"
      expr: commitment_category
      comment: "Category of commitment (employment, infrastructure, environment, cultural heritage)"
    - name: "commitment_source"
      expr: commitment_source
      comment: "Source of commitment (SIA, benefit agreement, permit condition, stakeholder engagement)"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of commitment (critical, high, medium, low)"
    - name: "risk_level"
      expr: risk_level
      comment: "Risk level if commitment not met"
    - name: "reporting_obligation_flag"
      expr: reporting_obligation_flag
      comment: "Whether commitment requires regulatory reporting"
    - name: "escalation_required_flag"

      comment: "Whether commitment requires escalation"
    - name: "commitment_year"
      expr: YEAR(commitment_date)
      comment: "Year commitment was made"
    - name: "due_year"
      expr: YEAR(due_date)
      comment: "Year commitment is due"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency for cost estimates"
  measures:
    - name: "commitment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of commitments"
    - name: "completed_commitment_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN commitment_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of completed commitments"
    - name: "overdue_commitment_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN commitment_status = 'overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of overdue commitments"
    - name: "completion_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN commitment_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commitments completed"
    - name: "avg_completion_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(completion_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average completion percentage across all commitments"
    - name: "total_estimated_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated cost of all commitments"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual cost incurred for commitments"
    - name: "avg_estimated_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated cost per commitment"
    - name: "critical_commitment_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN priority_level = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of critical priority commitments"
    - name: "high_risk_commitment_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `mining_ecm`.`_metrics`.`community_grievance`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Tracks community grievances including complaints, disputes, and resolution outcomes - critical for social licence to operate"
  source: "`mining_ecm`.`community`.`grievance`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "grievance_status"
      expr: grievance_status
      comment: "Current status of grievance (lodged, investigating, resolved, closed)"
    - name: "grievance_category"
      expr: grievance_category
      comment: "Category of grievance (environmental, employment, land access, compensation, safety)"
    - name: "subcategory"
      expr: subcategory
      comment: "Subcategory providing more detail"
    - name: "severity_classification"
      expr: severity_classification
      comment: "Severity level of grievance (low, medium, high, critical)"
    - name: "lodgement_channel"
      expr: lodgement_channel
      comment: "Channel through which grievance was lodged (hotline, email, in-person, community meeting)"
    - name: "resolution_outcome"
      expr: resolution_outcome
      comment: "Outcome of grievance resolution"
    - name: "escalation_level"
      expr: escalation_level
      comment: "Level to which grievance was escalated"
    - name: "is_anonymous"
      expr: is_anonymous
      comment: "Whether grievance was lodged anonymously"
    - name: "is_repeat_grievance"
      expr: is_repeat_grievance
      comment: "Whether this is a repeat grievance on same issue"
    - name: "requires_external_mediation"
      expr: requires_external_mediation
      comment: "Whether external mediation is required"
    - name: "complainant_satisfaction_rating"
      expr: complainant_satisfaction_rating
      comment: "Complainant satisfaction with resolution process"
    - name: "lodgement_year"
      expr: YEAR(lodgement_date)
      comment: "Year grievance was lodged"
    - name: "lodgement_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(lodgement_date))
      comment: "Quarter grievance was lodged"
    - name: "compensation_currency"
      expr: compensation_currency_code
      comment: "Currency of compensation amount"
  measures:
    - name: "grievance_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of grievances lodged"
    - name: "resolved_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN grievance_status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of grievances resolved"
    - name: "closed_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN grievance_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of grievances closed"
    - name: "resolution_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN grievance_status IN ('resolved', 'closed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of grievances resolved or closed"
    - name: "critical_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN severity_classification = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of critical severity grievances"
    - name: "high_severity_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN severity_classification = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of high severity grievances"
    - name: "repeat_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_grievance = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of repeat grievances on same issues"
    - name: "repeat_grievance_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_repeat_grievance = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of grievances that are repeats"
    - name: "external_mediation_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN requires_external_mediation = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of grievances requiring external mediation"
    - name: "total_compensation_paid"
      expr: SUM(CAST(compensation_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total compensation paid to resolve grievances"
    - name: "avg_compensation_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(compensation_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average compensation amount per grievance"
    - name: "anonymous_grievance_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_anonymous = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of anonymous grievances lodged"
$$
metric_views.description: Tracks community grievances including complaints, disputes, and resolution outcomes - critical for social licence to operate

      expr: drill_type

    - name: "abandonment_reason"
      expr: abandonment_reason
      comment: "Reason for hole abandonment if applicable"
    - name: "completion_year"
      expr: YEAR(completion_date)
      comment: "Year when the drill hole was completed"
    - name: "completion_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(completion_date), '-', YEAR(completion_date))
      comment: "Quarter when the drill hole was completed"
    - name: "core_diameter"
      expr: core_diameter
      comment: "Diameter of the drill core (e.g., NQ, HQ, PQ)"
    - name: "target_geology"
      expr: target_geology
      comment: "Target geological formation or unit"
  measures:
    - name: "total_drill_holes"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of drill holes executed"
    - name: "total_actual_depth"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_depth AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total metres drilled across all holes"
    - name: "total_planned_depth"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_depth AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned drilling metres"
    - name: "depth_achievement_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_depth AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(planned_depth AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of planned depth achieved - operational execution efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_recovery_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(recovery_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average core recovery percentage - critical data quality indicator for resource estimation"
    - name: "avg_actual_depth"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_depth AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average depth per drill hole"
    - name: "holes_completed"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hole_status = 'completed' THEN drill_hole_id END)
      comment: "Number of successfully completed drill holes"
    - name: "holes_abandoned"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hole_status = 'abandoned' THEN drill_hole_id END)
      comment: "Number of abandoned drill holes - indicator of drilling challenges or geological complexity"
    - name: "abandonment_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hole_status = 'abandoned' THEN drill_hole_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of drill holes abandoned - key risk and efficiency metric"
    - name: "total_hse_incidents"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT hse_incident_id)
      comment: "Count of HSE incidents associated with drill holes - safety performance indicator"
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `mining_ecm`.`_metrics`.`workforce_payroll`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Payroll and compensation metrics including gross pay, overtime, allowances, and deductions for labor cost management and compliance reporting."
  source: "`mining_ecm`.`workforce`.`payroll_record`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "pay_period_start"
      expr: pay_period_start_date
      comment: "Pay period start date for time-series payroll analysis"
    - name: "pay_period_end"
      expr: pay_period_end_date
      comment: "Pay period end date for payroll cycle tracking"
    - name: "payment_date"
      expr: payment_date
      comment: "Actual payment date for cash flow and disbursement analysis"
    - name: "payment_method"
      expr: payment_method
      comment: "Payment method (bank transfer, check) for payment operations analysis"
    - name: "payroll_status"
      expr: payroll_status
      comment: "Payroll processing status for operational monitoring"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for multi-currency payroll reporting"
    - name: "pay_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment month for monthly labor cost trending"
    - name: "pay_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', payment_date)
      comment: "Payment quarter for quarterly labor cost reporting"
  measures:
    - name: "total_gross_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_pay_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross pay before deductions for labor cost analysis and budgeting"
    - name: "total_net_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_pay_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net pay after deductions for actual cash disbursement tracking"
    - name: "total_base_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(base_pay_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total base pay excluding allowances and overtime for core labor cost tracking"
    - name: "total_overtime_pay"
      expr: SUM(CAST(overtime_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total overtime pay for overtime cost management and fatigue risk correlation"
    - name: "total_overtime_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(overtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total overtime hours worked for productivity and fatigue management"
    - name: "total_hours_worked"
      expr: SUM(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total hours worked for labor productivity and utilization analysis"
    - name: "total_site_allowance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(site_allowance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total site allowance paid for remote work cost tracking"
    - name: "total_fifo_allowance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(fifo_allowance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total FIFO allowance paid for fly-in-fly-out workforce cost management"
    - name: "total_tax_withheld"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_withheld_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax withheld for tax compliance and remittance tracking"
    - name: "total_superannuation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(superannuation_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total superannuation contributions for retirement benefit cost tracking"
    - name: "avg_gross_pay_per_employee"
      expr: AVG(CAST(gross_pay_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average gross pay per payroll record for compensation benchmarking"
    - name: "overtime_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(overtime_hours AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(hours_worked AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Overtime hours as percentage of total hours for overtime intensity monitoring"
    - name: "payroll_record_count"
      expr: COUNT(payroll_record_id)
      comment: "Total payroll records processed for payroll operations volume tracking"
$$
metric_views.description: Payroll and compensation metrics including gross pay, overtime, allowances, and deductions for labor cost management and compliance reporting.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `mining_ecm`.`_metrics`.`workforce_shift_schedule`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Shift scheduling and production metrics including headcount utilization, production performance, and safety compliance for operational efficiency and workforce deployment."
  source: "`mining_ecm`.`workforce`.`shift_schedule`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "shift_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', scheduled_start_datetime)
      comment: "Shift date for daily operational analysis"
    - name: "shift_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', scheduled_start_datetime)
      comment: "Shift month for monthly production trending"
    - name: "shift_type"
      expr: shift_type
      comment: "Shift type (day, night, swing) for shift pattern analysis"
    - name: "shift_status"
      expr: shift_status
      comment: "Shift status (scheduled, completed, cancelled) for operational tracking"
    - name: "production_area"
      expr: production_area
      comment: "Production area for area-based performance analysis"
    - name: "fatigue_risk_level"
      expr: fatigue_risk_level
      comment: "Fatigue risk level for safety and fatigue management"
    - name: "shift_priority"
      expr: shift_priority
      comment: "Shift priority for critical operations identification"
    - name: "safety_briefing_completed"
      expr: safety_briefing_completed
      comment: "Safety briefing completion flag for safety compliance monitoring"
    - name: "fatigue_risk_assessment_completed"
      expr: fatigue_risk_assessment_completed
      comment: "Fatigue risk assessment completion flag for fatigue management compliance"
  measures:
    - name: "total_shifts"
      expr: COUNT(shift_schedule_id)
      comment: "Total number of shifts scheduled for operational volume tracking"
    - name: "total_production_tonnes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_production_tonnes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual production in tonnes for production performance tracking"
    - name: "total_production_target_tonnes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(production_target_tonnes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total production target in tonnes for target vs actual analysis"
    - name: "production_achievement_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_production_tonnes AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(production_target_tonnes AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Production achievement rate as percentage of target for operational performance measurement"
    - name: "avg_equipment_availability_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(equipment_availability_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average equipment availability percentage for asset utilization and maintenance effectiveness"
    - name: "total_scheduled_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scheduled_duration_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total scheduled shift hours for labor capacity planning"
    - name: "avg_scheduled_hours_per_shift"
      expr: AVG(CAST(scheduled_duration_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average scheduled hours per shift for shift pattern analysis"
    - name: "total_incidents"
      expr: SUM(CAST(incident_count AS BIGINT))
      comment: "Total incidents reported during shifts for safety performance tracking"
$$
metric_views.description: Shift scheduling and production metrics including headcount utilization, production performance, and safety compliance for operational efficiency and workforce deployment.

      comment: "Total training hours completed for training effort and investment tracking"

      comment: "Total training hours required for training capacity planning"

$$
